text:

english:
***

text: In fact, kon may yara gid man nga VPD nga ma-eradicate ukon lubos madula na, ang “smallpox” pa gid lang.

english: Meaning that maybe it can be controlled first to the target incidence of COVID-19 that can be tolerated by our people, such as allowing EO 3 to remain until the “moderate risk” level of COVID-19 infection in the NCR at present.

text: Ina sa karon ang “acceptable” nga mahimo naton – ang padayon nga pag-monitor sang incidence sang COVID-19 paagi sa on-and-off nga pagpatuman sang “optional” nga paggamit sang face mask nga indi dapat maglapaw sa “moderate risk” nga level./PN

english: Not a long term solution for the No to PUV Phaseout Coalition Panay, raising fares on public vehicles is not a long term solution to the country's problem of continuous rise in fuel prices.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Elmer Forro, Lead convenor sang nasambit nga grupo, iya ginpahayag nga ila gid nga ginakilala ang pagpasaka sang pamasahe sa mga Public Utility Vehicles bangud ini amo ang labing apektado sa krisis, apang indi ini isa ka bastante ka solusyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Elmer Forro, lead convenor of the group, said they recognize the fare increase in public utility vehicles because they are the most affected by the crisis, but it is not a sufficient solution.

text: Suno kay Forro, pagsuspende sang excise tax kag E-vat ang pinaka mangin epektibo nga solusyon agud nga mas mahagan-hagan ang epekto sang pagtaas sang presyo sang produktong petrolyo sa publiko.
english: According to Forro, the suspension of excise tax and E-vat will be the most effective solution to mitigate the impact of the increase in the price of petroleum products on the public.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, may ara pa sang reserba nga langis ang pungsod nga insakto para sa duha ka bulan, rason nga dapat ibalik ang presyo sang gatong sa daan sini nga presyo bangud nga wala pa nagbakal ang Pilipinas sang mga produktong petrolyo umpisa sang nagsugod ang kinagamo sa Middle East.
english: He added that the country still has enough oil reserves for two months, which is why the price of fuel should be restored to its old price because the Philippines has not bought petroleum products since the unrest in the Middle East began.

english: Metro Manila is on the verge of being flooded again due to continuous rains brought by the southwest monsoon exacerbated by Typhoon Crising (Wipha), two low-pressure areas, and tropical storm Dante.

text: Ayon sa Metropolitan Manila Development Authority, isa sa mga dahilan ng pagbaha ay ang maling pagtatapon ng basura.
english: According to the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority, one of the causes of flooding is the improper disposal of garbage.

text: Samantala, iniulat ng Department of Public Works and Highways na 70% ng drainage system sa Metro Manila ay barado na kaya hindi na nito kayang kontrolin ang pagdaloy ng baha.
english: Meanwhile, the Department of Public Works and Highways reported that 70% of the drainage system in Metro Manila is blocked so it can no longer control the flood.

text:
𝗨𝗦𝗔 —Nagahalin ukon naga-ilig halin sa border sang United States of America (USA) kag Mexico ang minilyon ka galon sang sewage cascade ukon higko nga tubig ang nagailig kada adlaw pakadto sa Dagat Pasipiko

Samtang, minilyon pa ka galon sang gin-treat kag wala gin-treat nga sewage trickle ang nagailig man sa Tijuana River kag sa dagat sa north sang nasambit nga border.
english:
𝗨𝗦𝗔 —Originating or flowing from the border of the United States of America (USA) and Mexico, millions of gallons of sewage cascade or wastewater flow daily into the Pacific Ocean

Meanwhile, millions more gallons of treated and untreated sewage trickle into the Tijuana River and the sea north of the border.

text: Santo sa report, kon ang hangin ang nagadapya, ang baho sang bakterya sa higko ang masimhotan kag mahaklo sa mga banwa sang Imperial Beach sa San Diego County,kon sa diin, ginbansagan ni Mayor Paloma Aguirre nga pinakadaku nga kalamidad sa palibot kag ikaayong lawas sang publiko sa pungsod, nga wala sang may nakahibalo.
english: According to the report, when the wind blows, the smell of bacteria in the sewage can be smelled and smelled in the towns of Imperial Beach in San Diego County, where, Mayor Paloma Aguirre called the biggest environmental and public health disaster in the country, that no one knows.

text: Ini ang nagresulta man sang daw kaangay sang bagyo kag sunog, bangud sa baylo sang dekada nga wala sang pagtatap, ang krisis ang nagakinahanglan na sang deklarasyon sang emerhensya, agud nga mahatagan sang pundo sa pagbangon sa pag-atubang sang kahalitan, sa pamahog sa ikaayong lawas sang publiko, kag pagkadula sang turismo.
english: This has also resulted in what seems like hurricanes and fires, because instead of decades of neglect, the crisis now requires a declaration of emergency, in order to provide funds to recover from the damage, the threat to public health, and the loss of tourism.

text: Sa baylo, ang mga mahiligon sa baybayon kag mga politiko ang naga-antos sa malawig nga mga panikasog sa pagpa-uswag sang imprastraktura sa magtimbang nga bahin sang border.
english: Instead, beach enthusiasts and politicians are bearing the brunt of long-term efforts to improve infrastructure on both sides of the border.

text: Nahibaluan man nga ang International Wastewater Treatment Plant, isa ka planta nga sobra ang trabaho apang kulang sa pondo, ang gintukod sa bahin sang border sang Estados Unidos agud magtratar sang higko sang Mexico, ang nag-untat sa idalom sang dugang nga kadamuon nga pag-ilig sang sewage cascade sa border sa sulod sang duha ka tuig.
english: It is also known that the International Wastewater Treatment Plant, an overworked but underfunded plant, was built on the US side of the border to treat Mexican sewage, has shut down under the increased volume flow of the sewage cascade at the border for two years.

text: Sa pihak sini, ginaduso sang mga tagdumalahan sang amo nga planta nga dapat sila ang magbalik sa normal nga operasyon sa maabot nga Agosto.
english: Meanwhile, the management of the plant is proposing that they should resume normal operations by August.

text: Nagpahayag naman ang estado sang Mexico nga Baja California nga ang pinakaimportante nga pagkay-o sa naguba nga sewage infrastructure sang Tijuana ang matapos sa indi madugay, nga posible magabulig agud nga matapna ang spills.
english: The Mexican state of Baja California said the most important repairs to Tijuana's damaged sewage infrastructure will be completed soon, which will likely help contain the spills.

text: Plano sini nga mag-ivest sang $530 million sa sewage infrastructure halin 2023 tubtob 2027 agud nga malikawan nga mangin polluted ang U.S kag Mexican waters.
english: It plans to invest $530 million in sewage infrastructure from 2023 to 2027 to prevent U.S. and Mexican waters from becoming polluted.

text: Ginsirado naman sang mga opisyales sang health sa San Diego County ang north nga bahin sang pader sang border sang U.S.-Mexico epektibo sa sulod sang kapin sa tatlo ka tuig.
english: San Diego County health officials have closed the northern portion of the U.S.-Mexico border wall effectively for more than three years.

text: Nahibaluan nga sugod sang 2021, gbutangan malapit sa Imperial Beach pier sang mga karatula nga nagapaandam nga “Keep out of Water” nga nagapaandman sa mga surfer bangud sa toxic kag mahigko nga baybayon.
english: Since 2021, signs warning “Keep out of Water” have been installed near the Imperial Beach pier, warning surfers about the toxic and dirty beach.

text: ILOILO CITY-Natapos na ang masadya nga mga inadlaw sang empleyado sang isa ka commercial establishment sa Fuentes St., Iloilo City Proper matapos nga nadiskubre ang iya modus kag nadakpan ini sa akto nga pagpalasik sang kinarton nga mga produkto.
english: ILOILO CITY-The happy days of an employee of a commercial establishment in Fuentes St., Iloilo City Proper have ended after his modus operandi was discovered and he was caught in the act of throwing cartons of products.

text: Ang suspek amo si Lester Rubido, 26, residente sang Barangay Veterans Village, Iloilo City Proper kag driver sang delivery truck kag nagabulig man sa paghakot sang ila mga produkto sa bodega.
english: The suspect was identified as Lester Rubido, 26, resident of Barangay Veterans Village, Iloilo City Proper and driver of a delivery truck and also helping to transport their products to the warehouse.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Jobert Amado, hepe sang Iloilo City Police Station 7, iya ginpahayag nga mismo ang tag-iya sang iya gina-ubrahan nga warehouse ang nakakita kay Rubido kag natingal ini kun ngaa yara sa sulod sang bodega ang suspek apisar sirado na ini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Jobert Amado, chief of Iloilo City Police Station 7, said the owner of the warehouse where he worked saw Rubido and wondered why the suspect was inside the warehouse even though it was closed.

text: Suno kay Amado, base sa ila imbestigasyon kag sa pag-ako man ni Rubido, sa tion nga magsirado na ang warehouse, nagapabilin ini sa sulod agud magpanago kag ginakarga ang kinarton nga grocery items sa delivery truck.
english: According to Amado, based on their investigation and Rubido's confession, when the warehouse closed, he stayed inside to hide and loaded the cartons of grocery items into the delivery truck.

text: Pahayag ni Amado, ginadul-ong ni Rubido ini nga mga items sa Muelle Loney, Iloilo City Proper kun sa diin ini ginabaydan sang indi magnubo sa P30,000 sa kapin 30 ka karton sang mga produkto nga iya ginapalasik.
english: Amado said Rubido delivers the items to Muelle Loney, Iloilo City Proper where he is paid at least P30,000 for more than 30 cartons of the products he packages.

text: Nagagwa man nga salaligan gid sang tag-iya sang warehouse si Rubido bangud diri ini nagpatigayon sang summer job sang 2015, kag sang 2016-2018 nag-obra na ini sang regular, apang naghalin sang 2019 kag nagbalik sang 2021.
english: It also appears that the owner of the warehouse trusts Rubido because he conducted a summer job here in 2015, and in 2016-2018 he worked regularly, but left in 2019 and returned in 2021.

text: Bangud madugay na nga ginahimo ni Rubido ang modus,  ginabanta nga minilyon ka pesos naman ang balor sang iya kinawatan.
english: Because Rubido has been doing the modus for a long time, it is estimated that the value of his theft is millions of pesos.

text: Preso na ini subong sa Police Station 7 kag nagapangatubang sang kaso nga attempted qualified theft.
english: He is now detained at Police Station 7 and is facing charges of attempted qualified theft.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Patrolman Jonell Alimodian, traffic investigator sang Traffic Enforcement Unit, iya ginpahayag nga halin sa R. Mapa ang truck nga may karga nga boneless bangus kag padulong kuntani sa banwa sang Dumangas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Patrolman Jonell Alimodian, traffic investigator of the Traffic Enforcement Unit, said the truck was heading to Dumangas town from R. Mapa.

english: According to the truck passengers, they encountered a vehicle with a high beam causing it to light up and hit the wall.

english: Based on the initial assessment of the police, the driver of the truck smelled of alcohol and was said to have come from the party.

english: The two sustained injuries in various parts of their bodies but the driver was hit in the passenger seat but he jumped.

text: Padayon nga ginabulong sang Western Visayas Medical Center (WVMC) ang mga sakay sang truck.

text: Suno kay Mansoy, wala makit-an sang driver sang motorsiklo ang trisikad.

text: Bangud sa impact, nakaagum sang head injury ang driver sang motorsiklo nga nakatalana nga iga-refer sa hospital sa siyudad para sa nagakaigo nga pagbulong.

text: Nakaguwa na si Tropical Depression Fabian sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) base sa 1 a.m. nga bulletin sang state weather bureau.
english: Tropical Depression Fabian has already left the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) based on the 1 a.m. bulletin of the state weather bureau.

text: Pahayag sang PAGASA, ginalauman nga magaluya ini kag mahimo nga low pressure area (LPA) samtang yara na sa guwa sang Pilipinas.
english: According to PAGASA, it is expected to weaken and become a low pressure area (LPA) while outside the Philippines.

text: Ini ang ika-anum nga bagyo nga nagsulod sa PAR subong nga tuig.
english: This is the sixth typhoon to enter the PAR this year.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, padayon ang pag-monitor sang bureau sa Tropical Storm Podul nga mahimo magsulod sa PAR sa tunga-tunga sang Domingo sang gab-i kag Lunes sang aga.
english: Meanwhile, the bureau continues to monitor Tropical Storm Podul which may enter the PAR between Sunday night and Monday morning.

text:
Alas dies kagab-i, nasiplatan si Podul sa kalayuon nga 2,315 km nasidlangan sang Extreme Northern Luzon nga may dala nga kabaskugon sang hangin nga 85 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 105 km/h.

Nagahulag ini sa direksyon nga pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 15 km/h.
english:
At 10 pm, Podul was spotted 2,315 km east of Extreme Northern Luzon with winds of 85 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 105 km/h.

It is moving in the direction west northwest at a speed of 15 km/h.

text: 𝗦𝗢𝗨𝗧𝗛 𝗞𝗢𝗥𝗘𝗔 — Ginkilala sang Korte Suprema sang South Korea ang bag-o nga kinamatarong para sa mga same-sex couple.
english: 𝗦𝗢𝗨𝗧𝗛 𝗞𝗢𝗥𝗘𝗔 — South Korea’s Supreme Court has recognized new rights for same-sex couples.

text: Nakasaad diri nga ang estado dapat maghatag sang seguro sa ikaayong lawas para sa kaupod sang isa ka ‘gay’ sa isa ka talalupangdon nga desisyon nga nagbilin naman sa mga aktibista sang kalipay.
english: It stipulates that the state must provide health insurance for the partner of a ‘gay’ in a landmark decision that left activists elated.

text: Ang pinakamataas nga korte sang pungsod nagdesisyon nga “diskriminasyon” para sa mga state health insurers nga tratuhon ang mga mag-asawa nga pareho ang sekso sing tuhay sa ila mga heterosexual nga mga counterparts.
english: The nation’s highest court ruled it was “discrimination” for state health insurers to treat same-sex couples differently from their heterosexual counterparts.

text: Nagasiling sa isa ka desisyon nga sang mga aktibista nga mahimo magbukas sang opurtunidad para sa ulihi nga pag-legalize sang mga same-sex unions sa South.
english: Says in a ruling that by activists that could open up the opportunity for eventual legalization of same-sex unions in the South.

text: Ang desisyon, nga indi ma-apelar, nagakahulugan nga ang mga common-law nga mga asawa sang pareho nga sekso mahimo na karon magparehistro bilang mga dependent sa state health insurance sang ila mga kaupod — isa ka butang nga madugay na nga ginatugutan para sa mga heterosexual nga mga common-law.
english: The decision, which cannot be appealed, means that common-law spouses of the same sex can now register as dependents on their partners’ state health insurance — something that has long been allowed for heterosexual common-law spouses.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang kaso ang gindala sang isa ka ‘gay couple’, nga amo sanday So Seong-wook kag Kim Yong-min, nga nagapuyo sing tingob kag naghiwat sang seremonya sa kasal sang 2019.
english: It is known that the case was brought by a ‘gay couple’, namely So Seong-wook and Kim Yong-min, who live together and held a wedding ceremony in 2019.

text: Wala ini sing legal nga balido, bangud ang South Korea ang wala nagakilala sang kasal sang pareho nga gender.
english: It has no legal validity, as South Korea does not recognize same-sex marriage.

text: Sang 2021, ginkasuhan ni So ang National Health Insurance Service (NHIS) bangud gintapos sini ang mga benepisyo para sa iya kaupod — nga iya ginrehistro bilang isa ka dependent — pagkatapos nga matukiban nga sila isa ka same-sex couple.
english: In 2021, So sued the National Health Insurance Service (NHIS) for terminating benefits for her partner — whom she had registered as a dependent — after discovering they were a same-sex couple.

text: Sa isa ka talalupangdon nga desisyon sang nagligad nga tuig, ang isa ka Seoul High Court nagpabor sa mag-asawa, nga nagamando nga sa National Health Insurance Service nga ibalik ang mga benepisyo sang mga dependent.
english: In a landmark ruling last year, a Seoul High Court ruled in favor of the couple, ordering that it was up to the National Health Insurance Service to restore dependents’ benefits.

text: Apang gin-apelar sang health servie ang desisyon, nga nagdala sang kaso sa Korte Suprema.
english: But the health servie appealed the decision, taking the case to the Supreme Court.

text: Nagaguwa nga Korte Suprema nagdesisyon nga ini “diskriminasyon base sa sekswal nga oryentasyon nga indi pag-ilakip ang mag-asawa bangod lang sila pareho sing sekso ukon gender”.
english: Emerging Supreme Court ruled that it is “discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation to exclude a couple simply because they are of the same sex or gender”.

text: Ang korte nagdesisyon nga ang serbisyo sa ikaayong lawas ang desisyon nga indi pagkilalahon ang mga pareho nga sekso nga nagporma sang isa ka ekonomiko nga komunidad sang kabuhi nga kaanggid sa isa ka mag-asawa bilang mga dependent nga nagalapas sa kinamatarong.
english: The court ruled that the health service’s decision not to recognize same-sex couples who formed an economic community of life similar to a married couple as dependents violated the right.

text: Samtang, ang abogado sang mag-asawa nga si Chang Suh-yeon nagsiling nga ang desisyon “nagahatag sang paglaum” sa mga same-sex couple sa South Korea, apang nagsiling nga kulang.
english: Meanwhile, the couple’s lawyer Chang Suh-yeon said the ruling “gives hope” to same-sex couples in South Korea, but said that’s not enough.

text: Ini ang nagtulod sa mga mamalidha sa Kamara nga bag-ohon ang pagduso para sa same-sex civil partnerships.
english: This prompted lawmakers in the House to renew the push for same-sex civil partnerships.

text: Para sa LGBTQI Community sang pungsod, isa ini ka dako nga butang kag importante nga desisyon sang Korte Suprema.
english: For the LGBTQI Community of the country, this is a big deal and an important decision by the Supreme Court.

text: Nagnubo sa 16% ang mga pamilya nga Pilipino nga nakaeksperyensya sang “involuntary hunger” ukon kagutom.
english: The number of Filipino families experiencing involuntary hunger has dropped to 16%.

text: Santo sa latest nga report sang Social Weather Stations (SWS), ginabanta 4 million nga mga Pilipino sa pungsod ang nagabatyag sang kagutom sa last quarter sang 2020.
english: According to the latest report of the Social Weather Stations (SWS), an estimated 4 million Filipinos in the country are experiencing hunger in the last quarter of 2020.

text: Ang pinakaulihi nga hunger rate ang mas manubo sang 15 percent sa record-high nga 30.7 percent ukon 7.6 million nga mga pamilya sang Setyembre santo sa survey nga ginpatigayon sang Nobyembre 21 tubtub 25.
english: The latest hunger rate is 15 percent lower than the record-high of 30.7 percent or 7.6 million families in September according to the survey conducted November 21 to 25.

text: Ini ang mas doble naman sa pre-pandemic nga 8.8 percent ukon 2.1 million nga pamilya sang Disyembre 2019.
english: This is more than double the pre-pandemic 8.8 percent or 2.1 million families in December 2019.

text: Paathag sang SWS, ang involuntary hunger ang nagakahulugan nga wala sang may makaon sa sulod sang tatlo ka bulan.
english: The SWS explained that involuntary hunger means not having food for three months.

text: Ang Metro Manila ang may pinakamataas nga “incidence of hunger” nga may 23.3 percent ukon 780,000 nga pamilya.
english: Metro Manila has the highest incidence of hunger with 23.3 percent or 780,000 families.

text: Ini ang ginasundan sang Mindanao nga may 16%, Luzon nga may 14.4 percent kag Visayas nga may 14.3 percent.
english: This is followed by Mindanao with 16%, Luzon with 14.4 percent and Visayas with 14.3 percent.

text: Sang Setyembre, ang mga ginagutom ang yara sa 40.7 percent ukon 1.9 million ka pamilya sa Visayas, 37.5 percent ukon 2.1 million ka pamilya sa Mindanao, 28.2 percent ukon 941,000 ka pamilya sa Metro Manila kag 23.8 percent ukon 2.6 million nga pamilya sa Luzon.
english: In September, 40.7 percent or 1.9 million families in the Visayas, 37.5 percent or 2.1 million families in Mindanao, 28.2 percent or 941,000 families in Metro Manila and 23.8 percent or 2.6 million families in Luzon were hungry.

text: “With hunger at 16.7 percent in May, 20.9 percent in July and 30.7 percent in September, the average hunger rate for the full-year 2020 is a new record 21.1 percent of families,” pahayag sang SWS.
english: “With hunger at 16.7 percent in May, 20.9 percent in July and 30.7 percent in September, the average hunger rate for the full-year 2020 is a new record 21.1 percent of families,” the SWS said.

text:
Sang Nobyembre, ang 16 percent ang hunger rate ang kabug-usan na sang 12.6 percent ukon ginabanta 3.1 million ng Pilipino nga nakaeksperyensya sang “moderate hunger” kag 3.4 percent ukon 838,000 ka pamilya nga nakaeksperyensya sang “severe hunger.”

Ang Moderate hunger amo ang mga nakaeksperyensya sang “only once” ukon “a few times” nga kagutom sa sulod ang tatlo ka bulan.
english:
In November, the 16 percent hunger rate totaled 12.6 percent or approximately 3.1 million Filipinos experiencing moderate hunger and 3.4 percent or 838,000 families experiencing severe hunger.

Moderate hunger is those who have experienced hunger “only once” or “a few times” within three months.

text: Ang severe hunger naman ang nagakahulugan sang “often” ukon “always” nga kagutom sa sulod sang tatlo ka bulan.
english: Severe hunger means “often” or “always” hunger for three months.

text: Ang Fourth Quarter 2020 Social Weather Survey, amo ang pinakauna nga survey nga nagpatigayon sang face-to-face interview sa 1,500 adults, ukon 18 anyos pasaka.
english: The Fourth Quarter 2020 Social Weather Survey, is the first survey to conduct face-to-face interviews with 1,500 adults, or 18 years and older.

text: Ginkumpirma na ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has confirmed that

text: nga pirmahan sini ang hagna nga nagaduso nga i-postpone ang 2025 Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE).
english: to sign the bill proposing to postpone the 2025 Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE).

text: Samtang yara sa media forum sa Bengaluru, India, ginpamangkot siya sang mga reporters kun pirmahan sini ang bill ukon pabayaan lamang nga mag-lapse kag dalayon nga mangin layi.
english: While at a media forum in Bengaluru, India, he was asked by reporters whether he would sign the bill or just let it lapse and immediately become law.

text:
Sabat ni Marcos, “I’ll sign it.”

Ginplastar sini nga kinahanglan nga matutukan ang parliamentary elections sa Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) sa Oktubre.
english:
Marcos replied, “I’ll sign it.”

He stressed the need to focus on the parliamentary elections in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) in October.

text: Ini ang una nga bes sa maragtas nga may amo sini nga sahi sang eleksyon sa BARMM suno kay Marcos, kag dapat nga indi ini mapalpak bangud may epekto ini sa peace process.
english: This is the first time in history that there will be such an election in BARMM, Marcos said, and it must not fail because it will have an impact on the peace process.

text: Pahayag pa sini, bag-o lang natapos ang daku nga piniliay nga amo ang 2025 midterm national and local elections sang Mayo, kag mangin ang Commission on Elections (Comelec) suno sa iya ang nagpahayag na nga indi na nila ini masarangan.
english: He said the big elections, the 2025 midterm national and local elections in May, have just ended, and even the Commission on Elections (Comelec) has already stated that they can no longer afford it.

text: “We are facing one of the biggest elements here, kakatapos lang natin ng malaking eleksyon, midterm election… You have to remember, the BARMM election that is upcoming in October is the first time we have ever had this kind of election at all.
english: “We are facing one of the biggest elements here, we are just finishing up a big election, midterm election… You have to remember, the BARMM election that is upcoming in October is the first time we have ever had this kind of election at all.

text: Sa buong kasaysayan ng Pilipinas, hindi pa nagkaroon ng BARMM Parliament na hinalal ng tao.
english: In the entire history of the Philippines, there has never been a BARMM Parliament elected by the people.

text: So, that is why it is so important,” suno sa presidente.
english: So, that is why it is so important,” according to the president.

text: “If that election (BARMM) fails, malaking bagay, malaking failure ‘yan doon sa peace process.
english: “If that election (BARMM) fails, it's a big thing, a big failure in the peace process.

text: Kaya’t kailangan na kailangan maging matagumpay ang pagganap ng halalan ng BARMM.
english: That's why it's imperative that the BARMM elections be successful.

text: And that’s why we really are focusing on that,” dugang sini.
english: And that’s why we really are focusing on that,” it added.

text: Una na nga nag-anunsyo si Comelec chairperson George Garcia nga ginpahibalo siya sang Malacañang nga matabo ang pagpirma sang hagna para sa BSKE postponement sa Martes, Agusto 12.
english: Earlier, Comelec chairperson George Garcia announced that he was informed by Malacañang that the signing of the bill for the BSKE postponement will take place on Tuesday, August 12.

text: Naka-set kuntani ang piniliay sa Disyembre 1, 2025.
english: The election was supposed to be set for December 1, 2025.

text: Sang Hunyo, ginratipikahan sang Kongreso ang bicameral conference committee report nga nagaduso nga palawigon ang term of office sang barangay and SK officials pa-apat ka tuig, kag i-postpone ang elections kag sayluhon sa una nga Lunes sang Nobyembre 2026.#
english: In June, Congress ratified the bicameral conference committee report proposing to extend the term of office of barangay and SK officials for four years, and postpone the elections and move them to the first Monday of November 2026.#

text: Gintanyagan si NLEX Road Warriors point-guard Kiefer Ravena nga maghampang sang basketball sa Japan.
english: NLEX Road Warriors point-guard Kiefer Ravena was offered to play basketball in Japan.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirma mismo ni NLEX head coach Yeng Guiao.
english: This was confirmed by NLEX head coach Yeng Guiao.

text: Suno sa iya, ginkadto-an siya mismo ni Ravena agud istoryahan ang nangin offer sang Japan apang ini pa ang iya nga ginapanumdom kun ano bala ang iya mangin desisyon.
english: He said Ravena personally approached him to discuss Japan's offer but he is still thinking about what his decision will be.

text: Pahayag pa ni Guiao, wala niya ginapamalabagan si Ravena nga batunon ang offer sang Japan apang may yara sang problema sa iya kontrata sa NLEX kag nakadepende man sa Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) kun bala pahanugutan siya nga makalakat sa Japan agud maghampang.
english: Guiao said he does not object to Ravena accepting Japan's offer but there is a problem with his contract with NLEX and it also depends on the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) whether he will be allowed to travel to Japan to play.

text: Sang Oktubre lang nakapirma sang kontrata si Ravena sa NLEX Road Warriors sa diin nagalawig ini sang tatlo ka tuig.
english: Ravena signed a three-year contract with the NLEX Road Warriors in October.

text: Ang nasambit nga kontrata ang magluwas pa sa iya ginpirmahan sa Uniform Player Contract sang PBA.
english: The contract is in addition to the Uniform Player Contract he signed with the PBA.

text: Wala ginsapak sang barko sang China ang pag-radyo sang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) samtang nagalayag ini sa sulod sang exclusive economic zone (EEZ) sang Pilipinas.
english: The Chinese ship ignored the radio of the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) while sailing within the exclusive economic zone (EEZ) of the Philippines.

text: Suno kay Commodore Jay Tarriela, ang spokesperson sang PCG para sa West Philippine Sea, nagpadala ang ahensya sang islander aircraft agud mag-monitor kag magpalab-ot sang mensahe sa Chinese vessels kaina sang aga.
english: Commodore Jay Tarriela, PCG spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea, said the agency sent an islander aircraft to monitor and convey messages to Chinese vessels yesterday morning.

text: Pag-abot sa Batanes, nag-isyu sang radio challenge ang PCG sa CCG-4304 nga nagasiling nga wala ini sang legal nga awtoridad nga mag-operate sa kadagatan sang Pilipinas.
english: Upon arrival in Batanes, the PCG issued a radio challenge to CCG-4304 stating that it had no legal authority to operate in Philippine waters.

text: Sa pihak sini, wala sang sabat nga nabaton ang PCG.
english: However, the PCG did not receive a response.

text: “Upon locating the CCG-4304, the crew issued radio challenges, emphasizing that the vessel lacks legal authority to operate within the Philippines’ exclusive economic zone,” suno kay Tarriela.
english: “Upon locating the CCG-4304, the crew issued radio challenges, emphasizing that the vessel lacks legal authority to operate within the Philippines’ exclusive economic zone,” according to Tarriela.

text:
“Unfortunately, the CCG vessel did not respond.”

Nakit-an ang CCG-4304 sa nakatundan nga parte sang Batanes nga ginabanta 75 nautical miles sa nakatundan sang baybayon sang Sabtang island.
english:
“Unfortunately, the CCG vessel did not respond.”

CCG-4304 was found in the western part of Batanes about 75 nautical miles west of the coast of Sabtang island.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, sandig sa na-detect sang Dark Vessel Detection system sang Canada, nakit-an ang duha ka iban pa nga Chinese ships nga may bow numbers nga 3301 kag 3304 sa nasidlangan naman nga parte sang Batanes.
english: Meanwhile, based on the detection of Canada's Dark Vessel Detection system, two other Chinese ships with bow numbers 3301 and 3304 were found in the eastern part of Batanes.

text: Wala ugaling sila naradyuhan sang PCG bangud malayo ini kag malain na ang tyempo.
english: However, the PCG could not radio them because it was far away and the weather was bad.

text: “Consequently, adverse weather conditions and the distance to the other two CCG vessels (3304 and 3301) prevented the aircraft from reaching their locations,” pahayag pa ni Tarriela.
english: “Consequently, adverse weather conditions and the distance to the other two CCG vessels (3304 and 3301) prevented the aircraft from reaching their locations,” Tarriela said.

text: Apang dugang sini, preparado ang ahensya nga magpadala sang dugang nga resources pananglitan magpakatig-a pa gid ang Chinese vessels sa paghalin kag magapadayon sa pag-abante sa coastline sang Batanes.
english: However, he added that the agency is ready to send additional resources if the Chinese vessels insist on leaving and continue to advance along the coastline of Batanes.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang CCG 4304 kag 3304 ang pareho nga 112-meter Zhouyu class patrol ships nga armado sang 76 millimeter main gun, samtang ang CCG 3301 naman isa ka 98-meter Shucha II-class vessel nga may karga nga 37mm main gun.
english: CCG 4304 and 3304 are both 112-meter Zhouyu class patrol ships armed with a 76 millimeter main gun, while CCG 3301 is a 98-meter Shucha II-class vessel loaded with a 37mm main gun.

text: Una na nga nagpahayag ang SeaLight director nga si Ray Powell nga ang posisyon sang tatlo ka mga barko ang nagasunod sa bracketing pattern.#
english: Earlier, SeaLight director Ray Powell said the positions of the three ships followed a bracketing pattern.#

text: ILOILO CITY-Patay na sang masapwan sa isang bakante nga lote ang isa ka babate nga babaye nga nagaedad sang siyam ka tuig sa Lamitan City, Basilan.
english: ILOILO CITY-A nine-year-old girl was found dead in a vacant lot in Lamitan City, Basilan.

text:
Ginpahayag nga naglisensya ang biktima nga mangkuha sang nagkalahulog nga paho apang wala na ini makapauli pag-abot sang gab-i.

Pagkasunod nga adlaw, nakit-an nalang ang lawas sini sa kahilamunan kag nakaburambod pa sa iya liog ang iya pajama.
english:
The victim reportedly took permission to pick up the fallen smoke but did not return home by nightfall.

The next day, his body was found in the grass with his pajamas still wrapped around his neck.

text: Ginapatihan nga ginhimuslan pa ang bata.
english: The child is believed to have been raped.

text: Gin-aresto naman sang kapulisan ang 65-anyos nga suspek nga amo ang ginatudlo sang testigo.
english: Police arrested the 65-year-old suspect, who was identified by the witness.

text: Pasakaan ini sang kaso nga rape with homicide.
english: He will be charged with rape with homicide.

text: Nabaligya na sa balor nga $1.79 million ukon masobra P86 million sa isa ka auction ang basketball card ni NBA star Kobe Bryant.
english: NBA star Kobe Bryant's basketball card has been sold for $1.79 million or more than P86 million in an auction.

text:
Ang flawless Kobe Bryant rookie card ang ginakonsidera bilang “one of the rarest in existence.”

Suno sa Goldin Auctions, nabakal ang ini nga rookie card sang wala nagpakilala nga buyer.
english:
The flawless Kobe Bryant rookie card is considered as “one of the rarest in existence.”

According to Goldin Auctions, this rookie card was purchased by an anonymous buyer.

text:
Ang Topps trading card ang isa sa duha lamang sa bilog nga kalibutan nga ginakabig nga “black label pristine condition.”

Ini man ang pinakamahal nga Kobe Bryant card nga nabaligya.
english:
The Topps trading card is one of only two worldwide that is considered “black label pristine condition.”

It is also the most expensive Kobe Bryant card ever sold.

text: Natukiban sa pagpanalawsaw sang Department of Science and Technology – Philippine Nuclear Research Institute (DOST-PNRI) nga indi puro ang 80% nga mga ginabaligya nga produkto nga honey sa merkado sa pungsod.
english: Research by the Department of Science and Technology – Philippine Nuclear Research Institute (DOST-PNRI) found that 80% of honey products sold in the market in the country are not pure.

text: Suno kay Dr. Angel Bautista VII chemist sang DOST-PNRI, nagwa sa ginpatigayon nila nga pagtuon nga naga-unod sang syrup halin sa sugar cane ukon tuba sang mais ang kadam-an sa mga ginabaligya nga honey.
english: According to Dr. Angel Bautista VII, chemist of DOST-PNRI, revealed that most of the honey sold contains syrup from sugar cane or corn tuba.

text: Pinaagi sini suno sa natungdan, mas madamo nga produkto ang mabaligya sang mga manufacturers kag indi na kinahanglan pa nga magasto sang mahal.
english: Through this, he said, manufacturers will be able to sell more products and not have to spend expensive.

text: “62 out of the 76 (82%) of honey brands that were found to be adulterated were composed of 95% C4 sugar syrup.
english: “62 out of the 76 (82%) of honey brands that were found to be adulterated were composed of 95% C4 sugar syrup.

text: So, they are not actually adulterated but they are just completely purely sugar syrup,” pahayag ni Dr. Bautista.
english: So, they are not actually adulterated but they are just completely purely sugar syrup,” stated Dr. Bautista.

text: Paathag sang eksperto, 75% ukon 12 sa 16 nga local honey brands sa mga grocery kag souvenir shops ang indi matuod nga honey.
english: The expert explained that 75% or 12 out of 16 local honey brands in grocery and souvenir shops are not real honey.

text: Makabig naman nga impure ukon indi puro nga honey ang 87% ukon 64 halin sa 74 local brands nga ginabaligya online.
english: Meanwhile, 87% or 64 of the 74 local brands sold online are considered impure.

text:
“Lastly, from 41 imported honey products marketed in local stores, none of them were found to be adulterated.”

Nagakahangawa naman si Dr. Bautista sa posible malain nga epekto sa pagbakal sa mga produkto nga indi himo sa puro nga honey.
english:
“Lastly, from 41 imported honey products marketed in local stores, none of them were found to be adulterated.”

Dr. Bautista on the possible adverse effects of buying products that are not made with pure honey.

text: Ginakabig naman nga dako nga kapyerdihan sa mga beekepers ang kompetisyon sa mga nagabaligya sang peke nga honey products.
english: Competition from those selling fake honey products is considered a big loss for beekeepers.

text: “You may be buying honey for its wonderful health benefits, but because of adulteration, you may actually just be buying pure sugar syrup.
english: “You may be buying honey for its wonderful health benefits, but because of adulteration, you may actually just be buying pure sugar syrup.

text:
Consuming too much pure sugar syrup can lead to harmful health effects.”

“This is affecting our local honey industry so badly that we estimate that they are losing PhP200 million per year,” dugang pa ni Dr. Bautista.
english:
Consuming too much pure sugar syrup can lead to harmful health effects.”

“This is affecting our local honey industry so badly that we estimate that they are losing PhP200 million per year,” added Dr. Bautista.

text: Ginpanugyan naman sang Philippine National Standard for Honey sang Bureau of Agriculture and Fisheries Standards, nga wala sang dapat nga ginasimpon nga food additives ang mga ginabaligya nga honey sa merkado.
english: The Philippine National Standard for Honey of the Bureau of Agriculture and Fisheries Standards recommended that honey sold in the market should not contain food additives.

text: Kun may ara man, responsibilidad na sang manufacturers nga ibutang ini sa labelling lakip na ang lugar nga ginkuhaan sang honey.
english: If there is, it is the responsibility of the manufacturers to put it on the labeling including the place where the honey was taken.

text: Isa ka sahi sang analysis ang nakabulig sa mga researchers sang DOST-PNRI agud matumod ang resulta sang pagtuon kaangot sa honey products.
english: One type of analysis helped DOST-PNRI researchers to identify the results of the study on honey products.

text: Ginatawag ini nga “stable carbon isotope ratio analysis” sa diin pinaagi sini mahapos nga matumod ang ginhalinan sang isa ka substance.
english: This is called “stable carbon isotope ratio analysis” where it is easy to determine the origin of a substance.

text:
“This type of analysis allows researchers to see isotopes – elements with same number of electrons and protons but different number of neutrons – which can give clues on the origin of the substance.”

“The carbon-13 signature is like a fingerprint of honey and common adulterants like sugarcane and corn are completely different from each other.
english:
“This type of analysis allows researchers to see isotopes – elements with same number of electrons and protons but different number of neutrons – which can give clues on the origin of the substance.”

“The carbon-13 signature is like a fingerprint of honey and common adulterants like sugarcane and corn are completely different from each other.

text: Therefore, we can differentiate one from the other.
english: Therefore, we can differentiate one from the other.

text:
This unique isotopic signature is what we are using to tell if honey is authentic or fake,” pahayag ni Dr. Bautista.’

Napadala naman sang team ni Dr. Bautista sa Food and Drug Administration ang findings sang ila pagtuon.
english:
This unique isotopic signature is what we are using to tell if honey is authentic or fake,” Dr. Bautista said.’

The team of Dr. Bautista to the Food and Drug Administration the findings of their study.

text: Nagapanawagan naman ang eksperto sa mga otoridad nga hugtan ang ginapatuman nga polisa nga magahatag sang proteksyon sa industriya sang honey kag beekeepers sang pungsod.
english: The expert called on the authorities to tighten the policy that will protect the country's honey industry and beekeepers.

text: Ginpirmahan ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: Signed by Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: ang Executive Order No.
english: Executive Order No.

text:
42 para sa province-wide post-election cleanup campaign nga may tigulo “Limpyo Eleksyon for MoRProGRes.”

Ang order ang nagaduso sa tanan nga mga kandidato, partido, kag mga organisasyon nga may listahan sang partido nga nagpasakop sa 2025 elections nga kuhaon kag ihaboy sang nagakaigo ang ila campaign materials sa sulod sang lima ka adlaw pagkatapos sang eleksyon.
english:
42 for the province-wide post-election cleanup campaign titled “Limpyo Eleksyon for MoRProGRes.”

The order directs all candidates, parties, and party-listed organizations that participated in the 2025 elections to remove and properly dispose of their campaign materials within five days of the election.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Governor Defensor Jr., iya ginpahayag nga ang cleanup ang nagasunod sa Republic Act 9003, ukon sa Ecological Solid Waste Management Act sang 2000, nga nagapat-od nga ang proper waste collection kag paghaboy sang basura ang dapat ginasunod.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Governor Defensor Jr. said the cleanup is in compliance with Republic Act 9003, or the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000, which ensures that proper waste collection and disposal should be followed.

text: Suno kay Defensor, ang ila partido ang nagdeploy na sang salakyan ang agud makuha mga campaign posters kag tarpaulins.
english: According to Defensor, their party has already deployed vehicles to collect campaign posters and tarpaulins.

text: Maga-coordinate man sila sa mga LGU para suportahan ang inisyatibo.
english: They will also coordinate with LGUs to support the initiative.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga ang matipon nga mga materyales sa kampanya igahatag sa mga organisasyon nga nakabase sa komunidad agud i-upcycle sa mga bag, pouch, kag mga wallet.
english: She also explained that the collected campaign materials will be donated to community-based organizations to be upcycled into bags, pouches, and wallets.

text: Nagpirma si Gov.
english: Gov. signed.

text: Defensor sang amo nga executive order pila ka oras antis ini ginproklamar bilang reelected governor sang probinsya sa iya ikatatlo nga termino.
english: Defensor of the executive order hours before he was proclaimed as reelected governor of the province for his third term.

text: Ginplastar ni Senator Imee Marcos nga mahimo pa ma-revive ang impeachment complaint batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte pananglitan paboran sang Supreme Court ang motion for reconsideration sang Kamara kag balisdakon ang ila nauna nga ruling.
english: Senator Imee Marcos said the impeachment complaint against Vice President Sara Duterte could be revived if the Supreme Court favors the House's motion for reconsideration and overturns its previous ruling.

text: Pahayag ini sang senadora isa ka adlaw matapos nagboto ang upper chamber, 19-4-1, agud nga isaylo ang articles of impeachment batok kay Duterte sa archive.
english: The senator's statement came a day after the upper chamber voted, 19-4-1, to transfer the articles of impeachment against Duterte to the archives.

text: “It’s dead but it’s not really buried.
english: “It’s dead but it’s not really buried.

text: In effect, because it is in the archive…pwede namang hugutin pa uli kung magbago ang Korte Suprema suno sa presidential sister.
english: In effect, because it is in the archive...it can be tightened again if the Supreme Court changes, according to the presidential sister.

text:
Dugang sini, “Sumusunod lang kami sa batas at sa Korte Suprema.”

Ang nagboto pabor sa pag-archive sang impeachment case amo sanday Senators Alan Peter Cayetano, Pia Cayetano, Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa, JV Ejercito, Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero, Jinggoy Estrada, Sherwin Gatchalian, Bong Go, Lito Lapid, Loren Legarda, Rodante Marcoleta, Erwin Tulfo, Raffy Tulfo, Imee Marcos, and Robin Padilla, Senate Majority Leader Joel Villanueva, Camille Villar, and Mark Villar, kag Miguel Zubiri.
english:
He added, “We just follow the law and the Supreme Court.”

Voting in favor of archiving the impeachment case were Senators Alan Peter Cayetano, Pia Cayetano, Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa, JV Ejercito, Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero, Jinggoy Estrada, Sherwin Gatchalian, Bong Go, Lito Lapid, Loren Legarda, Rodan Legarde, Raffle, Erwin Marcole Tulfo, Imee Marcos, and Robin Padilla, Senate Majority Leader Joel Villanueva, Camille Villar, and Mark Villar, and Miguel Zubiri.

text: Nagpamalabag naman sanday Senators Bam Aquino, Risa Hontiveros, Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan, kag Senate minority leader Vicente “Tito” Sotto III samtang nag-abstain si Senator Ping Lacson.
english: Senators Bam Aquino, Risa Hontiveros, Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan, and Senate minority leader Vicente “Tito” Sotto III abstained while Senator Ping Lacson abstained.

text: Matandaan nga una na nagsiling ang Korte Suprema nga “unconstitutional” ang articles of impeachment, apang nag-file ang lower chamber kag duha pa ka grupo sang motion for reconsideration.#
english: The Supreme Court had earlier declared the articles of impeachment unconstitutional, but the lower chamber and two other groups filed a motion for reconsideration.

text: Ginpalikaw lang anay sang Oton Municipal Police Station (MPS) sa iya pamilya ang amay nga suspek sa pagpatay sang iya bata sa Barangay Sta.
english: The Oton Municipal Police Station (MPS) has just kept the father suspected in the murder of his son in Barangay Sta.

text: Rita, Oton, Iloilo.
english: Rita, Oton, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Raymundo Sarad, Jr., 36-anyos, samtang ang suspek amo si Raymundo Sarad, Sr., amay sang biktima, kag lunsay residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The victim was identified as Raymundo Sarad, Jr., 36, while the suspect was identified as Raymundo Sarad, Sr., father of the victim, and both residents of the said area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Lunelyn Talamillo, deputy chief of police sang Oton Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga kasunod sang pag-release sa suspek, wala na ini ginbalik pa sa ila balay sa Oton.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Lunelyn Talamillo, deputy chief of police of Oton Municipal Police Station, said that after the release of the suspect, he was not returned to his home in Oton.

text: Suno kay Talamillo, gindala ang suspek malayo sa ila banwa agud nga makalikaw sa pamilya.
english: According to Talamillo, the suspect was taken away from his town to avoid his family.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga wala pa nakaabot ang autopsy result sang biktima kag ginahulat-hulat na lang sang talatapan.
english: He also said that the autopsy result of the victim has not yet arrived and the office is waiting for it.

text: Nahibaluan nga apisar nga wala nag-ako ang amay sa otoridad nga siya ang nakabuno sa iya anak, nagtuad naman ini sa iya kabataan sa nahimo nga krimen.
english: It was learned that although the father did not admit to the authorities that he stabbed his son, he confessed to his children the crime.

text: Matandaan nga nasapwan ang biktima nga yara na sa kanal kag may pilas nga tuga sang pagkabuno.
english: The victim was found lying in a ditch with gunshot wounds.

text: Nagsulat ang duha ka Republican senators kay United States President Joe Biden agud hingyuon ini nga iplastar ang kumpleto nga lista sang options sang Pentagon kag State Department agud nga mabuligan kag masuportahan ang Pilipinas kasunod sang mga pagpang-harass sang China sa West Philippine Sea partikular sa Ayungin Shoal kun sa diin nahamtang ang daan nga warship nga BRP Sierra Madre.
english: The two Republican senators have written to United States President Joe Biden asking him to present a complete list of options for the Pentagon and State Department to assist and support the Philippines following China's harassment in the West Philippine Sea particularly in the Ayungin Shoal where the old warship BRP Sierra Madre is located.

text: Hulyo 12 sang ginsulat ini nanday Senador Roger Wicker kag Senador Jim Risch nga amo ang highest ranking Republicans sa Senate Armed Services Committee kag Senate Foreign Relations Committee.
english: It was written July 12 by Senator Roger Wicker and Senator Jim Risch who are the highest ranking Republicans on the Senate Armed Services Committee and Senate Foreign Relations Committee.

text: Suno sa duha ka opisyal, dapat nga kit-anon gid kag konkreto ang demonstrasyon sang suporta sang Estados Unidos sa Pilipinas.
english: According to the two officials, the demonstration of US support for the Philippines should be visible and concrete.

text: Kun magkulang lang sang gamay nga suporta suno sa duha, magaguwa nga indi handa ang Estados Unidos nga tumanon ang bilateral commitments sini.
english: If there is a lack of support, the two said, it will appear that the United States is not ready to fulfill its bilateral commitments.

text: “We must respond with visible and concrete demonstrations of our support.
english: “We must respond with visible and concrete demonstrations of our support.

text: Anything short of this risks our appearing unwilling to honor our bilateral commitments,” pahayag sa sulat.
english: Anything short of this risks our appearing unwilling to honor our bilateral commitments,” the letter said.

text: Kaangot diri, gin-request nanday Wicker kag Risch ang kumpleto nga lista sang military, diplomatic, kag economic options nga amo ang ginabalay sang Departments of State kag Defense bilang suporta sa Pilipinas.
english: In this regard, Wicker and Risch requested the complete list of military, diplomatic, and economic options that the Departments of State and Defense are outlining in support of the Philippines.

text: Matandaan nga una na nga ginpahayag ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: It can be recalled that President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: nga dapat mas masobra pa ang himuon sang Pilipinas ipaanggid sa pag-file lamang sang protesta sa tion nga may “illegal action” ang China batok sa mga Pilipino sa West Philippine Sea.
english: that the Philippines should do more than just file a protest when China has an “illegal action” against Filipinos in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Wala pa naghingyo ang Pilipinas sang bulig sang Amerika sa pag-resupply sa tropa sa Ayungin Shoal kag wala man sang plano pa nga i-invoke na ang pito ka dekada nga Mutual Defense Treaty (MDT) agud nga mabuligan sang Amerika ang Manila pag-abot sa depensa.
english: The Philippines has not yet requested US assistance in resupplying troops in the Ayungin Shoal and has no plans to invoke the seven-decade-old Mutual Defense Treaty (MDT) so that the United States can assist Manila in defense.

text: Ang pinakaulihi nga natabo nga pagpang-harass amo ang nagluntad sang nagligad nga Hunyo 17 kun sa diin ginbanggaan sang China Coast Guard ang mga Pinoy sa Ayungin Shoal, ginbungguaan kag gingisian ang sakayan, ginkawat ang mga armas nga dal-on kuntani sa BRP Sierra Madre, kag sang ulihi, nautdan pa sang tudlo ang isa ka Philippine Navy personnel.
english: The latest harassment occurred on June 17 when the Chinese Coast Guard collided with Filipinos in Ayungin Shoal, hit and torn the boat, stole weapons that were supposed to be taken to BRP Sierra Madre, and later, cut off the finger of a Philippine Navy personnel.

text: Gintawag ni President Marcos nga “iligal” ang amo nga aktwasyon apang indi pa ini suno sa iya makabig nga isa ka armed attack.#
english: President Marcos called the action “illegal” but said it was not yet considered an armed attack.

text: Kun si American trainer Freddie Roach ang pamangkuton, mas luyag niya nga makasumpong anay ni eight-division world champion Manny Pacquiao si American professional boxer Ryan Garcia antes pa man atubangon ang mga kaangay man nga American professional boxer nga sanday Terence Crawford kag Errol Spence.
english: As for American trainer Freddie Roach, he prefers eight-division world champion Manny Pacquiao to face American professional boxer Ryan Garcia before facing fellow American professional boxers Terence Crawford and Errol Spence.

text: Interesado si Roach kay Garcia nga posible mangin warm-up ni Pacquiao antes ang mas dako nga hampang kontra kanday Crawford kay Spence.
english: Roach is interested in Garcia as a possible warm-up for Pacquiao before the bigger match against Crawford and Spence.

text: Apang gin-athag ni Roach nga indi mahimo ipakanubo si Garcia bangud mas bata ini, mabakod, madasig kag may determinasyon nga makuha ang kadalag-an batuk kay Pacquiao.
english: But Roach explained that Garcia cannot be underestimated because he is younger, stronger, faster and has the determination to win against Pacquiao.

text: Nahibaluan nga ulihe nga hampang sang fighting senator ang natabo sang Hulyo 2019 pa sa diin ginlutos sini si American professional boxer Keith Thurman via split decision.
english: The fighting senator's last fight was in July 2019 when he defeated American professional boxer Keith Thurman via split decision.

text: Ginmandu na sang gobyerno ang pagpa-sirado sang public kag private universities sa Bangladesh kasunod sang lapnagon kag maduguon nga protesta batok sa kontrobersyal nga quota system sa mga trabaho sa gobyerno.
english: The government has ordered the closure of public and private universities in Bangladesh following widespread and bloody protests against the controversial quota system in government jobs.

text: Sa amo nga protesta, anum na ka mga tawo napatay kag masobra 400 ang nasamaran.
english: In the protests, six people have been killed and more than 400 injured.

text: Pila na ka mga syudad lakip na ang kapital nga Dhaka ang napuno sang tensyon sa sulod na sang pila adlaw bangud sa away sang supporters sang anti-quota movement kag ang ila kasumpong ilabi na ang student wing sang Awami League ukon mas kilala nga Bangladesh Chhatra League (BCL).
english: Several cities including the capital Dhaka have been filled with tension for several days due to the fight between supporters of the anti-quota movement and their opponents especially the student wing of the Awami League or better known as the Bangladesh Chhatra League (BCL).

text: Halimbawa sang mga eksena amo ang mga estudyante nga nagasakitanay gamit ang mga balakol; mga pulis nga nagagamit na sang tear gas kag rubber bullets; kag protesters nga nagadala na sang mga lungon bilang pagpakita sang simpatiya sa mga napatay sa amo nga protesta.
english: Examples of scenes are students hurting each other with sticks; police already using tear gas and rubber bullets; and protesters who are already carrying coffins as a show of sympathy for those killed in the protest.

text: Gina-demand sang protesters nga untaton na ang quota system nga nagatigana sang 30% sang government jobs sa mga pamilya sang mga beterano nga nangin kabahin sang war of independence sang Bangladesh sang 1971.
english: The protesters are demanding an end to the quota system that reserves 30% of government jobs for the families of veterans who were part of Bangladesh's war of independence in 1971.

text: Ginapanindugan sang protesters nga indi patas kag “discriminatory” ang amo nga tikang kag ang sarang lamang makabenepisyo diri amo ang supporters ni Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina kag gusto nila ini islan sang merit-based system.
english: The protesters insist that the move is unfair and discriminatory and that the only ones who can benefit from it are the supporters of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and they want to replace it with a merit-based system.

text:
Nadabukan pa ang tensyon bangud nagpahayag ang prime minister nga ‘razakars’ ang protesters ukon katumbas sang derogatory nga Bangla word para sa tinaga nga “traidor.”

Matandaan nga ini nga quota ang ginpauntat na sang korte kasunod man sang lapnagon nga protesta sang mga estudyante sang 2018.
english:
Tensions escalated when the prime minister declared the protesters 'razakars' or the equivalent of the derogatory Bangla word for the word “traitor.”

It can be recalled that this quota was already suspended by the court following the widespread protests of students in 2018.

text: Apang sang nagligad lamang nga bulan, nagpaguwa sang bag-o nga desisyon ang High Court sa amo nga pungsod kun sa diin ginbalik ang daan nga sistema sa quota rason nga naakig naman ang mga estudyante kag ginpadayon ang bayolente nga pagpakigbato apisar nga gin-suspinde naman ang amo nga court order.
english: But last month, the High Court in the country issued a new decision restoring the old quota system, which angered the students and continued the violent struggle despite the suspension of the court order.

text: (Photo: [Abdul Goni/AP Photo])
english: (Photo: [Abdul Goni/AP Photo])

text: ILOILO – Nagapasalamat ang bag-o nga director sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) sa suporta nga ginhatag sa iya sang probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: ILOILO – The new director of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) is grateful for the support given to him by the province of Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Colonel Gilbert Gorero, iya ginpahayag nga indi madali ang responsibilidad kag kahigayunan nga ginhatag sa iya, apang tuman ang iya pasalamat sa pagsalig nga ginhatag sang Iloilo Provincial Government kag ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Colonel Gilbert Gorero said the responsibility and opportunity given to him was not easy, but he is very grateful for the trust given by the Iloilo Provincial Government and Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: Suno kay Gorero, nagapasalamat man siya sa pamunuan sang Police Regional Office 6 nga nagrekomenda man sa iya sa national headquarters agud mangin full pledged na nga director sang IPPO.
english: Gorero said he is also grateful to the leadership of the Police Regional Office 6 for recommending him to the national headquarters to become the full pledged director of the IPPO.

text: Nagpanugyan man si Gorero sa kapulisan nga responsibilidad nila nga matapna ang krimen.
english: Gorero also advised the police that it is their responsibility to prevent crime.

text: Ini ang may kaangtanan man sa kontrobersyal nga kamatayon sang isa ka police asset nga Pol.
english: This is also in connection with the controversial death of a police asset, Pol.

text: Corporal Felfranz Lumahang nga ginapahayag ginluthang-patay sa isa ka drug buybust operation sa Abilay Sur, Oton, Iloilo.
english: Corporal Felfranz Lumahang who was allegedly shot dead in a drug buybust operation in Abilay Sur, Oton, Iloilo.

text: Lakip man sa mga programa nga igalunsyar ni Gorero sa pagpamuno sa IPPO, amo ang padayon nga pagtapna sang iligal nga droga, war against criminality, war against insurgency, war on corruption kag war against all forms of illegal gambling.
english: Among the programs that Gorero will launch as the head of the IPPO are the continuous fight against illegal drugs, war against criminality, war against insurgency, war on corruption and war against all forms of illegal gambling.

text: Sa paglunsyar sang nasambit nga programa, importante suno kay Gorero ang integridad, dignidad kag disiplina.
english: In launching the program, Gorero said integrity, dignity and discipline are important.

text: Nagakadapat nga may yara sang unified effort ang dignidad sa kapulisan, integridad nga obrahon ang tanan nga ikasarang agud makahatag hustisya, kag disiplina nga mangin ehemplo sa pumuluyo.
english: There should be a unified effort of dignity in the police, integrity to do everything possible to provide justice, and discipline to be an example to the people.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan nga kun may yara sang dignidad, integridad kag disiplina, mas mapadali ang pagsalig sang pumuluyo sa katapo sang Philippine National Police.
english: He added that if there is dignity, integrity and discipline, it will be easier for the people to trust the members of the Philippine National Police.

text: Handa nga magpalab-ot sang bulig ang Mandurriao Police Station kun kinahanglan sang iban nga ahensya sang gobyerno kaangot sa ginakahangaw-an nga pagdamo sang Chinese nationals sa Iloilo City.
english: The Mandurriao Police Station is ready to provide assistance if needed by other government agencies regarding the concerned increase in the number of Chinese nationals in Iloilo City.

text: Ginpahayag ini sang hepe sang estasyon nga si Police Captain Val Allan Cambel matapos na-mensyonar ang Monterosa Subdivision sa Mandurriao nga isa sa mga lokasyon sa syudad nga ginatiniran sang madamo nga Chinese nationals.
english: Station chief Police Captain Val Allan Cambel said this after mentioning the Monterosa Subdivision in Mandurriao which is one of the locations in the city where many Chinese nationals live.

text: Sandig ini sa nakasaad sa sulat ni Iloilo City Lone District Rep.
english: This is based on the letter of Iloilo City Lone District Rep.

text: Julienne ‘Jamjam’ Baronda sa Department of Justice sang ginhingyo sini nga imbestigaran sang National Bureau of Investigation kag Bureau of Immigration ini nga nationals bangud sa ginapahayag makaduluda nga pagtinir sa syudad sang mga tawo halin sa mainland China, indi halos makahambal sang English, nakabakal sang mga balay sa balor nga P30-million tubtub P50-million, kag may yara man sang luxury nga sports utility vehicles (SUVs).
english: Julienne 'Jamjam' Baronda to the Department of Justice when she requested that the National Bureau of Investigation and Bureau of Immigration investigate these nationals because of the alleged suspicious stay in the city of people from mainland China, hardly speak English, bought houses worth P30-million to P50-million, and have luxuries sports utility vehicles (SUVs).

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay Cambel, iya ginpahayag nga isa lamang ka supporting agency ang PNP kag may mga nagakaigu nga ahensya nga amo ang nagatutok sa pag-account sa sini nga nationals.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Cambel said the PNP is only one supporting agency and there are appropriate agencies that are focused on accounting for these nationals.

text: Wala pa sang tikang nga ginahimo subong sang pulis suno pa sa natungdan ilabi na bangud wala man sang na-report nga iligal nga mga aktibidad nga nahimo ang amo nga mga indibidwal.
english: The police are not taking any action yet, he said, especially since there were no reports of illegal activities committed by the individuals.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga isa ka tuig sini nga pagpungko bilang hepe sa Mandurriao Police Station, wala pa ini naka-encounter sang Chinese national nga involved sa anuman nga insidente ukon krimen.
english: He also said that in one year of his tenure as chief of the Mandurriao Police Station, he has not encountered a Chinese national involved in any incident or crime.

text: Apang bangud matunog subong nga gina-istoryahan ang Chinese nationals sa Pilipinas kun sa diin involved pa ang national security, nagpanugyan si Cambel sa publiko kag sa barangay officials nga magpakig-angot gid gilayon sa otoridad pananglitan may makit-an nga makaduluda nga mga aktibidad sa palibot nga ginakaulamiran sang sini nga mga nationals.
english: However, since there is a lot of talk about Chinese nationals in the Philippines where national security is still involved, Cambel advised the public and barangay officials to immediately contact the authorities if they see suspicious activities in the environment that these nationals are aware of.

text:
SULAT NI BARONDA SA DOJ

Matandaan nga sa sulat ni Baronda kay Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla, namensyonar man ang Puerto Real de Iloilo kag Ledesco Subdivision sa La Paz.
english:
BARONDA'S LETTER TO DOJ

It can be recalled that in Baronda's letter to Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla, he also mentioned Puerto Real de Iloilo and Ledesco Subdivision in La Paz.

text: Apisar nga suspetsa pa lamang ang tanan suno kay Baronda, mas maayo kun i-validate ini kag tumuron kun ini nga mga tawo ang nagapakigbahin man sa iligal nga aktibididad.
english: Although everything is still suspicious, Baronda said, it is better to validate it and determine if these people are also involved in illegal activities.

text: Gin-cite man sini ang ginakahangaw-an subong sang mga Pinoy nga Chinese “sleeper agents”; ang kaso ni Bamban, Tarlac Mayor Alice Guo nga nagguwa nga isa gali ka Chinese national nga si Guo Hua Ping; kag ang kaso sang 17 ka Chinese nationals nga nadakpan anay sa ginaalegar nga cybersex den sa Balantang, Jaro sang Nobyembre 2023 nga gina-alegar involved man sa human trafficking.
english: He also cited the current concerns of Filipinos that Chinese “sleeper agents”; the case of Bamban, Tarlac Mayor Alice Guo who turned out to be a Chinese national named Guo Hua Ping; and the case of 17 Chinese nationals who were arrested in an alleged cybersex den in Balantang, Jaro in November 2023 who are also allegedly involved in human trafficking.

text: “While these are mere suspicions, it is better to validate the veracity of these reports and determine whether these alleged Chinese are engaged in nefarious activities or not, as the Filipino people are worried about the so-called Chinese sleeper agents given the fact that your agency, the National Bureau of Investigation, has verified that Mayor Alice Guo and a Chinese national have the same fingerprints.
english: “While these are mere suspicions, it is better to validate the veracity of these reports and determine whether these alleged Chinese are engaged in nefarious activities or not, as the Filipino people are worried about the so-called Chinese sleeper agents given the fact that your agency, the National Bureau of Investigation, Mayor Ali and the Chinese have verified the same fingerprints.

text: Also, in November 2023, 17 Chinese nationals were arrested in Brgy.
english: Also, in November 2023, 17 Chinese nationals were arrested in Brgy.

text: Balantang, Jaro, here in Iloilo City due to cybersex and human trafficking,” kabahin sang sulat sini lang nga Hulyo.
english: Balantang, Jaro, here in Iloilo City due to cybersex and human trafficking,” part of the letter this July.

text: Bilang pagtapos sang sulat, ginplastar sang mamalidha ang safety sang mga Ilonggo kag ang importansya sa pag-proteher sa national security sang Pilipinas.
english: In conclusion, the lawmaker highlighted the safety of Ilonggos and the importance of protecting the national security of the Philippines.

text: “Given these, I would like to respectfully request that your good office investigate this matter through the National Bureau of Investigation and Bureau of Immigration in earnest.
english: “Given these, I would like to respectfully request that your good office investigate this matter through the National Bureau of Investigation and Bureau of Immigration in earnest.

text: We want to ensure that our people are safe and that our national security is protected.”#
english: We want to ensure that our people are safe and that our national security is protected.”#

text: Ginkwestyon ni House Speaker Martin Romualdez kun ngaa gindalian gid sang Senado nga i-archive ang articles of impeachment batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: House Speaker Martin Romualdez questioned why the Senate rushed to archive the articles of impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Kun i-archive ini, buot silingon, ginalubong na ini suno sa House Speaker.
english: If it is archived, it means it is being buried, the House Speaker said.

text: Apang pahayag niya, indi pa gani pinal ang ruling sang Korte Suprema nga unconstitutional ang articles of impeachment bangud may yara pa sang ginpang-file nga motion for reconsideration nga nagahingyo nga baliskadon sang Supreme Court ang nauna nga desisyon sini.
english: However, he said the Supreme Court's ruling that the articles of impeachment are unconstitutional is not yet final because there is still a motion for reconsideration filed asking the Supreme Court to reverse its previous decision.

text: “Why the rush?
english: “Why the rush?

text: [to archive]?
english: [to archive]?

text: The Constitution is clear: only the House has the exclusive power to initiate impeachment.
english: The Constitution is clear: only the House has the exclusive power to initiate impeachment.

text: That power is final within its sphere.
english: That power is final within its sphere.

text: We exercised that power lawfully, transparently, and in good faith—not out of spite but out of duty.
english: We exercised that power lawfully, transparently, and in good faith—not out of spite but out of duty.

text: Not to attack but to ask for answers—answers the Vice President never gave,” statement ni Romualdez.
english: Not to attack but to ask for answers—answers the Vice President never gave,” Romualdez statement.

text: “To archive is, in effect, to bury the Articles of Impeachment.
english: “To archive is, in effect, to bury the Articles of Impeachment.

text: Yet, the ruling of the Supreme Court is not final.
english: Yet, the ruling of the Supreme Court is not final.

text: On August 5, the House filed a Motion for Reconsideration.
english: On August 5, the House filed a Motion for Reconsideration.

text: The Court found our arguments serious enough to require the respondents, including the Vice President, to submit their comment.
english: The Court found our arguments serious enough to require the respondents, including the Vice President, to submit their comment.
