english: The case is active,” the Speaker said.

text: Gindepensahan man ni Romualdez ang pag-impeach sang Kamara kay Sara nga suno sa iya nagsunod sa Konstitusyon kag ginhimo “in good faith”.
english: Romualdez also defended the House’s impeachment of Sara, which he said followed the Constitution and was done “in good faith”.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga indi patas kag delikado para sa demokrasya sang Pilipinas kun hambalon lamang sang iban nga “power play” ang proseso sa pagpasabat sa mga public officials.
english: He also said it is unfair and dangerous for Philippine democracy if others call the process of holding public officials accountable a “power play”.

text: Wala sang pamulitika nga natabo suno sa iya, kundi nakaangkla tanan sa accountability ukon salabton nga base sa kamatuoran kag ginsumpaan nga mga dokumento.
english: There was no politics, he said, but everything was anchored in accountability based on truth and sworn documents.

text: “More than one-third of House Members signed the verified complaint.
english: “More than one-third of House Members signed the verified complaint.

text: Under the Constitution, that triggered the automatic transmittal of the Articles of Impeachment.
english: Under the Constitution, that triggered the automatic transmittal of the Articles of Impeachment.

text: No referral to the committee was needed.
english: No referral to the committee was needed.

text: No further plenary action was required.
english: No further plenary action was required.

text: The process was complete,” pahayag ni Romualdez.
english: The process was complete,” Romualdez said.

text: Pahayag pa sini, padayon ang pagpakig-away para sa kamatuoran kag para sa rule of law.
english: He said the fight for the truth and for the rule of law continues.

text: Gindugang man sang House Speaker nga wala sila nagatindog batok sa Senado, kundi nagatindog para sa Republika sang Pilipinas.
english: The House Speaker also added that they are not standing against the Senate, but standing for the Republic of the Philippines.

text: Kabahin pa sang iya statement: “Tuloy ang laban: For the Constitution, for the rule of law, and for the enduring truth that no public office is ever beyond the reach of accountability.”
english: “The fight continues: For the Constitution, for the rule of law, and for the enduring truth that no public office is ever beyond the reach of accountability,” he said.

text: Magapatawag si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr. will summon

text: sang stakeholder conference kaangot sa online gambling antes magdesisyon kun i-ban ini ukon indi.
english: of a stakeholder conference on online gambling before deciding whether to ban it or not.

text: Suno sa punong ehekutibo, mang-imbitar siya sang mga grupo lakip na ang Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) nga matunog nga nagaduso sa pagdumili sa online gambling.
english: The chief executive said he will invite groups including the Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) which is strongly pushing for a ban on online gambling.

text: Madamo suno kay Marcos sang mga nabatian halin sa CBCP gani nga ilakip ang mga pari kag obispo sa conference.
english: Marcos said he has heard a lot from the CBCP so priests and bishops should be included in the conference.

text: Yara man ang mga ginikanan kag stakeholders bangud mga kabataan ang masami nga involved sa sini nga hulubaton.
english: Parents and stakeholders are also present because children are often involved in this proverb.

text: Pahayag sini, ang mga inputs halin sa conference ang gamiton agud mabalanse ang pros kag cons sang ginaproponer nga online gambling ban.
english: He said the inputs from the conference will be used to balance the pros and cons of the proposed online gambling ban.

text: ”We still have to form the policy on what we are going to do about online gambling.
english: ”We still have to form the policy on what we are going to do about online gambling.

text: And to this end, I have already started to organize a… shall we, to convene a conference of those who are… all the stakeholders.
english: And to this end, I have already started to organize a… shall we, to convene a conference of those who are… all the stakeholders.

text: We are talking about, maraming marami tayong naririnig from the CBCP,” pahayag sini.
english: We are talking about, we hear a lot from the CBCP,” he said.

text: ”So, sama natin sila.
english: ”So, they’re like us.

text: Mga pari, mga obispo.
english: Priests, bishops.

text: The parents, of course, are stakeholders here kasi victimized demographic, ang mga kabataan.
english: The parents, of course, are stakeholders here because victimized demographic, the children.

text: Tapos, we have to talk to the people who will, kung mag-reregulate tayo, who will be doing the regulation.
english: Then, we have to talk to the people who will, if we reregulate, who will be doing the regulation.

text: The first effect of banning it fully is to put it underground.
english: The first effect of banning it fully is to put it underground.

text: And then we have no control.
english: And then we have no control.

text: ‘Yan talagang wala na tayong recognition,” dugang niya.
english: 'We really have no recognition,” he added.

text: Nahibaluan nga may mga mamalidha nga nagaduso sa pagtapna na sa online gambling bangud ginapaadik sini ang mga tawo sa sugal.
english: It is known that some lawmakers are proposing to ban online gambling because it makes people addicted to gambling.

text: May mga pagpang-alang-alang naman ang Department of Finance (DOF) sa proposal, kag sa baylo nga ban, ginaduso sini ang mas istrikto nga regulasyon.
english: The Department of Finance (DOF) has reservations about the proposal, and instead of a ban, it is pushing for stricter regulations.

text: Suno naman kay Marcos, ”The problem is not online gambling.
english: Marcos said, “The problem is not online gambling.

text:
The problem are the social effects on our children and those who are addicted to gambling.”

”Paano natin patitigilin ‘yan?
english:
The problem are the social effects on our children and those who are addicted to gambling.”

”How do we stop that?

text: These are the things that we are going to examine and we will come up with a plan to make sure that we address the problem,” suno sa chief executive.
english: These are the things that we are going to examine and we will come up with a plan to make sure that we address the problem,” said the chief executive.

text: Naga-contribute ang online gambling sang halos katunga sang P200 billion taxes nga makolekta sang gobyerno halin sa tanan nga gambling activities subong nga tuig.#
english: Online gambling contributes nearly half of the P200 billion taxes the government will collect from all gambling activities this year.

text: Magapatunga na ang gobyerno agud mabuligan nga mabalik sa normal ang presyo sang mga balaklon.
english: The government will step in to help restore commodity prices to normal.

text: Suno kay Department of Finance Undersecretary Gil Beltran, ang inflation sa Nobyembre ang nagtaas sa 3.3 percent bangud sa mataas nga presyo sang mga nagapanguna nga balaklon.
english: According to Department of Finance Undersecretary Gil Beltran, inflation in November rose to 3.3 percent due to high prices of basic commodities.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang inflation ukon pagtaas sa presyo sang mga balaklon sang Nobyembre ang mas mataas sang 2.5 percent kun ipaanggid sa 1.3 percent nga narekord sang Oktubre.
english: Inflation in November was 2.5 percent higher than the 1.3 percent recorded in October.

text: Ginpahayag ni Beltran nga ang inflation subong nga tuig ang sulod sa ginalauman sang gobyerno nga 2 to 4 percent nga target.
english: Beltran said inflation this year is within the government's expected 2 to 4 percent target.

text: Agud masigurado ang pagbalik sang normal sa presyo sang mga balaklon, magabulig ang Department of Agriculture kag Department of Transportation sa pagdeliver sang mga food supplies halin sa mga imports kag food-surplus regions.
english: To ensure the return to normal in commodity prices, the Department of Agriculture and Department of Transportation will assist in the delivery of food supplies from imports and food-surplus regions.

text: “However, to ensure prompt price normalization, the Department of Agriculture kag Department of Transportation may need to facilitate movement of food supplies from imports and food-surplus regions,” pahayag ni Beltran.
english: “However, to ensure prompt price normalization, the Department of Agriculture and Department of Transportation need to facilitate movement of food supplies from imports and food-surplus regions,” Beltran said.

text: Ang average nga presyo sang pagkaon sang Nobyembre ang nagtaas sang 4.49 percent, halin sa 2.13 percent sang nagligad nga bulan.
english: Average food prices in November rose 4.49 percent, up from 2.13 percent a month earlier.

text: Ang presyo sang karne ang nagtaas sang 8.15 percent, 5.32 percent sa isda kag 14.6 percent sa utanon.
english: Meat prices increased by 8.15 percent, fish by 5.32 percent and vegetables by 14.6 percent.

text: Paathag sang tiglikom, ang pagtaas sa presyo sang utanon ang bangud sa sunod-sunod nga bagyo nga nag-igo sa pungsod.
english: The secretary explained that the increase in vegetable prices was due to the successive typhoons that hit the country.

text: Nagsugod ang pagpangbaklas sang Iloilo City General Services Office sang Martes, Mayo 13, 2025 sang campaign materials sang mga kandidato kasunod sang National and Local Elections.
english: The Iloilo City General Services Office began on Tuesday, May 13, 2025 the unveiling of campaign materials of candidates following the National and Local Elections.

text:
Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engineer Niel Ravena, head sang General Services Office, iya ginpahayag nga yara sa 900 kilograms

Suno kay Ravena, yara na sa kabug-usan nga 4 ka tonelada ang nakolekta nga campaign materials halin sa pito ka Distrito sang Iloilo City.
english:
In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Engineer Niel Ravena, head of the General Services Office, said it was about 900 kilograms

According to Ravena, a total of 4 tons of campaign materials have been collected from the seven districts of Iloilo City.

text: Gin-ako man sini nga may mga nabilin pa nga mga tarpaulins ang wala nakuha sang talatapan sa pila ka designated areas.
english: He also acknowledged that there are still tarpaulins that the office has not removed in some designated areas.

text: Prayoridad man subong sang GSO nga kakson ang mga materyales nga yara pa sa pampubliko nga lugar.
english: The GSO is also prioritizing the removal of materials that are still in public places.

text: ILOILO CITY- Nasapwan nga wala na sang kabuhi ang anom ka foreign nationals sa isa ka luxury hotel room sa central Bangkok, Thailand.
english: ILOILO CITY- Six foreign nationals were found dead in a luxury hotel room in central Bangkok, Thailand.

text: Suno kay Prime Minister Srettha Thavisin, posible nga biktima sang poisoning ang anom ka mga turista nga lunsay nga Vietnamese, kag duha sa ila ang may dual US nationality.
english: According to Prime Minister Srettha Thavisin, the six tourists, all Vietnamese, and two of them with dual US nationality, may have been victims of poisoning.

text: Natukiban ang bangkay sang mga biktima sang isa ka cleaning staff ang nagsulod sa ila kwarto.
english: The bodies of the victims were discovered when a cleaning staff entered their room.

text: Ginapatihan nga may kaupod sila nga isa pa ka Vietnamese nga posible involved sa insidente.
english: They are believed to be accompanied by another Vietnamese who may have been involved in the incident.

text:
Base sa preliminary examination, wala sang nakit-an nga injuries nga patimaan nga may natabo nga away apang may senyales nga ginpainom sang toxic substance ang mga biktima

Natalana nga ipaidalom sa autopsy ang nasambit nga Vietnamese nationals.
english:
Based on the preliminary examination, no injuries were found to indicate a fight but there were signs that the victims were given a toxic substance.

The Vietnamese nationals are scheduled to undergo an autopsy.

text: Gin-ako sang Government Service Insurance System (GSIS) nga nag-invest ini sa online gambling platform nga DigiPlus Interactive Corp.
english: The Government Service Insurance System (GSIS) has admitted that it invested in online gambling platform DigiPlus Interactive Corp.

text: apang wala ini sang ginsapubliko nga kantidad kun pila.
english: but it did not disclose the amount.

text: Kasunod ini sang ginbulgar ni Senate Deputy Minority Leader Risa Hontiveros nga nag-invest ang GSIS sang masobra sa P1 billion sa gaming giant nga DigiPlus.
english: This follows the revelation by Senate Deputy Minority Leader Risa Hontiveros that the GSIS invested more than P1 billion in gaming giant DigiPlus.

text: Sa tunga sang pagpakamalaot halin sa publiko, nagsabat naman ang GSIS nga maga-kooperar ini sa oversight institutions kag sa regulatory bodies kaangot sa ginhimo sini nga investment.
english: Amid condemnation from the public, the GSIS responded that it will cooperate with oversight institutions and regulatory bodies regarding its investment.

text: Ginpasalig man sini nga suportahan ang transparency kag accountability sa tanan nila nga investment activities.
english: He also assured to support transparency and accountability in all their investment activities.

text: Sa ila nga statement, ginsulit man nga wala-punaw ang ila commitment nga mag-akto santo sa pinakamaayo nga interest sang mga myembro kag pensioners.
english: In their statement, they also reiterated their unwavering commitment to act in the best interest of members and pensioners.

text: “We welcome the scrutiny and call for public disclosure from various sectors, and we are prepared to present all relevant documents and data to the appropriate authorities.
english: “We welcome the scrutiny and call for public disclosure from various sectors, and we are prepared to present all relevant documents and data to the appropriate authorities.

text: As stewards of public trust, we affirm our unwavering commitment to act in the best interests of our members and pensioners,” suno sa GSIS.
english: As stewards of public trust, we affirm our unwavering commitment to act in the best interests of our members and pensioners,” GSIS said.

text: Gindugang man nga ginasunod lang nila ang ila mandato nga protektahan kag padakuon ang kontribusyon sang mga trabahador sang gobyerno.
english: He added that they are only following their mandate to protect and maximize the contribution of government workers.

text: Lakip man sa ginpasalig sang GSIS amo ang padayon nga pag-conduct sang comprehensive review sa charter, investment policies, risk exposure thresholds, kag sectoral guidelines ilabi na ang naga-involve sang sensitive ukon high-risk industries.
english: The GSIS also assured that it will continue to conduct a comprehensive review of the charter, investment policies, risk exposure thresholds, and sectoral guidelines especially those involving sensitive or high-risk industries.

text: As of June 2025, ang GSIS ang may total assets nga P1.88 trillion kag naka-record sang Net Operating Income nga P76.82 billion.
english: As of June 2025, GSIS has total assets of P1.88 trillion and recorded a Net Operating Income of P76.82 billion.

text: Matandaan nga una na ginkwestyon ni Hontiveros kun ano ang tuyo sang GSIS sa pag-invest sa gambling platform.
english: It can be recalled that Hontiveros earlier questioned the intention of the GSIS in investing in the gambling platform.

text: “In the first place, what was GSIS thinking, investing funds in online gambling?
english: “In the first place, what was GSIS thinking, investing funds in online gambling?

text: Eh tayo nga po, mga kasamang nagtatrabaho sa gobyerno, ni hindi pwedeng tumungtong sa casino lalo na hindi pwedeng magsugal doon,” suno sa senadora.
english: Eh tayo nga po, colleagues who work in the government, we can't go to the casino especially we can't gamble there,” said the senator.

text: “Kaya bakit ang GSIS, todo taya, at ginawang puhunan ang pera ng public employees sa sugalan?” #
english: “So why did the GSIS, all bets, and invest the money of public employees in gambling?” #

text: Ginahitso na ang pagbalik ni Filipino basketball player Kai Sotto sa Estados Unidos bangud ginkansela na ang final window sang 2021 FIBA Asia Cup qualifiers.
english: Filipino basketball player Kai Sotto's return to the United States is being postponed after the final window of the 2021 FIBA ​​Asia Cup qualifiers was cancelled.

text: Nagalaum ang kampo ni Sotto nga makaupod sa gihapon ini sa Team Ignite sa diin nag-umpisa na ang NBA G-League campaign.
english: Sotto's camp hopes that he will still be with Team Ignite where the NBA G-League campaign has already begun.

text: Suno kay Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas (SBP) director for operations Butch Antonio, nakaguwa na sa bubble ang nasambit nga basketball player kag padayunon na lang sini ang iya quarantine sa iya ginatiniran.
english: According to Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas (SBP) director for operations Butch Antonio, the said basketball player has already left the bubble and will continue his quarantine at his residence.

text: Nahibaluan nga nag-abot si Sotto sa Pilipinas sang Pebrero 2 agud nga mag-upod sa Gilas Pilipinas training sa Calamba City, Laguna.
english: Sotto arrived in the Philippines on February 2 to attend Gilas Pilipinas training in Calamba City, Laguna.

text: Ang Gilas ang nagahanda kuntani sa final window sang FIBA Asia Cup qualifiers nga patigayunon sa Doha subong nga bulan apang bangud sa nagataas nga kaso sang COVID-19 , ginkansela ang hampang.
english: The Gilas were preparing for the final window of the FIBA ​​Asia Cup qualifiers to be held in Doha this month but due to rising cases of COVID-19, the game was cancelled.

text: Ginpasalamatan naman ni Antonio si Sotto bangud handa ini nga buligan ang Gilas sa pagrepresenta sang Pilipinas.
english: Antonio thanked Sotto for his willingness to help the Gilas represent the Philippines.

text: Nagdangat sa P1.7-million ang balor sang ginapasuni shabu nga nakuha sa subject sa drug buy bust operation sa Barangay Carvasana, Calinog, Iloilo.
english: P1.7-million worth of suspected shabu seized from a suspect in a drug buy bust operation in Barangay Carvasana, Calinog, Iloilo.

text: Ang arestado amo si alias Pani, 45, residente sang Barangay Tabucan sa amo man nga banwa.
english: The arrested was identified as alias Pani, 45, resident of Barangay Tabucan in the same town.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Myles Dieron, hepe sang Calinog Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag ngamagluwas sa walo ka sachets sang suspected shabu nga nagabug-at sang 260 gramos nga nakuha sa subject, nakumpiskar man ang isa ka .45 caliber pistol nga may mga bala.
english: Police Major Myles Dieron, chief of the Calinog Municipal Police Station, said that besides eight sachets of suspected shabu weighing 260 grams, a .45 caliber pistol with ammunition was also seized from the suspect.

text: Suno kay Dieron, sang nagligad nga tuig pa ginsuguran ang monitoring sa subject apang nabudlayan ang otoridad nga madakpan ini bangud nga naga-transact ang suspek sa suod lang sini nga mga kakilala.
english: According to Dieron, the monitoring of the suspect began last year but the authorities found it difficult to arrest him because the suspect was transacting with his close acquaintances.

text: Ginapahayag nga wholesale ang transaksyon sang suspek kag wala ini nagabaligya sa Calinog kundi sa iban nga mga banwa.
english: The suspect's transaction is reportedly wholesale and he does not sell in Calinog but in other towns.

text: Wala nag-ako ang suspek kun sa diin nagahalin ang iligal nga droga, apang sandig sa pagpangusisa sang pulis, sa presuhan ginakuha ang shabu kag si alias Pani ang nagabaligya sa guwa.
english: The suspect did not admit where the illegal drugs came from, but based on police investigation, the shabu was taken from the jail and alias Pani was selling it outside.

text: Sa record sang pulis, nagaguwa nga nagagamit man sang iligal nga droga ang subject.
english: According to police records, the suspect also uses illegal drugs.

text: Natalana ini nga mag-atubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon sa Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002 kag RA 10591 ukon sa Comprehensive Law in Firearms and Ammunitions.
english: He is scheduled to face charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002 and RA 10591 or the Comprehensive Law in Firearms and Ammunitions.

text: Nag-umpisa na si Eight-division champion Manny Pacquiao sa iya nga training bilang pagpanghanda sa masunod niya nga away sa wala pa mahibaluan nga mangin kasumpong sang boxing champ.
english: Eight-division champion Manny Pacquiao has started his training in preparation for his next fight against an unknown opponent of the boxing champ.

text: Luyag sang 42 anyos sang showdown batuk kay mixed martial arts superstar Conor McGregor subong nga tuig apang nalutos ini pinaagi sa knocked out sa duha ka rounds batuk kay american mixed martial artist Dustin Poirier sa UFC 257 sa Abu Dhabi.
english: The 42-year-old wanted a showdown against mixed martial arts superstar Conor McGregor this year but was knocked out in two rounds against American mixed martial artist Dustin Poirier at UFC 257 in Abu Dhabi.

text: Bangud sini, may mga impormasyon nga nagaguwa nga mahimo si WBC interim lightweight champion Ryan Garcia na lang ang iya mangin kasumpong.
english: As a result, there are reports that WBC interim lightweight champion Ryan Garcia may be his only opponent.

text: Suno kay Pacquiao, handa na siya nga magbalik sa ring.
english: Pacquiao said he is ready to return to the ring.

text: Ginpahayag man sang fighting senator nga mahimo sa masunod nga ma inadlaw may yara siya sang dako nga balita ukon announcement nga ipakigbahin sa publiko.
english: The fighting senator also said that he may have a big news or announcement to share with the public in the coming days.

text: Sa subong, may yara na sang gina-uyatan si Pacquiao nga 62 wins kag 7 losses nga rekord sa patag sang boxing.
english: Pacquiao now holds a record of 62 wins and 7 losses in the boxing field.

text: Nagsaka si Alex Eala sa ika-61 puwesto sa pinakabag-o nga WTA ranking matapos ang iya maragtason nga kadalag-an sa Guadalajara 125 Open sa Mexico, kun sa diin siya ang nangin labing una nga Pilipina ang nagdaog sang WTA singles title.
english: Alex Eala rose to 61st place in the latest WTA rankings after her historic victory at the Guadalajara 125 Open in Mexico, where she became the first Filipina to win the WTA singles title.

text: Bangud sa nasambit kadalag-an, nagtaas sang 14 nga ranggo si Eala humalin sa anay ika-75.
english: With the win, Eala moved up 14 ranks from 75th.

text: Ginlutos niya si Panna Udvardy sang Hungary sa final, 1-6, 7-5, 6-3, sa isa ka come-from-behind win.
english: She defeated Panna Udvardy of Hungary in the final, 1-6, 7-5, 6-3, in a come-from-behind win.

text: Ang 20-anyos nga tennis star ang anay naglab-ot sa career-high ranking nga World No.
english: The 20-year-old tennis star once reached a career-high ranking of World No.

text: 56, amo ang ikatlo nga seed sa palaabuton nga Sao Paulo Open, isa ka WTA 250 tournament nga pagahiwaton subong nga semana sa Brazil.
english: 56, is the third seed in the upcoming Sao Paulo Open, a WTA 250 tournament to be held this week in Brazil.

text: Antes sini, nakuha man ni Eala ang iya una nga kadalag-an sa Grand Slam main draw sa US Open, bag-o na-eliminate sa second round.
english: Earlier, Eala also won her first Grand Slam main draw at the US Open, before being eliminated in the second round.

text: May isa ka babaye nga nagpasaka sang reklamo batok sa iya bana bangud sa kaugot nga may iban ini nga ginapalangga, ginatatap, kag ginahikap-hikap.
english: A woman filed a complaint against her husband because he was angry that he loved, cared for, and touched someone else.

text: Ang problema ugaling, indi tawo ang ginapangimunan sang asawa kundi isa ka kuring!
english: The problem is, however, that the wife is not jealous of a man but a cat!

text: Ginpasaka ang complaint sa Karnataka High Court sa syudad sang Bengaluru sa India.
english: The complaint was filed in the Karnataka High Court in the Indian city of Bengaluru.

text: Suno sa asawa, mas nagahatag sang tiyempo kag pagtatap ang iya bana sa ila hinuptanan nga kuring sa baylo nga siya nga asawa sini ang atipanon.
english: According to the wife, her husband gives more time and attention to their pet cat instead of her and his wife.

text: Kun ginakumpronta sini ang iya bana, ginaalegar nga naga-resulta ini sa pagbaisay kag gina-insulto pa siya.
english: When she confronts her husband, it allegedly results in an argument and he even insults her.

text: Ang malain pa suno sa asawa, pila ka beses naman siya nga ginakaros sang kuring kag wala man sang ginahimo ang iya bana.
english: Worse, the wife said, she was bitten by the dog several times and her husband did nothing.

text: Suno naman kay Justice M. Nagaprasanna, wala man sang specific allegations ang asawa natuhoy sa pagpang-harass sang iya bana kundi naga-focus lang gid sa iya kalain sang buot bangud sa ila nga kuring.
english: Justice M. Nagaprasanna said the wife had no specific allegations regarding her husband's harassment but focused on her anger over their dog.

text: Suno pa sa natungdan, indi isyu diri ang demand sa pagbayad sa damage bangud sa pagpamintas sang bana.
english: According to the concerned, the demand for damages due to the abuse of the husband is not an issue here.

text: Sa baylo, ang isyu amo ang sagod nga kuring nga nagapangaros sang pila na ka beses.
english: Instead, the issue is a pet cat that has been vomiting several times.

text: “The complaint is a narration of marriage and living together, but the crux of the allegation is founded upon the squabble regarding a pet cat that is in the house of the husband,” pahayag ni Justice Nagaprasanna.
english: “The complaint is a narration of marriage and living together, but the crux of the allegation is founded upon the squabble regarding a pet cat that is in the house of the husband,” stated Justice Nagaprasanna.

text:
“The allegation is that the husband takes care of the cat more than the wife.”

Matapos nabasahan ang indi kinaandan nga petisyon, wala na ginpadayon sang korte ang imbestigasyon batok sa bana.
english:
“The allegation is that the husband takes care of the cat more than the wife.”

After reading the unusual petition, the court did not continue the investigation against the husband.

text:
Sa baylo, ginsaway pa ang asawa bangud sa iya complaint nga ginakabig sang korte nga “minor domestic issue.”

Gindugang sang korte nga amo sini nga sahi sang mga petisyon ang rason kun ngaa naga-clog ukon nagasalalampaw ang dapat nga asikasuhon sa mga korte sa India.
english:
Instead, the wife was reprimanded for her complaint, which the court considered a “minor domestic issue.”

The court added that such petitions are the reason why the Indian courts are clogged or overwhelmed.

text: “It is such frivolous cases that have clogged the criminal justice system today, and if the investigation is permitted in the case at hand, it would add one more case to the already clogged justice system,” suno pa sa korte.#
english: “It is such frivolous cases that have clogged the criminal justice system today, and if the investigation is permitted in the case at hand, it would add one more case to the already clogged justice system,” the court further said.#

text: Naalarma ang pila ka mga motorista matapos makit-an ang isa ka lapsag nga nagakamang sa kilid sang national highway sa Barangay Tabalong, Dauis, Bohol, sang Martes, Enero 27, 2026.
english: Some motorists were alarmed after seeing a baby crawling on the side of the national highway in Barangay Tabalong, Dauis, Bohol, on Tuesday, January 27, 2026.

text: Gilayun nga nag-untat ang mga ini kag ginpahigad ang bata, agud indi mabungguan sang mga nagalabay nga salakyan.
english: They immediately stopped and pushed the child to the side, so as not to be hit by passing vehicles.

text: Base sa dash cam footage, makit-an nga malapit gid ang lapsag sa mga nagalabay nga mga salakyan, nga naghatag sang kabalaka sa iya seguridad.
english: Based on dash cam footage, the baby can be seen very close to passing vehicles, which raised concerns about his safety.

text: Sa ibestigasyon sang Dauis Municipal Police Station, nahibaluan nga bag-o lamang nagselebrar ang lapsag sang iya una nga kaadlawan apang may nagluntad nga wala pag-intindihanay sa tunga sang iya amay kag iloy antes ang ginapahayag pagbilin sa iya sa karsada.
english: According to the investigation of the Dauis Municipal Police Station, the baby had just celebrated his first birthday but there was a misunderstanding between his father and mother before the alleged abandonment of him on the street.

text: Ginapatihan nga ginbayaan ang nasambit nga lapsag sang iya iloy sa highway agud makuha ang atensyon sang iya bana, nga nagpadayon sa pagtrabaho bisan ginpangabay sang iloy nga magpabilin tungod kaadlawan sang bata.
english: It is believed that the mother left the baby on the highway to get the attention of her husband, who continued to work despite the mother's request to stay because it was the child's birthday.

text: Sa karun, yara sa kustodiya sang lolo ang lapsag samtang padayon ang imbestigasyon sang pulisya kag posible nga may kaso nga ipasaka batok sa mga ginikanan.
english: The baby is currently in the custody of the grandfather while the police investigation continues and a case may be filed against the parents.

text: Masobra 21,000 nga mga trabaho — local kag overseas ang itanyag online sang Department of Labor and Employement (DOLE) subong nga semana.
english: More than 21,000 jobs — local and overseas will be offered online by the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) this week.

text: Suno sa ahensya, ang job fair ang lakipan sang mga bakante nga trabaho gikan sa 600 ka mga domestic companies amo man sa 15 ka mga licensed recruitment agencies nga konektado sa Bahrain, Falkland Islands, Germany, Ghana, Ivory Coast, Japan, Jordan, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Lebanon, Micronesia, Myanmar, New Zealand, Palau, Qatar, Singapore kag Taiwan.
english: According to the agency, the job fair will include job vacancies from 600 domestic companies as well as 15 licensed recruitment agencies connected to Bahrain, Falkland Islands, Germany, Ghana, Ivory Coast, Japan, Jordan, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Lebanon, Micronesia, Myanmar, New Zealand, Myanmar Qatar, Singapore and Taiwan.

text: Kadam-an sa mga trabaho amo ang para sa mga factory nurses, nursing aides, care workers, engineers, telecommunications rigging technicians, maintenance technicians, carpenters, foremen, laborers, kag building cleaning workers.
english: Most of the jobs are for factory nurses, nursing aides, care workers, engineers, telecommunications rigging technicians, maintenance technicians, carpenters, foremen, laborers, and building cleaning workers.

text: Ang Balik-trabaho e-jobs kag online job fair ang patigayunon sa Disyembre 10 tubtob Disyembre 11 subong nga tuig.
english: The Back-to-work e-jobs and online job fair will be held from December 10 to December 11 this year.

text: Guilty beyond reasonable doubt sa tatlo ka counts sang kaso nga cyber libel ang ginpamatbat sang Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 39 batok sa brodkaster nga si Salvador Jun Capulot.
english: The Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 39 found broadcaster Salvador Jun Capulot guilty beyond reasonable doubt of three counts of cyber libel.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Honorato Sayno, Legal Counsel sang complainant nga si Shariko Salcedo, iya ginpahayag nga sang 2021 nagsugod ang hearing sang amo nga kaso matapos nga ini ang ginpasaka.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Honorato Sayno, Legal Counsel of complainant Shariko Salcedo, said that in 2021 the hearing of the case began after it was filed.

text: Suno kay Sayno, magluwas sa mga kaso sini, ginapabayad man si Capulot sang P150,000 nga moral damages, P100,000 nga exemplary damages, kag P50,000 nga attorney’s fee nga may kabug-usan nga P300,000.
english: According to Sayno, besides his cases, Capulot is also ordered to pay P150,000 moral damages, P100,000 exemplary damages, and P50,000 attorney's fee for a total of P300,000.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang kaso ang ginpasaka ni Shariko Salcedo kasunod sang pagmulay sa iya ni Capulot sa isa ka radio station sa Iloilo City.
english: The case was filed by Shariko Salcedo after Capulot insulted her at a radio station in Iloilo City.

text: Dugang pa ni Sayno nga isa ini ka sahi sang ‘defamatory’ nga nagaguba sang dungog kag reputasyon sang isa ka indibidwal.
english: Sayno added that it is a form of ‘defamatory’ that destroys the honor and reputation of an individual.

text: May mag remedyos naman nga mahimo himuon si Capulot kaangay sang pag-apply sang probation agud nga indi na siya kinahanglan serbihan sang warrant of arrest kag mahimo man mag-apelar sa Court of Appeals kon siya ang makapyansa.
english: There are remedies that Capulot can do such as applying for probation so that he does not have to be served with a warrant of arrest and can also appeal to the Court of Appeals if he is granted bail.

text: Apang kon ma-convict naman si Capulot kag ma-affirm, indi na siya mahimo nga makakuha sang probation.
english: But if Capulot is convicted and affirmed, he will not be eligible for probation.

text: Sa pagbayolar sang brodkaster sang Republic Act 10175, ginasentensyahan ini sang minimum nga anom ka bulan kag isa ka adlaw tubtob duha ka tuig kag apat ka bulan nga pagkapreso sa kada isa ka count sang kaso.
english: For violating Republic Act 10175, the broadcaster is sentenced to a minimum of six months and one day to two years and four months in prison for each count of the case.

text: Sang damlag lang, nagpapili pa si Capulot sa pagka-konsehal sang Iloilo City apang napaslawan nga makasulod sa top 12.
english: Recently, Capulot ran for Iloilo City councilor but failed to make it to the top

text: Nakuha na naman ni Olympic Games-bound Ernest John Obiena ang ika-duha nga gold medal apisar wala niya magguba ang kaugalingon nga Philippine record.
english: Olympic Games-bound Ernest John Obiena won his second gold medal despite not breaking his own Philippine record.

text: Ang una nga bulawan nga medalya nga iya nakuha ang halin sa 2021 Internationales Stadionfest Indoor athletics meet sa Mercedes-Benz Arena sa Berlin sa Germany nga may record breaking nga 5.80 meter-performance.
english: The first gold medal she won came from the 2021 Internationales Stadionfest Indoor athletics meet at the Mercedes-Benz Arena in Berlin in Germany with a record breaking 5.80 meter-performance.

text: Nagpasa si Obiena sang 5.68 meters sa jumpoff nila ni German Oleg Zernikel matapos nag-tie sila sa una nga attempt sa seven-man competition sang PSD Bank Indoor Meet sa Dortmund, Germany.
english: Obiena cleared 5.68 meters in his jumpoff with German Oleg Zernikel after they tied in the first attempt at the seven-man competition of the PSD Bank Indoor Meet in Dortmund, Germany.

text: Ang bronze medal ang nakuha naman ni German Torben Blech.
english: The bronze medal went to German Torben Blech.

text: Ini na ang ika-tatlo nga tournament ni Obiena subong nga tuig bilang paghanda sa 2021 Tokyo Olympics sa Hulyo 23 tubtob Agosto 8.
english: This will be Obiena’s third tournament this year in preparation for the 2021 Tokyo Olympics on July 23 to August 8.

text: Atubangon naman ni Obiena sanday world record holder Armand Duplantis sang Sweden, 2012 Olympic champion Renaud Lavillenie sang France, 2016 Olympic winner Thiago Braz sang Brazil kag two-time world champion Sam Kendricks sang United States.
english: Obiena will face world record holder Armand Duplantis of Sweden, 2012 Olympic champion Renaud Lavillenie of France, 2016 Olympic winner Thiago Braz of Brazil and two-time world champion Sam Kendricks of the United States.

text: Ginakabig ni House Deputy Majority Leader Lorenz Defensor nga isa ka daku nga kadulaan sa bahin sang Kamara ang duha sa ila mga kaupdanan sa prosecution panel nga wala nagdaog sa ila reelection bid.
english: House Deputy Majority Leader Lorenz Defensor considers it a big loss on the part of the House that two of their colleagues on the prosecution panel did not win their reelection bid.

text: Ini amo sanday Ako Bicol Representative Jil Bongalon kag General Santos City Representative Loreto Acharon nga ginkabos sa boto sa ila pagpadalagan liwat sa 2025 elections.
english: These are Ako Bicol Representative Jil Bongalon and General Santos City Representative Loreto Acharon who were defeated in their re-run in the 2025 elections.

text: Hulyo 30 ginalauman nga maga-umpisa ang impeachment trial batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte sa senado kasunod sang opisyal nga mga preparasyon sa pagbalik sang session sa Kongreso sa Hunyo 2.
english: The impeachment trial against Vice President Sara Duterte is expected to begin in the Senate on July 30 following official preparations for the resumption of the session in Congress on June 2.

text:
Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa Ilonggo lawmaker nga myembro man sang prosecution team, ginpahayag sini nga daku gid kuntani ang ikasarang sang duha nga iya ginlaragway nga “very competent and able lawyers.”

“They were very competent and able lawyers who would have done a very good for the prosecution,” suno kay Defensor nga isa man ka abogado.
english:
In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, the Ilonggo lawmaker, who is also a member of the prosecution team, said the two, whom he described as “very competent and able lawyers,” should have been very capable.

“They were very competent and able lawyers who would have done a very good for the prosecution,” said Defensor, who is also a lawyer.

text: Gindugang man ni Defensor ang posibilidad nga mangin private prosecutors ang duha ka mamalidha bangud mahimo sila malakip kun iimbitar gihapon sang chief prosecutor sa team bangud wala man ini ginadumilian sa trial.
english: Defensor also added the possibility that the two lawmakers will become private prosecutors because they can be included if the chief prosecutor still invites them to the team because it is not prohibited in the trial.

text: Sa pihak sini, kumpyansa man si Defensor sa abilidad nanday Congresswoman-elect Leila De Lima kag Congressman-elect Chel Diokno nga kabahin na sang gin-imbitaran ni House Speaker Martin Romualdez nga mangin myembro man sang prosecutors.
english: Meanwhile, Defensor is also confident in the abilities of Congresswoman-elect Leila De Lima and Congressman-elect Chel Diokno who are already invited by House Speaker Martin Romualdez to become members of the prosecutors.

text: “Sila ay mahuhusay na litigators, at kung willing silang tumulong sa impeachment, makakatulong sila sa pagpresenta nang maayos ng aming mga ebidensya,” dugang ni Defensor.
english: “They are good litigators, and if they are willing to help in the impeachment, they can help present our evidence properly,” Defensor added.

text: Suno pa sa iya, ang pinaka-importante amo nga mabatian sang mga Pilipino ang kaundan sang ebidensya sang prosecution amo man ang depensa sang bise-presidente.
english: He said the most important thing is that Filipinos hear the content of the prosecution's evidence as well as the vice-president's defense.

text: Importante man suno sa iya nga mabaton ang desisyon sang senator-judges.
english: He said it is also important to accept the decision of the senator-judges.

text: Nahibaluan nga si De Lima amo ang first nominee sang Mamamayang Liberal ukon ML nga ginalantaw nga makakuha sang isa ka pwesto sa Kongreso.
english: De Lima is the first nominee of the Mamamayang Liberal or ML who is expected to win a seat in Congress.

text: Nagpaguwa naman sang statement ang Akbayan partylist nga bug-os nga ila suporta sa ila first nominee nga si Diokno nga mangin kabahin sang panel.
english: The Akbayan partylist issued a statement that they fully support their first nominee, Diokno, to be part of the panel.

text: Ang Akbayan amo ang una nga grupo sa party-list race subong nga eleksyon.#
english: Akbayan is the first group in the party-list race this election.

text: Ginbasura sang huwes sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika ang classified documents case nga ginapangatubang ni anay Presidente Donald Trump.
english: A judge in the United States of America has dismissed the classified documents case facing former President Donald Trump.

text: Base sa desisyon ni Judge Aileen Cannon nga naka-base sa Florida kag gin-nominate anay ni Trump, isa ka paglapas sa layi ukon iligal ang pag-appoint kag funding kay Special Counsel Jack Smith nga amo ang nagapanguna sa prosecution.
english: Based on the ruling of Florida-based Judge Aileen Cannon, a former Trump nominee, the appointment and funding of Special Counsel Jack Smith, who is leading the prosecution, is a violation of the law or illegal.

text: Ginsaad sang judge nga wala sang otoridad si Smith nga ipasaka ang amo nga kaso, apang wala nakabutang sa desisyon sini kun legal ukon indi ang ginhimo sang anay presidente.
english: The judge promised that Smith did not have the authority to file such a case, but did not specify in his decision whether the former president's actions were legal or not.

text: “The clerk is directed to close this case,” kabahin sang 93-ka pahina nga desisyon ni Cannon.
english: “The clerk is directed to close this case,” part of Cannon’s 93-page ruling.

text: Ginalantaw nga iga-apelar sang prosecutors ang ruling sang federal judge.
english: Prosecutors are expected to appeal the federal judge's ruling.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa sini nga documents case, na-indict si Trump bangud sa ginpahayag pag-retain sang sensitibo nga national security documents sa iya Mar-a-Lago social club matapos nga nagbiya na ini sa posisyon bilang presidente sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika kag ginpunggan man sini ang government efforts agud nga makuha kuntani ang amo nga materyales.
english: In this documents case, Trump was indicted for allegedly retaining sensitive national security documents at his Mar-a-Lago social club after he resigned as president of the United States of America and for blocking government efforts to obtain the materials.

text: Ini nga desisyon sang judge ang makabig nga isa naman ka blockbuster legal victory para kay Trump kasunod man sang ruling sang Supreme Court sang Hulyo 1 kun sa diin ginsaad nga mahimo ma-enjoy sang former president ang immunity from prosecution sa “official acts” sini samtang yara siya sa posisyon.
english: The judge's decision is another blockbuster legal victory for Trump following the Supreme Court's July 1 ruling that promised the former president could enjoy immunity from prosecution for his official acts while in office.

text: Ginpaguwa ini nga desisyon kadungan man sang una nga adlaw sang Republican National Convention kun sa diin natalana nga iga-appoint si Trump bilang official candidate sang Republicans para sa 2024 presidential elections.
english: The decision was issued on the first day of the Republican National Convention where Trump is scheduled to be appointed as the Republicans' official candidate for the 2024 presidential elections.

text: Sang nagligad nga Sabado sang gab-i (Domingo sang aga sa Pilipinas) ukon isa ka adlaw antes ang convention, napilasan man si Trump sa isa ka assassination attempt sa Pennsylvania kadungan sang iya rally.#
english: Last Saturday night (Sunday morning in the Philippines) or a day before the convention, Trump was also wounded in an assassination attempt in Pennsylvania during his rally.

text: Nagaguwa sa inisyal nga report sang Iloilo City Police Station 9 nga 11 gid ka stab wounds ang naangkon sang foreman nga ginpatay sa sulod sang barracks sa Barangay Benedicto, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: According to the initial report of the Iloilo City Police Station 9, the foreman who was killed inside the barracks in Barangay Benedicto, Jaro, Iloilo City sustained 11 stab wounds.

text: Ang biktima nga foreman sa gina-construct nga multipurpose building sa barangay amo si Froilan Bernas, 63, residente sang Brgy.
english: The victim, a foreman of a multipurpose building under construction in the barangay, was identified as Froilan Bernas, 63, resident of Brgy.

text: Sooc, Arevalo.
english: Sooc, Arevalo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Patrolman Venjie Nebit, imbestigador sang Iloilo City Police Station 9, iya ginpahayag nga ini nga mga pilas ang nakit-an sa kilid, liog, kag dughan sang biktima.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Patrolman Venjie Nebit, investigator of Iloilo City Police Station 9, said the injuries were found on the side, neck, and chest of the victim.

text: Gin-athag sini nga ini pending pa sa imbestigasyon sang Scene of the Crime Operation (SOCO) team kag resulta nga ipaguwa sang Philippine National Police (PNP) crime laboratory.
english: He explained that this is still pending the investigation of the Scene of the Crime Operation (SOCO) team and the results will be released by the Philippine National Police (PNP) crime laboratory.

text: Ginatumod pa sang mga pulis kun sin-o posible ang persons of interest ilabi na bangud nagaguwa nga posible pagpangawat ang motibo sa krimen.
english: Police are still identifying possible persons of interest especially since it appears that the motive of the crime may be robbery.

text: Sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon, wala na ang cellphone kag kwarta sang biktima nga ginapahayag nga nagalab-ot sa P20,000.
english: According to initial investigation, the victim's cellphone and money allegedly amounting to P20,000 were gone.

text: Gina-imbestigaran man kun makabig nga inside job ang insidente bangud posible nakahibalo ang suspek nga nagaisahanon ang biktima sa iya kwarto kag posible nga nangin tsansa ini agud nga makapangawat.
english: It is also being investigated whether the incident was an inside job because the suspect may have known that the victim was alone in his room and it may have been a chance to steal.

text: Liwat nga nag champion sa bilog nga kalibutan ang Filipino karateka champion nga si James delos Santos.
english: Filipino karateka champion James delos Santos became world champion again.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay De Los Santos, sang Cebu City, iya ginpahayag nga pinaka ‘the best’ nga nabaton niya nga birthday gift amo ang pagdaog niya sang 1st gold medal sa 2021 SportData eTournament World Series.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, De Los Santos, of Cebu City, said the best birthday gift he received was winning the 1st gold medal in the 2021 SportData eTournament World Series.

text: Ang nasambit nga tournament ang ginakabig nga pinaka prestihiyoso nga virtual karate tournament sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: The tournament is considered the most prestigious virtual karate tournament in the world.

text: Ginlutos ni De Los Santos, ang pungsod France sa ika-16 nga round, Norway sang Quarterfinals kag Germany sang Semifinals.
english: De Los Santos defeated France in the round of 16, Norway in the quarterfinals and Germany in the semifinals.

text: Sa final round, ginlutos ni De Los Santos ang pungsod Africa.
english: In the final round, De Los Santos defeated Africa.

text: Diri kag nakuha niya ang pinakauna nga gold medal subong nga 2021.
english: It was here that he won his first gold medal in 2021.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga madamo pa siya sang tournaments subong tuig kag ang una nga gold medal ang nangin dako nga inspirasyon agud magpadayon siya sa kadalag-an.
english: He said he has many more tournaments this year and the first gold medal was a big inspiration for him to continue winning.

text: Nahibaluan nga si De Los Santos ang No.
english: De Los Santos is the No.

text: 1 sa world ranking sang Virtual Kata World Rankings sa diin nakatipon na siya sang 37 nga gold medal.
english: 1 in the world ranking of the Virtual Kata World Rankings where he has collected 37 gold medals.

text: Bangud sa COVID-19 pandemic, virtual kata tournaments na lamang ang ginapatigayon sa diin nagapasa ang mga atleta sang videos online agud i-judge sang mga referees.
english: Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, virtual kata tournaments are being conducted where athletes submit videos online to be judged by referees.

text: Nagdangat sa 3.8 million adult Filipinos ang nadulaan sang trabaho subong nga bulan sang Oktubre bangud sa pandemya.
english: A total of 3.8 million adult Filipinos lost their jobs this October due to the pandemic.

text: Santo sa record sang Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), 8.7 percent ang unemployment rate samtang, 14.4 percent naman ang underemployment rate.
english: According to the records of the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), the unemployment rate is 8.7 percent while the underemployment rate is 14.4 percent.

text: Ang National Capital Region (NCR) ang may ‘highest unemployment rate’ ukon pinakadamo nga wala sang trabaho samtang ang Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) naman ang may pinakamanubo nga numero nga nadulaan sang trabaho.
english: The National Capital Region (NCR) has the highest unemployment rate while the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) has the lowest number of unemployed.

text: Ang figures sa bulan sang Oktubre ang ginpaanggid sa 4.6 million jobless Filipinos ukon 10 percent unemployment rate nga narekord sang Hulyo.
english: The October figures were compared to the 4.6 million jobless Filipinos or 10 percent unemployment rate recorded in July.

text: Sang Oktubre 2019 ukon sa kaangay man nga bulan, 4.6 percent ang unemployment rate sa diin halos pilo ang nadulaan sang trabaho subong nga tuig.
english: In October 2019 or the same month, the unemployment rate was 4.6 percent with almost double the number of job losses this year.

text: Sang Abril, ang jobless rate ang yara sa 17.7 percent ukon kabug-usan nga 7.2 million nga unemployed nga resulta sang economic shutdown.
english: In April, the jobless rate was 17.7 percent or a total of 7.2 million unemployed as a result of the economic shutdown.

text: Samtang, sa independent survey naman sang Social Weather Stations (SWS), nagdangat sa 39.5 percent ukon 23.7 million Filipino ang nadulaan sang trabaho sang Oktubre.
english: Meanwhile, in an independent survey by the Social Weather Stations (SWS), 39.5 percent or 23.7 million Filipinos lost their jobs in October.

text: Ang PSA kag SWS ang nagagamit sang nagalain-lain nga metrics sa pag-isip sang unemployment.
english: The PSA and SWS use different metrics to calculate unemployment.

text: Ang unemployment ang nagtaas subong nga tuig umpisa sang nagpatuman ang gobyerno sang world’s longest and strictest lockdowns humalin sang Marso tubtub Hunyo nga isa ka tikang agud mapunggan ang pagdamo sang COVID-19 cases.
english: Unemployment has risen this year since the government implemented the world's longest and strictest lockdowns from March to June as a measure to curb the increase in COVID-19 cases.

text: Ginabanta nga P2-million ang balor sang iligal nga droga ang nakumpiskar sang otoridad kasunod sang isa ka drug buy bust operation sa Barangay Sto.
english: An estimated P2-million worth of illegal drugs were seized by the authorities following a drug buy bust operation in Barangay Sto.

text:
Domingo, Arevalo, Iloilo City subong nga gab-i.

Duha ang nadakpan nga amo sanday alias Roel, residente sang amo nga barangay, kag alyas Tan, residente sang Tanza Baybay, City Proper, magbayaw, lunsay gina-identify nga High Value Individuals (HVIs).
english:
Sunday, Arevalo, Iloilo City tonight.

Two were arrested, alias Roel, resident of the said barangay, and alias Tan, resident of Tanza Baybay, City Proper, brother-in-law, both identified as High Value Individuals (HVIs).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Glenn Soliman, chief sang Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit-6, iya ginpahayag nga 250 gramos ang ila una nga nakumpiskar sa possession sang duha nga katumbas sang P1.7-million.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Glenn Soliman, chief of the Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit-6, said they initially seized 250 grams of heroin from the possession of the two, equivalent to P1.7-million.

text: Samtang nagapadayon ang inventory, nagkooperar ang asawa ni alias Roel kag nagpanugid nga may dugang pa nga iligal nga droga sa ila nga balay.
english: While the inventory was ongoing, alias Roel's wife cooperated and told him that there were more illegal drugs in their house.

text: Gin-turn over ini sa kapulisan kag santo sa inisyal nga pahayag ni Soliman, nagalab-ot ini sa halos 50 grams nga nagadalagan sa balor nga P340,000.
english: It was turned over to the police and according to Soliman's initial statement, it amounted to almost 50 grams worth P340,000.

text: Pahayag sang RPDEU chief, may rekord na si alias Tan nga nadakpan man sang una bangud sa iligal nga droga, samtang ini naman ang una nga bes nga nadakpan si alias Roel.
english: The RPDEU chief said alias Tan has a record of being arrested for illegal drugs, while this is the first time alias Roel has been arrested.

text: Natalana nga mag-atubang ang duha sa panumbungon nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon sa Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: The two are scheduled to face charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Ginpabasura ni Sen.
english: Dismissed by Sen.

text: Rodante Marcoleta, pinaagi sa isa ka mosyon ang impeachment case batok kay Vice Pres.
english: Rodante Marcoleta, through a motion the impeachment case against Vice Pres.

text: Sara Duterte.
english: Sara Duterte.

text: Sa iya privilege speech sa plenaryo sang Senado, ginpahayag sini nga nagpagguwa sang statement ang Korte Supreman nga unconstitutional ang articles of impeachment batok kay VP Sara.
english: In his privilege speech to the Senate plenary, he said the Supreme Court issued a statement that the articles of impeachment against VP Sara are unconstitutional.

text: Suno pa sa Senador, wala man sang palakadtuan kun hulaton pa ang motion for reconsideration nga gin-file sang Kamara sa articles of impeachment batok sa Bise bangud “immediately executory” ang desisyon sang Korte Suprema.
english: The senator said there is no point in waiting for the motion for reconsideration filed by the House of Representatives on the articles of impeachment against the Vice because the Supreme Court's decision is “immediately executory”.

text: Pahayag pa niya, bangud unanimous ang desisyon sang mga mahistrado nga unconstitutional ang impeachment case batok sa Bise, possible na nga may isa ka mahistrado ang magbawi sang iya desisyon.
english: He said that since the judges unanimously decided that the impeachment case against the Vice is unconstitutional, it is possible for a judge to withdraw his decision.

text: Dugang pa niya, kun ginsiling sang Korte Suprema nga “void ab initio” kag “unconstitutional,” pati pwertahan kag bintana, ang ginsarado na para sa bisan ano nga apela.
english: He added that if the Supreme Court says “void ab initio” and “unconstitutional,” even the doors and windows are closed for any appeal.

text: Samtang, ginpamatukan naman ni Senate Minority Leader Tito Sotto ang mosyon ni Marcoleta bangud may yara pa sang motion for reconsideration ang Kamara.
english: Meanwhile, Senate Minority Leader Tito Sotto opposed Marcoleta's motion because the House still has a motion for reconsideration.

text: Suno pa sa iya, apisar immediately executory ang desisyon sang SC, indi pa ini sagihapon ang final.
english: He said that although the SC's decision is immediately executory, it is not yet final.

text: Ginaduso ni House Deputy Speaker Mikee Romero sa gobyerno nga dal-on sa prayoridad sa COVID-19 vaccination program ang mga atleta nga Pinoy nga magapasakop sa Tokyo Olympics kag 2021 Southeast Asian Games sa Hanoi, Vietnam.
english: House Deputy Speaker Mikee Romero urged the government to prioritize Filipino athletes who will participate in the Tokyo Olympics and 2021 Southeast Asian Games in Hanoi, Vietnam.

text: Paagi sa House Resolution No.
english: Through House Resolution No.

text: 1507, nagpanawagan si Romero sa Inter-Agency Task Force for the Management of Emerging Infectious Diseases kag sa iban pa nga ahensya sang gobyerno nga kabigon bilang “frontliners” ang mga atleta agud nga madala sila sa una nga mabakunahan batok sa COVID-19.
english: 1507, Romero called on the Inter-Agency Task Force for the Management of Emerging Infectious Diseases and other government agencies to consider athletes as “frontliners” so that they can be the first to be vaccinated against COVID-19.

text: Matandaan nga una na nagpahayag si vaccine czar Carlito Galvez Jr.
english: It can be recalled that vaccine czar Carlito Galvez Jr.

text: nga 50 million tubton 70 million ka tawo ang target nga mabakunahan sa sulod sang isa ka tuig kag magaumpisa ang vaccination sa Pebrero 20.
english: that 50 million to 70 million people are targeted to be vaccinated within a year and vaccination will begin on February 20.

text: Suno naman kay Romero, mapaidalom na ang national athletes sa qualifying stages sang Tokyo Olympics kag SEA Games sa Abril kag Mayo 2021.
english: Romero said the national athletes will be subjected to the qualifying stages of the Tokyo Olympics and SEA Games in April and May 2021.

text: Importante suno sa natungdan nga temprano pa sila nga mabakunahan agud makapasakop sila sa qualifying stages.
english: He said it is important that they are vaccinated early so that they can participate in the qualifying stages.

text: Posible nga sa Pebrero ukon sa Marso pa makapagwa sang desisyon ang mga organizers sang Tokyo Olympics kun pahagutan na ang mga tawo nga live nga magalantaw sang mga hampang sa Olympics.
english: It is possible that the organizers of the Tokyo Olympics will issue a decision in February or March on whether people will be allowed to watch the Olympic games live.

text: Matandaan nga gindesisyunan sang Japanese government kag sang International Olympic Committee nga ipaiway anay ang 2020 Olympics bangud sa pandemya amo nga ginhalin ini sa Hulyo 2021.
english: It can be recalled that the Japanese government and the International Olympic Committee decided to postpone the 2020 Olympics due to the pandemic so it was postponed to July 2021.

text: Subong nga tuig, nagapanindugan ang mga organizers nga dayunon na ang aktibidad apisar padayon nga nagataas ang kaso sang COVID-19 sa Japan kag apisar may anunsyo ang gobyerno nga palawigon ang state of emergency bangud sa wala untat nga paglaton sang balatian.
english: This year, the organizers insist on continuing the activity despite the continuous increase in COVID-19 cases in Japan and despite the government's announcement to extend the state of emergency due to the continuous spread of the disease.

text: Bangud sini, may mga ticket holders na nga nagpahayag nga indi na sila maglantaw gani nga nagaapply na sila para sa refund.
english: Because of this, some ticket holders have already said they will not watch the show and are applying for a refund.

text: Suno naman kay Tokyo 2020 Organizing Committee President Yoshiro Mori, tuman ka budlay ang pagdesisyon para sa ila gani lauman nga sa masunod nga bulan pa isapubliko ang ila nga desisyon.
english: Tokyo 2020 Organizing Committee President Yoshiro Mori said the decision was very difficult for them and they expect their decision to be made public next month.

text: Una diri, nagpahayag na si senior International Olympics Committee member Dick Pound nga dapat hatagan sang priority access ang mga atleta sa bakuna agud madayon ang ila Games sa Hulyo 23.
english: Earlier, senior International Olympics Committee member Dick Pound said athletes should be given priority access to the vaccine to hold their Games on July 23.

text: Ginakabig ni Retired Police Major Charlie Sustento nga kadalag-an ang pagboto sa iya sang malapit 80,000 ka mga pumuluyo sa 4th District of Iloilo.
english: Retired Police Major Charlie Sustento considers it a victory to be voted for by nearly 80,000 residents in the 4th District of Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Sustento, iya ginpahayag nga apisar nga nalutos siya sa pagka-congressman ginakabig gihapon niya ini nga isa ka dako nga kadalag-an para sa kandidato nga kaangay niya nga wala man sang kwarta nga ginpanagtag sa tawo agod lamang nga magboto sa iya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Sustento said that despite losing the congressman seat, he still considers it a big victory for a candidate like him who did not distribute money to people just to vote for him.

text: Suno pa kay Sustento, ini nagapkita lamang ang pagpalangga kag pagsalig sang mga Cuarto Distrito sa iya kag sa paglaum sang mga ini para sa bag-o nga istilo sang panghimanwa nga iya kuntani ginatanyag.
english: According to Sustento, this only shows the love and trust of the Cuarto Distrito for him and their hope for the new style of citizenship that he would have offered.

text: Bangud sini, nagpasalamat si Sustento sa mga nagsakdag sa iya kandidatura bisan pa nga liwat nga nangin madinalag-on ang iya kasumpong nga si incumbent 4th district Congressman Ferj Biron.
english: Sustento thanked those who supported his candidacy despite the victory of his opponent, incumbent 4th district Congressman Ferj Biron.

text: Apang, gin-athag man ni Sustento nga bisan pa nga may kwarta siya, indi man niya ini gihapon pag-usaron sa pagpamakal sang boto bangud ang amo nga buluhaton ang madugay naman niya nga ginapamatukan bilang isa ka police officer.
english: However, Sustento explained that even if he has money, he will not use it to buy votes because he has long opposed such activities as a police officer.

text: Dugang pa niya nga ang kadamuon sang boto nga iya nabaton, isa ka pamatuod nga amat-amat na nga nagabugtaw ang mga taga-Cuatro Distrito sa indi maayo nga pagdumala sa ila nga lugar.
english: He added that the number of votes he received is proof that the people of Cuatro District are slowly waking up to the poor management of their area.

text: Ginpakamaayo sang organizers nga ikansela ang All-Star Game sa Japan B. League bangud sa pagtaas sang kaso sang COVID-19 cases.
english: Organizers have decided to cancel the All-Star Game in the Japan B. League due to the increase in COVID-19 cases.

text: Hiwaton kuntani ang All-Star event sa Enero 15 tubtob Enero 16 sa Mito, Japan apang bangud sa padayon nga pagtaas sang kaso sang virus, ginkansela na lang ang event agud masiguro ang ikaayong lawas sang tanan.
english: The All-Star event was scheduled to be held from January 15 to January 16 in Mito, Japan but due to the continuous increase in cases of the virus, the event was canceled to ensure the health of all.

text: Magapakita man kuntani sang abilidad sa Slam Dunk Contest si San-En NeoPhoenix standout Thirdy Ravena apang ginkakas ini sa lineup matapos makaangkon sang injury.
english: San-En NeoPhoenix standout Thirdy Ravena was also scheduled to compete in the Slam Dunk Contest but was removed from the lineup after suffering an injury.

text: Doble subong ang paghalong ni Ravena agud malikawan nga matapikan liwat sang COVID-19.
english: Ravena is now taking double precautions to avoid being infected again with COVID-19.

text: Matandaan nga sang Nobyembre na-infect man ini sang virus.
english: It can be recalled that in November he was also infected with the virus.

text: Bug-os ang pagbaton ni Iloilo City Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon sa iya nangin kalutusan sa pagka-bise alcalde sa bag-o lang natapos nga eleksyon.
english: Iloilo City Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon has fully accepted his defeat for the vice mayoralty in the recently concluded elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ganzon, outgoing Vice Mayor sang Iloilo City, iya ginpahayag nga hugot sa iya tagipusuon kag iya ginarespeto ang nangin desisyon sang pumuluyo sang syudad sang Iloilo ilabi kag labaw sa tanan sa kun ano ang kabubut- on sang Ginoo sa iya kabuhi.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Ganzon, outgoing Vice Mayor of Iloilo City, said he respects the decision of the people of Iloilo City especially and above all in what is the will of the Lord in his life.

text: Nagalaom siya nga mapadayon ang maayo nga pagserbisyo sa pumuluyo sang mga katapo sang Sangguniang Panlungsod sa pagpamuno ni Vice Mayor Elect Love Love Baronda.
english: He hopes that the members of the Sangguniang Panlungsod under the leadership of Vice Mayor Elect Love Love Baronda will continue to serve the people well.

text: Nagapasalig man ini sa mga pumuluyo nga apisar nga wala siya ginhatagan sang kahigayunan nga padayunon ang iya serbisyo, magapabilin sa gihapon ang iya pagpalangga sa mga pumuluyo sang syudad sang Iloilo.
english: He also assured the people that although he was not given the opportunity to continue his service, his love for the people of Iloilo City will remain.

text: Nagapasalamat man si Ganzon sang mga tawo nga padayon nga nagasalig kag nagasuporta sa iya ilabi na sa pila ka tuig niya nga pagserbisyo sa syudad.
english: Ganzon also thanked the people who continue to trust and support him especially during his years of service to the city.

text: Nakaistoryahanay na sanday United States President Joe Biden kag si anay Presidente Donald Trump kasunod sang natabo sa rally sa Pennsylvania nga ginkapilas gid sang dulunggan sang Republican presumptive presidential nominee.
english: United States President Joe Biden and former President Donald Trump have held talks following the incident at a rally in Pennsylvania that seriously injured the ear of the Republican presumptive presidential nominee.

text: Suno kay Biden, nalipay siya nga maayo na subong ang kondisyon sang iya kasumpong kag naga-recover naman kasunod sang amo nga assassination attempt.
english: Biden said he is pleased that his opponent is now in good condition and recovering following the assassination attempt.

text: Sa iya video statement, liwat nga ginkondena ni Biden ang amo nga krimen kag nagpanawagan man sa Americans nga mag-isa.
english: In his video statement, Biden again condemned the crime and also called on Americans to unite.

text: “Unity is the most elusive goal of all, but nothing is more important than that right now: unity.
english: “Unity is the most elusive goal of all, but nothing is more important than that right now: unity.

text: We’ll debate and we’ll disagree.
english: We’ll debate and we’ll disagree.

text: That’s not going to change.
english: That’s not going to change.

text: But we’re not going to lose sight of who we are as Americans,” suno sa presidente.
english: But we’re not going to lose sight of who we are as Americans,” the president said.

text: Ginmandu man sini ang pag-review sang seguridad sa rally kun sa diin napilasan si Trump ilabi na bangud nagaulan ang mga pamangkot kun ngaa nakalusot ang shooter apisar una naman ginpahayag nga hugot man ang seguridad.
english: He also ordered a review of security at the rally where Trump was wounded especially as questions are rained over why the shooter escaped despite earlier statements that security was tight.

text: “There is no place in America for this kind of violence or any violence for that matter.
english: “There is no place in America for this kind of violence or any violence for that matter.

text: An assassination attempt is contrary to everything we stand for…as a nation—everything,” dugang sini.
english: An assassination attempt is contrary to everything we stand for…as a nation—everything,” it added.

text: Ginakonsiderar man subong nga i-kansela ang natalana nga pagbisita ni Biden sa Lyndon B. Johnson presidential library sa Austin, Texas kun sa diin natalana siya maghatag sang speech sa landmark Civil Rights Act nga ginpirmahan ni Johnson sang 1960s.
english: Biden is also considering canceling his scheduled visit to the Lyndon B. Johnson presidential library in Austin, Texas where he was scheduled to deliver a speech on the landmark Civil Rights Act signed by Johnson in the 1960s.

text: Base sa political strategists, ang shooting ang may daku gid nga epekto sa dalagan sang eleksyon sa USA ilabi na bangud natabo ini sa election battleground state of Pennsylvania kun sa diin nagdaog si Biden batok kay Trump sang 2020.
english: According to political strategists, the shooting will have a huge impact on the course of the election in the USA especially because it happened in the election battleground state of Pennsylvania where Biden won against Trump in 2020.

text: Matandaan nga sa Butler Country sa Pennsylvania, isa ang patay kag duha ang napilasan bangud sa pagpangluthang sang suspek nga ginkilala nga si Thomas Matthew Crooks, 20-anyos, residente sang Bethel Park sa amo man nga estado.
english: In Butler Country, Pennsylvania, one person was killed and two others were injured in a shooting incident identified as Thomas Matthew Crooks, 20, resident of Bethel Park in the same state.

text: Sang ulihi, ang amo nga gunman ang napatay man sa kamot sang Secret Service agents.
english: Later, the gunman was also killed by Secret Service agents.

text: Base sa satellite images, naka-posisyon ang shooter sang ginabanta 490 ka tapak halin sa stage sang ginhimo sini ang amo nga assassination attempt batok kay Trump.
english: Based on satellite images, the shooter was positioned about 490 feet from the stage when he carried out the assassination attempt against Trump.

text: Nagaguwa sa imbestigasyon nga isa ka kitchen worker ang suspek kag may dala nga AR-style rifle sang ginhimo sini ang krimen.
english: Investigation revealed that the suspect was a kitchen worker and was carrying an AR-style rifle when he committed the crime.

text: Base sa state voter records, nakit-an nga isa ini ka rehistrado nga Republican kag gin-report man nga naka-donate sang $15 ukon masobra P800 sa liberal campaign group nga ActBlue sang 2021.
english: Based on state voter records, he was found to be a registered Republican and also reportedly donated $15 or more than P800 to the liberal campaign group ActBlue in 2021.

text: Sandig sa US media reports, sang tion nga ginhimo sini ang krimen, nagasuksok si Crooks sang T-shirt halin sa Demolition Ranch, isa ka YouTube channel nga kilala sa mga content sini kaangot sa mga armas kag explosive devices.
english: According to US media reports, at the time of the crime, Crooks was wearing a T-shirt from Demolition Ranch, a YouTube channel known for its content related to weapons and explosive devices.

text: Ginapatihan man sang otoridad nga ang pusil nga gingamit agud tiruhon si Trump ang ginbakal sang amay sang suspek anum ka bulan na ang nagligad.
english: Authorities also believe the gun used to shoot Trump was purchased by the suspect's father six months ago.

text: Pila ka oras matapos ang shooting sa Trump rally, ginpahayag man sang law enforcers nga may nakit-an nga makaduluda nga mga device ukon mga materyales sa paghimo sang bomba nga yara sa salakyan kag balay sang suspek.
english: Hours after the shooting at the Trump rally, law enforcement also said suspicious devices or bomb-making materials were found in the suspect's car and house.

text: Padayon pa subong ang imbestigasyon sang otoridad kun ano gid ang motibo sini kag kun ini ang naangot na sa pulitika.
english: Authorities are still investigating the motive of the incident and whether it was politically motivated.

english: Ozamis Archbishop Martin Jumoad previously closed St.

text: John the Baptist Parish sa Jimenez, Misamis Occidental.
english: John the Baptist Parish in Jimenez, Misamis Occidental.

text: Ini matapos ang ginhimo sang bastos nga vlogger nga nagdupla sa holy water font sang simbahan.
english: This was after the rude vlogger spit on the church's holy water font.

text: Nagapadayon pa subong ang imbestigasyon sa insidente.
english: The investigation into the incident is still ongoing.

english:

It will only be reopened after the Rites of Reparation to restore the dignity and holiness of the parish.

text: Magahiwat naman sang Holy Hour kag Pagkumpisar bwas, Agusto 7 bilang pagpakita sang paghinulsol kag pagpangayo sang kapatawaran sa Mahal nga Makaako.
english: Holy Hour and Confession will be held tomorrow, August 7, as an expression of repentance and asking for forgiveness from the Almighty.

text: Ang ginhimo sang vlogger sa kagamitan nga sagrado ang ginakabig nga dako nga sala sa idalom sang Canon Law.
english: What the vlogger did with the sacred object is considered a serious sin under Canon Law.

text: Hugot nga ginkondenar ni Senador Robinhood Padilla ang padayon nga mass killings sa Gaza kag nagpanawagan sa gobyerno sang Israel nga respetuhon kag protektahan ang mga humanitarian personnel, amo man ang pagpasulod sang bulig para sa mga sibilyan nga Palestino.
english: Senator Robinhood Padilla strongly condemned the ongoing mass killings in Gaza and called on the Israeli government to respect and protect humanitarian personnel, as well as the introduction of aid for Palestinian civilians.

text: Sa iya nga privilege speech sa plenaryo sang Senado, ginpahayag ni Padilla nga dapat ipalab-ot sa Israel paagi sa diplomasiya ang katuyuan sang Pilipinas nga maghimo sang humanitarian mission para sa mga biktima sang krisis sa Gaza.
english: In his privilege speech to the Senate plenary, Padilla said the Philippines' intention to establish a humanitarian mission for the victims of the Gaza crisis should be conveyed to Israel through diplomacy.

text: Kaangot sini, nag-file si Padilla sang resolusyon nga nagapanawagan sa Israel nga sundon ang mga obligasyon sini sa idalom sang international humanitarian law.
english: In this regard, Padilla filed a resolution calling on Israel to comply with its obligations under international humanitarian law.

text: Hugot man nga ginkondenar sang senador ang indi makatawo nga pagtratar sa mga sibilyan sa Gaza.
english: The senator also strongly condemned the inhumane treatment of civilians in Gaza.

text: Dayunon ni anay United States President Donald Trump ang pagpadulong sa Milwaukee sa state sang Wisconsin subong nga adlaw apisar pa sang assassination attempt batok sa iya kadungan sang iya rally sa Pennsylvania ‘las sais sang Sabado sang gab-i oras sa amo nga estado (ukon ‘las sais kahapon sang aga oras sa Pilipinas).
english: Former US President Donald Trump will continue his visit to Milwaukee in the state of Wisconsin today despite the assassination attempt against him during his rally in Pennsylvania at 6 pm Saturday night (or 6 am yesterday Philippine time).

text: Suno kay Trump, indi sini matugutan ang anuman nga sirkumstansya, ang shooter, ukon ang potential nga assassin nga i-delay ang iya schedule sa pagtambong sa Republican National Convention.
english: Trump said he could not let any circumstance, the shooter, or the potential assassin delay his schedule to attend the Republican National Convention.

text: Sa amo nga convention sa Milwaukee, natalana niya nga batunon ang nomination sang Republican Party bilang opisyal nga kandidato sa pagka-presidente sa 2024 elections kag natalana man nga iga-anunsyo ang iya mangin runningmate.
english: At the convention in Milwaukee, he is scheduled to accept the Republican Party's nomination as the official presidential candidate for the 2024 elections and is also scheduled to announce his runningmate.

text: Nakatalana naman ang iya speech sa Huwebes.
english: His speech is scheduled for Thursday.
