text: Handa na si Vice Mayor-elect Love-Love Baronda nga ipaiway ang pulitika kag magtutok sa trabaho sa tion nga makapungko na sa pwesto kaupod ang mga bag-o nga gin-ileher nga mga lideres sang syudad sang Iloilo.
english: Vice Mayor-elect Love-Love Baronda is ready to put politics aside and focus on work once he takes office with the newly elected leaders of Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Baronda, iya ginpahayag nga tama gid kadako ang iya pagpasalamat sa tanan nga mga Ilonggo nga naghatag sang suporta kag pagsalig sa iya pagpadalagan bilang bise-alcalde.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Baronda said he is very grateful to all Ilonggos who gave their support and confidence in his run for vice-mayor.

text: Suno sa iya, wala gid nagbiya ang mga pumuluyo sang syudad sa iya halin pa sang una, kag sa sining piniliay, liwat nga ginpakita ang ila pagsalig kag paglaom sa iya liderato.
english: He said the people of the city have never abandoned him since the beginning, and in this election, they have once again shown their trust and hope in his leadership.

text: Dugang pa niya, excited na siya nga magserbisyo kaupod ang iban pa nga mga lideres nga nagdalaog sa tagsa-tagsa ka posisyon.
english: He added that he is excited to serve alongside other leaders who won their respective positions.

text: Ginkilala man niya ang kabudlay sang mga nagpanindugan nga magsuporta sa iya kag sa Team Sulong Gugma.
english: He also acknowledged the hard work of those who insisted on supporting him and Team Sulong Gugma.

text: Nagpalab-ot man sang mensahe si Baronda sa iya kasumpong nga si outgoing Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon nga kuntani magnami na ang ila relasyon kag ang iya respeto yara sa gihapon sa pihak sang wala pag-ilintindihanay sa panahon sang kampanya.
english: Baronda also conveyed a message to his opponent, outgoing Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon, that he hopes that their relationship will improve and that his respect is still there despite the misunderstanding during the campaign period.

text: Nagnubo sang 7.2% ang crime rate sa bug-os nga Western Visayas kun basehan ang una nga lima ka bulan ukon ang Enero-tubtob Mayo 2024 nga report sang Police Regional Office (PRO) VI.
english: The crime rate in Western Visayas decreased by 7.2% based on the first five months or the January-to-May 2024 report of the Police Regional Office (PRO) VI.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Police Lt.

text: Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson sang PRO VI, iya ginpahayag nga yara sa 4,820 ka mga krimen nga nagluntad sa amo nga period subong nga tuig nga mas manubo sa 5,194 nga amo nga tion sang 2023.
english: Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson of PRO VI, said there were 4,820 crimes that occurred in the same period this year, which is lower than the 5,194 in the same period in 2023.

text: Lakip diri ang walo ka specific crimes ukon focus crimes bangud sa ila severity (murder, homicide, physical injury, rape, robbery, theft, motor vehicle theft, and motorcycle theft) sa diin may yara sang 958 ka mga kaso ipaanggid sa 1,197 sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: These include eight specific crimes or focus crimes due to their severity (murder, homicide, physical injury, rape, robbery, theft, motor vehicle theft, and motorcycle theft) with 958 cases compared to 1,197 last year.

text: Ang index nga mas seryoso kag may impact sa public safety ang may 19.88% nga buhin — halin sa 1,202 sang 2023 panubo sa 963 sang 2024.
english: The index, which is more serious and has an impact on public safety, will see a 19.88% reduction — from 1,202 in 2023 down to 963 in 2024.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nagnubo sang 3.38 percent ang non-index crimes kaangay sang illegal drugs kag gambling.
english: Meanwhile, non-index crimes such as illegal drugs and gambling decreased by 3.38 percent.

text: Nagapati ang PRO VI nga resulta na ini sang mas madamo nga personnel sa field kag sa strategic areas kag sa bulig man sang local government units, force multipliers, advocacy support groups, kag iban pa nga nagabulig sa otoridad para mapabilin ang kalinong sa rehiyon.
english: PRO VI believes that this is the result of more personnel in the field and in strategic areas and also with the help of local government units, force multipliers, advocacy support groups, and others who are helping the authorities to maintain peace in the region.

text: Malapit tunga sa million nga balor sang druga, nakumpiskar sa ginpatigayon nga drug buy-bust operation sang Iloilo City Police Office – City Drug Enforcement Unit (ICPO-CDEU) sa Barangay Sto.
english: Nearly half a million worth of drugs were seized in a drug buy-bust operation conducted by the Iloilo City Police Office-City Drug Enforcement Unit (ICPO-CDEU) in Barangay Sto.

english: The subjects were identified as Rodel Magampo y Juson, 39, construction worker, and Norberto Faunillo Jr.

english: y Guillermo, 38, tricycle driver, both residents of Barangay San Juan, Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, Office-in-charge sang unit, iya ginpahayag nga nadakpan ang mga subject sa bulig sang Body Worn Camera (BWC) kun sa diin nadokumentuhan ang operasyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, Office-in-charge of the unit, said the suspects were arrested with the help of a Body Worn Camera (BWC) which documented the operation.

text:
Suno kay Inot, na-recover sa pag-hinakop sang mga subject ang ginabulubanta 65 grams nga suspected shabu nga may standard drug price nga 442,000.00 kag iban pa nga drug paraphernalia

Dugang pa ni Inot, na-monitor sang mga kapulisan nga may yara sang connection ang mga nagkaladakpan nga mga subject sa Muntinlupa kun sa diin amo ang ila nga source of iilegal drugs.
english:
According to Inot, 65 grams of suspected shabu with a standard drug price of 442,000.00 and other drug paraphernalia were recovered from the suspects.

Inot added that the police monitored that the arrested subjects have a connection to Muntinlupa which is their source of illegal drugs.

text: Ang mga nakumpiskar nga mga illegal droga ang igaturn-over sa PNP Iloilo Forensic Unit para sa nagakaigo nga imbistigasyon.
english: The seized illegal drugs will be turned over to the PNP Iloilo Forensic Unit for proper investigation.

text: Sa subong, yara na sa kustodiya sang Iloilo City Police Station 6 ang mga subject kag nagapangatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: The suspects are now in the custody of Iloilo City Police Station 6 and are facing charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Tugaplak ang trust kag performance ratings sang Senado sa second quarter sang Tugon ng Masa (TNM) survey sang OCTA Research.
english: The trust and performance ratings of the Senate in the second quarter of the Tugon ng Masa (TNM) survey by OCTA Research are up.

text: Ginpatigayon ini nga survey sang Hulyo 12 tubtob 17 kag may 1,200 respondents.
english: The survey was conducted from July 12 to 17 and had 1,200 respondents.

text: Suno sa OCTA, yara sa 49% lamang ang trust rating sang Senado sang Hulyo.
english: According to OCTA, the Senate's trust rating was only 49% in July.

text: Ini ang mas manubo sa 57% sang Nobyembre 2024.
english: This is down from 57% by November 2024.

text: Nagsarurot man ang performance rating sang Senado, halin sa 53%, nangin 47% ini.
english: The Senate's performance rating also declined, from 53% to 47%.

text: Suno sa res­pondents, undecided sila sa trust kag satisfaction sa trabaho sa Senado.
english: According to the respondents, they are undecided on trust and job satisfaction in the Senate.

text: Samtang, nagtaas naman ang trust ratings sang Kamara sa 57% sang Hul­yo, mas mataas sa 49% sang Nobyembre 2024.
english: Meanwhile, the House’s trust ratings rose to 57% in July, up from 49% in November 2024.

text: Nagsaka man sa 55% ang performance rating sang Kamara sa nasambit nga bulan kumparar sa 47% sang nagligad.
english: The performance rating of the House also rose to 55% in the said month compared to 47% last year.

text: Nalakip na man si American Interim World Boxing Council (WBC) lightweight champion Ryan Garcia sa malaba nga listahan nga luyag makasumpong si eight-division world champion Manny Pacquiao.
english: American Interim World Boxing Council (WBC) lightweight champion Ryan Garcia has also joined the long list of eight-division world champion Manny Pacquiao.

text: Sang Enero 3 lang natapos ang hampang ni Garcia matapos nangin madinalag-on pinaagi sa seventh-round knockout batuk kay Luke Campbell sang Great Britain.
english: Garcia's fight ended on January 3 after a seventh-round knockout victory over Great Britain's Luke Campbell.

text: Gani mas nagka-interes ini nga hangkaton si Pacquiao nga ginakabig sini idolo sa patag sang boxing.
english: So he became more interested in challenging Pacquiao, whom he considers an idol in the field of boxing.

text: Luyag ni Garcia nga mangin kabahin sang boxing career sang Pinoy champion antes ini magretiro.
english: Garcia wants to be part of the Pinoy champion's boxing career before he retires.

text: Yara sa lightweight division si Garcia samtang yara sa bantamweight class naman si Pacquiao.
english: Garcia is in the lightweight division while Pacquiao is in the bantamweight class.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagapanguna sa listahan si Ultimate Fighting Championship superstar Conor McGregor nga ginalauman nga makasambuwa ni Pacquiao subong nga tuig sa Middle East.
english: Ultimate Fighting Championship superstar Conor McGregor is expected to face Pacquiao this year in the Middle East.

text: Nakabaton na sang green light nga makahampang liwat si San Miguel superstar June Mar Fajardo — malapit isa ka tuig ang nakaligad matapos nga nagsuprer ini sang fracture sa iya natuo nga tiil.
english: San Miguel superstar June Mar Fajardo has received the green light to play again — nearly a year after she suffered a fracture in her right leg.

text: Suno kay San Miguel Corp.
english: According to San Miguel Corp.

text: sports director Alfrancis Chua, kinahanglan na nga maghanda si Fajardo para sa panibag-o nga season sang Philippine Basketball Association.
english: sports director Alfrancis Chua, Fajardo needs to prepare for the new season of the Philippine Basketball Association.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang Pebrero 3, 2020 sang nag-suprer sang fracture si Fajardo samtang naga-hanas ang iya nga team.
english: It was learned that on February 3, 2020, Fajardo suffered a fracture while training with his team.

text: Gin-ako naman ni Chua nga ang absence ni Fajardo ang isa ka game-changer indi lamang sa San Miguel kundi sa bilog nga liga.
english: Chua acknowledged that Fajardo's absence is a game-changer not only for San Miguel but for the entire league.

text: MANILA – Ginkumpirma sang Bureau of Treasury nga nagdangat sa P3.22 trillion ang utang sang gobyerno humalin sang Enero tubtub Oktubre subong nga tuig bangud sa COVID-19 response.
english: MANILA – The Bureau of Treasury confirmed that the government's debt reached P3.22 trillion from January to October this year due to the COVID-19 response.

text: Suno kay National Treasurer Rosalia de Leon, nagsaka sa 233% ang utang sang gobyerno sa una nga 10 ka bulan subong nga tuig.
english: According to National Treasurer Rosalia de Leon, the government's debt rose by 233% in the first 10 months of this year.

text: Ini ang mas mataas kun ipaanggid sa P967.56 nga utang sang gobyerno sa kaangay man nga binulan sang 2019.
english: This is higher compared to the P967.56 government debt in the same month of 2019.

text: Sa nasambit nga kantidad, P2.65 billion ang naghalin sa domestic lenders kag ang nabilin nga P574.44 billion ang naghalin sa external creditors.
english: Of the said amount, P2.65 billion came from domestic lenders and the remaining P574.44 billion came from external creditors.

text: Ang gross domestic nga utang sang gobyerno ang ginalakipan sang P420.31 billion sa Treasury bills, P561.91 billion sa Treasury bonds, P827.11 billion sa Retail Treasury Bonds, kag P840 billion sa short-term loans sa Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP).
english: The government's gross domestic debt includes P420.31 billion in Treasury bills, P561.91 billion in Treasury bonds, P827.11 billion in Retail Treasury Bonds, and P840 billion in short-term loans to the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP).

text: Sa utang naman sa luwas sang pungsod, ini ang ginalakipan sang P364.64 billions sa program loans kag P23.73 billion sa project loans halin sa bilateral kag multilateral partners.
english: As for foreign debt, it includes P364.64 billion in program loans and P23.73 billion in project loans from bilateral and multilateral partners.

text: Ang Foreign debt ang ginalakipan man sang P67.33 billion funds nga natipon halin sa euro bond sang Pebrero kag P118.74 billion sa global bonds.
english: Foreign debt also includes P67.33 billion in funds raised from euro bonds in February and P118.74 billion in global bonds.

text: Natumod na ang pila ka indibidwal kag korporasyon nga involved sa kurapsyon sa Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) kag malapit na nga i-ban sa mga proyekto sang gobyerno.
english: Several individuals and corporations involved in corruption in the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) have been identified and are about to be banned from government projects.

text: Sa pinakaulihi nga podcast episode ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., apisar wala ginpangalanan kun sin-o ang ginatumod nga contractors, ginpahayag sini nga lapit na lang nga pasakaan sang kaso ang mga indibidwal kag mga kum­paniya nga involved sa substandard projects.
english: In the latest podcast episode of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., although he did not name the contractors, he said that individuals and companies involved in substandard projects will soon be prosecuted.

text: Suno sa Presidente, yara na sa iya ang mga pangalan sang mga tawo nga responsable sa mga palpak nga flood-control projects nga rason sang pagbinaha sa pungsod.
english: The President said he already has the names of the people responsible for the failed flood-control projects that caused the flooding in the country.

text: Nagpaandam man ini nga pasabton sa layi ang sin-o man nga mapamatud-an nga guilty bisan pa matag-as ang ila posisyon sa gobyerno.
english: He also warned that anyone found guilty will be held accountable even if they hold high positions in the government.

text:
Siniguro ng National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) na magiging patas ang kanilang imbestigasyon laban sa 12 Pulis na dawit sa kaso ng mga missing sabungero’s.

Kung maaalala, pinatawan ng komisyon ang nasabing bilang ng mga pulis ng 90 days preventive suspension.
english:
The National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) has assured that their investigation against the 12 policemen involved in the missing sabungero's case will be fair.

If remembered, the commission gave the said number of policemen a 90 days preventive suspension.

text: Sa isang pahayag ay sinabi ni NAPOLCOM Vice Chairperson at Executive Officer Rafael Vicente Calinisan, layon ng hakbang na ito na mapanatili ang integridad ng imbestigasyon.
english: In a statement, NAPOLCOM Vice Chairperson and Executive Officer Rafael Vicente Calinisan said the step is aimed at maintaining the integrity of the investigation.

text: Makakatulong din ito para maiwasan ang anumang impluwensya sa mga saksi at ilalatag na ebidensya.
english: This will also help to avoid any influence on witnesses and evidence.

text: Kabilang sa mga pinatawan ng suspension ay sina Police Colonel Jacinto Malinao Jr., P/LtCol Ryan Jay Eliab Orapa, P/Major Mark Philip Simborio Almedilla, at iba pa.
english: Among those suspended were Police Colonel Jacinto Malinao Jr., P/LtCol Ryan Jay Eliab Orapa, P/Major Mark Philip Simborio Almedilla, and others.

text: Sinampahan na rin ito ng mga kasong Grave Misconduct at Conduct Unbecoming of a Police Officer.
english: He was also charged with Grave Misconduct and Conduct Unbecoming of a Police Officer.

text: Sila ay kabilang sa mga inakusahan ng whistle blower na si Julie ‘Dondon’ Patidongan na may kinalaman sa pagkawala at pagpatay sa mga nawawalang sabungero.
english: They are among those accused by whistle blower Julie 'Dondon' Patidongan of being involved in the disappearance and murder of the missing sabungero.

text: Gin-deklara sang International Basketball Federation nga ang mangin host sang 2021 FIBA Asia Cup amo ang Indonesia.
english: The International Basketball Federation has declared that the host of the 2021 FIBA ​​Asia Cup will be Indonesia.

text: Pagahiwaton ang tournament humalin Agosto 16 tubtob 28, 2021 sa diin 16 ka mga teams gikan sa Asia kag Oceania ang magapartisipar.
english: The tournament will be held from August 16 to 28, 2021 with 16 teams from Asia and Oceania participating.

text: Bangud nga host ang nasambit nga pungsod, automatic nga kaupod ang Indonesia sa 16 ka mga teams lakip na ang Lebanon kag Bahrain.
english: As the host country, Indonesia is automatically included in the 16 teams including Lebanon and Bahrain.

text: Isa man ang Indonesia nga makaupod sang Japan kag Pilipinas nga mangin host sang 2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup.
english: Indonesia will also join Japan and the Philippines in hosting the 2023 FIBA ​​Basketball World Cup.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini na ang ika-duha nga beses nga mangin host ang Indonesia sa FIBA Asia Cup.
english: This is the second time that Indonesia will host the FIBA ​​Asia Cup.

text: Kritikal ang asawa samtang pilason naman ang bana sini matapos nga ginbuno sang mag-amay nga ila man lang kaingod balay sa Brgy.
english: A wife was critically injured while her husband was injured after being stabbed by a couple who are their neighbors in Brgy.

text: East Baluarte, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: East Baluarte, Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Natabo ang insidente sa sulod mismo sang balay sang mga biktima nga sanday Rolando, 58 anyos kag iya asawa nga si Fatima, 54 anyos kag lunsay mga residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The incident occurred inside the house of the victims, Rolando, 58, and his wife, Fatima, 54, both residents of the said area.

text: Ang suspek amo sanday Eliseo, 60 anyos kag anak sini nga si Erwin, 28 anyos.
english: The suspects were identified as Eliseo, 60, and his son Erwin, 28.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay PCAPT Ryan Christ Inot, hepe sang Molo Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga ginsulod sang mga suspek ang puluy-an sang mga biktima samtang nagakatulog ang mga ini kag gipangbuno.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, PCAPT Ryan Christ Inot, chief of Molo Police Station, said the suspects entered the house of the victims while they were sleeping and stabbed them.

text: Suno kay Inot, yara man sa pihak nga kwarto ang tatlo ka kabataan sang mag-asawa kag nakit-an nila nga ginauyatan ni Eliseo si Rolando samtang ginabuno ini ni Erwin.
english: According to Inot, the couple's three children were also in the other room and saw Eliseo holding Rolando while Erwin stabbed him.

text: Matapos ang krimen, natigayon nga makapalagyo ang anak nga suspek samtang nadakpan naman ang amay sini nga nakahunong na subong sa Molo PNP.
english: After the crime, the suspect's son managed to escape while his father was arrested and is now detained at Molo PNP.

text: Padayon naman nga ginabulong sa ospital ang mga biktima kun sa diin nag-angkon ang babaye sang walo ka pilas sa likod kag may yara man sang pilas sa atubang nga parte sang lawas.
english: The victims are still being treated at the hospital where the woman sustained eight gunshot wounds in the back and another in the front of the body.

text: Ginpahayag ni Inot nga naggwa sa ila imbestigasyon nga may daan na nga hiligut-anon sa tunga sang duha ka pamilya.
english: Inot said their investigation revealed that there was an old quarrel between the two families.

text: Pahayag ni Inot, isa sa posible nga rason sang krimen amo ang ginpahayag nga masami nga pagpabati-bati sang kabataan sang mga biktima sa suspek.
english: Inot said one of the possible reasons for the crime was the alleged frequent harassment of the victims' children by the suspect.

text: Naggwa man sa imbestigasyon nga may grupo ang bata sang mga biktima nga kontra naman sang grupo sang nakapalagyo nga suspek nga si Erwin.
english: Investigation also revealed that the children of the victims had a group that was against the group of the escaped suspect, Erwin.

text: Natalana nga pasakaan ang mag-amay nga suspek sang kaso nga frustrated murder.
english: The father and son are scheduled to face charges of frustrated murder.

text: Ginkumpirma mismo ni National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Jaime Santiago nga ang mga lawas nga nakutkutan sa Capas, Tarlac amo ang missing beauty pageant contestant nga si Geneva Lopez kag ang iya Israeli fiance nga si Yitzhak Cohen.
english: National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Jaime Santiago himself confirmed that the bodies unearthed in Capas, Tarlac are those of missing beauty pageant contestant Geneva Lopez and her Israeli fiance Yitzhak Cohen.

text: Ini kasunod sang autopsy kag DNA test and analysis nga ginhimo sang ahensya.
english: This follows an autopsy and DNA test and analysis conducted by the agency.

text: Matandaan nga kahapon sang aga, Hulyo 6, sang nakutkutan sang Scene of the Crime Operatives (SOCO) ang nagakaagnas na nga bangkay sang lalaki kag babaye sa isa ka quarry site sa nabaw-ing nga bahin sang Barangay Sta.
english: It can be recalled that yesterday morning, July 6, when the Scene of the Crime Operatives (SOCO) excavated the decomposing bodies of a man and a woman at a quarry site in the recovered part of Barangay Sta.

text: Lucia sa Capas.
english: Lucia in Capas.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nadakpan naman sang Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) ang duha ka anay pulis, isa ka real estate middleman kag isa pa ka person of interest nga gina-alegar nga involved sa krimen.
english: Meanwhile, the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) arrested two former policemen, a real estate middleman and another person of interest allegedly involved in the crime.

text: Kadungan sang pag-aresto sa ila sa idalom sang Oplan Paglalansag Omega ukon ang government campaign batok sa private armed groups kag loose firearms, na-recover sang otoridad ang mga armas, ammunition kag Granada.10591.
english: Along with their arrest under Oplan Paglansansag Omega or the government campaign against private armed groups and loose firearms, the authorities recovered firearms, ammunition and grenades.10591.

text: Matandaan nga Hunyo 21 sang katapusan nga nakit-an nga buhi sanday Geneva kag ang iya nobyo sang nagbyahe sila pa-Capas para kuntani maglantaw sang duta nga ila plano nga baklon.
english: Geneva and her boyfriend were last seen alive on June 21 when they traveled to Capas to look at the land they planned to buy.

text: Pagkasunod nga adlaw, nakit-an nga sunog na ang ila salakyan sa kilid sang dalan sa amo nga banwa apang wala ang mga lawas sang biktima.
english: The next day, their vehicle was found burnt on the side of the road in the town but the bodies of the victims were missing.

text: Antes nakutkutan ang ila lawas kahapon, nagdangat pa sa P1.4-million ang gintanyag nga reward money sa makahatag sang impormasyon kaangot sa ila nahamtangan.
english: Before their bodies were exhumed yesterday, P1.4-million was offered as a reward money for information on their whereabouts.

text: Nakahanda na ang deployment sang mga personnel sang Iloilo City Public Order and Safety Management (POSMO) kag Traffic Transportation and Management Office (TTMO) para sa patigayunon nga Uswag Rally sa Gaisano Capital Grounds, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.
english: The deployment of personnel of the Iloilo City Public Order and Safety Management (POSMO) and Traffic Transportation and Management Office (TTMO) is ready for the Uswag Rally to be held at Gaisano Capital Grounds, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, iya ginpahayag nga ang rally magasugod alas-4 sang hapon kag pagasiraduhon ang dalan sa atubang sang nasambit nga mall.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos said the rally will start at 4 pm and the road in front of the mall will be closed.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, nagpatuman ma ang talatapan sang coordination meeting kag sang consultation sa lugar nga hiwatan sang aktibidad.
english: According to Garbanzos, the office also implemented a coordination meeting and consultation at the venue of the activity.

text: Ginabanta naman nga yara sa 20,000 tubtob 30,000 crowd ang ginalauman nga magatambong sa amo nga kahiwatan.
english: An estimated 20,000 to 30,000 crowd is expected to attend the event.

text: Gin-ako man sini nga isa sa pagpanghangkat nga mahimo maatubang amo ang parking sang lugar ilabi na nga may mga nagasulod man sa mall kon kagab-ihon.
english: He also acknowledged that one of the challenges that may be faced is the parking of the area especially that there are also those who enter the mall at night.

text: I-deploy sang POSMO kag TTMO ang 120 ka mga personnel agud bantayan ang dalagan sang trapiko kag ang mga magatambong.
english: POSMO and TTMO will deploy 120 personnel to monitor traffic flow and attendees.

text:
Nagbukas na subong nga hapon ang Jaro Public Market, Disyembre 10, 2025

Ginpangunahan ini ni City Mayor Raisa Treñas, Vice Mayor Love Baronda, kag iban pa nga mga konsehal sang siudad.
english:
Jaro Public Market opens this afternoon, December 10, 2025

It was led by City Mayor Raisa Treñas, Vice Mayor Love Baronda, and other city councilors.

text: Sa subong may ara sang 547 ka mga stalls ang merkado kun sa diin 293 na ka mga vendors ang may ara na sang pwesto.
english: Currently, the market has 547 stalls with 293 vendors already in place.

text: Madamo pa ang mga available nga pwesto sa sulod sang establisyamento kag amat-amat naman nga pagasudlon ang iban pa nga mga manugaligya sa masunod nga mga inadlaw.
english: There are still many available seats inside the establishment and other vendors will be gradually admitted in the coming days.

text: Balabagan sang Department of Justice (DOJ) ang apelar ni Senator Jinggoy Estrada sa Sandiganbayan nga tugutan ini nga magbyahe sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: The Department of Justice (DOJ) will oppose Senator Jinggoy Estrada's appeal to the Sandiganbayan to allow him to travel abroad.

text: Suno kay DOJ spokesperson Polo Martinez, isa ka “flight risk” si Estrada kag indi dapat magpa-abroad ilabi na nga may yara sang precautionary hold departure order (PHDO) batok sa iya halin sa korte sa Manila.
english: According to DOJ spokesperson Polo Martinez, Estrada is a “flight risk” and should not go abroad especially since there is a precautionary hold departure order (PHDO) against him from a court in Manila.

text: Gin-file ni Estrada ang mosyon nga nagapangayo sang pahanugot nga makabyahe sa Hong Kong, Macau, kag sa Japan halin sa Marso 31 tubtub Abril 5.
english: Estrada filed the motion seeking permission to travel to Hong Kong, Macau, and Japan from March 31 to April 5.

text: May ginapangatubang pa siya nga kaso kaangot sa alleged misuse sang iya nga Priority Development Assistance Fund (PDAF) sa nagligad sini nga termino bilang senador.
english: He is still facing charges regarding the alleged misuse of his Priority Development Assistance Fund (PDAF) during his previous term as senator.

text: Magluwas diri, may PHDO nga ginpagwa ang Manila Regional Trial Court Branch 52 matapos nakitaan sang probable cause agud patihan nga siya kag ang iban pa nga respondents ang posible nga magguwa sa pungsod agud nga makalikaw sa pag-aresto kag kaso.
english: In addition, a PHDO was issued by the Manila Regional Trial Court Branch 52 after finding probable cause to believe that he and the other respondents were likely to leave the country to avoid arrest and prosecution.

text: Ini nga order ang naangot naman sa plunder complaint batok kay Estrada sa DOJ bangud sang alleged involvement sini sa maanomaliya nga flood control projects.
english: The order is related to the plunder complaint against Estrada in the DOJ for his alleged involvement in anomalous flood control projects.

text: Pahayag pa ni Martinez, ang korte nga nag-isyu sang PHDO amo lamang ang maka-revoke sang ila kaugalingon nga order.#
english: Martinez said only the court that issued the PHDO can revoke its own order.

text: MADAMO nga kabuhi kag pangabuhian ang ginhalitan sang Covid, indi lang diri sa aton pungsod kundi sa bug-os gid nga kalibutan.
english: MANY lives and livelihoods have been destroyed by Covid, not only here in our country but around the world.

text: Nagpamuklat man ini, ugaling, sa aton sang madamo nga bagay nga nalipatan naton, nga ang iban sini mas importante pa gani sa kabuhi kag pagpangabuhi naton nga mga tawo.
english: It has also, however, revealed to us many things that we have forgotten, some of which are even more important to our lives and livelihoods as human beings.

text: Una na dira ang ka-importante sang aton kalagnon nga kabuhi.
english: First of all, the importance of our physical life.

text: Tungod sa Covid madamo ang nagbalik-loob sa Diyos, nangin mas matutum sa ila pagtuo, kag mas  madumdumon sa kinahanglanon sang mga kubos sa aton.
english: Because of Covid, many people have turned to God, become more faithful in their faith, and more mindful of the needs of those less fortunate than us.

text: Nangin mas makahulugan man ang pagbulig sa mga pumuluyo sang kontra partido nga gobyerno kag nalimtan sang madamo sa ila ang pulitika.
english: It also became more meaningful to help the people of the opposition government and many of them forgot about politics.

text: Wala man nagpabaya ang mga kauturan naton nga mas may ikasarang sa pangabuhi kag ang may oportunidad nga makabulig sang ila kabudlay.
english: Our brothers who are more affluent and who have the opportunity to help with their hard work have not been neglected.

text: Ang health protocols, nga gapatuman sang social distancing kag paggamit sang face mask bisan sa eskwelahan, naghatag man sing oportunidad agud mas epektibo pa gid ang pagtudlo sa mga kabataan.
english: The health protocols, which enforce social distancing and the use of face masks even in schools, also provided an opportunity to teach children more effectively.

text: Kon sadto nagaginutok ang mga kabataan sa klasehan, karon limitado lang sila sa bagay nga kadamuon para sa mas mabungahon nga pagtudlo sa ila.
english: If in the past children were crowded in the classroom, now they are limited to the right number for more effective teaching.

text: Ang ginapatuman subong sugod sang pagbukas sang klase sadtong Agosto 22 amo ang “blended learning”, kon diin ang isa ka paagi dira amo ang pagsulod sa klasehan sang isa ka grupo sang mga estudyante sing “face-to-face” samtang naga-“distancing learning” ang iban nga sa masunod nga tion sila naman ang ma-F2F, and so on.
english: What is being implemented since the opening of classes on August 22 is “blended learning”, where one way is to enter the classroom of a group of students “face-to-face” while “distancing learning” others who next time they will be F2F, and so on.

text: Sa isa ka klasehan nga nahibal-an naton, por ejemplo, mga 30 lang ang ginbaton sa F2F nga klase, kag ang nabilin sa 50 sa ila ma-“distancing learning” lang sa ila puluy-an, kag ugaling magbulos naman sa F2F nga klase sa amo man nga hulot.
english: In one class we know, for example, only about 30 students were accepted to the F2F class, and the remaining 50 of them would be “distancing learning” at home, and then replace the F2F class in the same room.

text: Sa isa ka klasehan nga nahibal-an ko man sadto sa Lapaz NHS, mga 70 gid ang mga estudyante.
english: In one class I knew at Lapaz NHS, there were about 70 students.

text: Pwede ini sila magbulos-bulos sa F2F kag “distancing learning” nga tag-35 ang kada grupo sa idalom sang “blended learning”.
english: They can alternate between F2F and distancing learning of 35 each under blended learning.

text: Sunu sa isa ka research sa United States, okey man ang kadamuon sang mga estudyante nga indi lang magsobra sa 40 sa isa ka klasehan.
english: According to a study in the United States, it is okay to have no more than 40 students in a class.

text: Tungod indi man tuman ka damo ang mga estudyante, mapahapos kag mas epektibo gid man matuod ang pagtudlo sang manunudlo.
english: Because there are not too many students, the teacher's teaching is easier and more effective.

text: Kag bisan “heterogeneous” pa ang klase, ukon mixla sang gakalain-lain nga mental ability.
english: And even if the class is heterogeneous, or a mixture of different mental abilities.

text: “Homogeneous” ang tawag sa klase nga halos kasubong ang ila group mental ability.
english: “Homogeneous” is the name given to a class that has almost the same group mental ability.

text:
***

Gina-pangibulahan naton si anay Bise Presidente Leni Robredo sa pagkapili sa iya sadtong Agosto 31 (oras sa US) sang Kennedy School’s Center for Public Leadership (CPL) sang Harvard University bilang isa sang mga Hauser Leaders para sa Fall 2022 Semester.
english:
***

We congratulate former Vice President Leni Robredo on being selected last August 31 (US time) by the Kennedy School’s Center for Public Leadership (CPL) of Harvard University as one of the Hauser Leaders for the Fall 2022 Semester.

text: Kaupod niya diri sanday US Representative Jane Harman, novelist kag columnist David Ignatius, Michael Lomax nga president kag CEO sang United Negro College Fund UNCF), kag Doy Seidman nga founder kag chairman sang LRN kag The HOW Institute for Society.
english: He is joined here by US Representative Jane Harman, novelist and columnist David Ignatius, Michael Lomax president and CEO of the United Negro College Fund UNCF), and Doy Seidman founder and chairman of LRN and The HOW Institute for Society.

text: Ang mapilian bilang Houser Leader sang Harvard’s CPL amo yadtong mga tawo nga kilala bilang “living examples of principled and effective public leadership”.
english: Elected as Houser Leader of Harvard’s CPL are those individuals who are known as “living examples of principled and effective public leadership”.

text: Ang pagkilala sa sining kapinasahe ni Robredo,siling sang CPL, bunga sang iya liderato bilang Bise Presidente sadto nga nagpatuman sing “standard of swift, efficient response…” sa pagbulig sa mga apektado nga mga komunidad indi lang sa tion sang kalamidad kundi sa padayon man nga rehabilitasyon sang ila kahimtangan.
english: The recognition of Robredo's efforts, the CPL said, is the result of his leadership as former Vice President who implemented a “standard of swift, efficient response...” to assist affected communities not only in times of disaster but also in the ongoing rehabilitation of their situation.

text: Gin-mensyonar man sang Center ang paglansar ni Robredo sang Angat Buhay Program sang Bise Presidente pa siya nga nakatutok sa pagbulig sa “the poorest, farthest, and smallest parts around the country”, nga wala mahimo sang iya mga kasumpong sa kampanya tungod ini nga mga lugar indi makahatag sa ila sang “winning votes”.
english: The Center also mentioned Robredo’s launch of the Angat Buhay Program when he was Vice President focused on helping “the poorest, farthest, and smallest parts around the country”, which his campaign opponents failed to do because these areas would not give them “winning votes”.

text: Tungod sa sining kabalaka sa mga “poorest of the poor”, si Robredo gid ang may madamo nga lugar nga nalab-ut sa kampanya ikumparar sa iya mga kasumpong kay bisan ang may mahatag lang sing diutay nga boto ginkadtuan pa niya.
english: Because of this concern for the “poorest of the poor”, Robredo has reached more places in the campaign compared to her opponents because even those who can only give a few votes she went.

text:
Daw ginasiling ni Robredo sadto nga “Indi bale mapierde ako indi lang mahambal nga ginpabayaan ko ang labing  kubos sa aton mga pumuluyo.”

Ining Angat Buhay Program ni Robredo sadto may bulig sang private sector tungod ang kontra-partido nga gobyerno indi makabulig sing lubos sa iya upisina.
english:
Robredo seemed to be saying, “It doesn't matter if I lose, I can't say that I neglected the poorest of our people.”

Robredo's Angat Buhay Program used to have the help of the private sector because the opposition government could not fully support his office.

text: Ginadumalahan, sa karon, ining programa ni Robredo sang NGO nga Angat Pinas Inc.
english: Robredo's program is currently being managed by the NGO Angat Pinas Inc.

text: nga gintukod niya sadtong Hulyo 2022 pagkatapos gid sang iya termino.
english: which he founded back in July 2022 right after his term ended.

text: Congratulations, Leni!/PN
english: Congratulations, Leni!/PN

text: Posible nga hawidan anay ukon indi pag-i-release ang sweldo ni Senator Bato Dela Rosa kasunod sang iya binulan na nga pag-absent sa iya trabaho.
english: Posible nga hawidan anay ukon indi pag-i-release ang sweldo ni Senator Bato Dela Rosa kasunod sang iya binulan na nga pag-absent sa iya trabaho.

text: Halin sang Nobyembre pa nga wala nagpakita sa Senado kag sa publiko si Dela Rosa kasunod sang mga report nga nagguwa na ang arrest warrant sang International Criminal Court batok sa iya.
english: Dela Rosa has not appeared in the Senate and the public since November following reports that the International Criminal Court has issued an arrest warrant against him.

text: Suno kay Senate President Pro Tempore Ping Lacson, padayon pa ang ila nga pag-istoryahanay ni Senate President Tito Sotto kun ano ang himuon, kag nalakip ang sweldo sa posible nga ipa-untat.
english: Suno kay Senate President Pro Tempore Ping Lacson, padayon pa ang ila nga pag-istoryahanay ni Senate President Tito Sotto kun ano ang himuon, kag nalakip ang sweldo sa posible nga ipa-untat.

text: Apang dugang niya, kinahanglan pa ini nga tun-an bangud may mga patakaran nga nasakop sang Civil Service Law.
english: However, he added that it needs to be studied because there are rules covered by the Civil Service Law.

text: Nagadangat sa P290,000 tubtub sa P330,000 ang sweldo sang senador sa kada bulan magluwas pa sa allowances.
english: The senator's monthly salary ranges from P290,000 to P330,000 in addition to allowances.

text: Una naman nga ginpahayag ni former senator Antonio Trillanes IV nga nagaplano ini nga mag-file sang ethics complaint batok kay Dela Rosa bangud sa iya padayon nga pag-absent.
english: Earlier, former senator Antonio Trillanes IV said he plans to file an ethics complaint against Dela Rosa for his continued absence.

text: Si Ombudsman Boying Remulla ang una nga nakamensyonar nga may arrest warrant na ang ICC batok kay Dela Rosa bangud sa nangin papel sini bilang PNP chief sang ginpatuman ang drug war.
english: Ombudsman Boying Remulla was the first to mention that the ICC has an arrest warrant against Dela Rosa for his role as PNP chief during the implementation of the drug war.

text: Nagtuad na sa labing nga tion ang US tv star nga si Ellen DeGeneres umpisa nga nagsaylo ini sa United Kingdom.
english: US tv star Ellen DeGeneres has confessed for the longest time since she moved to the United Kingdom.

text: Sa iya Social media account, ginsiling sini nga isa sa mga rason kun nagsaylo siya sa England bangud kay US President Donald Trump.
english: On his social media account, he said that one of the reasons he moved to England was because of US President Donald Trump.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang-una plang indi na ini komportable sa mga programa ni Trump.
english: It is known that he has always been uncomfortable with Trump's programs.

text: Plano man niya nga magpakasal liwat sa iya partner nga si Portia de Rossi sa England.
english: He also plans to remarry his partner Portia de Rossi in England.

text: Ginpanginwala man sini nga isa lang ka gimmick ang pagtapos sang iya TV show sang 2022.
english: He also denied that ending his TV show in 2022 was just a gimmick.

text: Si Ellen ang isa sa mga pinakakilala nga pangalan sa US TV sa sulod sang 30 ka tuig kun sa diin nagsikat man ini bilang host sa pila man ka popular nga awarding ceremony kaangay sang Oscars, Grammys kag Emmys.
english: Ellen has been one of the most recognizable names on US TV for the past 30 years, where she has also become famous as the host of several popular awarding ceremonies such as the Oscars, Grammys and Emmys.

text: Nag-upod man si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr sa mga world leaders nga nagpakamalaot sa pagluthang kay former President Donald Trump samtang nagapatigayon sang rally sa Pennsylvania.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. also joined world leaders who condemned the shooting of former President Donald Trump while holding a rally in Pennsylvania.

text: Suno kay Marcos, kaangay sang mga pumuluyo sa bug-os nga kalibutan nga, ginakondenar sini ang tanan nga sahi sang political violence.
english: According to Marcos, like citizens around the world, it condemns all forms of political violence.

text: “Together with all democracy loving peoples around the world, we condemn all forms of political violence.
english: “Together with all democracy loving peoples around the world, we condemn all forms of political violence.

text:
The voice of the people must always remain supreme.”

Nagapasalamat man si Marcos nga yara na si Trump sa maayo nga kondisyon.
english:
The voice of the people must always remain supreme.”

Marcos is also grateful that Trump is in good shape.

text: “It is with great relief that we receive the news that former President Donald Trump is fine and well after the attempt to assasinate (sic) him.
english: “It is with great relief that we receive the news that former President Donald Trump is fine and well after the attempt to assassinate (sic) him.

text:
Our thoughts and prayers are with him and his family.”

Nagpalab-ot man ini sang pagpangamuyo para kay Trump kag sa iya pamilya.
english:
Our thoughts and prayers are with him and his family.”

He also extended a prayer for Trump and his family.

text: Ginkumpirma ni former US President Trump nga napilasan ang iya natuo mga dulunggan kasunod sang assassination attempt sa iya samtang nagapatigayon ini sang rally sa Pennsylvania.
english: Former US President Trump confirmed that his right ear was injured following an assassination attempt on him while he was holding a rally in Pennsylvania.

text:
“I was shot with a bullet that pierced the upper part of my right ear.”

Suno kay Trump, sang nakabati ini sang lupok sang pusil, nakabatyag ini sang pagbagrong sa iya dulunggan.
english:
“I was shot with a bullet that pierced the upper part of my right ear.”

Trump said when he heard the gunshot, he felt a ringing in his ear.

text: Sa ulihi, namutikan sini nga may pilas na ini sa dulunggan kag nagsige na ang dugo sini.
english: Later, he noticed that he had a wound in his ear and was bleeding.

text: Didto na kag nahibaluan niya nga siya ang target sang shooter.
english: That’s when he knew he was the shooter’s target.

text: Gilayon naman nga gindala si Trump sa ospital agud madapatan sang nagakaigo nga pagbulong.
english: Trump was immediately taken to the hospital for treatment.

text: “I knew immediately that something was wrong in that I heard a whizzing sound, shots, and immediately felt the bullet ripping through the skin.
english: “I knew immediately that something was wrong in that I heard a whizzing sound, shots, and immediately felt the bullet ripping through the skin.

text: Much bleeding took place, so I realized then what was happening.
english: Much bleeding took place, so I realized then what was happening.

text:
GOD BLESS AMERICA!”

Napatay naman ang shooter kag isa ka attendee sa event.
english:
GOD BLESS AMERICA!”

The shooter and an attendee at the event were killed.

text: Magluwas diri, duha man ka mga attendees ang kritikal.
english: In addition, two attendees were also critical.

text: ILOILO CITY- Duha ka anggulo ang ginasundan sang kapulisan sa posible nga motibo sa pagpatay sa Indian National sa sa Brgy.
english: ILOILO CITY – Police are pursuing two angles in the possible motive behind the murder of an Indian national in Brgy.

text: Guzman- Jesena, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.
english: Guzman- Jesena, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.

text: Ang biktima amo si Jatinder Singh, 27-anyos, temporaryo nga naga-isrtar sa nasambit nga barangay.
english: The victim was identified as Jatinder Singh, 27, a temporary resident of the said barangay.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Val Cambel, hepe sang Mandurriao Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga isa sa ginasundan nila nga anggulo amo ang negosyo sini nga nagapautang.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Val Cambel, chief of Mandurriao Police Station, said one of the angles they are following is his lending business.

text: Suno kay Cambel, ang isa man ka posibilidad amo ang batasan sini kun mahubog nga masami nagamaoy.
english: According to Cambel, another possibility is his behavior when he is drunk and often gets angry.

text: Pahayag pa sang hepe, siya mismo ang nakasaksi kun paano magmaoy ang Indian National bangud ginpa-blotter na ini sadto.
english: The chief said he personally witnessed how the Indian National behaved because it was blottered.

text: Wala naman ginadula ni Cambel ang iban pa nga posible motibo sa pagpatay sa biktima.
english: Cambel did not rule out other possible motives for the murder.

text: Aminado ang coaching staff sang TNT Tropang Giga nga wala sang kasiguraduhan kun makahampang na subong nga adlaw sa Game 3 ang ila high scoring star nga si Ray Parks Jr.
english: The coaching staff of TNT Tropang Giga admitted that there is no certainty whether their high scoring star Ray Parks Jr. will be able to play in Game 3 today.

text: Sa subong lubong na sa 0-2 deficit ang Giga sa hugot nila nga kasumpong nga Barangay Ginebra San Miguel sa nagapadayon nga PBA Philippine Cup Finals.
english: Giga is now buried in a 0-2 deficit against their tough opponent Barangay Ginebra San Miguel in the ongoing PBA Philippine Cup Finals.

text: Suno kay TNT coach Bong Ravena, nagalaum sila nga makahampang na subong nga adlaw si Parks.
english: TNT coach Bong Ravena said they hope Parks will be able to play today.

text: Apang gin-ako man niya nga indi pa fully recover si Parks gikan sa iya injury.
english: But he also acknowledged that Parks is not fully recovered from his injury.

text: Indi pa suportado sang mga eksperto sa Amerika ang pagbalik sang mga fans sa NBA arena kag sa iban pa nga stadiums.
english: American experts do not yet support the return of fans to NBA arenas and other stadiums.

text: Ini ang sa pihak sang mga anunsyo nga malapit na lang madevelop ang COVID-19 vaccine kag mahimo na magamit sang publiko.
english: This is despite announcements that the COVID-19 vaccine will soon be developed and available to the public.

text: Suno kay Dr. Anthony Fauci, ang director ng National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases, mas maayo kun wala lang anay liwat sang fans nga personal nga magalantaw sa 2020-2021 NBA season.
english: According to Dr. Anthony Fauci, the director of the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases, said it would be better if there were no fans in person to watch the 2020-2021 NBA season.

text: Dapat suno kay Dr. Fauci nga unahon anay ang pagpangbakuna subong nga Disyembre tubtob sa Hunyo para sa general public.
english: According to Dr. Fauci to prioritize vaccination this December through June for the general public.

text: Sa Setyembre pa posible suno sa iya amat amat nga mahalugan ang mga restriction kag mahimo makabalik ang mga fans sa National Football League stadiums.
english: He said it is possible that the restrictions will be gradually eased and fans can return to the National Football League stadiums in September.

text: Nagpaguwa sang statement ang Philippine Army nga nagapasiguro sang maayo nga security situation sa Northern Negros subong nga adlaw sang eleksyon apisar pa sang natabo nga shooting incident sa Silay City.
english: The Philippine Army issued a statement ensuring a good security situation in Northern Negros today despite the shooting incident in Silay City.

text: Ginpahayag man sang militar nga isolated case ang hitabo kaina sang aga sa Sitio Ipil-Ipil, Brgy Mambulac kun sa diin nagbilin sang duha ka mga tawo nga patay kag pito ka pilason.
english: The military also declared an isolated case of the incident this morning in Sitio Ipil-Ipil, Brgy Mambulac which left two people dead and seven injured.

text: Article: Bombo Jissa Padios
english: Article: Bombo Jissa Padios

text: Nagtaas pa ang numero sang mga empleyado nga nadala sa layoff sa Walth Disney Company.
english: The number of employees involved in the layoff at the Walth Disney Company has increased.

text: Kun ang sadto 28,000 nga plano sang kompaniya, sa subong 32,000 na nga mga empleyado ang madulaan sang trabaho sa theme parks bangud sa epekto sang pandemya.
english: If the company's previous plan was 28,000, now 32,000 employees will lose their jobs in theme parks due to the impact of the pandemic.

text: Ang layoff ang mangin epektibo sa 2021.
english: The layoff will be effective in 2021.

text: Samtang ang theme parks sang Disney sa Florida ang liwat nga nagbukas bangud wala sang panibag-o nga outbreak sang virus apang hugot naman ang pagpatuman sang social distancing, testing kag paggamit sang face mask.
english: Meanwhile, Disney's theme parks in Florida have reopened with no new outbreaks of the virus but strictly enforce social distancing, testing and the use of face masks.

text: Ang Disneyland sa Paris ang liwat nga ginsirado bangud sa pagpatuman sang France sang panibag-o nga lockdown agud mapunggan ang second wave sang COVID-19.
english: Disneyland in Paris has been closed again due to France implementing a new lockdown to prevent a second wave of COVID-19.

text: Nagapabilin naman nga bukas ang theme parks sang nasambit nga kompaniya sa Shanghai, Hong Kong kag Tokyo.
english: The company's theme parks in Shanghai, Hong Kong and Tokyo remain open.

text: Sa pihak sang kapaslawan nga makasulod sa finals sang PBA Season 45 Philippine Cup, taas-noo sa gihapon si Phoenix Fuel Masters star Calivin Abueva sang bubble.
english: Despite failing to reach the finals of the PBA Season 45 Philippine Cup, Phoenix Fuel Masters star Calivin Abueva is still high on the bubble.

text: Ini matapos makakuha sang positibo nga panan-awan halin sa iya team sa pila ka bulan nga pagpabilin sini sa PBA Bubble sa Clark, Pampangga.
english: This is after getting positive feedback from his team during his months of stay in the PBA Bubble in Clark, Pampanga.

text: Suno sa teammate sini nga si RJ Jazul, dako ang pinagbag-o ni Abueva matapos ang 16 ka bulan nga suspensyon sa iya.
english: According to his teammate RJ Jazul, Abueva has changed a lot after his 16-month suspension.

text: Madamo man ini sang natun-an nga leksyon samtang yara sa guwa sang PBA nga napakita sini sa iya pagbalik sa Philippine Cup.
english: He also learned a lot of lessons while outside the PBA which he showed in his return to the Philippine Cup.

text: Dugang pa ni Jazul, mas nangin mature si Abueva kag ini ang may manami nga resulta para sa ila nga team.
english: Jazul added that Abueva has become more mature and this has had good results for their team.

text: Nagpakita sang kasulhay ang madamo nga mga botante sa Bonifacio Integrated School sa Iloilo City Proper subong nga 2025 Midterm Elections, bangud sa mas paspas kag mas hapos nga proseso nga dala sang bag-o nga feature sa proseso sang pagboto.
english: Many voters at the Bonifacio Integrated School in Iloilo City Proper expressed their relief during the 2025 Midterm Elections, due to the faster and easier process brought about by the new feature in the voting process.

text: Ang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) nagpasugod sang paggamit sang mas moderno nga vote counting machines subong nga tuig bilang kabahin sang digital upgrade sa electoral process sang Pilipinas.
english: The Commission on Elections (COMELEC) started using more modern vote counting machines this year as part of the digital upgrade in the Philippine electoral process.

text: Isa sa pinaka-nauyunan nga parte sang ila pagboto amo ang facial recognition display nga nagabulig sa mga botante nga dali lang makita ang ila presinto, kag malikawan ang dugay nga pagpangita sang mga pangalan sa manual nga listahan.
english: One of the most appreciated parts of their voting is the facial recognition display that helps voters easily find their polling station, and avoid long searches for names on a manual list.

text: Suno sa mga botante, mas malinong kag organisado na subong ang proseso kumpara sa nagligad nga mga eleksyon.
english: According to voters, the process is now more peaceful and organized compared to previous elections.

text: Ginalauman sang COMELEC nga ang pag-usar sang modernisado nga vote counting machines nga magapadugang sang kumpiyansa sang publiko sa eleksyon kag magapadayon ini sa masunod pa nga piniliay.
english: The COMELEC expects the use of modernized vote counting machines to increase public confidence in the election and continue in the next election.

text: Text by: Bombo Lyka Sican Sandiego
english: Text by: Bombo Lyka Sican Sandiego

text:
Nagpirmahanay ang Pilipinas kag India sang Martes, Agosto 5 sang kabug-usan nga 13 ka bag-o nga kasugtanan nga naga-cover sa mga areas nga may kaangtana sa tagsa ka interes nga ginkalakipan sang mga masunod:

-Exchange of Declaration on the Establishment of Strategic Partnership between the Republic of India and the Republic of the Philippines

-Plan of Action for the Implementation of the Strategic Partnership between the Republic of India and the Republic of the Philippines (2025-2029)

-Terms of Reference between the Indian Air Force and the Philippine Air Force on Air Staff Talks and

-Terms of Reference between the Indian Army and the Philippine Army on Army-to-Army Staff Talks and

-Terms of Reference between the Indian Navy and the Philippine Navy on Navy-to-Navy Staff Talks

-Treatment on mutual legal assistance in criminal matters between the government of Republic of India and the government of Republic of Philippines

-Treaty on transfer of sentenced persons between the government of Republic of India and the government of Republic of Philippines

-Programme of Cooperation in the field of Science and Technology for the period of 2025-2028 between the Department of Science and Technology of the Republic of India and the Department of Science and Technology of the Republic of the Philippines

-Implementation Program between the Department of Tourism of the Government of the Republic of the Philippines and the Ministry of Tourism of the Government of the Republic of India on Tourism Cooperation (2025-2028)

-Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of the Republic of India and the Government of the Republic of the Philippines on Cooperation in the Field of Digital Technologies

-Statement of Intent between Indian Space Research Organisation, Republic of India and the Philippine Space Agency, Philippines on Cooperation on the Peaceful Uses of Outer Space

-Terms of Reference for Enhanced Maritime Cooperation between the Indian Coast Guard and the Philippine Coast Guard

-Cultural Exchange Programme between the Government of the Republic of India and the Government of the Republic of the Philippines
english:
The Philippines and India signed on Tuesday, August 5 a total of 13 new agreements covering areas of mutual interest which included the following:

-Exchange of Declaration on the Establishment of Strategic Partnership between the Republic of India and the Republic of the Philippines

-Plan of Action for the Implementation of the Strategic Partnership between the Republic of India and the Republic of the Philippines (2025-2029)

-Terms of Reference between the Indian Air Force and the Philippine Air Force on Air Staff Talks and

-Terms of Reference between the Indian Army and the Philippine Army on Army-to-Army Staff Talks and

-Terms of Reference between the Indian Navy and the Philippine Navy on Navy-to-Navy Staff Talks

-Treatment on mutual legal assistance in criminal matters between the government of Republic of India and the government of Republic of Philippines

-Treaty on transfer of sentenced persons between the government of Republic of India and the government of Republic of Philippines

-Programme of Cooperation in the field of Science and Technology for the period of 2025-2028 between the Department of Science and Technology of the Republic of India and the Department of Science and Technology of the Republic of the Philippines

-Implementation Program between the Department of Tourism of the Government of the Republic of the Philippines and the Ministry of Tourism of the Government of the Republic of India on Tourism Cooperation (2025-2028)

-Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of the Republic of India and the Government of the Republic of the Philippines on Cooperation in the Field of Digital Technologies

-Statement of Intent between Indian Space Research Organization, Republic of India and the Philippine Space Agency, Philippines on Cooperation on the Peaceful Uses of Outer Space

-Terms of Reference for Enhanced Maritime Cooperation between the Indian Coast Guard and the Philippine Coast Guard

-Cultural Exchange Program between the Government of the Republic of India and the Government of the Republic of the Philippines

text: Ginapadalman sang Police Regional Office-6 kun may bag-o nga drug groups nga naga-operate sa Western Visayas.
english: The Police Regional Office-6 is investigating whether there are new drug groups operating in Western Visayas.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson sang PRO-6, iya ginpahayag nga indi pa conclusive ang ila gina-uyatan nga impormasyon kag padayon pa ini subong nga gina-validate sang intelligence operatives.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson of PRO-6, said the information they are holding is not yet conclusive and is still being validated by intelligence operatives.

text: Isa man sa ginalantaw nga pagpanghangkat amo nga limitado na ang mga impormasyon nga ginahatag sang ila nagkadalakdpan nga drug personalities kun sa diin sila nagakuha sang suplay sang iligal nga droga.
english: One of the challenges is that the information provided by their arrested drug personalities on where they get their supply of illegal drugs is limited.

text: Sa pihak sini, padayon nila nga gina-engganyo ini nga mga personalidad suno kay Solis para nga mahimo na nga drug-free ang rehiyon.
english: Meanwhile, they continue to encourage these personalities, Solis said, to make the region drug-free.

text: Una naman nga ginpahayag ni PRO-6 chief Police Brig.
english: Earlier, PRO-6 chief Police Brig.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Jack Wanky nga ginatumod sang Regional Intelligence Division kun may kaangtanan ang bag-o lang nadakpan nga drug suspects sa bag-o nga major groups ukon mga sindikato.
english: Jack Wanky said the Regional Intelligence Division is investigating whether the newly arrested drug suspects are linked to new major groups or syndicates.

text: Para nga makonsiderar ang grupo nga isa ka drug syndicate, kinahanglan nga makapasar ini sa validation nga gina-conduct sang Regional Police Intelligence Committee.
english: For the group to be considered a drug syndicate, it must pass validation conducted by the Regional Police Intelligence Committee.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang Hunyo 1 tubtub sang Hunyo 22 lamang subong nga tuig, nagdangat gid sa P30.5-million nga balor sang shabu ang na-recover sang otoridad sa 176 ka anti-drug operations sa bilog nga Western Visayas.
english: From June 1 to June 22 this year alone, P30.5-million worth of shabu was recovered by the authorities in 176 anti-drug operations across Western Visayas.

text: Sa sini nga mga operasyon, yara sa 237 ka drug suspects ang nadakpan.
english: In these operations, 237 drug suspects were arrested.

english: (Photo: PRO 6)

text: Gin-ako ni former Iloilo City Mayor kag abogado nga si Atty. Jerry Treñas nga mabudlay nga balion ang desisyon sang Supreme Court may kaangtanan sa Articles of Impeachment batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Former Iloilo City Mayor and lawyer Atty. Jerry Treñas said it is difficult to overturn the Supreme Court's decision regarding the Articles of Impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Kasunod ini sang pag-file sang kamara sang motion for reconsideration paagi sa Office of the Solicitor General agud baliskadon sang Korte Suprema ang ruling nga unconstitutional ang fourth impeachment complaint batok sa vice president.
english: This follows the chamber's filing of a motion for reconsideration through the Office of the Solicitor General to overturn the Supreme Court's ruling that the fourth impeachment complaint against the vice president is unconstitutional.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Treñas, iya ginpunto nga bangud unanimous ang amo nga desisyon sang pinakamataas nga hukmanan, tuman ka dako nga pagpanghangkat ini sa kamara.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Treñas, he pointed out that because the decision of the highest court was unanimous, it was a big challenge to the chamber.

text: Apang gin-ako naman ni Treñas nga sa iya panan-awan, may natabo nga judicial overreach.
english: However, Treñas acknowledged that in his view, there was judicial overreach.

text: Ang Judicial overreach amo ang sitwasyon kun sa diin ang judiciary ang naglapaw sa constitutionally assigned nga gahum sini kag nagpasilabot sa isyu nga iya sang executive ukon legislative branches sang gobyerno.
english: Judicial overreach is a situation where the judiciary exceeds its constitutionally assigned powers and interferes in issues that belong to the executive or legislative branches of government.

text: Matandaan nga ginpahayag ni House Speaker Martin Romualdez nga base sa nasaad sa konstitusyon, ang House of Representatives ang may exclusive power nga mag-initiate sang tanan nga kaso sang impeachment.
english: House Speaker Martin Romualdez said that based on the constitution, the House of Representatives has the exclusive power to initiate all impeachment cases.

text: Suno kay Romualdez, ini nga gahum ang wala ginapakigbahin sa ibn kag indi subject sa pre-approval kag wala man dapat sang kondisyon.
english: According to Romualdez, this power is not shared with IBN and is not subject to pre-approval and should not be conditional.

text: Sa pihak sini, kumporme naman ang alkalde nga nag-file sang motion for reconsideration ang kamara agud malantaw liwat sang Supreme Court ang nasambit nga ruling.
english: Meanwhile, the mayor agreed that the chamber filed a motion for reconsideration so that the Supreme Court could reconsider the ruling.

text: Nagpositibo sa COVID-19 ang basketball player nga si Thirdy Ravena nga ginkumpirma sang iya team nga San-en Neo-Phoenix.
english: Basketball player Thirdy Ravena has tested positive for COVID-19, confirmed by his team San-en Neo-Phoenix.

text: Naka-rekord sang temperatura nga 38.2°C si Ravena sang Nobyembre 26.
english: Ravena recorded a temperature of 38.2°C on November 26.

text: Sang ginpaidalom ini sa COVID-19 test, nagguwa nga nagpositibo ang iya resulta.
english: When he was tested for COVID-19, he tested positive.

text: Apang kahapon, nagnubo ang temperatura ni Ravena sa 36.9°C sa diin nagbalik na sa normal ang iya panabor kag makapanimaho naman ini.
english: However, yesterday, Ravena's temperature dropped to 36.9°C and her taste and smell returned to normal.

text: Sa subong, nagapabilin si Ravena sa ila balay samtang ginabulong.
english: For now, Ravena is staying home while undergoing treatment.

text: Nagdangat sa 71 ka Palestinians ang ginbawian sang kabuhi sang gin-atake sang Israel ang isa ka designated humanitarian zone sa Gaza agud kuntani patyon ang military chief sang Hamas nga si Mohammed Deif.
english: At least 71 Palestinians were killed when Israel attacked a designated humanitarian zone in Gaza in an attempt to kill Hamas military chief Mohammed Deif.

text: Sa report sang Gaza health ministry, ginsaad nga magluwas sa mga napatay, 289 ka mga tawo ang nasaraman.
english: In the report of the Gaza health ministry, it was promised that in addition to the dead, 289 people were injured.

text: Natabo ang atake sa Al-Mawasi, ang lugar nga amo ang ginsiling sang Israeli army nga kadtuan sang Palestinians matapos nga ginpahalin sila sa mga lugar nga ila anay gintiniran.
english: The attack took place in Al-Mawasi, the area where the Israeli army said Palestinians would go after they were evicted from areas where they had previously lived.

text: Sa statement sang militante nga grupo, ginsiling nga patalang lang ang rason sang Israel nga gin-target sini nga mga lider sang Hamas bangud luyag lang sang militar nga i-justify ang ila ginhimo nga pagpang-atake.
english: In a statement, the militant group said Israel's reason for targeting Hamas leaders was misleading because the military wanted to justify its attacks.

text: Apang nanindugan ang Israeli military nga ang strike batok kay Deif ang nag-target man kay Rafa Salama, ang commander sang Khan Younis Brigade sang Hamas.
english: But the Israeli military insisted that the strike against Deif also targeted Rafa Salama, the commander of Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade.

text: Ginsiling man sang Israel nga ang duha ka nasambit nga pangalan amo ang masterminds sa Oktubre 7 nga pagpang-atake sa southern Israel nga amo ang nag-resulta sa pagtimalos sang Tel Aviv kag siyam na ka bulan nga gyera sa Gaza.
english: Israel also said the two men were the masterminds of the October 7 attack in southern Israel that resulted in Tel Aviv's retaliation and the nine-month war in Gaza.

text: Ini na ika-pito nga tuyo sang Israel nga patyon si Deif apang iya gihapon nalusutan.
english: This is Israel's seventh attempt to kill Deif but he still escaped.

text: Nagapangibabaw siya sa Most Wanted list sang Israel sa sulod na sang pila ka dekada kag siya man ang ginatudlo nga rason sang kamatayon sang madamo nga Israelis bangud sa suicide bombings.
english: He has been on Israel's Most Wanted list for decades and is also blamed for the deaths of many Israelis in suicide bombings.

text: (Photo: Reuters)
english: (Photo: Reuters)

text: METRO, MANILA – Nagapati ang National Economic Development Authority nga sa tuig 2022 pa mabalik ang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas.
english: METRO, MANILA – The National Economic Development Authority believes that the Philippine economy will recover by 2022.

text: Suno kay acting Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Karl Kendrick Chua, ang ekonomiya ang posible mabalik sa pre-pandemic trajectory sa tunga-tunga sang tuig 2022 sa tion nga dalayon na nga mapatuman ang mga interventions kag precautions.
english: According to acting Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Karl Kendrick Chua, the economy is likely to return to its pre-pandemic trajectory by mid-2022 once interventions and precautions are consistently implemented.

text: Gina-ako sang tiglikom nga dako ang nangin epekto sa ekonomiya sa ginapatuman nga mga restrictions bangud sa pandemic.
english: The secretary acknowledges that the restrictions imposed due to the pandemic have had a huge impact on the economy.

text: “So all of these were all good starting points.
english: “So all of these were all good starting points.

text: Yes, there will be scars, there will be delays, but putting all the numbers together, we are seeing a return to 2019 levels sometime in the middle of 2022,” pahayag ni Chua.
english: Yes, there will be scars, there will be delays, but putting all the numbers together, we are seeing a return to 2019 levels sometime in the middle of 2022,” stated Chua.

text: Apang sa pihak sini, napatud-an nga “flexible” kag “responsive” ang ekonomiya sa pihak sang mga polisa nga ginpatuman santo sa public health standards.
english: However, the economy has proven to be “flexible” and “responsive” despite the policies implemented in accordance with public health standards.

text: Ginpahayag ni Chua nga antes ang pandemya, ang Pilipinas ang may mapag-on nga trajectory sang ekonomiya nga naga-average sang 6 percent humalin sang 2016 tubtub 2019 kag ginapanan-aw nga magtimbuok sa upper middle income economy santo sa World Bank standards.
english: Chua said that before the pandemic, the Philippines had a strong economic trajectory averaging 6 percent from 2016 to 2019 and is expected to become an upper middle income economy based on World Bank standards.

text: “These are not very far from our present period but we can accelerate that if we focus on the recovery program,” dugang pa sang tiglikom.
english: “These are not very far from our present period but we can accelerate that if we focus on the recovery program,” the secretary added.

text: Sa anom ka bulan nga pandemya, ang ekonomiya ang nagtibusok sa sulod sang tatlo ka quarters.
english: In the six-month pandemic, the economy has contracted for three quarters.

text: Ang ikaduha nga quarter sang tuig ang nakarecord sang 16.9% nga pagnubo sa ekonomiya kag ginasundan sang third quarter nga may pagtibusok nga nagdangat sa 11.5%.
english: The second quarter of the year recorded a 16.9% contraction in the economy followed by the third quarter with an increase of 11.5%.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Pilipinas ang nagapatuman sang world’s longest lockdown sa diin may mga lugar nga napaidalom sa general community quarantine (GCQ) kag modified general community quarantine.
english: The Philippines is implementing the world's longest lockdown with areas under general community quarantine (GCQ) and modified general community quarantine.

text: Magboto subong nga midterm nga election ang 80 tanan ka Female PDLs sa Iloilo City District Jail-Female Dormitory (ICDJ-FD).
english: All 80 Female PDLs in the Iloilo City District Jail-Female Dormitory (ICDJ-FD) will vote in the midterm election.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jail Senior Inspector Novella Ybañez, Acting Warden sang ICDJ-FD, iya ginpahayag nga nadelay ang pagboto sang mga PDLs bangud sa natabo nga miscommunication sa tunga sang Commission on Election (COMELEC) kag Electoral Board kun sa diin pasado ‘las 9 na sang aga nauna boto ang apat ka mga PDLs.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jail Senior Inspector Novella Ybañez, Acting Warden of the ICDJ-FD, said the voting of the PDLs was delayed due to miscommunication between the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) and the Electoral Board.

text: Nahibaluan nga 63 ang edad sang pinakatigulang nga botante nga PDL kag 18 naman ang pinakabata.Santu sa rekord, 15 ka PDL ang nakarehistro sa Jaro, 5 sa Lapuz, 3 sa Arevalo, 4 sa Mandurriao, 7 sa Lapaz, , 27 sa Molo, kag 20 sa City Proper.
english: The oldest PDL voter is 63 years old and the youngest is 18. According to records, 15 PDLs are registered in Jaro, 5 in Lapuz, 3 in Arevalo, 4 in Mandurriao, 7 in Lapaz, 27 in Molo, and 20 in City Proper.

text: Pagkatapos magboto ang mga PDLs pagadal-on ang ila balota sang tagsa ka polling precinct kun diin ang mga ini naka rehistro agud matingob ini isip kag may magabalik sa Female Dormitory nga katapo sang Electoral Board agud magdeklara.
english: After voting, the PDLs will take their ballots to each polling precinct where they are registered to be counted and some members of the Electoral Board will return to the Female Dormitory to declare.

text: Natalana nga matapos ‘las 2 sa hapon ang binotohay apang posible maisol ini bangud sa natabo nga delay.
english: The vote is scheduled to end at 2 pm but may be postponed due to the delay.

text: Text by: Bombo Phauline Pillora
english: Text by: Bombo Phauline Pillora

text: Nagdangat sa 917 ka mga indibidwal nga nagahimo sang iligal nga aktibidad ang nadakpan sang Police Regional Office 6 sa 15 ka adlaw nga operasyon humalin sang Hunyo 1-15.
english: A total of 917 individuals engaged in illegal activities were arrested by the Police Regional Office 6 during the 15-day operation from June 1-15.

text:

english:
In these 590 police operations conducted in Western Visayas, the following were arrested:

text: “These accomplishments are products of your relentless effort against all forms of illegal activities in your respective areas of responsibility.

text: Naghatag sang 2 million US dollars ukon P96.1 million si NBA legend Michael Jordan agud nga mapakaon ang mga imol sa Estados Unidos.
english: NBA legend Michael Jordan donated 2 million US dollars or P96.1 million to feed the poor in the United States.

text: Suno sa relief outfit nga Feeding America, wala nagduha-duha ang anay Chicago Bulls star nga magdonate sang nasambit nga kantidad.
english: According to the relief outfit Feeding America, the former Chicago Bulls star did not hesitate to donate the amount.

text: Suno naman sa 14-time NBA All-Star, importante ang maghatag sang bulig ilabi na sa mga naapektuhan bangud sa COVID-19 pandemic.
english: The 14-time NBA All-Star said it is important to provide assistance especially to those affected by the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagalab-ot na sa 54 million nga mga americans ang wala makaon.
english: It is known that up to 54 million Americans are already without food.

text: Sang Abril, nagpromisa ang US Department of Agriculture nga magapain ini sang 1.7 billion US dollars ukon P 81.7 billion agud buligan ang mga food banks bangud sa padayon nga pagtaas sang kaso sang mga nagakagutoman.
english: In April, the US Department of Agriculture promised to allocate 1.7 billion US dollars or P 81.7 billion to help food banks due to the continuous increase in cases of hunger.

text: MAKATI – Pasado na sa final reading sang Senado ang P4.5-trillion 2021 national budget.
english: MAKATI – The P4.5-trillion 2021 national budget has passed the final reading of the Senate.

text: Tanan nga 22 ka mga senador nga present sa plenaryo ang nagpabor sa pagpasar sang 2021 General Appropriations Bill.
english: All 22 senators present in the plenary voted in favor of passage of the 2021 General Appropriations Bill.

text: Ang pagpasar sang budget ang mas temprano sang isa ka bulan sa year-end deadline antes ang pag-expire sang current spending law.
english: The passage of the budget is one month earlier than the year-end deadline before the expiration of the current spending law.

text: Suno kay Senate Committee on Finance chair Sonny Angara, kuntani ang ginpasar nga budget ang makabulig sa mga pumuluyo kag sa ekonomiya sa pihak sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: According to Senate Committee on Finance chair Sonny Angara, the passed budget should have helped the people and the economy despite the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Lakip sa mga amendments sa Senado nga nalakip sa 2021 spending bill amo ang dugang nga P10-billion para sa pagbakal sang COVID-19 vaccines kag pag-hire sang mga contact tracers.
english: Among the amendments in the Senate included in the 2021 spending bill is an additional P10-billion for the purchase of COVID-19 vaccines and the hiring of contact tracers.

text: Ginalauman naman nga maumpisa sa masunod nga semana ang hearing sang bicameral conference agud maobra ang nagakalain-lain nga probisyon sang Senado kag House of Representatives.
english: The hearing of the bicameral conference is expected to begin next week to implement the various provisions of the Senate and House of Representatives.

text: apat ang patay matapos natabo ang encounter sang mga supporters sang mayoral candidates sa Langil Island, Basilan.
english: four people were killed after an encounter between supporters of mayoral candidates in Langil Island, Basilan.

text: Suno sa PNP, ang encounter natabo sa tunga sang supporters sang mayoral candidates sa Hadji Mohammad Ajul, Basilan.
english: According to the PNP, the encounter took place between supporters of mayoral candidates in Hadji Mohammad Ajul, Basilan.

text: Nagresponde ang Special Action Force (SAF) kag local police sa insidente kag ginaimbestigaran pa ang natabo.
english: The Special Action Force (SAF) and local police responded to the incident and are still investigating the incident.

text: Suno sa 11th Infantry Division sang Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), naggwa sa preliminary reports nga nagtiruhay ang magtimbang nga kampo kag indi magnubo sa isa ang patay sa kada bahin.
english: According to the 11th Infantry Division of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), preliminary reports indicated that both sides exchanged fire and at least one person was killed on each side.

text: PAMPANGA – Padayunon sang Philippine Basketball Association sa Martes ang bubble games sa Pampanga.
english: PAMPANGA – The Philippine Basketball Association will continue the bubble games in Pampanga on Tuesday.

text: Ini matapos ang apat ka adlaw nga pagpauntat sang hampang sa 2020 Philippine Cup bilang pagtuman sa rekomendasyon sang Inter-Agency Task Force on COVID-19 bangud sa na record nga COVID-19 cases.
english: This follows the four-day suspension of matches in the 2020 Philippine Cup in compliance with the recommendation of the Inter-Agency Task Force on COVID-19 due to recorded COVID-19 cases.

text: Kadungan sini, ginpasiguro sang PBA nga sundon ang tanan nga rekomendasyon sang Inter-Agency Task Force for the Management of Emerging Infectious Diseases antes ang pagpadayon sang hampang.
english: At the same time, the PBA assured that all recommendations of the Inter-Agency Task Force for the Management of Emerging Infectious Diseases will be followed before the resumption of the match.

text: Ginplastar ni anay Supreme Court Associate Justice Antonio Carpio ang masunod nga tikang nga pwede himuon sang Pilipinas matapos ang pinakaulihi nga pagpang-haras sang Chinese coast guard sa diin ginbungguan sang ila barko ang Filipino navy boats sa West Philippine Sea kun sa diin isa ka Filipino nga navy servicemember ang nautdan sang tudlo.
english: Former Supreme Court Associate Justice Antonio Carpio laid out the next steps the Philippines can take after the latest harassment by the Chinese coast guard where their ship collided with Filipino navy boats in the West Philippine Sea where a Filipino navy servicemember lost his finger.

text: Suno kay Carpio, kinahanglan nga maresolba sang Pilipinas ang “technical problem” antes ini maka- file sang bag-o nga kaso batok sa China sa international tribunal.
english: According to Carpio, the Philippines needs to resolve the “technical problem” before it can file a new case against China in the international tribunal.

text: Suno sa iya, ang tribunal wala sang hurisdiksyon sa military activities.
english: He said the tribunal had no jurisdiction over military activities.

text: Ginrekomendar niya nga islan ang presensiya, halin sa military pakadto sa sibilyan, magatukod sang lighthouse nga gina-operate sang coast guard sa Ayungin Shoal bangud makabig nga sibilyan ang coast guard.
