english: He recommended changing the presence, from military to civilian, building a lighthouse operated by the coast guard in Ayungin Shoal because the coast guard is considered a civilian.

text: Mahimo man suno sa iya nga makatukod sang substation sang coast guard ukon research center ang University of the Philippines sa area.
english: He said the University of the Philippines could also build a coast guard substation or research center in the area.

text: Dugang niya, samtang makapugong ang China sa construction sang civilian replacement para sa BRP Sierra Madre, mahimo magdangop ang Pilipinas sa tribunal kag ipakigbato ang civilian activity ini.
english: He added that while China can prevent the construction of the civilian replacement for the BRP Sierra Madre, the Philippines can turn to the tribunal and fight the civilian activity.

text: Samtang, gin-athag man ni Carpio nga makahingyo ang Pilipinas sa Estados Unidos nga i-escort ang resupply missions para sa tropa sa Ayungin Shoal.
english: Meanwhile, Carpio also explained that the Philippines can request the United States to escort resupply missions for troops in the Ayungin Shoal.

text: Patay ang 16 ka mga estudyante matapos nga nag-collapse ang ila eskwelahan sa central Nigeria.
english: Sixteen students were killed after their school collapsed in central Nigeria.

text: Ginapahayag nga nagakuha gid sang exam ang mga estudyante sa Saint Academy school sa Jos North district sa Plateau State sang natabo ang amo nga insidente.
english: The students were reportedly taking exams at Saint Academy school in Jos North district of Plateau State when the incident occurred.

text: Naghatag man sang statement ang National Emergency Management Agency nga nagakumpirma nga nag-collapse ang duha ka panalgan nga building kun sa diin nahamtang ang Saint Academy kag na-trap ang pila sa mga estudyante.
english: The National Emergency Management Agency also issued a statement confirming that the two-story building where Saint Academy is located collapsed and trapped some of the students.

text: Nagapadayon pa ang ginapatigayon sang otoridad nga search and rescue operation.
english: Authorities are still conducting a search and rescue operation.

text: Sandig sa inisyal nga impormasyon, 11 na sa mga lawas ang yara sa morgue sa Bingham University Teaching Hospital kag lima naman ang gindala sa mortuary sang Our Lady of Apostles Hospital sa Jos.
english: According to initial information, 11 of the bodies are in the morgue at Bingham University Teaching Hospital and five were taken to the mortuary of Our Lady of Apostles Hospital in Jos.

text: Suno naman sa ospital, 15 ang na-rescue nga mga kabataan kag subong ginadapatan na sang pagbulong.
english: According to the hospital, 15 children were rescued and are now undergoing treatment.

text: Wala pa sang madamo nga detalye nga nahatag kun ano ang rason sang pag-collapse apang ginpahayag nga tatlo ka adlaw na nga mamunog ang pag-ulan sa Plateau.
english: Not many details were given as to the cause of the collapse but it was said that it had been raining heavily in the Plateau for three days.

text: Nahibaluan nga masami nagakatabo ang kaangay nga trahedya sa mga building sa Nigeria bangud sa pigado nga law enforcement sa construction standards, negligence kag low-quality materials.
english: It is known that similar tragedies often occur in buildings in Nigeria due to poor law enforcement on construction standards, negligence and low-quality materials.

text: Duha na ang ginpahayag nga patay kag may mga nagkalasamaran sa shooting incident nga nagluntad sa Barangay Mambulac, Silay City, Negros Occidental subong nga aga kadungan sang eleksyon.
english: Two people have been reported dead and several others injured in a shooting incident that occurred in Barangay Mambulac, Silay City, Negros Occidental this morning during the election.

text: Sa inisyal nga report halin sa Bombo Radyo Bacolod, nakasaad nga ang mga biktima ang nagatindog sa gwa sang headquarters sang Grupo Asenso sang ginlabayan sang mga suspek nga nakasakay sa van kag ginpangluthang.
english: According to initial reports from Bombo Radyo Bacolod, the victims were standing outside the headquarters of Grupo Asenso when they were passed by suspects in a van and shot.

text: LAGUNA – Ginpa-iway sang Philippine Football League ang season opener bangud sa epekto sang Tropical Depression “Quinta,” kag sa na record nga COVID-19 cases.
english: LAGUNA – The Philippine Football League has postponed its season opener due to the impact of Tropical Depression “Quinta,” and the recorded COVID-19 cases.

text: Sa statement sang Liga, ginapahayag nga lima ka players ang nagpositibo sa COVID-19 antes pa man ang ila entry sa bubble sa Santa Rosa, Laguna.
english: In a statement, the league said five players tested positive for COVID-19 before their entry into the bubble in Santa Rosa, Laguna.

text: Suno kay Philippine Football League commissioner Coco Torre, may yara naman sang health measures nga ginapatuman agud nga indi na madugangan ang numero sang mga atleta nga nalatnan sang virus.
english: According to Philippine Football League commissioner Coco Torre, there are health measures being implemented to prevent an increase in the number of athletes infected with the virus.

text: Magluwas sa COVID-19 cases, mahimo man nga makaapekto sa hampang nga patigayunon sa Philippine Football Federation training center sa Carmona, Cavite ang weather condition tuga sang Tropical Depression “Quinta”.
english: Aside from the COVID-19 cases, the weather condition caused by Tropical Depression “Quinta” may also affect the match to be held at the Philippine Football Federation training center in Carmona, Cavite.

text: Ang season opener sang Philippine Football League ang patigayunon kun tani subong nga adlaw sang Dominggo, Oktubre 25.
english: The season opener of the Philippine Football League was scheduled to be held today, Sunday, October 25.

text: PAMPANGA – Ginpangunahan nanday Don Trollano kag Nino Canaleta ang Blackwater Elite agud lutuson ang NLEX Road Warriors sa nagapadayon nga 2020 PBA Philippine Cup sa AUF Sports Arena sa Angeles City, Pampanga.
english: PAMPANGA – Don Trollano and Nino Canaleta led the Blackwater Elite to defeat the NLEX Road Warriors in the ongoing 2020 PBA Philippine Cup at the AUF Sports Arena in Angeles City, Pampanga.

text: Nagtapos ang hampang sa score nga 98-88 kun sa diin lunsay nag score sang 18 points sanday Trollano kag Canaleta para sa Blackwater nga may 2-1 win loss record.
english: The game ended with a score of 98-88 with Trollano and Canaleta both scoring 18 points for Blackwater with a 2-1 win loss record.

text: Si Myke Ayonayon ang may 20 points agud pangunahan ang NLEX nga sa subong may 0-3 win loss record.
english: Myke Ayonayon had 20 points to lead NLEX which currently has a 0-3 win loss record.

text: Sa Alaska Aces naman, sanday Jeron Teng kag Jvee Casio ang nagpanguna paagi sa ila 19 kag 17 points batok sa Magnolia Hotshots Pambansang Manok.
english: For the Alaska Aces, Jeron Teng and Jvee Casio led the way with 19 and 17 points against the Magnolia Hotshots Pambansang Manok.

text: Nagtapos ang hampang sa score nga 87-81 kun sa diin lunsay may 1-2 win loss record ang Alaska kag ang Magnolia.
english: The game ended with a score of 87-81 with both Alaska and Magnolia having 1-2 win loss records.

text: Daku naman nga kadulaan sa Magnolia si Kevin Racal nga naka-angkon sang injury sa nauna nga hampang.
english: Kevin Racal, who suffered an injury in the previous game, will be a big loss for Magnolia.

text: Si Mark Barroca ang nagpanguna para sa Magnolia paagi sa iya 16 points.
english: Mark Barroca led the way for Magnolia with his 16 points.

text: Ginlaslasan ni Chinese foreign minister Wang Yi ang North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) bangud sa akusasyon sini nga ginabuligan sang China ang Russia sa gyera sa Ukraine.
english: Chinese foreign minister Wang Yi has lashed out at the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) over its accusation that China is helping Russia in the war in Ukraine.

text: Gintawag ni Wang nga lunsay wala sang basehan ang ginpanghambal sang NATO.
english: Wang called NATO's claims baseless.

text: Nagpaandam man ini sa Western alliance nga likawan na ang pagdabok sang kaangay nga mga kumprontasyon.
english: He also warned the Western alliance to avoid escalating such confrontations.

text: Ang komento ni Wang ang ginpaguwa inoras matapos ang pagtipon sang mga lider sang NATO sa Washington D.C kun sa diin nag-isyu sang deklarasyon nga nagamensyonar ang Russia-Ukraine war.
english: Wang's comments came hours after a meeting of NATO leaders in Washington D.C. where they issued a declaration mentioning the Russia-Ukraine war.

text: Ginmensyonar man ang China bilang “decisive enabler” sang Russia paagi sa paghatag sang “large-scale support” sa defense industrial base sang Moscow.
english: China was also mentioned as Russia’s “decisive enabler” by providing “large-scale support” to Moscow’s defense industrial base.

text: Nagpanawagan man ang NATO sa China nga untaton na ang tanan nga material and political support sa gyera sang Russia kaangay sang pag-suplay sang dual-use materials nga mga item nga pwede magamit sa civilian kag military purposes.
english: NATO also called on China to stop all material and political support to Russia's war such as supplying dual-use materials items that can be used for civilian and military purposes.

text: Antes sini, matandaan nga gin-akusaran man sang Western states ang Beijing sa pagsaylo sang drone and missile technology kag satellite imagery sa Moscow.
english: Earlier, it can be recalled that Western states also accused Beijing of transferring drone and missile technology and satellite imagery to Moscow.

text: Gina-estimate sang US nga 70% sang machine tools kag 90% sang microelectronics Russia imports subong ang naghalin na sa China.
english: The US estimates that 70% of machine tools and 90% of microelectronics Russia imports now come from China.

text: Base sa impormasyon nga gin-post sang Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration ukon PAGASA, ara sa “Danger Level” ang pungsod sang Iloilo City nga may yara sang 42°-degree Celsius heat index, kag Banwa sang Dumangas nga may ara man 43°-degree Celsius heat index.
english: Based on information posted by the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), the country is at the “Danger Level” with Iloilo City with a 42°-degree Celsius heat index, and Dumangas with a 43°-degree Celsius heat index.

text: Suno sa PAGASA, 42°-degree Celcius to 51°-degree Celcius, amo ang makaharadluk nga temperatura, kun sa diin makahatag na ini sang nagkalain-lain nga risgo kaangay sang heat stroke.
english: According to PAGASA, 42°-degree Celsius to 51°-degree Celcius, is the dangerous temperature, where it can cause various risks such as heat stroke.

text: Text by: Bombo Joedel Nollaga
english: Text by: Bombo Joedel Nollaga

text: Nag-abot sa Pilipinas ang dugang nga mga overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) kag ila mga pamilya nga naapektuhan sang nagasingki nga tensyon sa Middle East.
english: More overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) and their families have arrived in the Philippines affected by the escalating tensions in the Middle East.

text: Sa report sang Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), 32 ka repatriates halin sa Oman ang nakabalik sa Pilipinas sakay sa Oman Air flight WY843.
english: According to the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), 32 repatriates from Oman returned to the Philippines aboard Oman Air flight WY843.

text: Lakip sa sini nga numero ang 24 ka OFWs kag walo ka family dependents.
english: This number includes 24 OFWs and eight family dependents.

text: Magluwas sa ila, may yara man sang apat ka OFWs halin sa Dubai kag Oman nga ginbuligan man sang gobyerno nga makapauli.
english: Besides them, there are also four OFWs from Dubai and Oman who were also helped by the government to return home.

text: Suno sa DMW, bangud sang gyera, nagbuligay ang gobyerno kaupod ang embahada kag mga konsulado sang Pilipinas, DMW-Migrant Workers Offices, kag Overseas Workers Welfare Administration nga ma-arrange ang land transportation para nga makakadto ang mga Pinoy sa hilway nga exit points kag mga alternatibo nga airport nga bukas pa para sa international travels.
english: According to the DMW, due to the war, the government worked with the Philippine embassies and consulates, DMW-Migrant Workers Offices, and Overseas Workers Welfare Administration to arrange land transportation for Filipinos to go to free exit points and alternative airports that are still open for international travel.

text: “Ang airspace sa bansang pinanggalingan nila ay very limited kaya naghanap ng paraan to cross the border sa isang bansa na makakalipad sila, and now, they’re here,” kabahin sang pahayag ni Migrant Workers Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac.
english: “The airspace in their country of origin is very limited so they found a way to cross the border to a country where they can fly, and now, they’re here,” said Migrant Workers Secretary Hans Leo J. Cacdac.

text: Nahibaluan nga masobra na sa 400 Filipinos ang nagdesisyon nga magbalik sa Pilipinas halin sang nag-umpisa ang gyera sa Middle East sang Pebrero 28, 2026.#
english: More than 400 Filipinos have decided to return to the Philippines since the war in the Middle East began on February 28, 2026.#

text: Naghinugyaw ang mga tawo sa isa ka campaign caucus ni Manila Mayoral bet Isko Moreno Domagoso bangud sa mga ginhimo ni Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: People cheered at a campaign caucus of Manila Mayor bet Isko Moreno Domagoso over the actions of Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Bag-o ang iya speech para ikampanya ang senatorial slate sang PDP-Laban, ginkakas sang bise presidente ang seal sang Office of the Vice President (OVP) sa atubang sang iya lectern.
english: Before his speech to campaign for the PDP-Laban senatorial slate, the vice president removed the seal of the Office of the Vice President (OVP) in front of his lectern.

text: Nag-joke ini nga islan na lang ini sang seal ng Office of the President (OP).
english: He joked that he would just replace it with the seal of the Office of the President (OP).

text: Madamo ang naghangop sini nga ini na ang posible nga clue ni Sara sa iya pagpadalagan sa 2028 presidential elections.
english: Many interpreted this as a possible clue to Sara's run in the 2028 presidential elections.

text: “Ang susunod po, mangangampanya po ako sa inyong lahat.
english: “Next time, I will campaign for all of you.

text: Sandali lang, tanggalin ko lang po ‘yong seal ng aking opisina.
english: Just a moment, I'm just going to remove the seal of my office.

text: Ah oh, palitan natin ng seal ng Office of the President,” pahayag ni Sara samtang nagasinggit naman ang mga tawo sang “Duterte!
english: Ah oh, let's change the seal of the Office of the President,” Sara said while the crowd shouted “Duterte!

text:
Duterte!”

Dugang pa sini: “Tinanggal ko lang kasi iba ‘yong opisina, iba rin ‘yong pangangampanya.”

Apang buwelta pa gid sini: “Pero kung sa pangulo lang pumili lang kayo si Isko Moreno o si Sara Duterte.
english:
Duterte!”

He added: “I just removed it because it's a different office, it's a different campaign.”

But he added: “But if you are the president, choose Isko Moreno or Sara Duterte.

text:
Wala kaming problema.”

Matandaan nga nagpahayag si Sara nga ginkumbinse siya sang iya amay nga si former President Rodrigo Duterte nga magguwa kag magpangampanya ilabi na sa mga nagapadalagan sa idalom sang PDP-Laban.
english:
We have no problem.”

Sara said her father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, convinced her to go out and campaign especially for those running under the PDP-Laban.

text: Ginahimo ini sang bise-presidente samtang pending subong ang impeachment batok sa iya sa Senado.
english: The vice-president is doing this while the impeachment trial against him is pending in the Senate.

text: Sa amo man nga kampanya, naglahog si Sara kay Imee nga islan na lang ang iya apelyido.
english: During the same campaign, Sara urged Imee to change her last name.

text: Gin-joke man niya ini kun magapabilin gid man ang senadora sa iya nga kampo.
english: He also joked that the senator would remain in his camp.

text: “Magpalit ka na po ng apelyido mo.
english: “Change your last name.

text: Ay, Romualdez pala yung middle name mo,” pahayag sang bise.
english: Oh, your middle name is Romualdez,” the vice said.

text: Matandaan nga naghalin si Imee sa senatorial slate nga ginaendorso sang iya utod nga si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: It can be recalled that Imee left the senatorial slate endorsed by her brother President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: kasunod sang pagdakop kay former President Duterte sang Marso 11 kag pagdala sa iya sa The Hague.
english: following the arrest of former President Duterte on March 11 and his extradition to The Hague.

text: Kasunod sadto, nanguna man si Imee sa hearings sang Senado kaangot sa legalidad sang pag-aresto sa former president, tubtub nga sang ulihi, gin-endorso na siya ni Sara sa iya reelection bid.
english: Subsequently, Imee also led the Senate hearings on the legality of the arrest of the former president, until later, Sara endorsed her in her reelection bid.

text: Gamayan lang madisgrasya ang kilala nga pop star nga si Katy Perry sa tunga-tunga sang iya performance sa Lifetimes concert sa San Francisco.
english: Pop star Katy Perry almost had an accident in the middle of her performance at the Lifetimes concert in San Francisco.

text: Suno sa video nga nakuha sang isa ka fan, makita nga ginakanta ni Katy ang iya kilala nga hit song nga “Roar” samtang sakay siya sa butterfly-shaped nga prop.
english: According to a video captured by a fan, Katy can be seen singing her well-known hit song “Roar” as she rides the butterfly-shaped prop.

text: Sa Hinali lang, nag-malfunction ang amo nga props, nga nagresulta sa halos nadulaan siya sang balanse.
english: Suddenly, those props malfunctioned, causing him to almost lose his balance.

text: Maswerte lang nga nakauyat si Katy sa higot sang iya ng props rason nga nga wala ini gilayon nahulog.
english: Luckily, Katy was able to hold on to the rope of her props so it didn't fall immediately.

text: Sa pihak sang insidente, nagpadayon gihapon ang performer sa iya show, nga ginpakita ang iya professionalism kag determinasyon nga matapos ang performance.
english: Despite the incident, the performer still went ahead with his show, showing his professionalism and determination to finish the performance.

text: Magluwas sa kanta sini nga “Roar,” kilala man si Katy Perry sa iban pa niya nga mga kanta kaangay sang “Last Friday Night,” “Firework,” kag madamo pa nga mga international hits.
english: Besides its song “Roar,” Katy Perry is also known for her other songs like “Last Friday Night,” “Firework,” and many other international hits.

text: SA DAAN nga Konstitusyon kag tubtub sa pangginahum martial law ni anay Presidente Marcos Sr.
english: IN THE OLD Constitution and until the rule of martial law of former President Marcos Sr.

text: ang paghatag sing kaayuhan sa sosyedad ginapasalig lang para sa kadam-an, ukon “the greatest number”.
english: social welfare is only assured for the majority, or “the greatest number”.

text: Ginbag-o na ini sang 1987 (Cory) Constitution, nga bunga sang Edsa Revolution, nga nagapasanyog sang “common good”, ukon kaayuhan sang tanan.
english: This was changed by the 1987 (Cory) Constitution, a product of the Edsa Revolution, which promoted the “common good”, or the common good.

text: Pero malain pa kuno si Cory kag mas maayo si Marcos, nga daw indi importante sa ila ang Kahilwayan kag pagpasanyog sang “common good” samtang gina-enjoy man nila ini!
english: But Cory is said to be worse and Marcos is better, as if Freedom and the promotion of the common good are not important to them while they enjoy it!

text: Talagang sira!
english: They really are!

text: Sa karon man, ang libre nga Basic Education sa public schools ginpalawak pa sang Republic Act (RA) No.
english: Meanwhile, the free Basic Education in public schools has been expanded by Republic Act (RA) No.

text: 10533, ukon ang Enhanced Basic Education Act of 2013 halin sa 10 ka tuig tubtub 13 ka tuig nga lakip na ang Kindergarten kag duha ka tuig nga Senior High School.
english: 10533, or the Enhanced Basic Education Act of 2013 from 10 years to 13 years including Kindergarten and two-year Senior High School.

text: Ginpatuman ang Grade 11 sang SHS sadtong school year 2016-2017 kag ang Grade 12 sang SHS sadtong SY 2017-2018.
english: Grade 11 of SHS was implemented in school year 2016-2017 and Grade 12 of SHS in SY 2017-2018.

text: Mismo sa Cory Constitution, gina-garantiya ang kinamatarong sa mabungahon nga edukasyon sa tanan nga Filipino sa idalom sang Article XIV Section 1.
english: The Cory Constitution itself guarantees the right to a productive education to all Filipinos under Article XIV Section 1.

text: Ang Article XIV Section 2.3 nagapatuman naman sang subsidiya (subsidy) kag incentivo (incentives) sa mga deserving students sa mga eskwelahan, publiko man kag pribado.
english: Article XIV Section 2.3 provides for subsidies and incentives to deserving students in schools, both public and private.

text: Ginpalawak ang programa sini sa paghatag sing bulig sa idalom sang Government Assistance to Students and Teachers in Private Education (E-GASTPE Law, ukon ang RA No.
english: Its assistance program was expanded under the Government Assistance to Students and Teachers in Private Education (E-GASTPE Law, or RA No.

text: Nagahatag ang RA 8545 sang dugang nga benepisyo sa qualificado nga mga estudyante sa Grade 11 kag 12 nga luyag magtuon sa private schools nga ginapatuman sa idalom sang Public-Private Partnership (PPP) sa pagbinuligay sang gobyerno kag pribado nga sektor.
english: RA 8545 provides additional benefits to qualified students in Grades 11 and 12 who wish to study in private schools implemented under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) in collaboration between the government and the private sector.

text:
***

Ugaling taliwas sa gina-garantiya sang 1987 Constitution nga mabuligan sang gobyerno ang tanan nga mga estudyante.
english:
***

But contrary to the guarantee of the 1987 Constitution that the government can help all students.

text: Daw nalipatan sang gobyerno ang mga private schools nga dapat mabuligan sang “Fund Assistance for Private Education” (FAPE) sang gobyerno sa pagpakig-ugyon sini sa PPP.
english: The government seems to have forgotten the private schools that should be helped by the government's Fund Assistance for Private Education (FAPE) in its PPP agreement.

text: Sang sini lang, nangin controversial gani ang San Lorenzo College sa Quezon City, tungod sa hinali nga pagpanirado sini sadtong Agosto 15.
english: Recently, San Lorenzo College in Quezon City became controversial, due to its sudden closure on August 15.

text: Ina tungod indi na ini mabuligan sang gobyerno ang pagpa-enrol sang kinahanglan nga mga estudyante nga makasuporta man sa mga manunudlo kag sang ikabuhi mismo sang eskwelahan.
english: This is because the government can no longer help enroll the needed students who can also support the teachers and the livelihood of the school itself.

text: Siling gani ni Bishop Roberto Mallari sang San Jose de Nueva Ecija, chairman sang Commission on Catechesis and Catholic Education of the Catholic Bishops Conference of the Philippines (CBCP), nga ang bulig sang gobyerno sa private schools “crucial”.
english: Bishop Roberto Mallari of San Jose de Nueva Ecija, chairman of the Commission on Catechesis and Catholic Education of the Catholic Bishops Conference of the Philippines (CBCP), said that government assistance to private schools is “crucial”.

text: “Indi man lang tungod sa negosyo natukod ang mga private schools para mabuhi man, kundi, labi kag labaw sa tanan, natukod sila sa mayor nga misyon agud makabulig sa moral development sang mga kabataan,” paathag niya.
english: “Private schools are not only established for business to survive, but, above all, they are established with the main mission to help the moral development of children,” he explained.

text: Sunu sa Section 12, Article II sang 1987 Constitution, obligasyon sang gobyerno nga suportahan ang “development of moral character” sang mga kabataan nga mas epektibo nga mahimo sang mga religious schools.
english: According to Section 12, Article II of the 1987 Constitution, it is the obligation of the government to support the “development of moral character” of children which can be done more effectively by religious schools.

text: Sa Iloilo, nagpahibalo man sang ila pagpanirado ang 10 ka private schools diri.
english: In Iloilo, 10 private schools here also announced their closure.

text: Si DepEd regional spokesperson Hernani Escullar Jr.
english: DepEd regional spokesperson Hernani Escullar Jr.

text: nagpahibalo gani nga mga 74 gid ka private schools ang nagpanirado diri sa Western Visayas.
english: announced that about 74 private schools have closed in Western Visayas.

text: Sunu man kay Undersecretary for Planning Jesus Mateo, as of October 4, 2021, 860 ka private schools ang nag-untat pag-operar para sa SY 2020-2021.
english: According to Undersecretary for Planning Jesus Mateo, as of October 4, 2021, 860 private schools have stopped operating for SY 2020-2021.

text: Sa kabilugan, sobra 14,000 ka private schools ang bukas sadtong SY 2019-2020.
english: In total, more than 14,000 private schools were open during SY 2019-2020.

text:
***

Ang masakit pa kay indi gid mabuligan sang gobyerno bisan paano ang mga magagmay nga mga private schools.
english:
***

The painful thing is that the government can't help the small private schools anyway.

text: Sunu kay Eleazardo Kasilag, presidente sang Federation of Associations of Private Achools Adminiatrators (FAPSA), dapat man mabuligan ang “small private schools”.
english: According to Eleazardo Kasilag, president of the Federation of Associations of Private Achools Administrators (FAPSA), small private schools should also be helped.

text: Gintudlo niya ang Executive Order (EO) No.
english: He pointed to Executive Order (EO) No.

text: 156 nga nagatukod sang FAPE bilang isa ka “irrevocable trust fund” nga dapat kalakip diri ang mga magagmay nga mga private schools kag indi lang ang dalagku nga mga colleges kag universities.
english: 156 which establishes FAPE as an “irrevocable trust fund” that should include small private schools and not just large colleges and universities.

text: In fact, sa  budget mismo sang gobyerno, siling niya, sadtong 2021 ang gobyerno may budget nga P606.5 ka bilyon para sa DepEd, apang wala ini ma-share sa mga 6,000 small kag medium-sized schools.
english: In fact, in the government's own budget, he said, in 2021 the government had a budget of P606.5 billion for DepEd, but it was not shared with about 6,000 small and medium-sized schools.

text: Ngaa ayhan?
english: Why maybe?

text: Tungod lang kay gagmay lang sila nga mga eskwelahan kag ang qualificado lang ang dalagku nga colleges kag universities?
english: Just because they are small schools and only the big colleges and universities are qualified?

text: Indi ayhan dapat mas mabuligan ang magagmay nga mga private schools?
english: Shouldn't small private schools be given more help?

text: Kon ang mga kubos nga pumuluyo ang ginapalabi naton buligan, ngaa abe indi man ang mga magagmay nga mga private schools kay kubos man ini sila?
english: If we prefer to help the poor, why not the small private schools because they are also poor?

text: “Common good” man bala ang ginapatuman naton, indi bala?/PN
english: We are also implementing “common good”, right?/PN

text: Ginklaro sang Kamara nga wala nila ginakontra ang desisyon sang mga mahistrado sa Korte Suprema kundi ginahimo gid lamang nila ang ila nga obligasyon nga santo sa Konstitusyon.
english: The House made it clear that they are not opposing the decision of the judges in the Supreme Court but are merely carrying out their obligations under the Constitution.

text: Lakip ini sa ginplastar sang lower chamber sang nag-file na ini sang motion for reconsideration nga nagahingyo sa Korte Suprema nga baliskadon ang nauna nga desisyon sini nga unconstitutional ang articles of impeachment batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: This is among the issues raised by the lower chamber when it filed a motion for reconsideration asking the Supreme Court to overturn its previous decision that the articles of impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte are unconstitutional.

text: Suno kay House Speaker Martin Romualdez, wala nila ginahangkat ang awtoridad sang korte, kundi tuyo gid lamang nila nga mapabilin ang kinamatarong sang Kamara bilang tingog sang pumuluyo sa proseso sang pagpasabat sa mga opisyal sang gobyerno.
english: According to House Speaker Martin Romualdez, they are not challenging the authority of the court, but only intend to preserve the right of the House as the voice of the people in the process of holding government officials accountable.

text: “This is not an act of defiance.
english: “This is not an act of defiance.

text: It is an act of duty,” kabahin sang deklarasyon sini.
english: It is an act of duty,” part of its declaration.

text: “With full respect for the Constitution, in defense of institutional balance, and in the name of the Filipino people, the House of Representatives has filed a Motion for Reconsideration before the Supreme Court,” dugang niya.
english: “With full respect for the Constitution, in defense of institutional balance, and in the name of the Filipino people, the House of Representatives has filed a Motion for Reconsideration before the Supreme Court,” he added.

text: “We do not challenge the authority of the Court.
english: “We do not challenge the authority of the Court.

text: We seek only to preserve the rightful role of the House – the voice of the people – in the process of accountability,” pahayag pa ni Speaker Romualdez.
english: We seek only to preserve the rightful role of the House – the voice of the people – in the process of accountability,” Speaker Romualdez said.

text: Kadungan sang pagpanindugan nga klaro sa Konstitusyon nga ang Kamara amo lang ang may eksklusibo nga kinamatarong sa pagpa-sugod sang impeachment, ginpahayag ni Romualdez nga ginsunod nila ang Konstitusyon kag ang mga nagliligad nga desisyon sang Korte Suprema sa ginpatigayon nga impeachment sang mga kongresista kay Duterte.
english: While insisting that it is clear in the Constitution that the House of Representatives has the exclusive right to initiate impeachment, Romualdez said they followed the Constitution and the previous decisions of the Supreme Court in the impeachment of Duterte by congressmen.

text: Sa ila nga apela sa Korte Suprema, ginpahayag ni Romualdez nga isa lang ka reklamo sang impeachment ang “initiated” batok kay Duterte, kag indi apat, kaangay sang ginahambal sa desisyon sang Korte Suprema.
english: In their appeal to the Supreme Court, Romualdez said only one impeachment complaint was “initiated” against Duterte, and not four, as stated in the Supreme Court's decision.

text: Paathag sang Speaker, ginbutang lang sa archive ang tatlo ka una nga impeachment complaints sang napadala na sa Senado ang ikaapat nga reklamo nga pirmado sang 215 ka mga kongresista.
english: The Speaker explained that the first three impeachment complaints were only archived when the fourth complaint signed by 215 congressmen was sent to the Senate.

text: Importante ini nga pagpasunod suno sa iya bangud nagapamatuod ini nga may isa lamang ka valid initiation kag indi apat.
english: This is important, he said, because it proves that there is only one valid initiation and not four.

text: “On February 5, 2025, the House transmitted the fourth impeachment complaint – filed and signed by 215 Members – to the Senate.
english: “On February 5, 2025, the House transmitted the fourth impeachment complaint – filed and signed by 215 Members – to the Senate.

text: Only after this transmittal did we archive the earlier three complaints.
english: Only after this transmittal did we archive the earlier three complaints.

text: That sequence matters.
english: That sequence matters.

text: It proves there was only one valid initiation, not four,” paathag sini sa iya video message.
english: It proves there was only one valid initiation, not four,” he explained in his video message.

text: “Even the Court’s own precedent – Francisco v. House – supports this: Only one impeachment can be initiated, and that initiation begins with a one-third endorsement or a referral.
english: “Even the Court’s own precedent – ​​Francisco v. House – supports this: Only one impeachment can be initiated, and that initiation begins with a one-third endorsement or a referral.

text: That is exactly what the House did,” dugang sang opisyal.
english: That is exactly what the House did,” the official added.

text: Gindugang pa sang lider sang Kamara nga wala sang nakasulat sa Konstitusyon nga kinahanglan pa pasabton anay si Duterte sa mga akusasyon batok sa iya antes ipadala sa Senado ang articles of impeachment.
english: The House leader added that there is nothing written in the Constitution that Duterte must be held accountable for the charges against him before the articles of impeachment are sent to the Senate.

text: Ang iya sabat kag panindugan batok sa mga akusasyon suno kay Romualdez ang dapat nga matabo na lang sa Senate trial bilang impeachment court, pareho sang natabo sa iban nga mga opisyal nga na-impeach na.
english: His answer and stand against the accusations, Romualdez said, should be held in the Senate trial as an impeachment court, as happened to other officials who have already been impeached.

text: Kahapon, Agusto 4, sang gin-file sang Kamara ang motion for reconsideration paagi sa Office of Solicitor General nga amo ang nagatindog nga abogado sang lower chamber.#
english: Yesterday, August 4, when the House filed the motion for reconsideration through the Office of Solicitor General who is the standing lawyer of the lower chamber.#

text: Duha na ka mga barangay sa banwa sang Lemery ang ginrespondehan sang kapulisan agud ikumpirma kun may mga vote buying gidman nga nagakatabo.
english: Two barangays in Lemery town have already been responded to by the police to confirm whether there is indeed vote buying going on.

text: Sa interview sang Bombon Radyo kay Police Captain John Robles, hepe sang Lemery Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga may mga nag-report sa ila nga may ginapatigayon nga vote buying sa amo nga mga barangay apang sa tion nga ginkadtuan ini, wala sang amo nga hitabo.
english: In an interview with Bombon Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain John Robles, chief of Lemery Municipal Police Station, said they received reports of vote buying in the barangays but when they visited the barangays, there was no such incident.

text: Suno kay Robles, magluwas diri, may mga nakit-an man sa social media apang wala sang pormal nga may naga-complaint sa ila estasyon.
english: According to Robles, besides this, there are also those who have been seen on social media but no one has formally complained to their station.

text: Dugang ni Robles, kung may mga makit-an ukon may ginahawidan nga mga ebidensya kaangot sa pagpamakal sang boto gilayon lang nga makipag-angot sa ila.
english: Robles added that if anyone finds or has evidence related to vote buying, they should immediately contact them.

text: Text by: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑯𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒂 𝑨𝒏𝒅𝒂𝒔𝒂
english: Text by: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑯𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒂 𝑨𝒏𝒅𝒂𝒔𝒂

text: MANILA – Magapaidalom sa “bubble” set up training ang mga locally based Olympic-bound Filipino athletes.
english: MANILA – Locally based Olympic-bound Filipino athletes will undergo “bubble” set up training.

text: Pila lamang sa ginapili-an nga venue sang Philippine Sports Commission amo ang Inspire Sports Academy sa Calamba, Laguna ukon sa historic island sang Corregidor.
english: Some of the venues chosen by the Philippine Sports Commission are the Inspire Sports Academy in Calamba, Laguna or the historic island of Corregidor.

text: Suno kay Philippine Sports Commission commissioner Ramon Fernandez, ginahitso na sa subong ang mangin venue sang training.
english: According to Philippine Sports Commission commissioner Ramon Fernandez, the venue for the training is being prepared.

text: Ginpahayag ni Fernandez nga sa Nobyembre ukon sa Disyembre magapadayon na ang training sang mga atleta nga magapakigbahin sa Olympics kasubong nanday Carlos Yulo sa gymnastics, EJ Obiena sa pole vault, Eumir Marcial kag Irish Magno sa boksing.
english: Fernandez said that in November or December, the training of athletes who will participate in the Olympics such as Carlos Yulo in gymnastics, EJ Obiena in pole vault, Eumir Marcial and Irish Magno in boxing will continue.

text: Sa subong, ginpahayag sang four-time PBA MVP nga gina-istoryahan pa kun pila ka tawo ang pahanugutan nga makasulod sa bubble.
english: Meanwhile, the four-time PBA MVP said they are still discussing how many people will be allowed in the bubble.

text: CANADA – Gintay-og sang magnitude 6.4 nga linog ang southwestern sang Canada malapit sa Vancouver City.
english: CANADA – A magnitude 6.4 earthquake shook southwestern Canada near Vancouver City.

text: Suno sa United States Geological Survey (USGS), ang sentro sang linog ang yara 194 kilometers sang southwest sang Port Alice.
english: According to the United States Geological Survey (USGS), the epicenter was located 194 kilometers southwest of Port Alice.

text: Ginpahayag man sang USGS nga nabatyagan sang 2,000 ka mga pumuluyo ang pagtay-og.
english: The USGS also said 2,000 residents felt the quake.

text: Una nga natukiban ang mahinay nga pag-uyog pasado alas 8 sang aga sa ila lokal nga oras.
english: The faint tremor was first detected shortly after 8 a.m. local time.

text: Narekord man sang USGS makaligad ang isa pa ka oras, ang isa pa ka linog nga may kabaskugon nga 5.4 ang nag-uyog mga 115 miles sa nakatundan sang Tofino.
english: Also recorded by the USGS another hour later, another quake with a magnitude of 5.4 struck about 115 miles west of Tofino.

text: Suno naman sa gobyerno sang Canada, ang linog nga may kabaskugon nga kapin sa 6 magnitude ang ginakabig na nga mabaskog, tubtob sa mga 62 ka milya ang kalayuon nga mahimo makatuga sang kahalitan ilabi na sa indi maayo nga pagkatukod sang mga buildings kag iban pa nga mga estraktura.
english: According to the Canadian government, an earthquake with a magnitude of more than 6 is considered strong, up to about 62 miles away, which can cause damage especially to poorly constructed buildings and other structures.

text: Gin-athag man sang USGS nga wala sang risgo sang tsunami kasunod sang mabaskog nga linog.
english: The USGS also clarified that there is no risk of a tsunami following the strong earthquake.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang linog, ang liwat nga natabo wala pa isa ka semana matapos ang nagluntad nga magnitude 5 nga linog sa amo man nga lugar.
english: The earthquake occurred less than a week after a magnitude 5 earthquake struck the same area.

text: Ang nauna nga linog ang nasentro man sa Dagat Pasipiko sa baybayon sang Canada, halos 150 ka milya gikan sa Tofino, kag may pareho nga narekord nga kadalumon.
english: The earlier quake was also centered in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of Canada, nearly 150 miles from Tofino, and had the same recorded depth.

text: Nagdugang pa ang aktor kag major Hollywood fundraiser para sa Democrats nga si George Clooney sa pagpanawagan kay US President Joe Biden nga mag-atras na sa kampanya sini para sa reelection subong nga 2024.
english: Actor and major Hollywood fundraiser for Democrats George Clooney has called on US President Joe Biden to withdraw from his 2024 re-election campaign.

text: Si Clooney ang isa sa nag-host sa star-studded fundraiser para kay Biden sa Los Angeles sang bulan sang Hunyo nga halos duha ka semana antes nahuy-an ang 81-anyos nga presidente bangud sa pigado sini nga performance sa presidential debate batok sa Republican presumptive nominee kag anay President Donald Trump.
english: Clooney co-hosted a star-studded fundraiser for Biden in Los Angeles in June nearly two weeks before the 81-year-old was embarrassed by his poor performance in a presidential debate against Republican presumptive nominee and former President Donald Trump.

text: Pahayag ni Clooney nga nagalaragway sa iya kaugalingon bilang “lifelong Democrat”, indi na pareho si Biden sa ginpakita sini nga performance sang 2020.
english: Clooney, who describes himself as a “lifelong Democrat”, said Biden is no longer the same performance he showed in 2020.

text: Nagapati ang natungdan nga indi na magdaog ang Democrats sa Nobyembre kun si Biden ang kandidato, magluwas pa nga indi man sini maangkon ang House kag madula man pati sa ila ang Senado.
english: He believes that the Democrats will not win in November if Biden is the candidate, besides not winning the House and losing the Senate.

text: Ginbuyagyag pa ni Clooney nga indi lang ini iya kaugalingon nga opinyon bangud amo man sini ang opinyon sang mga myembro sang Kongreso kag mga gobernador nga iya naistorya sang pribado.
english: Clooney revealed that this is not just his own opinion because it is also the opinion of members of Congress and governors he has spoken to privately.

text: Una na nga gin-ako ni Biden nga apektado sang iya edad ang iya debate performance, apang nagpromisa ini nga magapadayon siya sa kandidatura kag indi ini mag-atras kay Trump bisan sa ikaduha nga presidential debate sa Septyembre.
english: Biden has previously acknowledged that his age has affected his debate performance, but he has promised that he will pursue the candidacy and will not back down from Trump even in the second presidential debate in September.

text: Nakasulod na sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) ang gina-monitor sang state weather bureau nga low pressure area sa nasidlangan nga parte sang pungsod.
english: The low pressure area monitored by the state weather bureau in the eastern part of the country has entered the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR).

text: Sa 8:00 p.m. update sang Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) subong nga Agusto 4, nasiplatan ang LPA sa kalayuon nga 1,025 nasidlangan sang Southeastern Luzon.
english: In the 8:00 p.m. update of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) this August 4, the LPA was spotted at a distance of 1,025 east of Southeastern Luzon.

text: Pahayag sang state weather bureau, manubo ang posibilidad sini nga mangin bagyo sa masunod nga 24 oras.
english: According to the state weather bureau, it is unlikely to become a typhoon in the next 24 hours.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang ahensya nga ini nga LPA ang mahimo magdala sang pag-ulan-ulan sa eastern part sang Southern Luzon kag Visayas sa Huwebes kag sa Byernes.#
english: The agency earlier said that this LPA is likely to bring rains in the eastern part of Southern Luzon and Visayas on Thursday and Friday.

text: Na-release na sang Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board ang P716 million nga cash subsidies sa mga public utility vehicle operators.
english: The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board has released P716 million in cash subsidies to public utility vehicle operators.

text: Suno kay LTFRB Officer-in-Charge Zona Russet Tamayo, ang nasambit nga balor ang ginhatag sa mga operators sang 110,000 ka mga bus, P2P buses, jeepneys, minibuses, UV Express kag Philcab units.
english: According to LTFRB Officer-in-Charge Zona Russet Tamayo, the said value was given to the operators of 110,000 buses, P2P buses, jeepneys, minibuses, UV Express and Philcab units.

text: Sa idalom sang Bayanihan To Recover As One act, ang mga apektado nga mga negosyo sa road sector ang makabaton sang cash grant balor P6,500.
english: Under the Bayanihan To Recover As One act, affected businesses in the road sector will receive a cash grant worth P6,500.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang kabug-usan nga pondo nga gintalana sa sini nga katuyuan ang nagabalor sang P2.6 billion.
english: The total fund allocated for this purpose is worth P2.6 billion.

text: USA – Nagapabilin nga buhi ang paglaum sang Miami Heat nga makabawi sa game 3 sang 2020 NBA Finals batok sa Los Angeles Lakers.
english: USA – The Miami Heat's hopes of a comeback in game 3 of the 2020 NBA Finals against the Los Angeles Lakers remain alive.

text: Ini matapos nga ginlutos sang Lakers ang Heat sa 10 points deficit sa game 2 sa score nga 124-114.
english: This comes after the Lakers beat the Heat to a 10-point deficit in game 2 with a score of 124-114.

text: Suno kay Coach Erik Spoelstra, tuman ka gamay sang tyansa sang Heat nga makasulod sa 2020 NBA Finals apang ila ini nga nalampuwasan apisar sang mga pagpanghangkat.
english: According to Coach Erik Spoelstra, the Heat had very little chance of reaching the 2020 NBA Finals but they overcame it despite the challenges.

text: Ginpahayag ni Spoelstra nga apisar sang 2-0 lead sang Lakers, tinguhaan sang iya team nga makabawi sa game 3 agud mapwersa ang game 7.
english: Spoelstra said that despite the Lakers' 2-0 lead, his team will try to recover from game 3 to force game 7.

text: Apisar nga mabaskog ang Lakers kun sa diin nagahampang si LeBron James, ginpahayag sang Fil-Am coach nga “extremely stubborn” kag “persistent” ang Heat sa handum nga makabawi sa hampang.
english: Although the Lakers are strong with LeBron James, the Fil-Am coach said the Heat are “extremely stubborn” and “persistent” in their desire to recover.

text: Ang game 3 ang patigayunon buwas sa aga, Oktubre 5, kag ang coverage ang mabati-an live sa Bombo Radyo Iloilo.
english: Game 3 will be played tomorrow morning, October 5, and the coverage will be heard live on Bombo Radyo Iloilo.

text: ILOILO CITY- Naaresto ang isa ka wanted nga lalaki nga may kaso nga rape paagi sa graduation photo sang iya bata nga naka-post sa facebook.
english: ILOILO CITY- A wanted man with a rape case was arrested for posting his daughter's graduation photo on Facebook.

text: Suno sa otoridad, 10 ka tuig na nila nga ginapangita ang suspek bangud sa kaso nga rape sa iya nga hinablos.
english: According to the authorities, they have been looking for the suspect for 10 years in connection with the rape of his nephew.

text:
Natultulan sang mga pulis sa Aklan ang suspek apang ang iya kaso ang narekord sa Quezon kag nalakip man ini sa “most wanted person” sang Region 4-A.

Ginpahayag nga ginhimuslan sang suspek ang iya hinablos nga menor de edad sang 2014 sa Pagbilao, Quezon.
english:
Police in Aklan tracked down the suspect but his case was recorded in Quezon and he is also included in the “most wanted person” of Region 4-A.

The suspect allegedly raped his minor nephew in 2014 in Pagbilao, Quezon.

text: Halin sa Aklan, gindala na sa Quezon ang suspek.
english: From Aklan, the suspect was brought to Quezon.

text: Nagpromisa si US President Joe Biden nga hatagan ang Ukraine sang lima ka bag-o nga strategic air defence systems agud nga batuan ang wala-untat nga pagpang-atake sang Russia.
english: US President Joe Biden has promised to provide Ukraine with five new strategic air defense systems to counter Russia’s relentless attacks.

text: Kabahin ini sang speech sang presidente sang iya gin-abi-abi ang mga lider sang North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) sa pagbukas sang tatlo ka adlaw nga summit sa Washington DC.
english: This was part of the president’s speech when he welcomed the leaders of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) at the opening of the three-day summit in Washington DC.

text: Sa amo nga speech, ginsiling ni Biden nga mas gamhanan subong ang NATO samtang nga ginaatubang sini ang mga hitabo sa tunga sang gyera sang Russia kag Ukraine.
english: In the speech, Biden said NATO is more powerful now as it deals with the events between the Russia-Ukraine war.

text: Suno kay Biden, magapares ang Amerika sa Germany, Italy, the Netherlands kag Romania agud mag-donar sang Patriot missile batteries kag iban pa nga systems sa Ukraine bangud man sa mga sibilyan nga nagkalamatay sa atake sang Russia.
english: Biden said the United States will pair with Germany, Italy, the Netherlands and Romania to donate Patriot missile batteries and other systems to Ukraine because of the civilian casualties in the Russian attack.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga adlaw, ginpulbos sang missiles sang Russia ang children’s hospital sa Kyiv nga isa sa pinakamalala halin sang nagsugod ang Russian invasion sang Pebrero 2022.
english: It can be recalled that the previous day, Russian missiles pulverized the children’s hospital in Kyiv, one of the worst since the Russian invasion began in February 2022.

text: 43 ka mga tawo halin sa nanuhay-tuhay nga bahin sang Ukraine ang napatay sa amo nga pagpang-atake sang Lunes nga adlaw kag masobra naman sa 100 ang napilasan.#
english: 43 people from different parts of Ukraine were killed in the attack on Monday and more than 100 were injured.

text: Ginpahayag ni Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief Gen.
english: Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief Gen.

text: Nicolas Torre III nga ginalantaw sang PNP ang posibilidad sang pagbakal sang non-lethal nga kagamitan para sa mga pulis nga nagaresponde sa mga insidente, agud malikawan ang madugo nga engkwentro sa mga suspetsado.
english: Nicolas Torre III said the PNP is looking into the possibility of purchasing non-lethal equipment for policemen who respond to incidents, to avoid bloody encounters with suspects.

text: Ini nga pahayag ang naguwa matapos ang insidente sa Pavia, Iloilo sang nagligad nga Sabado, kun sa diin gintiro-patay sang isa ka pulis ang isa ka lalaki nga nagawaras kag may dala nga kutsilyo.
english: This statement came after the incident in Pavia, Iloilo last Saturday, where a policeman shot dead a man who was carrying a knife.

text: Suno kay Torre, ang ginakonsiderar nga non-lethal weapons amo ang mga plastic nga batuta, pepper spray, kag taser.
english: Torre said the only considered non-lethal weapons are plastic batons, pepper spray, and a taser.

text: Una na nga nagmando si Torre sa mga kapulisan nga una dapat gamiton ang non-deadly nga pamaagi sa pagresponde sa mga krimen.
english: Earlier, Torre ordered the police to use non-deadly methods to respond to crimes.

text: Samtang ginapatigayon ang imbestigasyon sa pulis nga nalakip sa insidente sa Pavia, ginpahayag ni Torre nga ginhahatagan anay ini sang benefit of the doubt kag padayon nga ginasuportahan sang PNP leadership.
english: While the investigation into the policeman involved in the Pavia incident is ongoing, Torre said he is being given the benefit of the doubt and continues to be supported by the PNP leadership.

text: Pahayag man ni Torre nga kabahin sang standard training sang mga kapulisan ang paggamit sang unarmed combat, disarming techniques, kag iban pa nga non-lethal nga pamaagi sa pagpakalma sang mga peligroso nga sitwasyon.
english: Torre also said that part of the standard training of the police is the use of unarmed combat, disarming techniques, and other non-lethal methods to calm dangerous situations.

text: Mas istrikto pa sa mga pagsulundan sa National Basketball Association ukon NBA ang mga patakaran nga ipatuman sa PBA Bubble sa Clark, Pampanga.
english: The rules that will be enforced at the PBA Bubble in Clark, Pampanga are stricter than the rules of the National Basketball Association or NBA.

text: Suno kay Secretary Vince Dizon, presidente sang Bases Conversion and Development Authority (BCDA), “gold standard” ang safety kag health guidelines sang NBA, apang masobra pa diri ang ipatuman hampang sa Pilipinas.
english: According to Secretary Vince Dizon, president of the Bases Conversion and Development Authority (BCDA), the NBA's safety and health guidelines are “gold standard”, but more will be implemented in the Philippines.

text: Para sa PBA restart, dapat magsuksok sang face mask ang mga players nga yara nagapungko sa bench.
english: For the PBA restart, players sitting on the bench must wear face masks.

text: Indi man pagpahanugutan ang mga pamilya sang players nga magsulod sa bubble sa bisan ano nga bahin sang season.
english: Players’ families will also not be allowed into the bubble at any point during the season.

text: Indi man mahimo ang pag-high five ukon ano man nga selebrasyon sang hampang.
english: High fiving or any celebration of the game is also not allowed.

text: Suno naman kay PBA commissioner Willie Marcial, kun may maggwa sa bubble, indi na ini pagpahanugutan nga makabalik apisar emergency pa ang rason sang paggwa.
english: According to PBA commissioner Willie Marcial, if someone leaves the bubble, he will not be allowed to return even if the reason for leaving is an emergency.

text: Nahibaluan nga natalana nga magbalik ang Philippine Cup sa Oktubre 11 sa Angeles University Foundation gym.
english: The Philippine Cup is scheduled to resume on October 11 at the Angeles University Foundation gym.

text: MANILA – Target sang Philippine Basketball Association nga umpisahan ang 46th season sa Abril sa masunod nga tuig.
english: MANILA – The Philippine Basketball Association targets to start its 46th season in April next year.

text: Ini agud nga mahatagan sang kahigayunan ang PBA players nga mangin available matapos ang pagpakigbahin sang national team sa FIBA Asia Cup 2021 qualifiers sa Pebrero.
english: This is to give the PBA players the opportunity to be available after the national team's participation in the FIBA ​​Asia Cup 2021 qualifiers in February.

text: Suno kay PBA Commissioner Willie Marcial, ang 45th season ang ginalauman nga magatapos sa mid-December kag ang Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas mismo ang nagpahibalo tuhoy sa FIBA qualifiers sa Pebrero apisar nga gin-anunsyo sang FIBA nga ang continental qualifiers ang patigayunon sa Nobyembre subong nga tuig kag sa February 2021.
english: According to PBA Commissioner Willie Marcial, the 45th season is expected to end in mid-December and the Philippine Basketball Association itself announced the FIBA ​​qualifiers in February despite FIBA ​​announcing that the continental qualifiers will be held in November this year and February 2021.

text: Apisar sini, ginpasalig ni Marcial nga all out support ang PBA sa Gilas Pilipinas.
english: Despite this, Marcial assured that the PBA will give all out support to Gilas Pilipinas.

text: Nahibalu-an nga ang 45th season sang PBA ang gin-untat sa sulod sang anum ka bulan bangud sa COVID-19 pandemic kag isa lamang ka game ang natigayon sa tunga sang San Miguel Beermen kag Magnolia Hotshots antes ang suspension sang Marso.
english: The 45th season of the PBA was suspended for six months due to the COVID-19 pandemic and only one game was played between the San Miguel Beermen and Magnolia Hotshots before the suspension in March.

text: Ang liga ang maga-umpisa sa Oktubre 11 apang kinahanglan sang PBA ang approval sang Inter-Agency Task Force kag kun pahanugutan, ang hampang ang patigayunon sa Clark Freeport Zone.
english: The league will start on October 11 but the PBA needs the approval of the Inter-Agency Task Force and if approved, the game will be held in the Clark Freeport Zone.

text: ILOILO CITY- Kumpirmado nga may violation ang Aggrisential Feeds, Inc.
english: ILOILO CITY- Aggrisential Feeds, Inc. has been confirmed to have a violation.

text: sa Sitio Wati, Barangay Talusan, Dumangas, Iloilo.
english: in Sitio Wati, Barangay Talusan, Dumangas, Iloilo.

text: Ini may kaangtanan sa reklamo ni former Sangguniang Bayan Member Serafin Deduro Jr.
english: This is in connection with the complaint of former Sangguniang Bayan Member Serafin Deduro Jr.

text: sang Dumangas batok sa nasambit nga feed milling facility.
english: of Dumangas against the said feed milling facility.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo 4th District Board Member Rolly Distura, chairman sang committee on infrastructure sa Sangguniang Panlalawigan, iya ginpahayag nga matapos ang ila ginpatigayon nga ocular inspection sa lugar pagkatapos sang committee hearing sa Sangguniang Panlalawigan, napat-ud nga wala pa man natapos ang conversion gikan sa agricultural agud mangin industrial use apang naptindog na ang pasilidad kag iban nga istruktura.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo 4th District Board Member Rolly Distura, chairman of the committee on infrastructure in the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, said that after their ocular inspection of the area after the committee hearing in the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, it was determined that the conversion from agricultural to industrial use has not been completed. the facility and other structure.

text: Suno kay Distura, may posibilidad nga dagdagan sang nagakaigo nga penalidad ang nasambit nga kompaniya bangud sa nasambit nga violation.
english: Distura said there is a possibility that the company will be subject to appropriate penalties for the violation.

text: Pahayag pa sang board member nga substantial man ang compliance sang kompaniya sa iban nga requirements apang kinahanglan nga i-comply ang iban pa gid nga rekisitos.
english: The board member said the company's compliance with other requirements is substantial but other requirements need to be complied with.

text: Gin-athag naman niya nga wala sang pamulitika sa likod sang nasambit nga tikang sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan.
english: He clarified that there is no politics behind the Sangguniang Panlalawigan's move.

text: Nahibaluan nga magkasumpong sa pulitika sanday Distura kag Dumangas Mayor Ronaldo Golez.
english: Distura and Dumangas Mayor Ronaldo Golez are political opponents.

text: Apisar sang mainit nga away nanday Mayoralty candidate Sally Lopez kag Incumbent Mayor Darwin Jonjon Bajada sa pagka-alkalde sa Banwa sang San Dionisio, Iloilo, wala pa sang may nabalhag ang San Dionisio Municipal Police Station (MPS) nga election-related incident.
english: Despite the heated fight between Mayoralty candidate Sally Lopez and Incumbent Mayor Darwin Jonjon Bajada for the mayoralty of San Dionisio, Iloilo, the San Dionisio Municipal Police Station (MPS) has not yet recorded any election-related incident.

text: Suno sa San Dionisio MPS, 100% na sila nga preparado kon sa diin, naka-augment na sa designated areas ang ila police personnel agud bantayan ang mga Automated Counting Machines (ACM).
english: According to San Dionisio MPS, they are 100% prepared where their police personnel have been augmented in designated areas to guard the Automated Counting Machines (ACM).

text: Bangud ang banwa yara sa idalum sang yellow category, ginpasigurado sang talatapan nga pasangkaron ang pagbantay sa seguridad sang mga pumuluyo.
english: As the town is under the yellow category, the office assured to step up the security of the residents.

text: Sa piyak nga bahin, napang-distribute naman ang mga Automated Counting Machines (ACM) sa tagsa ka voting centers kag na-testingan na ang mga ini sang Mayo 7 kon sa diin, wala man sang mga problema.
english: Meanwhile, the Automated Counting Machines (ACM) were distributed to each voting center and were tested on May 7 where there were no problems.

text:
Hatagan naman prayoridad ang mga PWD’s, Senior Citizens kag mga gabusong nga bayi, mahimo sila makaboto halin alas-5:00 sang aga tubtob alas-7:00 sang gab-i.

Nahibaluan nga ang banwa sang San Dionisio ang may yara sang 25 ka voting centers, 159 ka established precincts kag 44 naman ang clustered precincts.
english:
Priority will be given to PWDs, Senior Citizens and pregnant women, they can vote from 5:00 am to 7:00 pm.

The town of San Dionisio has 25 voting centers, 159 established precincts and 44 clustered precincts.

text: May kabug-usan naman nga 26,603 ka mga botante ang banwa, kun sa diin, 13, 564 ang mga lalaki kag 13,039 naman ang mga babayi.
english: The town has a total of 26,603 voters, of which 13,564 are males and 13,039 are females.

text: Text by: Bombo Volunteer Michael Roy Balajadia
english: Text by: Bombo Volunteer Michael Roy Balajadia

text: ILOILO CITY-Ginabantayan na sang bilog nga kalibutan si United States President Joe Biden kun mapakita pa sini nga may ikasarang pa siya nga mangin presidente sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika kag itiglawas ang pinakagamhanan nga pungsod sang dugang nga apat ka tuig.
english: ILOILO CITY – The world is watching United States President Joe Biden to see if he can show that he is still capable of becoming president of the United States of America and representing the most powerful country for another four years.

text: Ini kadungan sang patigayunon nga North Atlantic Treaty Organization summit sa Washington DC kun sa diin magatililipon ang mga lideres sang mga member countries agud ipakita ang ila paghugpong sa tunga sang pila ka pinakaseryoso nga pamahog sa alyansa sa sulod sang 75 ka tuig sini nga maragtas.
english: This coincides with the upcoming North Atlantic Treaty Organization summit in Washington DC where leaders of member countries will gather to show their solidarity amid some of the most serious threats to the alliance in its 75-year history.

text: Madamo ang nagakangawa para kay Biden kasunod sang ginpakita sini nga performance sa ila una nga presidential debate ni Donald Trump nga kaangay nga maathag nga patimaan nga nagaluya na ini dala sang ika katigulangon.
english: Many are worried about Biden following his performance in their first presidential debate with Donald Trump which seems to be a clear sign that he is weakening with old age.

text: Isa sa ginabantayan sa summit amo ang solo news conference ni Biden nga magatakos sang iya mental clarity sa atubang sang mga world leaders kag ang ano man nga ipakita sini ang mahimo magpahangawa pa dugang sa mga Democrats kag mahimo magtulod sa Partido nga mangita sang iban nga standard bearer para sa presidential election.
english: One of the things to watch at the summit is Biden's solo news conference that will measure his mental clarity in front of world leaders and whatever it shows could further worry Democrats and could push the Party to find another standard bearer for the presidential election.

text: MANILA – Igadonar ni 8-Division World Champion Manny Pacquiao ang premyo sa away niya batok sa Irish mixed martial arts star nga si Conor McGregor sa masunod nga tuig.
english: MANILA – 8-Division World Champion Manny Pacquiao will donate the prize in his fight against Irish mixed martial arts star Conor McGregor next year.

text: Suno kay Jayke Joson, special assistant si Pacquiao, daku nga porsyento ang igadonar sang fighting senator para sa COVID-19 victims.
english: According to Jayke Joson, Pacquiao's special assistant, the fighting senator will donate a large percentage for COVID-19 victims.

text: Ginpahayag ni Joson nga sa subong, indi maluyag si Pacquiao nga mangin hot topic ang iya masunod nga away bangud nga may yara sang pandemya.
english: Joson said that for now, Pacquiao does not want his next fight to be a hot topic because of the pandemic.

text: Sa baylo nga mangin sentro sang atensyon sang publiko, ginpahayag ni Joson nga ginatutukan ni Pacquiao ang paghatag sang bulig sa mga nagakinahanglan.
english: Instead of being the center of public attention, Joson said Pacquiao is focused on providing assistance to those in need.

text: Nauna nga ginpahayag ni Sean Gibbons, presidente sang Manny Pacquiao Promotions, nga ang away sa tunga sang eight-division world champion kag sang Irish mixed martial arts star ang mangin “tremendous global event” kag ginapahayag nga ini ang patigayunon sa middle east.
english: Earlier, Sean Gibbons, president of Manny Pacquiao Promotions, said the fight between the eight-division world champion and the Irish mixed martial arts star will be a “tremendous global event” and will reportedly be held in the middle east.

text: Ginkawatan sang isa ka security guard ang pawnshop nga iya man ginabantayan sa Rodriguez, Rizal.
english: A security guard robbed a pawnshop he was also guarding in Rodriguez, Rizal.

text: Suno kay Police Colonel Felipe Maraggun, provincial director sang Rizal Province Provincial Office, gingamit pa mismo sang suspek ang iya nga service firearm sang ginhimo sini ang krimen.
english: According to Police Colonel Felipe Maraggun, provincial director of the Rizal Provincial Office, the suspect used his service firearm when he committed the crime.

text: Ginapahayag nga yara sa P1.2-million ang nakuha sini nga kuwarta kag kagamitan antes nagpalagyo.
english: He allegedly took about P1.2-million in cash and equipment before fleeing.

text: Suno kay Maraggun, na-profile nila ang guwardiya kag natukiban nga may utod ini nga pulis nga amo naman ang ginkontak sang otoridad agud nga mapasungka ang suspek.
english: According to Maraggun, they profiled the guard and discovered that he had a brother who was a policeman who was contacted by the authorities to surrender the suspect.

text: Isa ka semana matapos ang nahimo sini nga krimen, nagsungka ini sa mga pulis paagi sa iya nga utod.
english: A week after the crime, he surrendered to the police through his brother.

text: Ginaproseso na subong agud nga ma-recover ang mga kinawatan sini.
english: It is now being processed to recover the stolen goods.

text: Nahibaluan nga tatlo ka tuig na ini nga nagaserbe bilang security guard sa pawnshop antes sini nahimo ang pagpangawat.
english: It was learned that he had been serving as a security guard at the pawnshop for three years before committing the robbery.

text: Sampaw-sampaw nga kaso ang atubangon sang suspek lakip ang illegal possession of firearms.
english: The suspect will face multiple charges including illegal possession of firearms.

text: Naglab-ot sa 10 ka mga tawo ang napatay kag 40 ang missing bangud sa pagkatiphag sang duta sa iligal nga minahan sang bulawan sa Sulawesi Island sa Indonesia.
english: At least 10 people have been killed and 40 are missing in a landslide at an illegal gold mine on Indonesia's Sulawesi Island.

text: Natabo ini sa Suwawa district sa probinsya sang Gorontalo kun sa diin ang mga biktima amo ang mga manug-mina kag mga residente malapit sa lugar.
english: The incident occurred in Suwawa district of Gorontalo province where the victims were miners and residents nearby.

text: Masobra 160 ka mga personnel lakip ang national rescue team, police kag military personnel ang ginpadala para mag-rescue sa mga missing nga indibidwal.
english: More than 160 personnel including the national rescue team, police and military personnel were sent to rescue the missing individuals.

text: Kagab-i, temporaryo pa nga gin-untat ang search operations suno sa disaster mitigation agency bangud sa mamunog nga pag-ulan.
english: Last night, the disaster mitigation agency said the search operations were temporarily suspended due to heavy rains.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang small-scale kag illegal mining amo ang flash point sang kumplikto kag mga aksidente kaangay sini sa Indonesia — ang pungsod kun sa diin ang mineral resources ang masami yara sa nabaw-ing gid kag protected forest areas nga indi halos ma-regulate sang gobyerno.
english: It is known that small-scale and illegal mining is the flash point of conflict and accidents like this in Indonesia — a country where mineral resources are often located in highly recovered and protected forest areas that can hardly be regulated by the government.

text: Liwat nga gindumdom sang misis nga si Vannesa ang iya bana nga si basketball legend nga si Kobe Bryant pinaagi sa pag-post sang mga gamit sini sa social media.
english: Vannesa's wife once again remembered her husband, basketball legend Kobe Bryant, by posting his belongings on social media.

text: Malapit walo na ka bulan sang nagtaliwan si Kobe kaupod sang ila anak nga si Gianna kag pito ka iban pa sang nagtibusok ang helicopter nga ila ginasakyan.
english: It has been nearly eight months since Kobe died along with their daughter Gianna and seven others when the helicopter they were traveling in crashed.

text: Sa instagram post ni Vanessa, iya ginpakita ang mga gamit ni Kobe kag may hashtag nga #HoarderWife.
english: In Vanessa’s instagram post, she showed off Kobe’s stuff and hashtaged it #HoarderWife.

text: Suno kay Vanessa, ginatago niya ang mga gamit ni Kobe para sa iya mga kabataan.
english: Vanessa says she keeps Kobe’s stuff for her kids.

text: Lakip sa mga memorabilia amo ang jersey ni Kobe sang 2001 All-Star Game, ang bayo sini pag-champagne shower kasunod sang pagdaog sang Lakers kag sapatos.
english: Among the memorabilia are Kobe's 2001 All-Star Game jersey, his dress and champagne shower following the Lakers' victory and shoes.

text: Nagsaka na sa 36 ka mga sibilyan ang napatay bangud sa pagpaulan sang Russia sang missiles sa Ukraine sa tungang-adlaw kahapon nga amo ang ginakabig nga pinakamakamamatay nga atake sang Moscow sa sulod na sang pila na ka bulan.
english: The death toll from Russia's missile rain on Ukraine at noon yesterday has risen to 36, in what is considered Moscow's deadliest attack in months.

text: Ginproklamar man sang gobyerno sang Ukraine ang day of mourning subong nga Martes.
english: The Ukrainian government also proclaimed a day of mourning on Tuesday.

text: Suno sa Ukrainian air force, napunggan man sang air defences ang 30 sa 38 ka missiles apang daku gihapon ang halit lakip ang lima ka civilian buildings, residential houses, business center kag duha ka medical facilities sa Kyiv, central cities sang Kryvyi Rih kag Dnipro kag duha ka eastern cities.
english: According to the Ukrainian air force, air defenses also intercepted 30 of the 38 missiles but still caused heavy damage including five civilian buildings, residential houses, a business center and two medical facilities in Kyiv, central cities of Kryvyi Rih and Dnipro and two eastern cities.

text: 22 sa mga patay ang yara sa Kyiv samtang 82 naman ang napilasan.
english: 22 of the dead were in Kyiv while 82 were injured.

text: 11 ang napatay sa Dnipropetrovsk region kag 64 ang pilason; samtang tatlo naman sa casualties ang yara sa eastern town sang Pokrovsk kun sa diin gin-target sang missiles ang industrial facility.
english: 11 killed in the Dnipropetrovsk region and 64 wounded; while three of the casualties were in the eastern town of Pokrovsk where the missiles targeted the industrial facility.

text: Nagpasalig si Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy nga magatimalos sila kag nagpanawagan man ini sa ila Western allies nga magbalos man kasunod sang amo nga atake.
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy has vowed to retaliate and has called on his Western allies to retaliate following the attack.

text: Subong nga adlaw natalana man nga mag-convene ang United Nations Security Council kasunod sang request sang Britain, France, Ecuador, Slovenia, kag United States.
english: The United Nations Security Council is also scheduled to convene today following the request of Britain, France, Ecuador, Slovenia, and the United States.

text: Nagpaguwa naman sang statement ang Russian Defence Ministry nga defence industry targets kag aviation bases sa Ukraine ang ila target.
english: The Russian Defense Ministry issued a statement saying they were targeting defense industry targets and aviation bases in Ukraine.

text: Sulit-sulit nga ginpanginwala sang Moscow nga gina-target sini ang mga sibilyan kag civilian infrastructure apisar nga maathag nga linibo na ka civilians ang napatay halin sang invasion nga natabo sang Pebrero 2022.
english: Moscow has repeatedly denied targeting civilians and civilian infrastructure despite the fact that thousands of civilians have been killed since the invasion took place in February 2022.

text: Ini nga atake sang Russia ang natabo antes ang tatlo ka adlaw nga summit sang NATO kun sa diin isa si Zelenskiy sa magatambong.
english: The Russian attack came ahead of a three-day NATO summit where Zelenskiy was one of the participants.

text: MANILA – Ginabanta nga magalab-ot sa P65 million ang gastuhon sang Philippine Basketball Association para sa pagpadayon sang liga sa Clark, Pampanga sa Oktubre.
english: MANILA – The Philippine Basketball Association is estimated to spend P65 million for the continuation of the league in Clark, Pampanga in October.

text: Suno kay PBA Board chairman Ricky Vargas, ang nasambit nga kantidad ang gamiton para sa akomodasyon kag pagkaon sang tagsa ka team.
english: According to PBA Board chairman Ricky Vargas, the said amount will be used for accommodation and food of each team.

text: Ginpahayag ni Vargas nga ang P65 million ang mas manubo na sa una nga pondo bangud sa discounts.
english: Vargas said the P65 million is already less than the initial fund due to discounts.

text: Nalakip man sa P65 million ang free testing kits nga gina-require sa tagsa ka player.
english: The P65 million also includes free testing kits required for each player.

text: Gindesisyunan sang PBA Board nga magpatigayon sang bubble sa Clark kun sa diin maga-umpisa ang All-Filipino Cup sa Oktubre 9.
english: The PBA Board decided to hold a bubble in Clark where the All-Filipino Cup will start on October 9.

text: Sa pagkamatuod suno kay Vargas, isa lamang ang Clark sa 20 ka mga venue nga ginpili-an kun sa diin isa sa mga ginkonsiderar ang maayo nga connectivity para sa game broadcast.
english: In fact, Vargas said, Clark was only one of the 20 venues selected where one of the considerations was good connectivity for the game broadcast.

text: Ang pagpatigayon sang liga ang nagadepende sa approval sang Inter-Agency Task Force.
english: The conduct of the league is dependent on the approval of the Inter-Agency Task Force.

text: Ang mga team nga magapakigbahin ang magatinir sa isa ka hotel samtang ang game naman ang patigayunon sa Angeles University Foundation.
english: The participating teams will stay in a hotel while the game will be held at the Angeles University Foundation.

text: Ang tagsa ka team ang may dedicated bus kag ginaduso ang pag-angkon sang tatlo ka practice venues.
english: Each team will have a dedicated bus and it is proposed to have three practice venues.

text: Nauna na nga ginpahayag ni PBA commissioner Willie Marcial nga 2 ka game ang patigayunon sa tagsa ka adlaw kun sa diin ang top 4 teams ang magapaidalom sa elimination round paagi sa twice-to-beat advantage.
english: Earlier, PBA commissioner Willie Marcial said that two games will be played each day where the top four teams will undergo the elimination round through twice-to-beat advantage.

text: Ang semifinals ang mangin best-of-5 affair samtang ang finals ang mangin best-of-7.
english: The semifinals will be a best-of-5 affair while the finals will be best-of-7.

text: ILOILO CITY- Isa ang patay kag tatlo ang pilason matapos nagbunggu-anay ang duha ka motorsiklo sa Barangay Poblacion, Concepcion, Iloilo.
english: ILOILO CITY – One person was killed and three others were injured when two motorcycles collided in Barangay Poblacion, Concepcion, Iloilo.

text: Ang napatay amo Christian Delos Santos, 26, nga amo ang driver kag pilason naman ang angkas sini nga si Herardo Bano, 31, lunsay residente sang Barangay Talotu-an, Concepcion, Iloilo.
english: The deceased was identified as Christian Delos Santos, 26, who was the driver and his passenger, Herardo Bano, 31, both residents of Barangay Talotu-an, Concepcion, Iloilo, was injured.

text: Pilason naman ang mag-asawa nga angkas sang pihak nga motorsiklo nga sanday Fritz Raniel Cristobal, 26, kag iya nga asawa nga si Shaira Mae Cristobal, lunsay residente sang Barangay Bacjawan Sur, Concepcion, Iloilo.
english: Fritz Raniel Cristobal, 26, and his wife, Shaira Mae Cristobal, both residents of Barangay Bacjawan Sur, Concepcion, Iloilo, sustained injuries.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Chief Master Sergeant Edzel Casia, imbestigador sang Concepcion Municipal Police Station, hepe sang Concepcion Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nag-inom ang mag-abyan sa NHA People’s Village sa Barangay Bacjawan Sur padulong kuntani sa banwa.
english: Police Chief Master Sergeant Edzel Casia, investigator of the Concepcion Municipal Police Station, said the two friends were drinking at NHA People's Village in Barangay Bacjawan Sur on their way to the town.

text: Samtang ang mag-asawa naman ang naghalin ang banwa kag pauli na kuntani sa ila balay.
english: Meanwhile, the couple had left town and were on their way home.

text: Suno kay Casia, naglapaw sa pihak nga linya ang motorsiklo nga ginasakyan sang mag-abyan sa diin nasugata nila ang motorsiklo nga ginasakyan sang mag-asawa.
english: According to Casia, the motorcycle ridden by the friends crossed the other lane where they met the motorcycle ridden by the couple.

text: Nagtabog naman ang mag-abyan kag napilasan sa diin nag-angkon ang driver sang patal nga pilas nga amo ang gintunaan sang iya kamatayon.
english: The friends fled the scene and were injured, with the driver sustaining fatal injuries that led to his death.

text: Pilason naman ang mag-asawa sa diin gindala ang mga ini sa ospital.
english: The couple sustained injuries and were taken to the hospital.

text: Himuon na lang nga bubble-type format ang duha ka mga FIBA Asia Cup qualifiers bangud sa COVID-19 pandemic.
english: The two FIBA ​​Asia Cup qualifiers will be held in a bubble-type format due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Natalana ini nga patigayunon sa Nobyembre kag Pebrero 2021.
english: It is scheduled to take place in November and February 2021.

text: Nagapakig-angot naman ang FIBA sa mga host public health authorities agud nga mapatuman ang mga protocols kaangay sang pagpa-idalom sa PCR testing sang mga magapartisipar.
english: FIBA is liaising with the host public health authorities to implement protocols such as PCR testing of participants.

text: Tagsa ka bubble ang pagabug-usan sang apat kag walo ka mga team.
english: Each bubble will consist of four and eight teams.

text: Yara sa Group A ang Pilipinas kun sa diin kaupod sini ang South Korea, Thailand kag Indonesia.
english: The Philippines is in Group A with South Korea, Thailand and Indonesia.

text: Ginasiguro man sang FIBA nga padayon nila nga bantayan ang COVID-19 situation kada adlaw.
english: FIBA also ensures that they continue to monitor the COVID-19 situation on a daily basis.

text: Matandaan nga ginlutos sang Pilipinas ang Indonesia sa score nga 100-70 sa first window sang qualifiers sang Pebrero antes nga makansela ang mga hampang.
english: The Philippines beat Indonesia 100-70 in the first window of the qualifiers in February before the matches were cancelled.

text: MANILA – Nagsaka ang numero sang Filipino seafarers nga nakabalik sa trabaho apisar sang coronavirus pandemic.
english: MANILA – The number of Filipino seafarers who have returned to work has increased despite the coronavirus pandemic.

text: Suno kay Department of Labor and Employment Undersecretary Joji Aragon, naglab-ot sa 46,000 nga sea-based migrant workers ang na-deploy sang Setyembre.
english: According to Department of Labor and Employment Undersecretary Joji Aragon, 46,000 sea-based migrant workers were deployed in September.

text: Ang nasambit nga data suno kay Aragon ang mas mataas sa 41,000 nga na record sang nakaligad nga tuig sa kasubong nga bulan.
