english: Aragon said the data is higher than the 41,000 recorded last year in the same month.

text: Sang 2019, 1 sa 5 ka Filipino workers ang seafarer kag nagapangatlo sa may pinakadaku nga remittances.
english: In 2019, 1 in 5 Filipino workers were seafarers and had the third largest remittances.

text: Nahibalu-an nga ang Pilipinas ang isa sa world’s leading suppliers sang merchant seafarers kun sa diin naglab-ot sa 500,000 ang Filipino seafarers ang nakatrabaho sa vessel kasubong sang oil tankers kag cruise ships sang nakaligad nga tuig.
english: The Philippines is one of the world's leading suppliers of merchant seafarers with 500,000 Filipino seafarers employed on vessels such as oil tankers and cruise ships last year.

text: Sang damlag lang, ginduso ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte ang pagpasar sang layi nga nagamandu sa pagtukod sang government agency para sa Filipino migrant workers kag iya man nga ginakonsiderar ang pagtukod sang department para sa seafarers.
english: Recently, President Rodrigo Duterte proposed the passage of a law mandating the establishment of a government agency for Filipino migrant workers and he is also considering the establishment of a department for seafarers.

text: Ang nasambit nga plano sang Presidente ang ginasuportahan naman sang Department of Labor and Employment.
english: The President's plan is supported by the Department of Labor and Employment.

text: Handa na ang Los Angeles Lakers nga maatubang ang Denver Nuggets sa Western Conference finals apisar nga may yara sang pagpangduha-duha si lakers coach Frank Vogel bangud kay Nikola Jokic.
english: The Los Angeles Lakers are ready to face the Denver Nuggets in the Western Conference finals despite lakers coach Frank Vogel having doubts over Nikola Jokic.

text: Ang Game 1 ang patigayunon sa adlaw sang Byernes, oras sa Estados Unidos.
english: Game 1 will be played on Friday, US time.

text: Suno kay Vogel, si Jokic ang isa sa mga pinaka-pinasahi nga players sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: Vogel said Jokic is one of the most unique players in the world.

text: Ini bangud sa iya 3-point line kag nagaserbe nga center position sa liga.
english: This is due to his 3-point line and serves as the center position in the league.

text: Bangud sini pahayag ni Vogel, kinahanglan nga may yara sang pinasahi man nga lihok ang Lakers sa ila pag atubang sa Nuggets.
english: Vogel said the Lakers need to have a special move against the Nuggets.

text: Ginkakas bilang director sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office si PCol Bayani Razalan isa ka adlawa antes ang eleksyon.
english: PCol Bayani Razalan was removed as director of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office a day before the election.

text: Suno kay Lt.
english: According to Lt.

text: Col.
english: Col.

text: Arnel Solis, spokesperson sang Police Regional Office 6, ang order sa pag-relieve kay Razalan ang epektibo kahapon, Mayo 10 apang subong nga adlaw ini naggwa.
english: Arnel Solis, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office 6, said the order to relieve Razalan was effective yesterday, May 10 but was issued today.

text: Pahayag ni Solis, ang relief order ang may clearance halin sa Commission on Elections.
english: Solis said the relief order has clearance from the Commission on Elections.

text: Temporaryo nga magabulos kay Razalan si PCol Roland Bulalacao nga amo ang Chief Regional Staff sang PRO-6.
english: PCol Roland Bulalacao, the Chief Regional Staff of PRO-6, will temporarily replace Razalan.

text: Matandaan nga una na nakabaton sang order ang Police Regional Office 6 halin kay PNP Chief Rommel Francisco Marbil nga kakson si Razalan sa posisyon apang apang wala mapatuman bangud wala pa sang clearance halin sa Comelec.
english: It can be recalled that the Police Regional Office 6 had earlier received an order from PNP Chief Rommel Francisco Marbil to remove Razalan from his position but it was not implemented because there was no clearance from the Comelec.

text: MANILA – Gindula na sang Department of Agriculture ang ban sa importation sang baboy kag by-products gikan sa Belgium apisar sang African Swine Fever (ASF) outbreak.
english: MANILA – The Department of Agriculture has lifted the ban on the importation of pigs and by-products from Belgium despite the African Swine Fever (ASF) outbreak.

text: Ini matapos nga nagpaguwa ang DA sang Memorandum Order No.
english: This comes after the DA issued Memorandum Order No.

text: 55, series of 2020 nga napetsahan sang Oktubre 26, kun sa diin ginamandu ang pagdula sa temporary ban sa importation sang domestic pigs, pork meat kag semen gikan sanasambit nga pungsod.
english: 55, series of 2020 dated October 26, which orders the lifting of the temporary ban on the importation of domestic pigs, pork meat and semen from the said country.

text: Suno sa Department of Agriculture, ang ASF outbreak sa European country ang nagaapekto lamang sa wild boars santo sa World Organisation for Animal Health.
english: According to the Department of Agriculture, the ASF outbreak in the European country is only affecting wild boars according to the World Organization for Animal Health.

text: Santo sa report, ang pinaka-ulihi nga kaso sa Belgium ang na record sang Marso kag subong, ang nasambit nga pungsod ang makabig nga ASF free.
english: According to the report, the latest case in Belgium was recorded in March and now, the country is considered ASF free.

text: Nahibalu-an nga ginmandu sang nasambit nga ahensya sang gobyerno ang importation sang hogs kag pork products sang Oktubre 2018 bangud sa ASF outbreak.
english: The government agency ordered the importation of hogs and pork products in October 2018 due to the ASF outbreak.

text: Naglugdang ang ginakabig most-advanced nga locally-made warship sang Iran samtang yara sa port sa syudad sang Bandar Abbas nga malapit sa Strait of Hormuz.
english: Iran's most-advanced locally-made warship sank while in port in the city of Bandar Abbas near the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Sandig sa reports sang Iranian media, “aksidente” ang natabo samtang nga ginakaayo ang amo nga naval destroyer IRIS Sahand (F74).
english: According to Iranian media reports, the “accident” occurred while the naval destroyer IRIS Sahand (F74) was being repaired.

text: Ginpahayag man nga nadulaan ini sang balanse bangud sa pagsulod sang tubig sa tangke sini.
english: It also reportedly lost its balance due to water entering its tank.

text: May mga tawo nga nagkalasamaran kag subong gindala na sa ospital.
english: Some people were injured and have now been taken to hospital.

text: Ini nga 1,300-ton vessel ang may yara sang surface-to-surface kag surface-to-air missiles, anti-aircraft batteries kag sophisticated radar and radar-evading capabilities.
english: This 1,300-ton vessel is equipped with surface-to-surface and surface-to-air missiles, anti-aircraft batteries and sophisticated radar and radar-evading capabilities.

text: Ginpaguwa ini sang 2018 kag bag-o lang nahatagan sang upgrade sa weapons kag sensors kag hana na kuntani nga magpatigayon sang routine patrol sang natabo ang amo nga insidente.
english: It was released in 2018 and had just been upgraded with weapons and sensors and was about to conduct a routine patrol when the incident occurred.

text: Naga-umpisa na ang pagpangita sa panibag-o nga coach para sa Houston Rockets matapos nga gin-anunsyo ni Mike D’Antoni nga mangin free agent na lamang ini kag indi na magbalik pa sa nasambit nga team.
english: The search for a new coach for the Houston Rockets is underway after Mike D'Antoni announced that he will become a free agent and will not return to the team.

text:
Pito ka mga top candidates ang pili-an agud nga mangin coach sang Rockets nga amo sanday;

*Jeff Van Gundy – American basketball coach kag commentator sang ESPN, ang American multinational basic cable sports channel.
english:
Seven top candidates will be selected to coach the Rockets namely;

*Jeff Van Gundy – American basketball coach and commentator for ESPN, the American multinational basic cable sports channel.

text: Nangin head coach sang New York Knicks kag Houston Rockets sa National Basketball Association.
english: Was head coach of the New York Knicks and Houston Rockets in the National Basketball Association.

text: *Tyronn Jamar Lue – American professional basketball coach, assistant coach sang Los Angeles Clippers sa National Basketball Association.
english: *Tyronn Jamar Lue – American professional basketball coach, assistant coach of the Los Angeles Clippers in the National Basketball Association.

text: Nagserbe man sadto bilang head coach sang Cleveland Cavaliers.
english: Also previously served as head coach of the Cleveland Cavaliers.

text: *Chris Finch – American former professional basketball player, associate head basketball coach sang New Orleans Pelicans.
english: *Chris Finch – American former professional basketball player, associate head basketball coach of the New Orleans Pelicans.

text: Anay assistant coach sang Denver Nuggets kag Houston Rockets sa NBA.
english: Former assistant coach of the Denver Nuggets and Houston Rockets in the NBA.

text: *Sam Cassell – American professional basketball coach, nangin assistant coach sang Los Angeles Clippers.
english: *Sam Cassell – American professional basketball coach, former assistant coach of the Los Angeles Clippers.

text: *Billy Donovan- American professional basketball coach kag sanay head coach sang Oklahoma City Thunder.
english: *Billy Donovan- American professional basketball coach and trained head coach of the Oklahoma City Thunder.

text: *Nate McMillan- American basketball coach, anay head coach sang Indiana Pacers.
english: *Nate McMillan- American basketball coach, former head coach of the Indiana Pacers.

text: Siya ang nangin coach sang Seattle SuperSonics humalin 2000 tubtob 2005, kag Portland Trail Blazers humalin 2005 tubtob 2012.
english: He coached the Seattle SuperSonics from 2000 to 2005, and the Portland Trail Blazers from 2005 to 2012.

text:
kag,

*Kenny Atkinson- American professional basketball coach kag former player.
english:
and,

*Kenny Atkinson- American professional basketball coach and former player.

text: Nangin head coach sang Brooklyn Nets.
english: Became the head coach of the Brooklyn Nets.

text: Nagserbe man siya bilang Director of Player Development para sa Houston Rockets sang 2007–2008.
english: He also served as the Director of Player Development for the Houston Rockets in 2007–2008.

text: Lumipad patungong India si Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. flew to India.

text: ngayong Lunes para sa kanyang kauna-unahang state visit sa naturang bansa, kasabay ng pagdiriwang ng ika-75 anibersaryo ng ugnayang diplomatiko ng Pilipinas at India.
english: this Monday for his first state visit to the country, in conjunction with the celebration of the 75th anniversary of diplomatic relations between the Philippines and India.

text: Umalis ang presidential flight mula Maynila kaninang umaga at tinatayang walong oras ang biyahe ng presidente.
english: The presidential flight left Manila this morning and the president's trip is estimated to take eight hours.

text: Ayon sa Malacañang, bibisita si Marcos sa New Delhi at Bangalore, kung saan makikipagpulong siya sa mga opisyal ng pamahalaang Indian at mga negosyanteng lokal.
english: According to Malacañang, Marcos will visit New Delhi and Bangalore, where he will meet with Indian government officials and local businessmen.

text: Sa New Delhi, inaasahang makikipagpulong siya kina Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi at President Droupadi Murmu.
english: In New Delhi, he is expected to meet Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Droupadi Murmu.

text: Inaasahang pangunahing tatalakayin ang mga usaping pang-ekonomiya at depensa sa pagitan ng dalawang bansa.
english: The two countries are expected to mainly discuss economic and defense issues.

text: Kasama sa delegasyon ni Marcos ang ilang pangunahing miyembro ng economic team ng Pilipinas, kabilang sina Special Assistant to the President for Investment and Economic Affairs Frederick Go at Trade Secretary Cristina Roque.
english: Marcos' delegation includes key members of the Philippine economic team, including Special Assistant to the President for Investment and Economic Affairs Frederick Go and Trade Secretary Cristina Roque.

text: Ayon sa datos, umabot na sa $3.5 bilyon ang halaga ng bilateral trade sa pagitan ng Pilipinas at India noong 2024.
english: According to the data, the value of bilateral trade between the Philippines and India will reach $3.5 billion by 2024.

text: Bukod sa ekonomiya, tatalakayin din ng dalawang panig ang pagpapalawak ng defense at security cooperation.
english: Aside from the economy, the two sides will also discuss the expansion of defense and security cooperation.

text: Nitong mga nakaraang buwan, pinalakas ng Pilipinas at India ang kanilang ugnayan sa pamamagitan ng joint maritime patrols at kontrata sa pagbili ng mga misayl mula sa India.
english: In recent months, the Philippines and India have strengthened their ties through joint maritime patrols and contracts for the purchase of missiles from India.

text: Nakatakdang lumagda ang dalawang bansa sa hindi bababa sa anim na kasunduan, kabilang na ang mga larangan ng legal cooperation, agham, at teknolohiya.
english: The two countries are scheduled to sign at least six agreements, including in the fields of legal cooperation, science, and technology.

text: ILOILO CITY- Nangayo sang bulig ang Poland sa Finland, Germany kag Greece agud magpadala sang ila mga suldado para bantayan ang border sa Belarus bangud sa problema sa migration.
english: ILOILO CITY – Poland has asked Finland, Germany and Greece for help to send their soldiers to guard the border with Belarus due to migration problems.

text: Suno kay Bombo Neva Intrepido- Kessler, international correspondent sa Poland, gin-report sang Polish government nga mas nagadamo nga migrants ang nagasulod sa ila pungsod paagi sa ila border sa Belarus.
english: According to Bombo Neva Intrepido-Kessler, international correspondent in Poland, the Polish government has reported that more and more migrants are entering their country through their border with Belarus.

text: Pahayag ni Intrepido- Kessler, ginakabalak-an sang Poland nga ang mga tawo nga naga-cross sa border ang gin-train agud mag-atake sa Polish soldiers.
english: Intrepido-Kessler said Poland is concerned that people crossing the border have been trained to attack Polish soldiers.

text: Suno pa sa natungdan, hybrid warfare ang ginahimo sang Belarus kag dapat ini nga punggan sa pinakamadali nga panahon.
english: He said Belarus is engaged in hybrid warfare and should be stopped as soon as possible.

text: Bangud sa iya aktibo nga liderato kag adbokasiya sa komunidad kag sa kabataan, madamo na sang nabaton nga pasidungog si Ayumi Cassandra Sumagaysay Zerrudo kag isa na diri ang pagkilala sa iya bilang Ilongga youth leader kag ginhingadlan man ini bilang Miss Beauty with a Purpose Western Visayas 2024 kag amo man nga Outstanding Student Leaders sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: Due to her active leadership and advocacy in the community and children, Ayumi Cassandra Sumagaysay Zerrudo has received many awards including being recognized as an Ilongga youth leader and being named Miss Beauty with a Purpose Western Visayas 2024 and Outstanding Student Leaders in Iloilo City.

text: Sa pagpakigbahin man sang istorya ni Zerrudo sa Bombo Radyo Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga sa kada pageantry nga dapat intrahan sang isa ka kandidata importante ang iya adbokasiya.
english: Sharing her story with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Zerrudo said that in every pageantry that a candidate should participate in, her advocacy is important.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga ini ang rason kun ngaa naga-colaborate kag nagabinuligay ang nagkalain-lain nga organisasyon bangud sa adbokasiya nga gusto mo mapasangkad.
english: He said that this is the reason why different organizations collaborate and help each other because of the advocacy that you want to expand.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa karon nagaserbe man si Zerrudo bilang Q&A mentor sang mga pageant titleholders sa Iloilo agud mapabaskog ang kumpiyansa kag abilidad sang mga kababainhan sa public speaking.
english: Zerrudo is also currently serving as a Q&A mentor to pageant titleholders in Iloilo to strengthen the confidence and skills of women in public speaking.

text: Dugang pa diri, ini man siya ang ginpasidunggan nga Lakambini ng Kalikasan Iloilo City 2023, Miss Philippine Youth Iloilo 2025 Princess kun sa diin nakuha sini ang Best in Interview sa amo nga pageant.
english: In addition, she was also awarded Lakambini ng Kalikasan Iloilo City 2023, Miss Philippine Youth Iloilo 2025 Princess where she won the Best in Interview in the pageant.

text: Suno sa iya, ginahimo niya nga plataporma ang iya mga korona agud makahatag inspirasyon kag paglaum sa kabataan kag sa iya komunidad.
english: She said she uses her wreaths as a platform to inspire and give hope to children and her community.

text: Patay ang 17-anyos nga dalagita nga iloy matapos ginkuga sang anay nobyo matapos nangayo sang sustento para sa ila nga bata.
english: A 17-year-old mother died after being stabbed by her ex-boyfriend after asking for alimony for their child.

text: Natabo ini sa Lipa, Batangas.
english: This happened in Lipa, Batangas.

text: Nasapwan na lang ang bangkay sang biktima sa atubang sang ila nga balay sa Lipa.
english: The victim's body was found in front of their house in Lipa.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, naglisensya ang biktima nga may kadtuan ini apang wala na nakabalik tubtob nga nadiskubre nga nakigkita ini sa anay nobyo.
english: According to the investigation, the victim took a license to go somewhere but did not return until it was discovered that she had met her ex-boyfriend.

text: Natigayon naman nga maaresto ang suspek nga nag-ako man sa krimen.
english: The suspect was arrested and confessed to the crime.

text: Kaso nga murder ang ipasaka batoksa suspek.
english: A case of murder will be filed against the suspect.

text: Sulod na si Alex Eala sa finals sang Guadalajara 125 Open.
english: Alex Eala is now in the finals of the Guadalajara 125 Open.

text: Ini matapos nga mangibabaw sa semifinals batok kay American kayla Day, 6-2, 6-3 sa hampang nga ginhiwat sa Mexico.
english: This after winning the semifinals against American kayla Day, 6-2, 6-3 in the match held in Mexico.

text: Apisar nangin mahinay ang umpisa ni Eala sa fisrta set kun sa diin naka-abanse si Day sang 0-2 apang wala ini ginpabay-an sang Pinay tennis player.
english: Although Eala had a slow start in the first set where Day took a 0-2 lead, the Filipino tennis player did not let him go.

text: Ini man ang ikaduha nga finals appearance ni Eala sa WTA final.
english: This is also Eala's second finals appearance in a WTA final.

text: Makasambuwa niya sa final si World No.
english: He will face World No.

text: 134 Panna Udvardy sang Hungary.
english: 134 Panna Udvardy of Hungary.

text: Ginkadismaya ni Former Buenavista, Guimaras Mayor Eugene Reyes ang paggamit ni Mayor Samuel Gumarin kag sang iya nga kaalyado sang ayuda sa pagpamulutika.
english: Former Buenavista, Guimaras Mayor Eugene Reyes disappointed the use of political aid by Mayor Samuel Gumarin and his allies.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Eugene Reyes, iya ginpahayag nga sa idalom sang mandatu sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) ginadumilian ang mga kandidato nga magpaguwa sang ayuda ilabi na nga eleksyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Eugene Reyes said that under the mandate of the Commission on Elections (COMELEC), candidates are prohibited from releasing aid especially during elections.

text: Suno kay Reyes, tatlo ka semana na ang nagligad, ginkakibot niya nga ang mga residente ang dali-dali nga nagapa-photocopy sang ila mga ID’s bangud sa may i-claim nga ayuda kag pahambalon sang pangalan ni “Mayor Samuel Gumarin”.
english: According to Reyes, three weeks ago, he was surprised that residents were quick to photocopy their ID's because of the aid to be claimed and the name of “Mayor Samuel Gumarin”.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga kasunod sang amo nga tikang sang mga nasambit nga opisyal, ginasundan ini sang pagpanghatag sang ayuda sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD).
english: He also explained that following the move of the said officials, it is followed by the distribution of assistance by the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD).

text: Ginklaro man ni Reyes nga luyag lang niya nga makit-an sang COMELEC Region 6 ang nagakatabo sa ila banwa bangud parte na ini sa vote buying.
english: Reyes also clarified that he just wants the COMELEC Region 6 to see what is happening in their town because it is about vote buying.

text: Dugang niya nga wala ini nagapamalabag sa mga ayuda para sa senior citizen kag pumuluyo, bangud tuyo lamang niya nga indi maimpluwensyahan sang pagpamulitika ang paghatag sang ayuda.
english: He added that this does not interfere with the assistance for senior citizens and residents, because he only intends not to be influenced by politics in the provision of assistance.

text: Ginhangkat man sini nga magdebate si Gumarin agud mahibaluan sang publiko kon sin-o ang nagasugid sang matuod.
english: He also challenged Gumarin to debate so that the public will know who is telling the truth.

text: Nagapati naman si Sangguniang Bayan Member Vincent Pascal De Asis nga ang ginhimo sang kampo ni Gumarin ang abuse of state resources nga nakasaad man sa COMELEC.
english: Sangguniang Bayan Member Vincent Pascal De Asis believes that what Gumarin's camp did was an abuse of state resources as stated in the COMELEC.

text: Suno kay De Asis, sa pagselebrar sang Worship Festival sang amo nga banwa, ang administrasyon ang nagbutang sang P350,000 nga amount para sa amo nga aktibidad.
english: According to De Asis, in celebration of the Worship Festival of the town, the administration allocated P350,000 for the activity.

text: Dugang sini nga may dokumento nga pirmado sang Tourism Officer sang ila banwa nga nagapamatuod nga ang kwarta nga gingamit sa tarpaulin sang festival, ang gin-gamit man sa ila campaign tarpaulins.
english: He added that there is a document signed by the Tourism Officer of their town that proves that the money used for the tarpaulin of the festival, was also used for their campaign tarpaulins.

text: Bangud diri, nagalaum ini nga mahatagan sang dako nga igtalupangod sang COMELEC ang amo nga issue.
english: Because of this, he hopes that the COMELEC will give more attention to the issue.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga nagadihon na sila sang legal nga kaso agud mapasaka batok sa mga opisyal agud madagdagan sang show cause order.
english: He also said they are already preparing a legal case to be filed against the officials to increase the show cause order.

text: Itlog diri, itlog didto.
english: Eggs here, eggs there.

text: Amo ini ang aton pirme ginasud-an, pinakamahapos dakpon kun nagadali nga makakaon, nagapanamit sang mga linuto, kag paborito man sang mga kabataan.
english: It is our favorite food, easiest to catch when we are in a hurry, flavors dishes, and is also a favorite of children.

text: Apang nakahibalo ka bala nga may isa ka itlog nga nagabalor sang malapit na sa P15,000?
english: But did you know that there is an egg that is worth close to P15,000?

text:
Indi abi ini kinaandan kag sa pagkamatuod ginatawag nga “one-in-a-billion egg.”

Ang una nga nangin tag-iya sini amo si Ed Pownell nga residente sang Lambourn, Berkshire, South East England.
english:
It is not common and is actually called a “one-in-a-billion egg.”

Its first owner was Ed Pownell who was a resident of Lambourn, Berkshire, South East England.

text: Suno kay Ed, hubog siya sang nagtambong sa isa ka auction kag tubtub subong wala siya nakahibalo kun ngaa nagpatuga-tuga siya nga baklon ang itlog sa balor nga P11,193.30.
english: According to Ed, he was drunk when he attended an auction and until now he does not know why he pretended to buy the egg for P11,193.30.

text: “I had a glass in the local down here in Lambourn and thought I’d pop in a bid,” suno kay Ed.
english: “I had a glass in the local down here in Lambourn and thought I’d pop in a bid,” according to Ed.

text: Antes ini nakakadto sa auction, nabakal ini sang isa ka babaye sa local supermarket sa Scotland sang June 2023.
english: Before it went to auction, it was bought by a woman at the local supermarket in Scotland in June 2023.

text: Natingala gid abi ang babaye bangud perpekto gid ang pagkabilog sang itlog kag sang iya ini gin-research, natukiban niya nga isa lang ini sa isa ka bilyon.
english: The woman was surprised because the egg was perfectly round and when she researched it, she discovered that it was only one in a billion.

text: Wala niya ini ginluto kag sa baylo, gindala sa auction house nga Thomas Roddick Callan sang Agusto 2024.
english: He did not cook it and instead, took it to auction house Thomas Roddick Callan in August 2024.

text: Didto na kag nadag-an ini ni Ed kag apisar pa nga daw ka mahal gid sini, nangin proud owner siya sang perfectly-round egg bangud well-spent man suno sa iya ang iya kuwarta.
english: That's when Ed won it and although it seemed very expensive, he became the proud owner of the perfectly-round egg because he said his money was well-spent.

text: Gin-preserve na ini nga itlog, ginkakasan sang egg yolk kag egg white ukon buot silingon, shell na lang ang nabilin sa egg.
english: This egg has been preserved, removed the egg yolk and egg white or that is, only the shell remains of the egg.

text: Ginpaminsar ni Ed ang potential market value sini kag nadumduman sini nga i-donate ini sa Iuventas Foundation nga isa ka charity para sa mentoring, life coaching, kag mental health support sa mga kabataan sa Oxfordshire.
english: Ed thought about its potential market value and remembered to donate it to the Iuventas Foundation which is a charity for mentoring, life coaching, and mental health support to children in Oxfordshire.

text: Abi sang foundation “joke” lang ang itlog, apang sa bulig sang social media, naglapta ang istorya sini kag madamo ang nangin interesado.
english: The foundation thought the egg was just a “joke”, but with the help of social media, the story spread and many became interested.

text: Didto na kag nagdesisyon ang foundation nga ipa-auction ini.
english: That's when the foundation decided to put it up for auction.

text: Didto nabakal ang itlog sang malapit P14,926 kag kabahin sang masobra P373,000 nga natipon sang foundation bangud sa iban pa nga items nga ila gin-upod sa auction.
english: The egg was bought for nearly P14,926 and was part of the more than P373,000 raised by the foundation thanks to other items they included in the auction.

text: Tuman ang kalipay sang mga nagabug-os sa foundation bangud sa isa lang ka itlog, madamo nga kabataan ang mabuligan ilabi na ang nagakinahanglan sang suporta sa mental health nga amo gid ang ginatutukan sang ila management.
english: The foundation is very happy because with just one egg, many children can be helped especially those in need of mental health support which is the focus of their management.

text: Ginpangayo ni President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. asked

text: ang suporta sang iban nga pungsod para sa kandidatura sang Pilipinas sa non-permanent seat sa United Nations Security Council para sa 2027-2028.
english: foreign support for the Philippines’ candidacy for a non-permanent seat on the United Nations Security Council for 2027-2028.

text: Ginhimo ini sang presidente sa iya speech sa special plenary session sang United Nations General Assembly sa New York City sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: The president did this in his speech at the special plenary session of the United Nations General Assembly in New York City in the United States of America.

text: Natalana ang eleksyon sa Hunyo 3, 2026.
english: The election is scheduled for June 3, 2026.

text: Suno kay Marcos, masami ginapamatud-an sang Pilipinas nga isa ini ka independent kag masaligan nga partner, isa ka innovative pathfinder, kag committed peacemaker.
english: According to Marcos, the Philippines has often proven itself to be an independent and reliable partner, an innovative pathfinder, and committed peacemaker.

text: Ginbalikan man sini ang kontribusyon sang pungsod sa development sang kalibutan, kag kun paano sini ginaposisyon ang kaugalingon agud nga matiglawas ang tingog sang Global South sa United Nations Security Council.
english: He also recalled the country's contribution to world development, and how it is positioning itself to represent the voice of the Global South in the United Nations Security Council.

text: “We lodged our candidature mindful that a non-permanent seat on the UN Security Council is not a right of any state, but a privilege earned through consistent, dedicated, meaningful, and concrete partnership in the service of the United Nations and so of humanity,” suno kay Marcos.
english: “We lodged our candidacy mindful that a non-permanent seat on the UN Security Council is not a right of any state, but a privilege earned through consistent, dedicated, meaningful, and concrete partnership in the service of the United Nations and so of humanity,” according to Marcos.

text: Pahayag pa sini, kinahanglan ang kalibutan ang amo nga council ilabi na subong nga panahon kun sa diin may mga kumplikto kag pag-ilinaway sang mga pungsod sa rehiyon.
english: He said the world needs such a council especially nowadays where there are conflicts and conflicts between countries in the region.

text: “The Philippines stands ready once again to contribute, to help calm voices of division, provide a voice of balance, to shun ambition for service, and always as a voice for principled peace,” dugang niya.
english: “The Philippines stands ready once again to contribute, to help calm voices of division, provide a voice of balance, to shun ambition for service, and always as a voice for principled peace,” he added.

text:
Ginsugpon sini ang pagpangayo sang suporta: “And thus, I stand before you to humbly petition for your support for the Philippines in the elections on the 3rd of June, 2026.”

Sa amo man nga speech, nagpanawagan ang presidente sa paghagan-hagan sang mga kalakasan kag pag-respeto sa international law lakip na sa UN Charter kag humanitarian law sa conflict areas kaangay sang Gaza, Ukraine, Sudan kag sa Middle East.
english:
It added the request for support: “And thus, I stand before you to humbly petition for your support for the Philippines in the elections on the 3rd of June, 2026.”

In the same speech, the president called for a mitigation of violence and respect for international law including the UN Charter and humanitarian law in conflict areas such as Gaza, Ukraine, Sudan and the Middle East.

text: “Watching events in Gaza, the Ukraine, Sudan, the Middle East, and in many other places, I cannot help but ask, are we succeeding?
english: “Watching events in Gaza, the Ukraine, Sudan, the Middle East, and in many other places, I cannot help but ask, are we succeeding?

text: Or are we failing our ancestors who, in 1945, forged this assembly out of shared anxiety, shared hope, and endeavor to fulfill humanity’s aspirations for peace?
english: Or are we failing our ancestors who, in 1945, forged this assembly out of shared anxiety, shared hope, and endeavor to fulfill humanity’s aspirations for peace?

text: Are we failing those who will succeed us?” dugang sini.
english: Are we failing those who will succeed us?” it added.

text: Pahayag pa sini, suportado sang Pilipinas ang mga tikang agud nga maduso ang kalinong kag mahatagan sang prayoridad ang kinahanglanon sang mga komunidad nga apektado sang gyera.
english: He said the Philippines supports measures to promote peace and give priority to the needs of war-affected communities.

text: “We firmly support peacekeeping models that place paramount consideration for the needs of the community.
english: “We firmly support peacekeeping models that place paramount consideration for the needs of the community.

text: We place emphasis on the promotion of efficient, responsive and non-politicized peacekeeping models that promote the well-being of women, children, older persons, people living with disabilities, and all vulnerable people,” dugang sini.
english: We place emphasis on the promotion of efficient, responsive and non-politicized peacekeeping models that promote the well-being of women, children, older persons, people living with disabilities, and all vulnerable people,” it added.

text: Diri na kag nagpanawagan man si Marcos sang paghulag sang kalibutan agud nga tapuson na ang gyera.
english: Marcos also called for world action to end the war.

text: “Then and now, we stand ready to do our part to stay the forces of war, to end conflict, to ease suffering.
english: “Then and now, we stand ready to do our part to stay the forces of war, to end conflict, to ease suffering.

text: We call for urgent and much-needed action for peace in the Middle East, in the Ukraine, in Sudan, the DRC, the Sahel, Yemen and Myanmar.
english: We call for urgent and much-needed action for peace in the Middle East, in the Ukraine, in Sudan, the DRC, the Sahel, Yemen and Myanmar.

text: Their people continue to live in fear and in despair,” pahayag sang presidente.
english: Their people continue to live in fear and in despair,” the president said.

text: “These tragedies need to stop.
english: “These tragedies need to stop.

text: Innocence must be protected and their basic needs immediately provided.”#
english: Innocence must be protected and their basic needs immediately provided.”#

text: Magasaka ang presyo sang gasolina epektibo subong nga aga.
english: Petrol prices will rise effective this morning.

text: Base sa advisories sang oil companies, madugangan sang P1.20 ang presyo sang kada litro sini.
english: Based on the advisories of oil companies, the price of oil will increase by P1.20 per liter.

text: Wala naman sang pagbag-o sa presyo sang kerosene kag diesel.
english: There was no change in the price of kerosene and diesel.

text: Ini ang ikaduha nga sunod-sunod nga semana nga may price hike sa gasolina, kag pang-34 naman nga saka subong nga tuig.
english: This is the second consecutive week of gasoline price hikes, and the 34th increase this year.

text: MAYOR naton nga mga problema sa karon amo ang COVID (ang pwede itawag naton sa Covid-19 kag mga variant sini), inflation, kag wala palangitan-an.
english: OUR MAJOR problems right now are COVID (what we can call Covid-19 and its variants), inflation, and unemployment.

text: Kon matandaan ta pa, inigu kita sang COVID-19 sadtong Pebrero 2020.
english: If we remember, we were hit by COVID-19 in February 2020.

text: Kag indi lang kita diri sa pungsod kundi ang bug-os gid nga kalibutan.
english: And not just us here in the country but really the whole world.

text: Ang mga nagtuhaw sini nga mga variant nagdugang man sa pagpanghalit sa aton.
english: Those who have emerged these variants have also increased their damage to us.

text: Madamo ang nagkalamatay, na-ospital sing madugay, kag na-isolate sa ila mga pamilya.
english: Many died, were hospitalized for long periods of time, and were isolated from their families.

text: Nagpabudlay pa gid sa aton pangabuhi ang lockdown, social distancing kag iban pa nga health protocols.
english: Lockdown, social distancing and other health protocols have made our lives more difficult.

text: Nagtahaw gid man ang pagsalakay sang COVID sang amat-amat na ipatuman ang pagpang-bakuna.
english: The COVID outbreak began when vaccination was gradually implemented.

text: Apang sa gihapon nagaamlig kita bisan indi gid man makamamatay na ini.
english: But we still protect ourselves even if it is not deadly.

text: Tungod ina kay nagapabilin nga makalalaton ini nga pwede kita gihapon ma-isolate, kon na-infect, sing at least isa ka semana.
english: That's because it remains contagious and we can still be isolated, if infected, for at least a week.

text: Of course, naghatag sing paglaum sa aton pangabuhi ang ining pagtahaw sang pagpanalakay sang COVID nga nagapatimaan na sang amat-amat nga pag-“recover” sang aton ekonomiya.
english: Of course, the resurgence of the COVID-19 pandemic has given hope to our lives, which is already a sign of the gradual recovery of our economy.

text: Ugaling, madamo gihapon ang wala nabakunahan tungod sa ila pagtuo (religious belief) kag kahadlok sa posible matabo nga komplikasyon.
english: However, many are still not vaccinated because of their religious beliefs and fear of possible complications.

text: Ang mahimo na gid lang naton seguro sa ila amo ang pagpaseguro nga masunod man nila ang health protocols para indi makapanglaton sa iban kag agud indi man sila malatnan.
english: The only thing we can do for them is to ensure that they follow the health protocols so that they do not spread to others and so that they do not get infected.

text:
***

Siste man kay nagtuhaw ang inflation, ukon pagtinaas sang bili sang mga balaklon.
english:
***

It is also true that inflation, or the rise in the price of goods, has appeared.

text: Nalakip diri ang bili sang mga basic kag essential goods, nga ang pagsaka ginpasugtan na gani sang DTI tungod, kon indi, mamyerde man ang mga manugbaligya.
english: This includes the price of basic and essential goods, whose increase has been approved by the DTI because, otherwise, vendors will also lose.

text: Natabo ini sang indi na ma-kontrol ang mga hitabo sa aton market economy sa idalom sang Law of Supply and Demand.
english: This happened when events in our market economy spiraled out of control under the Law of Supply and Demand.

text: Labi na gid sang nagpasaka ang mga producers sang bili sang ila mga produkto agud bawion ang ila kapierdihan tungod kulang na ang manugbakal sa ila kapigaduhon.
english: Especially when producers raised the price of their products to make up for their losses because there were not enough buyers in their poverty.

text: Naglain pa kay nagluntad ang gyera sa tunga sang Rusya kag Ukraine nga naghatag sing pagsalangisag sa negosyo sang langis.
english: To make matters worse, the war between Russia and Ukraine has thrown the oil business into turmoil.

text: Ining inflation pwede “supply-driven”, nga tuga sang kakulangan sang “supply”, kag “demand-driven” nga tuga sang pagsaka sang “demand” katulad sang pagsaylo sang madamo sa pagbakal sang “brown sugar” halin sa sobra kamahal karon nga “refined sugar”.
english: This inflation can be supply-driven, caused by a lack of supply, and demand-driven, caused by an increase in demand such as the shift of many to buy brown sugar from the now very expensive refined sugar.

text: Gina-medyosan masolbar ining problema sa karon sang Marcos Administration.
english: The Marcos Administration is trying to solve this problem.

text:
***

Kinahanglan mapahagan-hagan naton ining mga problema sa aton ekonomiya sa karon.
english:
***

We need to alleviate these problems in our economy right now.

text: Sa bahin sang gobyerno, kinahanglan mapabilin ang ikasarang sini agud mapadalagan sing maayo ang ekonomiya sa kabug-usan (macroeconomics), samtang wala ginapabay-an ang indibidwal nga pagpaninguha (microeconomics) sang tanan, labi na gid ang mga kubos kag magagmay nga mga negosyo.
english: On the part of the government, it must maintain its ability to run the economy as a whole (macroeconomics), while not neglecting the individual efforts (microeconomics) of all, especially the poor and small businesses.

text: Una na diri ang pag-angkon sang pondo nga makuha sa buhis kag iban pa nga sulokton nga government service fees kag penalties.
english: First of all, the acquisition of funds from taxes and other government service fees and penalties.

text: Pwede man makapangutang ang gobyerno sang masarangan sini bayaran.
english: The government can also borrow what it can afford to pay.

text: Pwede man makakuha kwarta ang gobyerno sa dalagku nga mga korporasyon paagi sa pagbaligya sa ila sang government securities nga mapagkakitaan man nila.
english: The government can also make money from big corporations by selling them government securities that they can also make money from.

text: Kag tani bastante na ini agud magamit sang gobyerno sa pagpabangon sang aton ekonomiya sa kabug-usan.
english: And hopefully it will be enough for the government to use to revive our economy as a whole.

text:
***

Sa aton problema sa palangitan-an, kinahanglan ipadayon ang mga trabaho sa nasugdan na nga mga infra projects samtang gina-encourage ang pagsanyog sang komersyo agud may kadtuan ang kita sang mga trabahador.
english:
***

In our environmental problem, it is necessary to continue the work on the infra projects that have already been started while encouraging the development of trade so that the income of the workers has a place to go.

text: Pwede man mahaylo sang gobyerno ang mga negosyo sa pagdugang trabaho kag empleyado paagi sa ihatag nga tax credit.
english: The government can also entice businesses to add jobs and employees through tax credits.

text: Basi matagaan man sing dugang nga sweldo ang mga minimum wage workers agud indi matam-an sang inflation.
english: Maybe minimum wage workers will also be given more salaries to keep inflation at bay.

text: Subong man sing ayuda ang mga kubos nga gakinahanglan gid bulig.
english: Also, help the poor who are in dire need.

text: Pati na sing subsidiya ang mga gahikahos nga mga production sector.
english: Even subsidies for the struggling production sectors.

text: Ugaling, indi man kita magsalig lang sa ayuda sang gobyerno kag sang mabulig man sang makasangkol nga private sector.
english: However, we must not rely solely on government assistance and the help of the private sector.

text: Kinahanglan man naton mangita sing dugang nga income.
english: We also need to find more income.

text: Sa iban nga panimalay, nagabulig na gani ang asawa kag pila sang ila mga kabataan.
english: In some households, the wife and some of their children even help.

text: Indi man dapat kalimtan sang mga OFW nga mabuligan ang ila panimalay diri sa Filipinas.
english: OFWs should not forget to help their families here in the Philippines.

text: Kinahanglan mag-budget sang ginakita agud mapaigu ini kag likawan gastuhan ang mga indi man kinahanglanon gid.
english: You need to budget your income to make ends meet and avoid spending on unnecessary things.

text: Tani makabulig man ang gobyerno sa pagpahulam puhunan sa magagmay nga negosyo agud mapabangon ang ila negosyo.
english: I hope the government can also help lend money to small businesses to revive their businesses.

text: Nagabulig man gani ang non-profit sector katulad sang ang mga non-government organizations (NGOs) nga ang misyon amo ang makabulig.
english: The non-profit sector is also helping such as non-government organizations (NGOs) whose mission is to help.

text: Nagabulig pati na gani ang tri-media sa ila mga programa nga nagahatag cash kag in-kind nga premyo sa ila audience./PN
english: Even tri-media helps in their programs that give cash and in-kind prizes to their audience./PN

text: Nagalab-ot sa P706 million ang halit nga tuga sang bagyo Quinta sa crops kag livestock sector.
english: The damage caused by Typhoon Quinta in the crops and livestock sector amounted to P706 million.

text: Suno sa Department of Agriculture, ang kabug-usan nga halit sa agri-fisheries ang nagsaka sa P705.87 million gikan sa una nga gin-report nga P401.73 million sa diin 25,483 nga mga mangunguma kag manugpangisda ang apektado.
english: According to the Department of Agriculture, the total damage to agri-fisheries rose to P705.87 million from the initially reported P401.73 million where 25,483 farmers and fishermen were affected.

text: Samtang 19,971 hectares sang agricultural areas sa Ilocos Region, CALABARZON, Bicol Region, Western Visayas kag Zamboaga Peninsula ang nagguba.
english: Meanwhile, 19,971 hectares of agricultural areas in Ilocos Region, CALABARZON, Bicol Region, Western Visayas and Zamboaga Peninsula were destroyed.

text: Ang mga apektado naman nga mga commodities ang ginalakipan sang rice, corn, high value crops, fisheries, livestock, irrigation kag agri-facilities.
english: The affected commodities include rice, corn, high value crops, fisheries, livestock, irrigation and agri-facilities.

text: Gindeklara nga dead on arrival sa ospital ang driver sang motorsiklo nga nakabunggo sa nasumalang nga Sports Utility Vehicle (SUV) sa radial road sa Brgy.
english: The driver of the motorcycle that collided with a Sports Utility Vehicle (SUV) on the radial road in Brgy.

text: Lanit, Jaro, Iloilo City kagab-i, Mayo 10.
english: Lanit, Jaro, Iloilo City last night, May 10.

text: Ang driver sang motorsiklo amo si Alyas Nito, 58-anyos, kag residente sang Brgy.
english: The driver of the motorcycle was identified as Nito, 58, resident of Brgy.

text: Tacas, Jaro, samtang, ang driver sang SUV amo si Alyas Rene, 56-anyos, kag residente sang Leganes.
english: Tacas, Jaro, meanwhile, the driver of the SUV was identified as Rene, 56, resident of Leganes.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Patrolman Japeth Cudo, traffic investigator sang Traffic Enforcement Unit (TEU), iya ginpahayag nga halin sa Leganes ang SUV nga may duha ka sakay nga padulong kuntani sa Circumferential Road sa Buhang, Jaro, sang nagapadulong ini sa taytay nagbunggoanay ini sila sang motor nga halin naman sa Circumferential Road kag padulong naman sa Leganes.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Patrolman Japeth Cudo, traffic investigator of the Traffic Enforcement Unit (TEU), said the SUV with two passengers was heading to Circumferential Road in Buhang, Jaro from Leganes when it collided with a motorcycle heading to Circumferential Road in Buhang, Jaro.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan nga apat ka linya ang karsada, apang one-way lang ang linya nga halin sa Leganes bangud ginakay-o ang dalan, kun sa diin ara pa sa right of way ang SUV, samtang naglapaw sa iya linya ang motorsiklo sang nagluntad ang aksidente.
english: He added that the road has four lanes, but only one-way line from Leganes because the road is being repaired, where the SUV is still in the right of way, while the motorcycle crossed its lane when the accident occurred.

text: Head-on collision ang natabo kag nagsuhot sa idalom sang SUV ang driver sang motor nga nagresulta sa patal nga pilas sa ulo kag sa dughan nga gintunaan sang iya kamatayon.
english: A head-on collision occurred and the driver of the motorcycle slipped under the SUV resulting in fatal head and chest injuries that led to his death.

text: Nagagwa sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon nga posible ang gintunaan sang aksidente amo ang mamunog nga ulan bangud indi maayo kitaon ang dalan kag madulom ang porsyon sang karsada, apang padayon nga nagatipon sang CCTV footages ang kapulisan malapit sa lugar.
english: Initial investigation revealed that the accident may have been caused by heavy rain as the road was not visible and the portion of the road was dark, but police are still collecting CCTV footages near the scene.

text: Sa subong, ara sa kustodiya sang kapulisan ang driver sang SUV samtang ginahulat pa ang pinal nga desisyon sang pamilya sang driver sang motorsiklo kun ang mga ini ang mapasaka sang kaso.
english: The driver of the SUV is currently in police custody while the family of the motorcycle driver is awaiting a final decision on whether to file a case.

text: (Article: Bombo Phauline Pillora)
english: (Article: Bombo Phauline Pillora)

text: Naglab-ot pa sang isa ka dekada antes nakabalik sa Western Conference finals ang Los Angeles Lakers matapos ginlampaso sa Game 5 ang Houston Rockets sa score nga 119-96 sa natabo nga hampang sa Walk Disney World Complex sa Florida.
english: It took a decade for the Los Angeles Lakers to return to the Western Conference finals after beating the Houston Rockets 119-96 in Game 5 at the Walk Disney World Complex in Florida.

text: Nanguna si Lakers superstar LeBron James sa hampang nga may 29 points, 11 rebounds kag 7 assists sa iya all-around game agud tapuson ang nila sa Rockets sa 4-1.
english: Lakers superstar LeBron James led the way with 29 points, 11 rebounds and seven assists in his all-around game to end their 4-1 win over the Rockets.

text: Gintinguhaan ni James ang pag-atake batuk sa depensa sang Rockets nga mahilig sa small-ball offense.
english: James tried the offense against a Rockets defense that loves small-ball offense.

text: Apang wala ini sang nangin epekto kay James sa diin nag pa ulan pa ang Lakers sang 3 points shots.
english: But it had no effect on James and the Lakers rained down 3 point shots.

text: Aminado naman si LeBron nga dako ang pagsalig sa iya sang mga fans agud nga madala liwat sa championship ang iya nga team.
english: LeBron admitted that the fans have a lot of confidence in him to bring his team back to the championship.

text: Nagdaog si Pinoy boxer Jerwin Ancajas batok kay Ruben Casero sang Uruguay.
english: Filipino boxer Jerwin Ancajas won against Ruben Casero of Uruguay.

text: Nakuha ni Ancajas ang majority decision nga daog sa sambuwa nga ginhiwat sa Long Beach, California.
english: Ancajas won the majority decision in the fight held in Long Beach, California.

text: Duha ka judges ang naghatag sang 80-72 nga pabor kay Ancajas samtang ang isa ang naghatag sang draw 76-76 sa super-bantanweight fight.
english: Two judges gave it 80-72 in favor of Ancajas while one scored it a draw 76-76 in the super-bantanweight fight.

text: May yara sang 37 ka kadalag-an, apat ka pyerde kag duha ka draw nga may yara sang 24 knockouts ang anay International Boxing Federation super-flyweight champion.
english: The former International Boxing Federation super-flyweight champion has 37 wins, four losses and two draws with 24 knockouts.

text: Nagdangat sa lima ka tawo ang kumpirmado nga napatay kag malapit 100 ang nasamaran bangud sa buhawi nga naglaslas sa probinsya sang Shangdong nga nahamtang sa eastern China.
english: At least five people have been confirmed dead and nearly 100 injured in a typhoon that struck eastern China's Shangdong province.

text: Sa syudad sang Heze, naglaslas ang buhawi kahapon sang hapon lakip na sa area sang Dongming kag Juancheng kun sa diin napilasan ang 88 ka mga tawo.
english: In Heze City, a typhoon struck yesterday afternoon including in the area of ​​Dongming and Juancheng where 88 people were injured.

text: Malapit man sa 3,000 ka balay ang naguba; 48 power supply lines kag masobra 4,000 hectares sang pananum ang nahalitan.
english: Nearly 3,000 homes were also destroyed; 48 power supply lines and more than 4,000 hectares of crops were damaged.

text: Suno sa Dongming County Emergency Management Bureau, nag-establisar na ang local government sang command center kag naglunsar man sang emergency response operations.
english: According to the Dongming County Emergency Management Bureau, the local government has already established a command center and also launched emergency response operations.

text:
Naga-conduct na subong ang emergency services sang “post-disaster disposal and on site clean-up.”

Suno naman sa China Weather News nga ginapadalagan sang China Meteorological Administration, masami gid man nga ma-eksperyensyahan ang kaangay sini nga mga buhawi sa southern kag coastal provinces sang China kaangay sang Guangdong kag Jiangsu.
english:
Emergency services are now conducting post-disaster disposal and on site clean-up.

According to the China Weather News, run by the China Meteorological Administration, such typhoons are often experienced in China's southern and coastal provinces such as Guangdong and Jiangsu.

text: Sa sini nga bulan, matandaan nga nagbalhag ang China Meteorological Administration sang ila tuigan nga Blue Book sa state of climate change sa pungsod kun sa diin nagguwa ang report na-eksperyensyahan sang pungsod ang pinakamainit nga tyempo halin sang 1901 kag nagpaandam man nga mahimo masami paabuton ang extreme weather” kag “climate events.”
english: This month, the China Meteorological Administration published its annual Blue Book on the state of climate change in the country, which reported that the country experienced the hottest weather since 1901 and warned that extreme weather and climate events could be expected.

text: CORSICA – Ginkustodiya sang otoridad sa Corsica ang Irish mixed martial arts star nga si Conor McGregor bangud sa ginapahayag attempted sexual assault kag indecent exposure.
english: CORSICA – Authorities in Corsica have taken Irish mixed martial arts star Conor McGregor into custody for alleged attempted sexual assault and indecent exposure.

text: Suno sa pahayag sang prosecutor’s office, ang reklamo ang ginpasaka sang Setyembre 10 kag bangud sini, si McGregor ang ipaidalom sa hearing sang gendarmerie services.
english: According to a statement from the prosecutor’s office, the complaint was filed on September 10 and as a result, McGregor will be subject to a hearing by the gendarmerie services.

text: Magluwas diri, wala na sang may ginhatag nga detalye ang prosecutor’s office may kaangtanan sa ginapahayag offense nga nahimo sang 32 anyos nga Mixed Martial Artist.
english: Besides, the prosecutor's office did not provide any details regarding the alleged offense committed by the 32-year-old Mixed Martial Artist.

text: Nahibalu-an nga si McGregor nga icon sang Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) kag ginbansagan nga ‘Notorious’, ang indi na bag-o sa kontrobersiya.
english: It is known that McGregor, who is an icon of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) and nicknamed 'Notorious', is not new to controversy.

text: Sang 2019, nakuhaan sang video si McGregor bangud sa pag-atake sa isa ka tigulang nga lalaki sa Dublin bar kag sang 2018, gin-atake man niya ang bus nga ginasakyan sang UFC fighters sa New York.
english: In 2019, McGregor was caught on video for attacking an elderly man in a Dublin bar and in 2018, he also attacked a bus carrying UFC fighters in New York.

text: Sang Hunyo subong lang nga tuig sang gin-anunsyo sang natungdan ang iya retirement sa ika-tatlo nga kahigayunan.
english: In June this year, he announced his retirement for the third time.

text: MANILA – Suportado sang Department of Tourism (DOT) ang panawagan nga magpatuman sang price cap sa coronavirus tests may kaangtanan sa ginaduso nga buksan ang turismo agud makabawi ang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas.
english: MANILA – The Department of Tourism (DOT) supports the call to implement a price cap on coronavirus tests in connection with the proposed reopening of tourism to recover the Philippine economy.

text: Suno kay DOT Sec.
english: According to DOT Sec.

text: Bernadette Romulo-Puyat, mas makapaayo nga may yara sang price cap sa RT-PCR kag antigen testing agud nga mangin affordable ang travel.
english: Bernadette Romulo-Puyat, it would be better to have a price cap on RT-PCR and antigen testing to make travel affordable.

text: Nauna na nga ginpahayag ni Cabinet Secretary Karlo Nograles nga ginatun-an sang gobyerno ang tuhoy sa pagpatuman sang price cap sa COVID-19 tests kasunod sang report nga nagalab-ot sa P9,000 ang sukot sa iban nga facilities.
english: Earlier, Cabinet Secretary Karlo Nograles said the government is studying the implementation of a price cap on COVID-19 tests following reports that some facilities charge up to P9,000.

text: Matandaan nga ginpahanugutan sang Inter-Agency Task Force ang non-essential overseas travel para sa mga Filipino nga may yara sang confirmed roundtrip tickets, travel kag health insurance, declaration tuhoy sa risgo sang travel kag trip delays kag medical test within 24 hours sang departure.
english: The Inter-Agency Task Force has allowed non-essential overseas travel for Filipinos with confirmed roundtrip tickets, travel and health insurance, declaration on the risk of travel and trip delays and medical test within 24 hours of departure.

text: Ang problema lang suno sa Philippine Travel Agencies Association amo nga may yara sang additional cost sa pila ka destinasyon nga naga-require sang COVID-19 testing.
english: The only problem, according to the Philippine Travel Agencies Association, is that there is an additional cost in some destinations that require COVID-19 testing.

text: Maaring ituloy na ng Commission on Election (COMELEC) ang national voter registration sa Oktubre dahil sa inaasahang pagpapaliban ng barangay at Sangguniang Kabataan Election (BSKE) ngayong taon.
english: The Commission on Elections (COMELEC) may continue the national voter registration in October due to the expected postponement of the barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Election (BSKE) this year.

text: Sinabi ni COMELEC chiarman George Garcia, na kapag maipagpaliban ang halalan sa Disyembre 1 at magigign Nobyembre 2026 ay kanilang bubuksan ang registration pagkatapos ng Bangsamoro Parliamentary Election.
english: COMELEC chairman George Garcia said that if the election is postponed to December 1 and November 2026, they will open the registration after the Bangsamoro Parliamentary Election.

text: Itinuturing nito na pinakamahabang voter registration mula Oktubre 2025 hanggagn Hulyo 2026.
english: It considers the longest voter registration from October 2025 to July 2026.

text: Magugunitang inabisuhan na ng Malacanang ang COMELEC na nakatakdang pirmahan ni Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr sa Agosto 12 ang panukalang pagpapaliban ng halalan.
english: Malacanang has already notified the COMELEC that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is scheduled to sign on August 12 the proposal to postpone the elections.

text: Gin-ako sang Houston Rockets nga daw kaangay nga nadulaan sila sang pangalibutan rason nga napierde na naman ini batuk sa Los Angeles Lakers sa Game 4 sang Western Conference semifinal series.
english: The Houston Rockets admitted that they felt like they had lost their environment and lost again to the Los Angeles Lakers in Game 4 of the Western Conference semifinal series.

text: Suno kay Rockets coach Mike D’Antoni, nakulangan sang kapagsik kag kabakod ang team rason nga wala ini makabawi sa Los Angeles.
english: According to Rockets coach Mike D’Antoni, the team lacked energy and stamina, which is why it did not recover in Los Angeles.

text: Nagpakita ang Houston sang kahinaan sa paghampang sa diin napaslawan ang mga ini nga maka-score sang second chance ukon fast-break point sa una nga tatlo ka quarter sang hampang.
english: Houston showed a weakness in play where they failed to score a second chance or fast-break point in the first three quarters of the game.

text: Kun si Houston star James Harden naman ang pamangkuton, iya ginpahayag nga wala naman sila sang may mahimo pa kundi tinguhaan nga makabawi sa Game 5.
english: As for Houston star James Harden, he said they have no choice but to try to recover in Game 5.

text: Sa subong, nagakabit na lang ang Houston sa posible nga pagkadagdag sini sa serye bangud kapyot na sang Lakers ang 3-1 lead.
english: Houston is now clinging to a possible addition to the series as the Lakers hold a 3-1 lead.

text: Nagpaandam ang kapulisan sa posible pangatubangon nga mga kunsekwensya sang mga indibidwal nga magalapas sa liquor ban nga ipatuman epektibo Domingo, Mayo 11.
english: Police warned of the possible consequences of individuals who violate the liquor ban that will be implemented effective Sunday, May 11.

text: Suno kay Police Lt.
english: According to Police Lt.

text: Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson sang Police Regional Office VI, ang bayolasyon sa sini nga pagsulundan ang mahimo magresulta sa pagka-preso sang isa tubtub anum ka tuig.
english: Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office VI, said violation of this rule can result in imprisonment of one to six years.

text: Mahimo man madagdag ang penalidad nga permanente nga disqualification sa public office kag pagkadula sang kinamatarong sa pagboto.
english: The penalty of permanent disqualification from public office and loss of the right to vote may also be added.

text: Tubtub sa Lunes, Mayo 12, ang implementasyon sang ban kag na-cover sini ang tanan bisan ano pa ang political affiliation.
english: The implementation of the ban is until Monday, May 12, and covers everyone regardless of political affiliation.

text: Buot silingon sini, isa ka adlaw antes ang eleksyon, kag sa mismo adlaw sang piniliay, hugot nga ginadumilian ang pagbakal, pagbaligya, pagdala, kag pag-inom sang makahulubog nga ilimnon.
english: This means that, one day before the election, and on election day itself, it is strictly forbidden to buy, sell, transport, and consume alcoholic beverages.

text: Ginadumilian ang hotel, resort, restaurant owners kag managers nga mag-intra sa mga aktibidad nga naga-involve sang makahulubog nga ilimnon.
english: Hotel, resort, restaurant owners and managers are prohibited from participating in activities involving alcoholic beverages.

text: Ang exempted lamang amo ang mga establisyemento nga na-certify sang Department of Tourism (DOT) bilang tourist-oriented kag regular nga naga-cater sa foreign tourists.
english: The only exemptions are establishments that have been certified by the Department of Tourism (DOT) as tourist-oriented and regularly cater to foreign tourists.

text: Mahatag ang exemption kun nakakuha ang establisyemento sang written approval halin sa Comelec officials, kag pananglitan naaprubahan sang poll body, ang foreign tourists lamang ang pwede nga maka-inom sang alcohol sa exempted establishments sa tion nga ginapatuman ang liquor ban.
english: The exemption will be granted if the establishment obtains written approval from Comelec officials, and if approved by the poll body, only foreign tourists are allowed to drink alcohol in exempted establishments during the liquor ban.

text: Patay ang top-ranked grandmaster sang Bangladesh nga si Ziaur Rahman matapos nga nag-suprer sang stroke kag nag-collapse sa iya board kadungan sang iya ginpasakupan nga national championship match.
english: Bangladesh's top-ranked grandmaster Ziaur Rahman died after suffering a stroke and collapsing on his board during the national championship match.

text: Suno kay Bangladesh Chess Federation general secretary Shahab Uddin Shamim, natabo ang pag-collapse sang 50-anyos nga grandmaster sa 12th round match sang championship batok sa isa pa ka grandmaster nga si Enamul Hossain.
english: According to Bangladesh Chess Federation general secretary Shahab Uddin Shamim, the collapse of the 50-year-old grandmaster occurred in the 12th round match of the championship against another grandmaster Enamul Hossain.

text: Ginhingagaw ini dala sa ospital sa kapital sang pungsod nga Dhaka apang gindeklarar sang doctor nga dead on arrival.
english: He was rushed to a hospital in the capital Dhaka but was pronounced dead on arrival.

text: Sang tion nga napatay si Rahman, yara man sa pihak nga lamesa ang iya anak nga nagahampang man sang chess.
english: At the time Rahman died, his son, who was also playing chess, was at the other table.

text: Siya ang ginakilala nga highest ranked sa lima ka chess grandmasters sang Bangladesh.
english: He is recognized as the highest ranked among the five chess grandmasters of Bangladesh.

text: Pila ka beses sini nga nadag-an ang national championship kag gintiglawas pa ang Bangladesh sa 44th Chess Olympiad sa India sang 2022.
english: He has won the national championship several times and even represented Bangladesh at the 44th Chess Olympiad in India in 2022.

text: Gindesignar si former Iloilo City Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog bilang special adviser ni House Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: Former Iloilo City Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog was designated as special adviser by House Speaker Martin Romualdez.

text:
Gin-anunsyo ini antes ang speech sang anay alkalde sa final campaign sang Team Sulong Gugma sa Mandurriao subong nga gab-i.

“A very good news just came in.
english:
This was announced before the former mayor's speech at the final campaign of Team Sulong Gugma in Mandurriao tonight.

“A very good news just came in.

text: He is now the newly-designated special adviser for the House of Representatives of the Philippines — World Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog,” kabahin sang introduction sang host sa former mayor.
english: He is now the newly-designated special adviser for the House of Representatives of the Philippines — World Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog,” part of the host’s introduction to the former mayor.

text: Sa kopya sang Memorandum halin kay Secretary-General Reginald Velasco nga ginsapubliko subong man nga gab-i, nakasaad nga epektibo ang bag-o nga designasyon ni Mabilog halin sang Mayo 1.
english: A copy of the Memorandum from Secretary-General Reginald Velasco that was made public tonight, states that Mabilog's new designation will be effective from May 1.

text: Ginplastar sa memorandum nga importante ang kontribusyon kag mga panan-awan ni Mabilog sa iya field of expertise para nga mas mapaayo pa ang legislative agenda sang Kamara.
english: The memorandum stressed the importance of Mabilog's contribution and insights in his field of expertise to further improve the legislative agenda of the House.

text: Matandaan nga nagbalik si Mabilog sa Pilipinas sang 2024 matapos ang pito ka tuig nga self-imposed exile sa luwas sang pungsod matapos gintawag anay ni former president Rodrigo Duterte nga “big-time narco politician” sang 2017.
english: Mabilog returned to the Philippines in 2024 after seven years of self-imposed exile abroad after being called a “big-time narco politician” by former President Rodrigo Duterte in 2017.

text: Lakip man siya sa naghatag sang testimoniya sa quad-committee sa Kamara nga naga-imbestigar sa drug war sang former president.
english: He was also among those who testified to the House quad-committee investigating the former president's drug war.

text: Sang Enero 2025, matandaan nga naghatag man si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: In January 2025, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sang executive clemency kay Mabilog kaangot sa iya administrative case sang 2017.
english: of executive clemency to Mabilog in connection with his administrative case in 2017.

text: Sa amo nga desisyon, gin-angot sang Malacañang ang mga accomplishment sini bilang anay local chief executive sang Iloilo City.
english: In the decision, Malacañang linked his accomplishments as former local chief executive of Iloilo City.

text: MANILA – May yara sang rollback sa presyo sang Diesel kag Kerosene samtang wala naman sang pagbag-o sa presyo sang Gasolina.
english: MANILA – There was a rollback in the price of diesel and kerosene while there was no change in the price of gasoline.

text: Ang ang price adjustment ang mangin epektibo subong nga adlaw, Oktubre 27.
english: The the price adjustment will be effective today, October 27.

text: Santo sa abiso sang mga kompaniya sang langis, magalab-ot sa 25 centavos ang buhin sa kada litro sang Diesel samtang 15 centavos naman sa Kerosene kag wala naman sang price adjustment sa Gasolina.
english: According to the oil companies, the price of diesel will be reduced by 25 centavos per liter while kerosene will be reduced by 15 centavos and there will be no price adjustment for gasoline.

text: Santo sa latest data gikan sa Department of Energy, ang year-to-date adjustments ang may net decrease nga P4.67 per liter sa Gasolina, P10.01 per liter sa Diesel kag P13.44 per liter sa Kerosene as of October 20, 2020.
english: According to the latest data from the Department of Energy, the year-to-date adjustments have a net decrease of P4.67 per liter in Gasoline, P10.01 per liter in Diesel and P13.44 per liter in Kerosene as of October 20, 2020.

text: Pareho nga nadepensahan sang NBA (National Basketball Association) defending champion nga Toronto Raptors kag Denver Nuggets ang ila nagkalain-lain nga serye sa nagapadayon nga semifinal sa Eastern Conference sa Disney World sa Florida.
english: Both the NBA (National Basketball Association) defending champion Toronto Raptors and Denver Nuggets defended their respective series in the ongoing semifinals in the Eastern Conference at Disney World in Florida.

text: May yara na sang duha ka mga panibag-o nga daog ang Raptors matapos nga mapierde ang Celtics sa Game 4 sa 100-93.
english: The Raptors now have two straight wins after beating the Celtics in Game 4 100-93.

text: Naka-score sang series-best 23 points si Cameroonian basketball player Pascal Siakam kag gindugangan man sang amerikano nga Kyle Lowry.
english: Cameroonian basketball player Pascal Siakam scored a series-best 23 points and American Kyle Lowry added.

text: Samtang nagabulig man sa opensa nanday Serge Ibaka nga may 18 points kag si Fred VanVleey nga magpakita ang 17 nga puos.
english: Serge Ibaka with 18 points and Fred VanVleey with 17 points also helped the offense.

text: Sa bahin sang Celtics, wala na puslan ang 24 points kag 10 ka rebounds ni american Jason Tatum.
english: For the Celtics, American Jason Tatum's 24 points and 10 rebounds were useless.

text: Ang Game 5 ang natalana sa Setyembre 8, bwas nga adlaw.
english: Game 5 is scheduled for September 8, tomorrow.

text: Samtang nagakayod sang maayo ang Denver agud indi na maliwat pa nga mapierde sila sang Clippers kaangay sa natabo sang Game 1.
english: Meanwhile, Denver is working hard to avoid losing to the Clippers again like they did in Game 1.

text: Sa kampo sang Clippers, ginkakibot sang kadam-an nga ang anay two-time NBA final Most Valuable Player nga si Kawhi Leonard ang may yara lamang sang 30 puntos.
english: In Clippers camp, it surprised many that former two-time NBA final Most Valuable Player Kawhi Leonard only had 30 points.

text: Ginakonsider sang Oton Municipal Police Station nga person of interest ang amay matapos nasapwan-patay ang anak sini nga lalaki sa Brgy.
english: The Oton Municipal Police Station is considering a father as a person of interest after his son was found dead in Brgy.

text: Sta.
english: Sta.

text: Rita.
english: Rita.

text: Oton, Iloilo.
english: Oton, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Raymundo Sarad, Jr., 36-anyos, residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The victim was identified as Raymundo Sarad, Jr., 36, resident of the said place.

text: Kaina sang aga sang nakit-an ini nga yara na sa kanal kag may pilas nga tuga sang pagkabuno sa iya nga wala nga butkon kag wala nga paa.
english: He was found in a ditch yesterday morning with gunshot wounds to his left arm and left leg.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Lunelyn Talamillo, deputy chief of police sang Oton Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nakita nga may dugo ang tiil sang amay, may hanog ang mata kag nakuha man sa iya posisyon ang kutsilyo nga may dugo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Lunelyn Talamillo, deputy chief of police of Oton Municipal Police Station, said the father was found with blood on his leg, a bruised eye and a knife with blood was also recovered from his possession.

text: Magluwas diri, sang gin-check ini sa ila nga balay, nakit-an man nga may mantsa sang dugo ang bed sheet kag ang ulunan sa hiligdaan sang biktima.
english: Besides, when they checked their house, they also found blood stains on the bed sheet and the pillow on the victim's bed.

text:
Lunsay nakainom kagab-i ang mag-amay kag ginaalegar nga may mga kasilingan nga nakabati sang ila pagbaisay kagab-i.

Yara na sa kustodiya sang pulis ang amay kasunod sang insidente.
english:
The father and daughter were both drunk last night and it is alleged that some neighbors heard their argument last night.

The father is now in police custody following the incident.

text: Pahayag sang PNP, nagkuha naman sila sang sample sang blood stain agud nga ma-check kun naga-santo ini sa dugo sang biktima.
english: The PNP said they took a sample of the blood stain to check if it matched the blood of the victim.

text:
‘NAKABUNGGO LANG’

Kun basehan ang bersyon sang istorya sang amay nga si Raymundo Sarad, Sr., iya ginpahayag nga magkaupod sila sang iya anak nga nag-inom sa balay ni Alyas Bunis kon sa diin nagalahuganay pa sila sa amo nga tion.
english:
‘JUST CRASHED’

Based on the version of the story of the father, Raymundo Sarad, Sr., he said that he and his son were drinking at the house of Alyas Bunis where they were still dating at the time.

text: Suno sa amay, manog alas-dose sang kagab-ihon sang nag-una siya nga nagpauli sa ila balay.
english: According to the father, it was around 12:00 pm when he first returned home.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga nakibot na lamang siya sang ginpukaw siya sa ila balay agud ipahibalo nga nasapwan ang iya anak sa kanal kaina sang aga.
english: She said she was shocked when she was woken up at home to be informed that her son was found in the canal yesterday morning.

text: Nagdepensa man ang amay nga nakabunggo lamang siya rason nga may black eye.
english: The father also defended that he was hit by a black eye.

text: Nagpanginwala ini nga ginsumbag siya sang iya anak.
english: She denied that her son hit her.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Sarad nga apisar lunsay nga hubog sila sang iya anak kagab-i, wala sila nakabaisay.
english: Sarad also said that although he and his son were both drunk last night, they did not argue.

text:
‘PIRME NAGABAISAY KUN HUBOG’

Gintuad naman sang utod sang biktima nga masami gid man nagabaisay si Junior kag ang ila amay kun mahubog.
english:
‘ALWAYS ARGUING WHEN DRUNK’

The victim's brother admitted that Junior and their father often argued when he was drunk.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Sheila Mae Suarez, iya ginpahayag nga istorya-hinubog lang ang gina-awayan sang iya amay kag utod, apang masami nga naga-ayuhay man kun maumpawan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Sheila Mae Suarez said her father and brother used to fight over drunkenness, but they often got along when they were comforted.

text: Suno naman kay Punong Barangay Danilo Villacastin, mismo ang bata ang naga-istorya sa iya nga nagapuis sila sang iya amay, kag nakapanugid man ang amay bangud mag-abyan man sila sini.
english: According to Punong Barangay Danilo Villacastin, the child himself told him that he and his father were fighting, and the father was able to tell him because they were friends.

text: Gindugang sang barangay official nga wala sang blotter report kag wala man nakaagi nga nagresponde ang barangay bangud daw nahimo na lang nga normal ang ila masami nga pagbaisay.#
english: The barangay official added that there was no blotter report and the barangay did not respond because it seems that their frequent arguments have become normal.

text: Nabuhi kag nadugangan pa ang military activities sang China sa teritoryo sang Taiwan partikular na ang combat patrol.
english: China's military activities in Taiwanese territory, particularly combat patrols, have been revived and increased.

text: Sang Martes, matandaan nga ginsakyan sang Chinese officials kag ginkumpiska ang isa ka Taiwanese fishing boat bangud sa gin-alegar nga iligal sini nga paglayag sa dagat sang Beijing — hitabo nga gintawag sang senior Taiwan official nga akto sang psychological warfare.
english: On Tuesday, Chinese officials boarded and confiscated a Taiwanese fishing boat for allegedly illegally sailing in Beijing waters — an incident that a senior Taiwan official called an act of psychological warfare.

text: Magluwas diri, gin-report man sang defense ministry nga halin 7:00 kahapon, na-detect sini ang 26 Chinese military aircraft lakip ang J-16 fighters nga nagahimo sang “joint combat readiness patrol” kaupod sa Chinese warships.
english: In addition, the defense ministry also reported that as of 7:00 am yesterday, it detected 26 Chinese military aircraft including J-16 fighters conducting a joint combat readiness patrol with Chinese warships.

text: Ini nga aircraft sang China ang naglupad sa airspace pa-naaminhan, sentro, kag nabagatnan nga bahin sang Taiwan.
english: The Chinese aircraft flew in the airspace north, central, and southern parts of Taiwan.

text: Halin sang nagsugod ang Hulyo, nagdangat na sa 127 ka Chinese military aircraft ang nag-operate malapit sa Taiwan suno pa sa defense ministry.
english: Since the beginning of July, 127 Chinese military aircraft have operated near Taiwan, the defense ministry said.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang China nga ang ugat sang ila problema sa Taiwan amo ang “separatist” views sang bag-o sini nga presidente nga si Lai Ching-te.
english: China has previously said the root of its problem with Taiwan is the “separatist” views of its new president, Lai Ching-te.

text: Matandaan nga nagpatigayon pa sang war games ang China sang nagpungko sa posisyon si Lai sang Mayo.
english: China was still conducting war games when Lai took office in May.

text: Ginabasura ni Lai ang pag-angkon sang China sa soberanya sang Taiwan bangud ginpahayag sini nga indi ang mainland China kundi sila mismo nga mga pumuluyo sang Taipei ang maka-desisyon para sa ila buwas-damlag.#
english: Lai rejects China's claim to Taiwan's sovereignty because he said it is not mainland China but the people of Taipei themselves who can decide for their future.

text: MANILA – Nangin mahapos para sa Filipino kag World No.
english: MANILA – It was easy for Filipino and World No.

text: 2 online karateka nga si James “OJ” delos Santos ang paglab-ot sang kampeyonato sa e-Champions Trophy World Series #1.
english: 2 online karateka James “OJ” delos Santos won the e-Champions Trophy World Series #1 championship.

text: Ini matapos nga nagpakita sang isa na naman ka golden performance si delos Santos nga tumandok sang Cebu kag ginlutos si Taylor Scott sang Canada sa semifinals.
english: This is after delos Santos, a native of Cebu, showed another golden performance and defeated Taylor Scott of Canada in the semifinals.

text: Nagdaug si delos Santos matapos nga gin-reject ang video entry ni Scott kag ini na ang ika-anum nga bulawan nga medalya sang 30 anyos nga Filipino Karateka athlete.
english: Delos Santos won after Scott's video entry was rejected and this is the sixth gold medal for the 30-year-old Filipino Karateka athlete.

text: Bangud sini, ang anay Southeast Asian Games double bronze medalist ang nahatagan sang free ride sa finals batok kay Domont Matias Moreno sang Switzerland.
english: As a result, the former Southeast Asian Games double bronze medalist was given a free ride to the finals against Domont Matias Moreno of Switzerland.

text: Ang resulta sang championship round ang mahibalu-an subong nga adlaw, Setyembre 6.
english: The results of the championship round will be announced today, September 6.

text: Sang nakaligad lamang nga apat ka bulan, nakakuha sang madamo nga medalya si delos Santos sa 13 ka tournaments.
english: In the past four months alone, delos Santos has won multiple medals in 13 tournaments.

text: Nadakpan ang isa ka babaye nga nagtuyo nga magpalusot sang iligal nga droga sa iya bana nga nagapanimuron sa sulod sang Caloocan City Jail.
english: A woman was arrested for trying to smuggle illegal drugs to her husband who was sleeping inside the Caloocan City Jail.

text: Ini nga babaye, 45, ang nagbisita sa amo nga jail facility sang nagligad nga Byernes, Abril 5.
english: The woman, 45, visited the jail facility last Friday, April 5.
