text: Sa routine search pa lamang, nakit-an na sang otoridad ang anum ka sachets sang ginapatihan shabu nga gintago pa sini sa pribado nga parte sang iya nga lawas.
english: In a routine search, the police found six sachets of suspected shabu that he had hidden in his private parts.

text: Suno kay Jail Superintedent Jerome Verbo, ginbutang ang droga sa plastic, gin-selyuhan sang condom, kag gin-insert sa iya nga kinatawo.
english: According to Jail Superintendent Jerome Verbo, the drugs were placed in plastic, sealed with a condom, and inserted into his genitals.

text: “Very elastic yan, papasok talaga,” suno kay Verbo.
english: “It’s very elastic, it really fits,” Verbo said.

text: Magluwas sa drugs, nakumpiska man sa babaye ang aluminum foil kag 60 ka sigarilyo.
english: Besides the drugs, aluminum foil and 60 cigarettes were also confiscated from the woman.

text: Nagpaandam man ang natungdan nga indi makalusot ang ini nga mga taktika sang mga bisita bangud maid-id ang search sa pasilididad kun sa diin kun babaye ang magasulod, lady personnel man ang assigned nga mag-rikisa.
english: He also warned that these tactics of the visitors will not escape because the search is thorough in the facility where if a woman enters, lady personnel are also assigned to search.

text: Bangud sa hitabo, indi lamang bana ang nahal-id sa presuhan kundi pati ang misis nga kasuhan man sang illegal possession of drugs.
english: Because of the incident, not only the husband was imprisoned but also the wife who was also charged with illegal possession of drugs.

text: ILOILO CITY-Nagdepensa ang Punong Barangay sang Democracia, Jaro, Iloilo City matapos ginpasakaan sang kaso sang More Electric and Power Corporation bangud ginpahayag nga may yara sang illegal connection ukon jumper sang kuryente sa ila balay.
english: ILOILO CITY-The Punong Barangay of Democracia, Jaro, Iloilo City defended himself after being sued by More Electric and Power Corporation for allegedly having an illegal connection or jumper of electricity in his house.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Brgy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Punong Brgy.

text: Rex Jalbuena, iya ginpanindugan nga indi iya ang nadiskubre nga jumpers sa poste sa kilid sang ila balay.
english: Rex Jalbuena, he insisted that the jumpers discovered on the pole next to their house were not his.

text: Suno kay Jalbuena, ang nasambit nga jumper ang ginapanag-iyahan sang iya tiya apang nasal-an lang sang MORE Power nga iya ini bangud nagaagi sa ila balay ang electrical wires pakadto sa balay sang iya tiya.
english: According to Jalbuena, the jumper belonged to his aunt but MORE Power found it to be his because the electrical wires passed through their house to his aunt's house.

text: Nahibaluan nga magluwas kay Jalbuena, ginpasakaan man sang kaso si Kagawad Elmer Jareño nga nag-ako naman nga nagagamit ini sang jumper.
english: Besides Jalbuena, Kagawad Elmer Jareño was also charged with using a jumper.

text: Nagpalapit na ang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) sa Senado agud hingyuon nga amyendaran ang Republic Act 11310 ukon ang Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps).
english: The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) has approached the Senate to request an amendment to Republic Act 11310 or the Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps).

text: Suno kay Senator Erwin Tulfo, nagsumiter si DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian sang mga gina-propose nga amyenda sa layi, kag nalakip diri ang pagkakas sang pito ka tuig nga limit sa enrollment sang 4Ps.
english: According to Senator Erwin Tulfo, DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian submitted proposed amendments to the law, including the removal of the seven-year limit on 4Ps enrollment.

text: Base sa report sang DSWD, may 2.4 million ka benepisyaryo ang posible nga makakas sa 4Ps apisar wala pa nagmaayo ang ila kahimtangan, kun indi pa pagdulaon ang nasambit nga limitasyon.
english: According to the DSWD report, there are 2.4 million beneficiaries who are likely to be excluded from 4Ps even though their situation has not improved, if the limit is not lifted.

text: Dugang pa ni Tulfo, luyag man sang DSWD nga ipasulod sa amyenda ang mas hugot nga regulasyon sa pagpili sang mga kwalipikado nga pamilya nga dapat hatagan sang cash grant.
english: Tulfo added that the DSWD also wants to include in the amendment stricter regulations on the selection of eligible families who should be given cash grants.

text: Ini ang ginahinyo bangud may pila ka kaso sang pag-abuso sa programa, kag may mga benepisyaryo nga padayon nga ginahatagan apisar nabuligan na kag nag-umwad na ang pangabuhi.
english: This is requested because there are some cases of abuse in the program, and there are beneficiaries who continue to be given despite being helped and improving their lives.

text: Matandaan sa SONA ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos, ginmandu ang expansion ukon pagpasangkad sang 4Ps para mapasulod diri ang mga homeless kag maprayoridad sa libre nga pagtuon sa kolehiyo ang kabataan sang mga benepisyaryo.
english: It can be recalled that in President Ferdinand Marcos' SONA, the expansion of 4Ps was ordered to include the homeless and to give priority to the free college education of the children of the beneficiaries.

text: MANILA – Mahimo na nga makapadulong sa Pilipinas ang foreign investors umpisa Nobyembre 1.
english: MANILA – Foreign investors will be able to visit the Philippines starting November 1.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirma ni Presidential Spokesperson Atty. Atty Harry Roque kasunod sang pagsinapol nga ginpatigayon sang Inter-Agency Task Force.
english: This was confirmed by Presidential Spokesperson Atty. Atty Harry Roque following the meeting conducted by the Inter-Agency Task Force.

text: Suno kay Roque, ang foreigners nga may 47A2 visas gikan sa Department of Justice, Aurora Pacific Economic Zone and Freeport Authority, Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority kag investor visa gikan sa Department of Immigration ng pahanugutan nga makapadulong sa pungsod.
english: According to Roque, foreigners with 47A2 visas from the Department of Justice, Aurora Pacific Economic Zone and Freeport Authority, Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority and investor visas from the Department of Immigration will be allowed to enter the country.

text: Ginpahayag ni Roque nga ang mga pahanugutan lamang amo ang may yara sang valid kag existing visas sa tion sang time of entry kag kinahanglan nga may yara man sang pre-booked accredited quarantine facility.
english: Roque said that only those who have valid and existing visas at the time of entry and must also have a pre-booked accredited quarantine facility will be allowed.

text: Apisar sini, ginadumili-an sa gihapon ang mga foreign tourists.
english: Despite this, foreign tourists are still prohibited.

text: Magapadala ang Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation and Management Office (TTMO) sang tag-duha ka personnel sa kada voting center sa syudad sang Iloilo para sa Mayo 12 nga eleksyon.
english: The Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation and Management Office (TTMO) will send two personnel to each voting center in Iloilo City for the May 12 elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, head sang talatapan, iya ginpahayag nga napatigayon naman ang send-off ceremony sa ila mga katapo nga ipadala sa 66 voting centers nga may 417 clustered precincts.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, head of the office, said the send-off ceremony was held for their members to be sent to 66 voting centers with 417 clustered precincts.

text: Magluwas sa traffic personnel, may iga-deploy man nga myembro sang Public Order and Safety Management Office (POSMO) bangud may mga manugbaligya man nga gintugutan sa mga eskwelahan kadungan sang eleksyon.
english: Besides traffic personnel, members of the Public Order and Safety Management Office (POSMO) will also be deployed as there are also vendors allowed in schools during the election.

text: Pagkatapos sang lunch time sa Lunes, ipatigayon ang road closure sa Mabini Street — halin sa dalan General Luna pakadto sa dalan Delgado — para sa seguridad sa final canvassing sa Jubillee Hall.
english: After lunch time on Monday, a road closure will be conducted on Mabini Street — from General Luna street to Delgado street — for security during the final canvassing at the Jubillee Hall.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana sang ginpatigayon sang opisina ang onsite inspection sa mga polling center.
english: Last week, the office conducted an onsite inspection of the polling centers.

text: Ini agud ma-check ang drop-off areas kag ang reserved parking kag makapakighinun-anon man sa school personnel para masigurado nga matalunsay ang dalagan sang piniliay.
english: This is to check the drop-off areas and reserved parking and also to communicate with school personnel to ensure the smooth running of the election.

text: Nagsaka na sa 18 ang numero sang patay lakip na duha ka kabataan matapos nga nagbungguanay ang dump truck kag ang isa ka depampasahero nga van sa Barangay Luhong, Antipas, Cotabato.
english: The death toll has risen to 18, including two children, after a dump truck collided with a passenger van in Barangay Luhong, Antipas, Cotabato.

text: Sa imbestigasyon sang awtoridad, pakadto sa Antipas proper ang dump truck sang nadulaan ini sang preno kag nagbunggo sa nasugata sini nga van nga rason pa sang pagkalayo sini.
english: According to the investigation of the authorities, the dump truck was heading to Antipas proper when it lost its brakes and collided with a van that caused it to catch fire.

text: Lakip man nagkalamatay amo mismo ang driver sang van samtang nagapabilin naman sa kustodiya sang pulis ang nagadala sang dump truck kag posible nga mangatubang sang kaso nga reckless imprudence resulting to multiple physical injuries and damage to property.
english: Among the dead was the driver of the van while the driver of the dump truck remains in police custody and may face charges of reckless imprudence resulting to multiple physical injuries and damage to property.

text: Sa inisyal man nga impormasyon, may tatlo ka mga biktima nga nakaluwas sa insidente apang tuman man ka seryoso nga mga samad ang naangkon sa lawas bangud sa sunog.
english: According to initial information, three victims survived the incident but sustained serious injuries.

text: May mga nakakita man sang insidente nga nagsiling nga tuman ka pwersado ang natabo nga pagbungguanay rason nga nagbaliskad ang van, nagligid kag nagtupa sa kanal sa kilid sang highway antes nagkarab-karab ang kalayo.
english: Witnesses said the collision was so forceful that the van overturned, rolled and fell into a ditch on the side of the highway before catching fire.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang otoridad sa insidente kag padayon man nga gina-identify ang 18 nga nagkalamatay.#
english: Authorities are still investigating the incident and are still identifying the 18 dead.

text: MANILA – Magapanghatag sang libre nga bike ang Department of Labor and Employment para sa mga interesado nga magtrabaho bilang food couriers.
english: MANILA – The Department of Labor and Employment will distribute free bikes to those interested in working as food couriers.

text: Suno kay DOLE Sec.
english: According to DOLE Sec.

text: Silvestre Bello III, nationwide ang pagpanghatag sang libre nga bike.
english: Silvestre Bello III, the distribution of free bikes is nationwide.

text: Ang nasambit nga programa suno kay Bello ang igalunsyar sa Metro Manila kag Pasig.
english: Bello said the program will be launched in Metro Manila and Pasig.

text: Para sa mga interesado nga mag-avail sang libre nga bike, mahimo nga magpakig-angot sa mga talatapan sang Department of Labor and Employment.
english: For those interested in availing a free bike, please contact the offices of the Department of Labor and Employment.

text: Nagpaguwa ang Chinese embassy sang security alert matapos nga nasamaran ang duha ka Chinese nationals sa isa ka pagpang-atake sa Tokyo, Japan sang nagligad nga semana.
english: The Chinese embassy issued a security alert after two Chinese nationals were injured in an attack in Tokyo, Japan last week.

text: Suno kay Bombo Josel Palma, international correspondent sa Japan, nagguwa sa reports nga may apat ka kalalakihan nga may dala nga tubo nga nagsakit sa duha ka mga Chinese samtang yara sila sa Kanda district sang Tokyo alas nueve sang aga sang Huwebes.
english: According to Bombo Josel Palma, international correspondent in Japan, there were reports that four men with pipes assaulted two Chinese while they were in the Kanda district of Tokyo at 9 am on Thursday.

text: Lunsay pilas sa ulo ang naangkon sang duha ka mga biktima.
english: Both victims sustained head injuries.

text: Pahayag nila, wala man sang ginpangayo ang mga suspek kag indi man nila kilala ang mga ini antes ang engkwentro sang amo nga adlaw.
english: They said the suspects did not ask for anything and they did not know them before the encounter that day.

text:
Nagpanawagan naman ang Chinese embassy sa gobyerno sang Japan nga ipadakop gid ang mga suspek bangud sa ila ginlaragway nga “xenophobic sentiments.”

“In response to the recent xenophobic sentiments in Japanese society, the embassy has lodged a solemn representation with Japan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs, demanding concrete measures to be taken by the Japanese side in terms of protecting the safety and legitimate rights of Chinese citizens in Japan,” kabahin sang statement sang embahada.
english:
The Chinese embassy called on the Japanese government to arrest the suspects for what they described as “xenophobic sentiments.”

“In response to the recent xenophobic sentiments in Japanese society, the embassy has lodged a solemn representation with Japan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs, demanding concrete measures to be taken by the Japanese side in terms of protecting the safety and legitimate rights of Chinese citizens,” the embassy in Japan said in a statement.

text: Nahibaluan nga mga Chinese ang pinakadaku nga grupo sang foreigners sa Japan kag isa man sa pinakadako nga grupo sang mga turista.
english: Chinese are the largest group of foreigners in Japan and one of the largest groups of tourists.

text: Magluwas diri, ginkilala man ang Chinese nationals sang nagligad nga tuig bilang pinakadako nga grupo sang foreigners nga na-naturalize bilang Japanese citizens.
english: In addition, Chinese nationals were also recognized last year as the largest group of foreigners naturalized as Japanese citizens.

text: Ini nga atake sa Tokyo ang natabo samtang nga nagahinampot man ang ika-80 nga anibersaryo sang pagtapos sang World War II kag Chinese People’s War of Resistance batok sa Japanese Aggression.
english: The attack in Tokyo came as the 80th anniversary of the end of World War II and the Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression approached.

text: Suportado ni Japanese tennis star Naomi Osaka ang mga tawo nga nagapakigbato batok sa social injustice.
english: Japanese tennis star Naomi Osaka supports people fighting against social injustice.

text: Sa pag-umpisa sang hampang sa US Open sa New York, nagsuksok ang tennis star sang face mask nga may ngalan nga Breonna Taylor, ang African American nga ginluthang sang mga kapulisan tubtob napatay sang Mayo subong nga tuig sa Louisville, Kentucky.
english: To kick off play at the US Open in New York, the tennis star wore a face mask bearing the name of Breonna Taylor, the African American who was shot to death by police in May this year in Louisville, Kentucky.

text: Nahibaluan nga madamo nga atleta sa kalibutan ang nagapromote sang Black Lives Matter (BLM) movement.
english: It is known that many athletes in the world promote the Black Lives Matter (BLM) movement.

text: May kaangtanan diri, ginpahayag sang highest-paid female athlete nga nakahibalo siya nga madamo nga tawo ang nagalantaw sa tennis, gani ginagamit niya ini nga paagi agud mapakilala ang social justice kag mapahibalo ang istorya ni Taylor.
english: In this regard, the highest-paid female athlete said that she knows that many people watch tennis, so she is using this medium to promote social justice and raise awareness of Taylor’s story.

text: Suno pa kay Osaka, may pito pa siya ka face masks apang gin-una niya sa pagsuksok ang may ngalan ni Taylor bangud siya ang pinakaimportante subong nga labi nga kontrobersyal ang racism kag police shootings sa Estados Unidos.
english: Osaka said she has seven more face masks but she prioritized the one with Taylor's name on it because she is the most important one now that racism and police shootings are increasingly controversial in the United States.

text: Nagdangat sa 750 ka mga personnel ang ginpalapta sang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) sa Western Visayas agud magbulig sa pagbantay sang seguridad sa 2025 national and local elections.
english: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) has deployed 750 personnel in Western Visayas to help maintain security for the 2025 national and local elections.

text: Kahapon, Mayo 9, sang ginpatigayon ang send-off ceremony sa Zone II, Bo.
english: Yesterday, May 9, when the send-off ceremony was held in Zone II, Bo.

text: Obrero, Lapuz, Iloilo City kaupod sa stations, sub-stations, kag operational control units.
english: Obrero, Lapuz, Iloilo City along with stations, sub-stations, and operational control units.

text: Gin-deploy sila sa nagkalain-lain nga mga pantalan kag presinto sa Rehiyon VI.
english: They were deployed to various ports and precincts in Region VI.

text: Nagpanguna sa seremonya si CG Western Visayas Commander Commodore Philipps Soria.
english: The ceremony was presided over by CG Western Visayas Commander Commodore Philipps Soria.

text: Yara man sa event si Reverend Father Lieutenant Ronel O. Dizon PCG para sa paghatag sang blessing sa tanan nga CGDWV personnel para sa ila safety sa tion sang eleksyon.
english: Also present at the event was Reverend Father Lieutenant Ronel O. Dizon PCG to bless all CGDWV personnel for their safety during the election.

text: Nanindugan ang Commission on Elections-Ajuy nga wala pa sang kumpirmado nga insidente sang vote buying sa amo nga banwa.
english: The Commission on Elections-Ajuy insists that there is no confirmed incident of vote buying in the town.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ester R. Abisan, Election Officer III sang Comelec Ajuy, iya ginpahayag nga may nagkadto nga isa ka persona sa ila talatapan kahapon nga adlaw, Mayo 9, kag nagreport nga may ara sang vote-buying nga nagakatabo sa isa ka beach resort sa Barangay Malayuan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Ester R. Abisan, Election Officer III of Comelec Ajuy, said a person came to their office yesterday, May 9, and reported that there was vote-buying happening at a beach resort in Barangay Malayuan.

text: Gilayon man ini nga gin-aksyunan sang Comelec Ajuy, sa pagpanguna sang Philippine National Police, nga amo ang nagpadulong sa nasambit nga beach resort agud kumpirmahon ang nasambit nga report.
english: The Comelec Ajuy, led by the Philippine National Police, immediately took action, which went to the beach resort to confirm the report.

text: Apang wala ini sang may napakita nga ebidensiya kag wala man nagsiling kon sin-o nga kandidato ang nagapamakal sang boto.
english: But he did not show any evidence and did not say which candidate was buying votes.

text: Dugang pa sang opisina, kun may yara gid man sang reklamo, dapat nga pormal ini ukon isa ka written complaint, verified kag notarized.
english: The office added that if there is a complaint, it should be formal or a written complaint, verified and notarized.

text: Nagpahanumdom man si Abisan sa mga Ajuynon nga indi gid magbaton sang bisan ano nga kwarta bilang kabaylo sang ila boto, bangud kun madakpan, posible ang mga ini ang magapangatubang sang kaso.
english: Abisan also reminded the Ajuynon not to accept any money in exchange for their vote, because if caught, they may face charges.

text: (Article: Bombo Volunteer Renan Jay Salico)
english: (Article: Bombo Volunteer Renan Jay Salico)

text: Nasapwan-patay ang duha ka mga bata edad duha kag tatlo ka tuig sa sulod sang isa ka salakyan nga naka-park sa kilid sang dalan sa Barangay Malabanias, Angeles City, Pampanga.
english: Two children aged two and three were found dead inside a vehicle parked on the side of the road in Barangay Malabanias, Angeles City, Pampanga.

text: 1:50 kahapon sang hapon sang nakit-an ang mga bangkay kun sa diin sandig pa sa inisyal nga impormasyon, suffocation ang rason sang ila kamatayon.
english: The bodies were found around 1:50 pm yesterday. According to initial information, suffocation was the cause of their deaths.

text: Sa dugang nga impormasyon sang Angeles City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO), aga pa lang sang nag-umpisa sa pagpangita ang mga ginikanan sang mga biktima.
english: According to the Angeles City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO), the parents of the victims started searching early in the morning.

text: May yara sang ginpaguwa nga CCTV footage ang barangay nga 9:30 kaina sang aga, nakit-an pa nga buhi ang duha ka bata kag nagahampang sa lugar malapit man sa kun diin sila nasapwan.
english: The barangay released CCTV footage that at 9:30 this morning, the two children were found alive and playing in the area near where they were found.

text: Indi ila ang salakyan nga nahamtangan sang mga bangkay suno pa sa Angeles City CDRRMO, gani nalakip sa imbestigasyon kun paano nakasulod ang duha sa amo nga Toyota Vios.
english: The vehicle in which the bodies were located was not theirs, according to the Angeles City CDRRMO, so the investigation includes how the two got into the Toyota Vios.

text: Ginahulat pa ang mangin report sang PNP-SOCO kun ano gid ang rason sang kamatayon sang duha kag kun sin-o ang may salabton.
english: The report of the PNP-SOCO is still awaited on the cause of death of the two and who is responsible.

text: Nagpadala man sang mensahe sang simpatiya si Angeles City Mayor Carmelo “Pogi” Lazatin Jr.
english: Angeles City Mayor Carmelo “Pogi” Lazatin Jr. also sent a message of sympathy.

text: kag nagpasalig nga buligan sang local government unit ang pamilya sang mga biktima.#
english: and assured that the local government unit will assist the families of the victims.#

text: MANILA – Plano sang Philippine National Oil Company – Exploration Corp.
english: MANILA – The Philippine National Oil Company – Exploration Corp. plans to.

text: nga upisahan ang drilling sa area malapit sa Malampaya kasunod sang mandu ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte nga dulaon na ang moratorium sa oil exploration sa West Philippine Sea.
english: to resume drilling in the area near Malampaya following President Rodrigo Duterte's order to lift the moratorium on oil exploration in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Santo sa timeline works, ang oil production ang mahimo nga mag-umpisa sa late 2026 ukon early 2027.
english: According to the timeline works, oil production could start in late 2026 or early 2027.

text: Suno kay Philippine National Oil Company – Exploration Corp.
english: According to Philippine National Oil Company – Exploration Corp.

text: president Lt.
english: president Lt.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Rozzano Briguez, ang drilling ang paga-umpisahan sa masunod nga tuig.
english: Rozzano Briguez, the drilling will start next year.

text: Ginpahayag ni Briguez nga ginatutukan sa subong ang 2 ka service contracts nga SC 57 kag SC 59 kun sa diin ang nasambit nga proyekto ang patigayunon sa “disputed areas” kag isa naman sa Northwest Palawan.
english: Briguez said they are currently focusing on two service contracts, SC 57 and SC 59, where the project will be implemented in disputed areas and one in Northwest Palawan.

text: Pagkatapos nga ginmandu ni Presidente Duterte ang pagdula sang moratorium, gilayon nga gin-umpisahan sang state-owned Philippine National Oil Company ang proseso agud matigayon ang SC 57 kag SC 59 kag tinguhaan man nila nga matigayon ang duha pa ka service contracts nga SC 75 kag SC 58.
english: After President Duterte ordered the lifting of the moratorium, the state-owned Philippine National Oil Company immediately started the process to obtain SC 57 and SC 59 and will also try to obtain two other service contracts, SC 75 and SC 58.

text: Para naman kay Senator Sherwin Gatchalian nga chairman sang Senate Committee on Energy, ang projected 2026 production ang makabig nga “good news.”
english: For Senator Sherwin Gatchalian, chairman of the Senate Committee on Energy, the projected 2026 production is considered “good news.”

text: Ginmultahan sang $25,000 ukon P1.2 million sang National Basketball Association (NBA) sanday Oklahoma City Thunder guard Dennis Schroder kag Houston Rockets forward P.J. Tucker matapos nagtapungulay.
english: The National Basketball Association (NBA) fined Oklahoma City Thunder guard Dennis Schroder and Houston Rockets forward P.J. Tucker after a fight.

text: Natabo ang insidente sa nabilin nga 6 minutes 51 seconds sa third quarter sa diin nagdaog ang Rockets sa score nga 114-80.
english: The incident occurred with 6 minutes 51 seconds left in the third quarter where the Rockets won 114-80.

text: Ginpalapitan ni Schroder si Tucker sa diin duha sila ang natumba tubtob nga sila ang gintambagan sang iban nga mga players.
english: Schroder approached Tucker where both fell until they were advised by other players.

text: Una na nga nakaangkon sang flagrant foul 2 kag ginpahalin sa court si Shroder samtang si Tucker ang ginhatagan sang technical foul kag ginpahalin man sa court.
english: Earlier, Shroder had a flagrant foul 2 and was sent off while Tucker was given a technical foul and sent off.

text: MANILA – Ginalauman nga may pagsaka liwat sa presyo sang Diesel kag Kerosene samtang may rollback naman sa Gasolina sa Martes, Oktubre 20.
english: MANILA – Diesel and kerosene prices are expected to rise again while gasoline prices will rollback on Tuesday, October 20.

text: Santo sa forecast, ginabanta nga magalab-ot sa 15-20 centavos ang saka sa kada litro sang Kerosene samtang 20-30 centavos naman ang saka sa kada litro sang Diesel.
english: According to the forecast, the price of kerosene is expected to increase by 15-20 centavos per liter while diesel will increase by 20-30 centavos per litre.

text: Sa Gasolina, magalab-ot sa 30-40 centavos ang buhin sa kada litro.
english: For gasoline, the tax will be 30-40 centavos per liter.

text: Nahibalu-an nga ini na ang ika-duha nga semana nga may pagsaka sa presyo sang Diesel kag Kerosene.
english: This is the second week that the price of diesel and kerosene has increased.

text: Wala pa sang nabaton nga pormal nga reklamo ang San Joaquin Municipal Police Station kaangot sa ginaalegar nga natabo nga baklanay sang boto sa banwa.
english: The San Joaquin Municipal Police Station has not yet received a formal complaint regarding the alleged vote buying in the town.

text: Ini kasunod sang picture nga ginpadala sa Bombo Radyo kun sa diin may yara sang mini fan, may tumbler, kag listahan sang pangalan sang mga kandidato.
english: This follows a picture sent to Bombo Radyo where there is a mini fan, a tumbler, and a list of names of the candidates.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Christler John Ledesma, hepe sang San Joaquin Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga wala sang na-file nga blotter report ang sin-o man nga indibidwal ukon grupo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Christler John Ledesma, chief of the San Joaquin Municipal Police Station, said no blotter report was filed by any individual or group.

text: Apang suno kay Ledesma, may intelligence officer naman nga amo ang naga-imbestigar sa nagalapta nga mga laragway subong sa social media.
english: However, Ledesma said there is an intelligence officer who is investigating the pictures that are circulating on social media.

text: Gin-athag ni Ledesma nga bukas ang ila talatapan amo man ang Commission on Elections (Comelec) sa munisipalidad pananglitan may yara sang gusto mag-reklamo.
english: Ledesma explained that their office is open as well as the Commission on Elections (Comelec) in the municipality in case anyone wants to complain.

text: Nahibaluan nga santo sa Resolution 11104 sang Comelec Kontra Bigay Committee, partikular sa Section 24, nakaplastar nga ang vote-buying kag vote-selling amo ang akto sang paghatag, pagtanyag, kag pag-promisa sang anuman nga may balor kabaylo sang boto para sa kandidato.
english: It is known that according to Resolution 11104 of the Comelec Kontra Bigay Committee, particularly in Section 24, it is stipulated that vote-buying and vote-selling is the act of giving, offering, and promising anything of value in exchange for votes for a candidate.

text: Liwat nga nasiplatan sa Ayungin Shoal sa West Philippine Sea ang China Coast Guard (CCG) 5901 ukon ang “The Monster” nga amo ang pinakadako nga coast guard ship sa kalibutan.
english: China Coast Guard (CCG) 5901 or “The Monster” which is the largest coast guard ship in the world has been spotted again in Ayungin Shoal in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Ini suno sa maritime expert monitoring ship movements sa West Philippine Sea.
english: This is according to maritime expert monitoring ship movements in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Ginpahayag ni former US Air Force official kag former Defence Attaché Ray Powell nga ang CCG 5901 ang nag-upod sa CCG 5203 sa Ayungin Shoal kaina sang aga.
english: Former US Air Force official and former Defense Attaché Ray Powell said CCG 5901 joined CCG 5203 in Ayungin Shoal yesterday morning.

text: Matandaan nga sang Hunyo 24 sang ulihi nga nakit-an ang CCG 5901 sa Ayungin Shoal on June 24.
english: It can be recalled that on June 24, CCG 5901 was last seen in Ayungin Shoal on June 24.

text: Ang paglayag sini sa West Philippine Sea ang kasunod sang bayolente nga insidente sa shoal sang Hunyo 17 nga nag- involve sang Chinese kag Filipino personnel nga nagresulta pa sa pagkautod sang tudlo sang isa ka Filipino navy officer.
english: Its sailing in the West Philippine Sea follows a violent incident on the shoal on June 17 involving Chinese and Filipino personnel that resulted in the amputation of the finger of a Filipino navy officer.

text: Base on monitoring sang Philippine authorities, sa sulod sang 10 ka adlaw, ang Chinese vessel nag-agi sa 12 ka features sang West Philippine nga amo ang Parola Island, Pagasa Island, Zamora Reef, Bayani Bank, Union Bank, Kagitingan Reef, Rizal Reef, Panganiban Reef, Lawak Island, Patag Island, Escoda Shoal kag Bajo De Masinloc.
english: Based on monitoring by Philippine authorities, within 10 days, the Chinese vessel passed through 12 features of the West Philippines namely Parola Island, Pagasa Island, Zamora Reef, Bayani Bank, Union Bank, Kagitingan Reef, Rizal Reef, Panganiban Reef, Lawak Island, Patag Island, Escoda Shoal and Masinloc.

text: Magluwas sa sini nga mga area, ang higante nga barko ang nagpadulong man sa kadagatan nga sakop sang El Nido, Palawan kun sa diin 34 nautical miles ang distansya sini sa baybayon.
english: Aside from these areas, the giant ship also headed to the waters of El Nido, Palawan where it is 34 nautical miles from the coast.

text: Ang Chinese vessel ang ulihi nga namonitor nga yar sa 46 nautical miles southeast sang Sanya, Hainan sa China sang Hunyo 27.
english: The Chinese vessel was last monitored yar 46 nautical miles southeast of Sanya, Hainan in China on June 27.

text: MANILA – Aprobado na ang pagpanghatag sang cash gift ukon “13th month” sa mga pensioner sang Social Security System kag Government Service Insurance System sa Disyembre.
english: MANILA – The distribution of cash gift or “13th month” to pensioners of the Social Security System and Government Service Insurance System in December has been approved.

text: Ang sa SSS, kabaylo sang isa ka bulan nga pension ang mabaton sang benepisyaryo kag halos pareho man ang mabaton sang GSIS pensioners.
english: In the SSS, in exchange for one month's pension, the beneficiary receives almost the same as the GSIS pensioners.

text: Magluwas diri, mahimo nga indi anay makapadulong sa talatapan ang GSIS pensioners tubtub sa katapusan sang 2020 para sa yearly revalidation.
english: In addition, GSIS pensioners may not be able to visit the office until the end of 2020 for yearly revalidation.

text: Magalunsyar man sang pautang ang GSIS tubtub sa P500,000 para sa mga pensiyonado sa una nga quarater sang 2021.
english: The GSIS will also launch a loan of up to P500,000 for pensioners in the first quarter of 2021.

text: AUSTRALIA – Gindayaw sang Hall of Fame promoter nga si Bob Arum ang performance sang sparring partner ni 8-Division World Champion Manny Pacquiao nga si Tim Tszyu sang Australia.
english: AUSTRALIA – Hall of Fame promoter Bob Arum praised the performance of 8-Division World Champion Manny Pacquiao’s sparring partner Tim Tszyu of Australia.

text: Partikular nga gintumod ni Arum amo ang away ni Tszyu batok kay anay WBO world welterweight champion Jeff Horn sa Queensland Country Bank Stadium sa Townsville, Australia sang damlag lang.
english: Specifically, Arum referred to Tszyu’s fight against former WBO world welterweight champion Jeff Horn at the Queensland Country Bank Stadium in Townsville, Australia recently.

text: Suno kay Arum, terrific kag real goods ang iya panulukan kay Tszyu nga amo anay ang naga-uyat sang Australian light-middleweight title sang 2019.
english: Arum said he sees Tszyu, who held the Australian light-middleweight title in 2019, as terrific and real goods.

text: Ginpahayag ni Arum nga iya naka-istorya ang manager kag promoter kun sa diin luyag nila nga may isa pa ka fight ang Australian professional boxer antes matapos ang 2020.
english: Arum said he has spoken to the manager and promoter where they want the Australian professional boxer to have another fight before the end of 2020.

text: Ang 25-year-old unbeaten boxer nga naga-uyat sang record nga 16-0 with 12 knockouts ang anak ni retired world light welterweight champion Kostya Tszyu.
english: The 25-year-old unbeaten boxer who holds a record of 16-0 with 12 knockouts is the son of retired world light welterweight champion Kostya Tszyu.

text: Nahibalu-an nga si Tszyu ang nangin sparring partner ni Pacquiao sa away batok sa Amerikano nga si Keith Thurman.
english: Tszyu was Pacquiao's sparring partner in the fight against American Keith Thurman.

text: Ginbuyagyag ni former senator Cynthia Villar nga luyag na nga i-dispose sang iya bana nga si former Senate President Manny Villar ang ginapanag-iyahan nila nga PrimeWater, ang kontrobersiyal nga water service provider.
english: Former senator Cynthia Villar has revealed that her husband, former Senate President Manny Villar, wants to dispose of PrimeWater, the controversial water service provider.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagapangatubang ang PrimeWater sang madamo nga mga reklamo bangud sa palpak nga serbisyo sa masobra 100 areas kun sa diin may yara ini sang joint venture agreement (JVA) sa mga water districts.
english: PrimeWater is facing many complaints due to failed services in more than 100 areas where it has joint venture agreements (JVA) with water districts.

text: Suno kay Cynthia, ginagamit sang iban ang PrimeWater batok sa ila sa pulitika.
english: Cynthia said others are using PrimeWater against them politically.

text: Suno sa iya, wala sila nagaginansya diri.
english: He says they are not profiting here.

text: Pahayag niya, ang malawig ng interruptions kag mahigko nga tap water ang indi lang dapat ibasol sa ila bangud sa iban nga lugar, may mga isyu man sa suplay.
english: He said the long interruptions and dirty tap water should not be blamed on them because in other areas, there are also supply issues.

text: Ginhalimbawa niya ang water district sa San Jose del Monte sa Bulacan nga nag-angkon sang dako nga kapierdehan umpisa sang 2018 matapos nagsulod sa JVA upod sa PrimeWater bangud sa mga problema tuga sang mataas nga elevation.
english: He cited the example of the water district in San Jose del Monte in Bulacan which suffered huge losses since 2018 after entering into a JVA with PrimeWater due to problems caused by high elevation.

text: Dugang niya, indi tanan ang sala sang water service provider.
english: He added that it is not all the fault of the water service provider.

text: Ang PrimeWater isa ka subsidiary sang Prime Asset Ventures Inc., nga ginapanag-iyahan ni Manuel Paolo nga amo ang subang nga bata sang mag-asawa nga Cynthia kag Manny.
english: PrimeWater is a subsidiary of Prime Asset Ventures Inc., owned by Manuel Paolo who is the stepson of Cynthia and Manny.

text: Ginapabasura ni Vice President Sara Duterte sa Department of Justice ang reklamo nga ginpasaka sa iya sang National Bureau of Investigation.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte has asked the Department of Justice to dismiss the complaint filed against her by the National Bureau of Investigation.

text: May kaangtanan ini gihapon sa pagpamahog sini kay Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr., First Lady Liza Araneta Marcos kag House Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: It is still related to his threats against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., First Lady Liza Araneta Marcos and House Speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: Partikular nga gin-file sang NBI ang reklamo nga Sedition kag Grave Threats nga may kaangtanan sa Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2012.
english: Specifically, the NBI filed a complaint of Sedition and Grave Threats related to the Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2012.

text: Ang hingyo sini ang nasaad sa counter-affidavit sang bise presidente sa pag-atubang sini sa preliminary investigation sang DOJ sa iya nga reklamo kahapon.
english: His request was stated in the vice president's counter-affidavit when he faced the preliminary investigation of the DOJ into his complaint yesterday.

text: Nakasaad sa amo nga affidavit nga dapat lamang nga indi na pagdayunon pa ang hearing sa kaso kag ibasura na lamang ini.
english: The affidavit states that the hearing of the case should not be continued and it should be dismissed.

text: Kaangot diri, nagalaum ang kampo ni VP Sara nga mahatagan sang due process ang reklamo nga gin-file batok sa iya.
english: In this regard, VP Sara's camp hopes that the complaint filed against him will be given due process.

text: Sulod na ang pambato sang Pilipinas nga si Alex Eala sa semifinals sang Guadalajara 125 Open sa Mexico.
english: Philippine boxer Alex Eala is now in the semifinals of the Guadalajara 125 Open in Mexico.

text: Sini nga kaagahon oras diri sa Pilipinas, ginlutos sang 20-anyos nga tennis sensation si Nicole Fossa Huergo sang Italya, 7-6(2), 6-2, sa quarterfinals.
english: This morning time here in the Philippines, the 20-year-old tennis sensation defeated Nicole Fossa Huergo of Italy, 7-6(2), 6-2, in the quarterfinals.

text: Ginpatigayon ang sambuwa inoras lang matapos nagdaog si Eala batok sa American player nga si Varvara Lepchenko sa Round of 16.
english: The match was held just hours after Eala won against American player Varvara Lepchenko in the Round of 16.

text: Halos isa ka adlaw nga na-suspend ang amo nga match (sa deciding set) bangud sa ulan.
english: The match (in the deciding set) was suspended for almost a day due to rain.

text: Sa semifinals sa Sabado, atubangon ni Eala si Kayla Day sang Amerika.
english: In Saturday’s semifinals, Eala will face Kayla Day of the United States.

text: Antes sa iya hampang sa Mexico, nakapasakop ang Pinay tennis star sa main draw sang US Open kun sa diin nakalab-ot ini sa second round.#
english: Before her match in Mexico, the Filipina tennis star participated in the main draw of the US Open where she reached the second round.

text: KON madayon ang school opening sa Agosto 22 kag mapatuman na ang Face-to-Face nga klase, panugyan ta lang nga indi kita tani malipat sang mga dapat himuon agud ma-protejeran sing maayo ang aton mga kabataan sa ila  na pagbalik sa eskwelahan.
english: IF the school opening continues on August 22 and the Face-to-Face classes are implemented, we advise you not to forget the things you need to do to protect your children when they return to school.

text: By the way, ang masunod nga mga panugyan naton diri base man sa mga panugyan mismo sang mga health authorities sa ila advisory kag press releases.
english: By the way, the following recommendations are based on the recommendations of the health authorities themselves in their advisory and press releases.

text: Pero, kon indi magsantu ang ano man nga panugyan naton diri sa inyo nahibal-an halin sa inyo kaugalingon nga health sources, sa inyo na ina kon ano ang sundon ninyo.
english: However, if any of the advice we give here does not match what you know from your own health sources, it is up to you to decide what to do.

text: Dapat ugaling – kag dapat gid – kaugyon ini sa panugyan sang aton mismo Deparment of Health kag Inter-Agency Task Force (IATF) batok sa Covid-19, samtang nagapadayon ini sang pagpabakuna sang mga pumuluyo lakip na ang mga kabataan.
english: However, it must – and must – be in line with the advice of our own Department of Health and the Inter-Agency Task Force (IATF) against Covid-19, as it continues to vaccinate the public including children.

text:
***

Syempre, lakip man sa aton pagpahanumdum ang mga manunudlo, iban pa nga empleyado sa eskwelahan, mga ginikanan kag mga bantay sang mga kabataan, mga drayber nga magadala sa ila pakadto sa eskwelahan kag pauli, kag mga iban pa.
english:
***

Of course, our reminder also includes teachers, other school employees, parents and guardians of children, drivers who will take them to and from school, and others.

text: Sa panugyan mismo sang aton Department of Health, una na dira ang padayon  nga paggamit sang publiko sing DOH-recommended nga face mask.
english: On the advice of our Department of Health, first of all, the public should continue to wear DOH-recommended face masks.

text: Kinahanglan man ang pagpatuman sang isa tubtub duha ka metro nga distansya sa tunga sang mga tawo agud malikawan ang pagpanglaton sang mga mikrobyo sa malapitan, nga importante mapatuman gid sa mga klasehan.
english: It is also necessary to implement a one to two meter distance between people to prevent the spread of germs in close proximity, which is important to implement in classrooms.

text: Magpalayo man sa mga naga-ubo, nagapangatsi,  ukon nagasugilanon malapit sa inyo kay mayor ina nga kabangdanan sang pagpanglaton sang COVID-19 virus kag iban pa nga mga mikrobyo nga dala sang hangin.
english: Also stay away from those who are coughing, sneezing, or talking near you as they are a major cause of transmission of the COVID-19 virus and other airborne germs.

text: Obligahon man ang kaugalingon sa pagtalikud ukon tabunan ang baba sang panyo ukon tissue, ukon, wala na gid, sang siku kon kita man ang mag-ubo ukon mangatsi.
english: Also force yourself to turn away or cover your mouth with a handkerchief or tissue, or, no longer, with your elbow if you cough or sneeze.

text: Makapanglaton man ang mga mikrobyo nga makuha naton sa mga bagay nga makaptan naton kag madala sa aton ilong, baba kag mata kon diin makasulod ang mga mikrobyo, gani likawan ang pagtandug sang kamot sa ini nga bahin sang kalawasan.
english: Germs that we get from things we touch and bring into our nose, mouth and eyes where germs can enter are also contagious, so avoid touching this part of the body.

text: Maghugas sang kamot gamit ang limpyo nga tubig kag habon ukon sang sanitizer, katulad sang 70% alcohol, sa una nga kahigayunan nga makakapot kita sa mga bagay nga masami mateneran sang mikrobyo, katulad sang lilisuan sang ganhaan.
english: Wash hands with clean soap and water or a sanitizer, such as 70% alcohol, at the first opportunity to touch objects that are often infected with germs, such as doorknobs.

text: Indi pagdal-on ang sapatos ukon ismagol sa sulod sang balay kay ang higko sini posible may dala sing mikrobyo nga makuha sa duta nga madala naton sa sulod sang balay kag mahaklo sa pagpanglimpyo sa balay.
english: Do not bring shoes or bags inside the house because the dirt may carry germs from the soil that we can bring inside the house and breathe in when cleaning the house.

text: Sa pag-abot sa balay, maligo dayon kag ilikaw anay ang mga nasuob nga panapton sa iban nga panapton kag ugaling labhan ini sa tubig kag habon bag-o ihalay.
english: When you get home, take a shower immediately and keep the soiled clothes away from other clothes and then wash them with soap and water before hanging them.

text:
***

Kinahanglan man ready ang eskwelahan sa pagpatigayon sang mga health measures nga makapaseguro sang pagpangamlig sa mga kabataan, kag iban pa, batok sa COVID-19 virus kag iban pa nga mga mikrobyo.
english:
***

The school must also be ready to implement health measures that will ensure the protection of children, and others, against the COVID-19 virus and other germs.

text: Lakip na diri ang kinahanglan nga necessary test sa mga sintoma sang COVID-19 bag-o magsulod sa eskwelahan ang estudyante, mga ginikanan ukon bantay, mga manunudo kag iban pa nga masulod kag magtener sa eskwelahan.
english: This includes the required necessary test for symptoms of COVID-19 before entering the school for students, parents or guardians, teachers and others who enter and stay at the school.

text: Dapat may Nurse’s Room kon diin madala dayon kag matatap ang mga kabataan kag iban pa nga magapakita sang sintoma sang COVID-19 kag kon ano man nga kabangdanan.
english: There should be a Nurse's Room where children and others who show symptoms of COVID-19 and any other cause can be immediately taken and cared for.

text: Dapat man may easily accessible nga handwash facility ukon sanitizer kag na-sanitize nga lalapakan sa pagsulod sang eskwelahan kag mga klasehan.
english: There should also be an easily accessible handwash facility or sanitizer and sanitized footprints at the entrance of schools and classrooms.

text: Kinahanglan may mga posted signs man sa immediate premises sang eskwelahan nga nagapahanumdum kon ano ang dapat ukon indi himuon.
english: There should also be posted signs in the immediate premises of the school reminding what should or should not be done.

text:
***

Sa salakyan, dapat tanan nga kabataan naka-mask, nakapungko nga may “sneezing/cough guard” sa bal-ot nila.
english:
***

In the vehicle, all children must be masked, seated with a sneezing/cough guard on their lap.

text: Ang drayber mismo may face mask kag may available nga sanitizer sa salakyan.
english: The driver himself has a face mask and sanitizer is available in the vehicle.

text: Ang salakyan dapat bukas ang salandigan sa kilid kag, kon mag-ulan, mabinlan sang bastante ka daku nga giha para maagyan sang hangin.
english: The vehicle should have an open side seat and, in the event of rain, leave a large enough gap for air to pass through.

text: Para ini sa pagpaseguro nga maka-circular pagwa ang hangin kag indi magtener sa sulod.
english: This is to ensure that the air can circulate out and not stay inside.

text: May paagi man sa pagbayad pasahe nga wala sabad.
english: There is also a way to pay for fares without fuss.

text: Maglikaw man sa indi kinahanglan nga pagsugilanon, kag kon ano pa nga indi bagay himuon.
english: Also avoid unnecessary conversation, and anything else that is not appropriate to do.

text: Dapat naga-obserbar gid sing good hygiene ang salakyan agud mapaseguro ang pagka-limpyo sini.
english: The vehicle should observe good hygiene to ensure its cleanliness.

text: Amlig gid mga boys and girls, ma’am and sir, kag ang tanan para sa mabungahon nga “New Normal” na sa eskwelahan!/PN
english: Stay safe boys and girls, ma’am and sir, and everything for a fruitful “New Normal” in school!/PN

text: Gin-delete sang tech executive ang iya LinkedIn page matapos makit-an siya nga may kaupod nga babaye nga indi man niya asawa sa concert sang Coldplay sa Boston.
english: The tech executive deleted his LinkedIn page after he was seen with a woman who was not his wife at a Coldplay concert in Boston.

text: Suno sa mga netizens kag mga report, nakilala ang lalaki nga si Andy Byron, chief executive sang software firm nga Astronomer samtang ang babaye naman amo si Kristin Cabot, ang human resources head sang kompaniya.
english: According to netizens and reports, the man was identified as Andy Byron, chief executive of the software firm Astronomer while the woman was identified as Kristin Cabot, the company's human resources head.

text: Sa video nga nagalapta subong online, makit-an nga nagahaksanay ang duha sa Foxboro’s Gillete Stadium .
english: In a video now circulating online, the two can be seen hugging at Foxboro's Gillete Stadium .

text: Sang na-realize sang duha nga nakita sila sa big screen, gilayon nga nagpanago ang lalaki samtang nagtalikod naman sa camera ang babaye.
english: When the two realized they were seen on the big screen, the man immediately hid while the woman turned away from the camera.

text: Sa subong, wala pa nakapaguwa sang statement sanday Byron kag Cabot nahanungod sa insidente.
english: As of now, Byron and Cabot have not released a statement regarding the incident.

text: Nagpatukod ang Department of Agriculture (DA) sang Interim Social and Environmental Safeguards (SES) Unit agud masiguro ang transparent kag responsable nga pagpatuman sang ila mga infrastructure projects.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) has established an Interim Social and Environmental Safeguards (SES) Unit to ensure the transparent and responsible implementation of its infrastructure projects.

text: Suno kay DA Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel, Jr., importante ang tikang nga ini ilabi sa pagsaylo sang farm-to-market road (FMR) projects halin sa Department of Public Works and Highways umpisa 2026, kag bilang sabat sa flood control scandal.
english: DA Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel, Jr., said the move is important especially with the transfer of farm-to-market road (FMR) projects from the Department of Public Works and Highways starting 2026, and in response to the flood control scandal.

text: Nahibaluan nga masobra sa 60,000 km sang kabug-usan nga 131,000 km sang FMR network ang wala pa napatindog.
english: It is known that more than 60,000 km of the total 131,000 km of the FMR network remains unconstructed.

text: Magluwas sa FMRs, tinutuyo man sang DA nga palaparon ang agriculture infrastructure projects pinaagi sa food hubs, cold storage, kag rice mills.
english: Aside from FMRs, the DA also aims to expand agriculture infrastructure projects through food hubs, cold storage, and rice mills.

text: Ginpunto man sang SES Unit ang pagsunod sa mga national regulation sang gobyerno amo man ang guideline sang mga development partner, kag siguruhon may proteksyon man sa palibot kag kumunidad ang kadad proyekto.
english: The SES Unit also pointed out the compliance with the national regulations of the government as well as the guidelines of the development partners, and ensure that each project has environmental and community protection.

text: May tawo na bala nga nakatampuyong sa imo?
english: Has anyone ever touched you?

text: Masakit nga matampa ilabi na kun wala ka man sang sala… apang nakahibalo ka bala nga may mga tawo nga nagabayad para lang nga matampuyong sila bisan sa atubang sang publiko?
english: It hurts to be slapped especially when you are innocent... but did you know that there are people who pay just to be slapped even in public?

text: Popular ini nga slap service sa isa ka ilimnan sa Japan nga ginatawag nga Yotteba.
english: This slap service is popular at a bar in Japan called Yotteba.

text: Kilala ang Yotteba sa ila manamit nga chicken wings kag barato nga beer, apang ang rason kun ngaa mas unique ang ila establisyemento amo ang espesyal nga serbisyo sa mga hubog nga customer.
english: Yotteba is known for its delicious chicken wings and cheap beer, but the reason why their establishment is more unique is the special service to drunk customers.

text: Halin sang ginbuksan ini duha ka tuig na ang nagligad, ginpakilala nila ang serbisyo nga kilala sa locals bilang “binta” kun sa diin tampuyungon sang waitress ang customer para nga mamaras-masan sa kahulugbon antes sila magpauli.
english: Since opening two years ago, they have introduced the service known locally as “binta” where the waitress will accompany the customer to drink before they go home.

text: Nagabayad ang customer sang P191 kag nagadugang pa sang P38 kun may specific staff member sila nga amo ang gusto nila ang magtampa sa ila.
english: The customer pays P191 and adds P38 if they have a specific staff member who they want to slap them.

text: Apang ini nga restaurant ang nagdesisyon nga untaton ini nga service sang damlag lang matapos nakabaton sang complaint halin sa isa ka customer nga ginaalegar nakaangkon sang injury bangud sa pagtampa sa iya duha ka bulan na ang nagligad.
english: However, this restaurant decided to stop this service recently after receiving a complaint from a customer who allegedly sustained an injury due to slapping him two months ago.

text: Suno pa sa marketing official, daw lahog-lahog lang man kuntani nila ini apang nangin popular na, apang bangud may epekto naman ini sa ila nga reputasyon, nag-desisyon sila nga indi na ini paghimuon.
english: According to the marketing official, they were supposed to do it as a joke but it became popular, but because it had an impact on their reputation, they decided not to do it.

text: Nagadaku naman abi ang ila nga chain kag gusto sang management nga maayo ang ila nga imahe sa mga customer.
english: Their chain is growing and the management wants to have a good image among customers.

text: Nahibaluan nga magluwas sa Yotteba, may isa man ka ilimnan nga ginatawag nga Shachihoko-ya nga nagtanyag man sang kaangay nga serbisyo halin sang 2012 apang gin-untat sang COVID-19 pandemic kag wala na gintanyag liwat halin sang amo nga tion.
english: It is known that besides Yotteba, there is also a bar called Shachihoko-ya which also offered a similar service since 2012 but was discontinued by the COVID-19 pandemic and has not been offered again since that time.

text: Ginahikayat sang Ilongga maritime leader nga si Christel Marie Layson ang mga kababainhan nga magkuha sang career sa port kag maritime industry.
english: Ilongga maritime leader Christel Marie Layson encourages women to pursue careers in the port and maritime industry.

text: Ini bangod indi lamang ini para sa kaugalingon kundi bulig man sa pungsod kag sa global economy.
english: This is because it is not only self-serving but also a help to the country and the global economy.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Layson, iya ginpahayag nga kon magsulod ang kababaihan sa amo nga industriya, wala lang sang mga ini ginapauswag ang ila kaugalingon kundi ginabuligan man nila ang ila komunidad kag ang ekonomiya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Layson said that when women enter the industry, they not only improve themselves but also help their community and the economy.

text: Si Layson ang presidente sang Women in Maritime Philippines, isa ka organisasyon nga nagapromote kag nagasuporta sa kababainhan sa maritime sector.
english: Layson is the president of Women in Maritime Philippines, an organization that promotes and supports women in the maritime sector.

text: Dugang pa sini, ginhingadlan man siya nga Miss Iloilo Paraw Regatta – Reyna ng Aliwan 2016 kag nagrepresentar sang Iloilo sa national pageant stage.
english: In addition, she was also named Miss Iloilo Paraw Regatta – Reyna ng Aliwan 2016 and represented Iloilo on the national pageant stage.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga importante nga may ara sang disiplina, determinasyon, kag pagpati sa kaugalingon ang isa ka babayi agud malab-ot ang iya handom kag mangin inspirasyon sa iban pa gid nga kababainhan.
english: She said it is important for a woman to have discipline, determination, and self-belief to achieve her dreams and be an inspiration to other women.

text: Nagpakig-angot na ang Commission on Elections-Mina, Iloilo sa Task Force Katotohanan, Katapatan at Katarungan (KKK) sang poll body sa possble tikang batuk sa job hire sang Local Government Unit sang banwa nga assigned sa ila opisina bangud sa pagpost sang video online kadungan sang Byernes Santo, Abril 18, 2025.
english: The Commission on Elections-Mina, Iloilo has contacted the Task Force Truth, Justice and Justice (KKK) of the poll body for possible action against the job hire of the Local Government Unit of the town assigned to their office for posting a video online during Good Friday, April 18, 2025.

text: Sa video makit-an si Mina Mayor Lydia Grabato kag officer sang Comelec sa diin ginakwestyun sang alkalde ang operation sang Oplan Baklas nga natabo sang Abril 4.
english: The video shows Mina Mayor Lydia Grabato and Comelec officers where the mayor questions the operation of Oplan Baklas that took place on April 4.

text: Sa statement nga ginpaguwa sang Comelec-Mina, nasaad nga ang video nakuha sang Abril 4 pagkatapos lang sang official operation sang Task Force Baklas sa diin ang mga ginadumilian nga campaign materials sang local kag national candidates ang ginpangkakas kag ginkumpiska.
english: In a statement issued by the Comelec-Mina, it was said that the video was taken on April 4 just after the official operation of Task Force Baklas where the prohibited campaign materials of local and national candidates were dismantled and confiscated.

text: Nagpadulong sa Comelec-Mina si Mayor Grabato on behalf sang iya political party kag ginkwestyun ang ginpatigayon nga baklas operation sa diin iya ginpabutyag ang iya disapproval kag criticism, ilabi na sa designation sang common poster areas.
english: Mayor Grabato went to the Comelec-Mina on behalf of his political party and questioned the conducted baklas operation where he expressed his disapproval and criticism, especially in the designation of common poster areas.

text: Suno sa Comelec-Mina, bilang public servants, bukas sila sa tanan nga sahi sang reklamo kag kritisismo halin sa stakeholders.
english: According to the Comelec-Mina, as public servants, they are open to all kinds of complaints and criticism from stakeholders.

text: Nakahatag naman sang proactive measures ang opisina agud nga ma-address ang reklamo sang alkalde may kaangtanan sa designation sang common poster areas kag ginsabat naman sang Comelec-Mina ang mga palamangkutanon kag concerns halin sa supporters sang iban nga local candidates tuhoy sa baklas operation sang Abril 4 — antes pa man ini gin-post ang video clip online.
english: The office took proactive measures to address the mayor's complaint regarding the designation of common poster areas and the Comelec-Mina responded to questions and concerns from supporters of other local candidates regarding the April 4 baklas operation — even before the video clip was posted online.

text: Dugang pa sang Comelec-Mina, ang video clip nga gin-upload ang ginakabig nga sahi sang digital information campaign ilabi na nga gin-post pa gid ini sang Good Friday sa diin ginadumilian ang pagpangampanya.
english: The Comelec-Mina added that the video clip uploaded is considered a kind of digital information campaign especially since it was posted on Good Friday where campaigning is prohibited.

text: Posible pahayag sang opisina nga ginlapas sang video uploader ang Comelec Resolution No.
english: The office said it is possible that the video uploader violated Comelec Resolution No.

text:
11064 ukon “Guidelines On The Use Of Social Media, Artificial Intelligence, And Internet Technology, For Digital Election Campaign, And The Prohibition And Punishment Of Its Misuse For Disinformation, And Misinformation, In Connection With The 2025 National And Local Elections And The Barmm Parliamentary Elections.”

Ginkumpirma man sang Comelec-Mina nga job hire sang LGU nga assigned sa ila opisina ang nag-video kag ginpost nga wala man lang nakahibalo ang talatapan.
english:
11064 or “Guidelines On The Use Of Social Media, Artificial Intelligence, And Internet Technology, For Digital Election Campaign, And The Prohibition And Punishment Of Its Misuse For Disinformation, And Misinformation, In Connection With The 2025 National And Local Elections And The Bar Elections.”

The Comelec-Mina also confirmed that a job hire of the LGU assigned to their office posted the video without the office's knowledge.

text: Samtang ginapabilin sang Comelec-Mina nga wala sang employer-employee relationship sa tunga sang commission kag sa staff, ang opisina ang naghimo na sang precautionary measure kag padayon nga gina-imbestigaran ang insidente.
english: While the Comelec-Mina maintains that there is no employer-employee relationship between the commission and the staff, the office has already taken precautionary measures and is continuing to investigate the incident.

text: Ginkansela sang Badminton World Federation ang ila mga tournaments sa Asya bangud sa COVID-19 pandemic.
english: The Badminton World Federation has canceled its tournaments in Asia due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Pila sa mga tournaments nga ini ang ginalakipn sang New Zealand, China, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia kag Thailand.
english: Some of these tournaments include New Zealand, China, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand.

text: Lakip man diri ang Thomas and Uber Cup nga ginakabig dako nga event.
english: This includes the Thomas and Uber Cup which is considered a big event.

text: Nagpasalig man si Badminton World Federation secretary-general Thomas Lund nga kaayuhon niya ang panibag-o nga petsa sa mga nakansela nga tournaments.
english: Badminton World Federation secretary-general Thomas Lund also assured that he will fix the new date for the canceled tournaments.

text: MANILA – Ginahingyo sang Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry sa property firms nga magtanyag sang rent relief sa small, medium and micro enterprises (MSMEs) bangud sa COVID-19 pandemic.
english: MANILA – The Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry is urging property firms to offer rent relief to small, medium and micro enterprises (MSMEs) due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Suno sa Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry, ang MSMEs nga nagabug-os sa 99 percent sang negosyo kag 66 percent sang total employment, amo ang lubos nga naapektuhan.
english: According to the Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry, MSMEs, which account for 99 percent of businesses and 66 percent of total employment, were the most affected.

text: Ginpahayag ni PCCI president Benedicto Yujuico nga kalabanan sa magagmay nga negosyo ang nagsirado matapos namiyerdihan bangud sa low consumer confidence.
english: PCCI president Benedicto Yujuico said most of the small businesses closed down after suffering losses due to low consumer confidence.

text: Bangud sini, ginapanugyanan ang management sang malls kag commercial buildings nga magpangita sang paagi agud nga indi magsirado ang ila mga tenant.
english: Because of this, the management of malls and commercial buildings is advised to find ways to keep their tenants from closing.

text: Pinabulaanan ng Philippine Constitution Association (PilConsa) na mayroong katotohanan ang kumalat na dokumento o kanilang umano’y opisyal na pahayag hinggil sa isyu ng Impeachment.
english: The Philippine Constitution Association (PilConsa) has denied that there is any truth in the leaked document or their alleged official statement on the issue of impeachment.

text: Kung saan itinuring nila itong peke o gawagawa lamang matapos lumabas sa publiko kaugnay sa kanilang posisyon sa naganap na deklarasyon ng Korte Suprema nitong nakaraan.
english: Where they considered it fake or fabricated after appearing in public regarding their position in the declaration of the Supreme Court in the past.

text: Ayon sa pahayag ni retired Chief Justice at Philconsa Chair Reynato Puno, kanyang sinabi na pag-uusapan pa lamang nila ang magiging posisyon ng samahan ukol sa naturang isyu.
english: According to retired Chief Justice and Philconsa Chair Reynato Puno, he said they are still discussing the position of the association on the issue.

text: Ang peke kasing dokumento na kumalat online ay nagsasabing nababahala umano ang Philconsa sa naging ruling ng Supreme Court.
english: The fake document that circulated online says that Philconsa is concerned about the Supreme Court's ruling.

text: Nakasaad rin sa umano’y pekeng opisyal na pahayag ang paniniwalang lumagpas sa limitasyon, at ginambala ng Korte Suprema ang ‘separation of powers’ at ‘constitutional boundaries’ na nakapanghihina raw sa otoridad ng Kongreso na mapanagot ang mga tiwaling opisyal.
english: The allegedly fake official statement also contained a belief that went beyond the limits, and the Supreme Court challenged the separation of powers and constitutional boundaries that allegedly weakened the authority of Congress to hold corrupt officials accountable.

text: Kaya’t ng umabot ang kumalat na dokumentong ito sa Philconsa, agaran nila itong itinangging may katotohanan.
english: So when this leaked document reached Philconsa, they immediately denied it with the truth.

text: Bunsod nito’y kanilang pinayuhan ang publiko at maging ang mga miyembro ng media na iberipika muna ang impormasyon at sumangguni lamang sa opisyal nilang tanggapan.
english: They advised the public and even members of the media to verify the information and contact their official office.

text: MANILA – Nagapadayon ang kampanya sang rice farmer groups agud makatipon sang 1 million nga pirma agud ibasura ang Rice Tariffication Law nga amo ang ginatudlo sang pagpamigado sang local farmers.
english: MANILA – Rice farmer groups continue their campaign to collect 1 million signatures to repeal the Rice Tariffication Law which is said to be impoverishing local farmers.

text: Suno kay Cathy Estavillo sang local rice policy advocacy group nga “Bantay Bigas”, madamo nga rice farmers sa subong ang nalumos sa utang bangud sa tuman ka barato nga farmgate prices sang palay.
english: According to Cathy Estavillo of the local rice policy advocacy group “Bantay Bigas”, many rice farmers are currently drowning in debt due to the very cheap farmgate prices of rice.

text: Ginpahayag ni Estavillo nga santo sa ila pagtuon, kun P17 ang per kilo, magalab-ot lamang sa P133 kada adlaw ang kita sang rice farmers.
english: Estavillo said that according to their study, if the price is P17 per kilo, the income of rice farmers will only reach P133 per day.

text: Apisar sini, ang retail price sang bugas ang nagapabilin sa mataas nga presyo bangud nga indi available ang P27 per kilo kag ang P32 per kilo nga rice variants nga ginabaligya sang National Food Authority antes ginpatuman ang nasambit nga layi.
english: Despite this, the retail price of rice remains high because the P27 per kilo and P32 per kilo rice variants sold by the National Food Authority before the implementation of the law were not available.

text: Bangud sini, ginpahayag ni Danilo Ramos, presidente sang Kilusang Magbubikid ng Pilipinas, nga nagakadapat na nga dulaon ang Rice Tariffication Law.
english: Because of this, Danilo Ramos, president of the Kilusang Magbubikid ng Pilipinas, said that the Rice Tariffication Law should be abolished.

text: Magluwas diri, ginapanawagan man sang grupo nga baklon sang National Food Authority ang local rice sa presyo nga indi magnubo sa P20 per kilo kag ibaligya sa merkado sa barato nga presyo.
english: In addition, the group also called on the National Food Authority to buy local rice at a price of not less than P20 per kilo and sell it in the market at a cheap price.

text: Nakumspiskar ang isa ka armas kag P1.4-million nga balor sang iligal nga droga sa duha ka mga gina-alegar durugista kadungan sang bisperas sang kapistahan sa Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: A firearm and P1.4-million worth of illegal drugs were confiscated from two suspected drug pushers on the eve of the fiesta in Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Sa drug buy bust nga ginpangunahan sang City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU) sa Barangay Tabuc Suba sa amo nga distrito, nadakpan sanday alias Ruben sang Barangay Tacas kag alias John Philip sang Barangay Tabuc Suba.
english: In a drug buy bust led by the City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU) in Barangay Tabuc Suba in the same district, alias Ruben of Barangay Tacas and alias John Philip of Barangay Tabuc Suba were arrested.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Police Lt.

text: Col.
english: Col.

text: Antonio Benitez Jr, head sang CDEU, iya ginpahayag nga nakuhaan ang duha sang 13 ka magagmay nga sachets sang ginapatihan shabu kag duha ka knot-tied sachets nga ginabanta nagabug-at sang 208 gramos, kag may yara man sang 38 caliber revolver.
english: Antonio Benitez Jr., head of the CDEU, said the two were recovered with 13 small sachets of suspected shabu and two knot-tied sachets weighing 208 grams, as well as a 38 caliber revolver.

text: I-distribute kuntani ang droga sa distrito sang Jaro suno kay Benitez apang natigayon nga mapunggan sang otoridad.
english: Benitez said the drugs were supposed to be distributed in Jaro district but were stopped by the authorities.

text: Duha ka semana ang monitoring antes ginpatigayon ang operasyon sang mga pulis.
english: The monitoring lasted for two weeks before the police operation was conducted.

text: Sandig sa inisyal nga impormasyon, may daan na nga kaso si alias Ruben nga kaangot man sa paghupot sang iligal nga droga kag explosives sang 2017 apang nakatigayon ini nga makaguwa sa presuhan.
english: According to initial information, alias Ruben has a previous case related to the possession of illegal drugs and explosives in 2017 but he managed to get out of jail.

text: May na-mensyonar na nga source ang duha suno kay Benitez apang iga-check pa sang kapulisan.
english: Benitez said the two have already mentioned a source but the police will check.

text: Nakilala na sang Special Investigation Task Group “Dayang” ang gunman sa pagpatay sa 89-anyos nga beterano nga journalist nga si Juan “Johnny” Dayang.
english: The Special Investigation Task Group “Dayang” has identified the gunman in the killing of 89-year-old veteran journalist Juan “Johnny” Dayang.

text: Si Dayang ang ginluthang-patay sang tatlo ka beses samtang yara ini sa sulod sang ila balay sang gab-i sang Abril 29, 2025.
english: Dayang was shot three times while inside her house on the night of April 29, 2025.

text: Ang suspek amo si Kim Wency Bayang Antonio, alyas BB Boy, 39, anay gwardiya kag residente sang Bacoor, Cavite apang tumandok sang Balugo, Valencia, Negros Oriental.
english: The suspect was identified as Kim Wency Bayang Antonio, alias BB Boy, 39, former guard and resident of Bacoor, Cavite but native of Balugo, Valencia, Negros Oriental.

text: Pinaagi sa backtracking, natumod ang identity sang suspek matapos nga mausoy ang lodging house nga gina-alegar nga gintiniran sini sa Kalibo humalin sang Abril 3.
english: Through backtracking, the identity of the suspect was identified after the lodging house where he allegedly stayed in Kalibo since April 3 was searched.

text: Ginpahayag nga nag-arkila man ini sang nagkalain-lain nga motorsiklo nga gin-gamit sa pag-surveillance sa balay ni Dayang sa Villa Salvacion, Brgy.
english: He also reportedly rented various motorcycles used for surveillance at Dayang's house in Villa Salvacion, Brgy.

text: Andagao, Kalibo.
english: Andagao, Kalibo.

text: Nakumpirma man nga nadakpan na ini sadto sa drug buy-bust operation sa Pasig City sang 2021.
english: It was also confirmed that he was previously arrested in a drug buy-bust operation in Pasig City in 2021.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagtanyag na sang P500,000 nga reward money ang Aklan provincial government kag LGU-Kalibo para sa sin-o man nga makahatag sang impormasyon sa kapulisan para nga madakpan ang suspek.
english: The Aklan provincial government and LGU-Kalibo have already offered a P500,000 reward money for anyone who can provide information to the police to arrest the suspect.

text: Nagdepensa ang Malacañang kun ngaa wala nalawagan ang online gambling sa 4th State of the Nation Address ukon SONA ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: Malacañang defended why online gambling was not mentioned in President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.'s 4th State of the Nation Address or SONA.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Claire Castro, indi mahimo nga padalian ang desisyon sang presidente bangud kinahanglan pa ang ma-id-id nga pagtuon sa mangin resulta sini.
english: Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said the president's decision cannot be rushed because a thorough study of the consequences is still needed.

text: Kinahanglan anay suno kay Castro nga matumod kun nagadamo bala ang iligal nga aktibidad sa lisensyado ukon sa indi lisensyado nga online gambling sites.
english: Castro said it is necessary to determine whether illegal activities are increasing in licensed or unlicensed online gambling sites.

text: Ginhalimbawa pa sini ang isa ka kongresista nga nadakpan nga nagalantaw sang e-sabong sa iya cellphone samtang naga-sesyon sa Kamara, apisar nga iligal naman ang e-sabong sa Pilipinas.
english: He cited the example of a congressman who was caught watching e-sabong on his cellphone while in session in the House, despite the fact that e-sabong is illegal in the Philippines.

text: Antes pa man ang SONA, may mga mamalidha na nga nagapanawagan sang total ban sa online gambling bangud mas dako ang epekto sini ipaanggid sa kita nga mahatag sa gobyerno.
english: Even before the SONA, some lawmakers were already calling for a total ban on online gambling because it has a greater impact than the revenue it brings to the government.

text: Nagbalik na sa training ang Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) teams matapos ang kapin anum ka bulan nga pahuway sang liga bangud sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: The Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) teams have returned to training after more than six months of league break due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Suno kay PBA commissioner Willie Marcial, una gid nga nag-umpisa ang Barangay Ginebra sang ila paghanas kahapon nga adlaw kag ginalauman nga adlaw-adlaw na ini nga matabo.
english: According to PBA commissioner Willie Marcial, Barangay Ginebra first started their training yesterday and it is expected that it will happen every day.

text: Matandaan nga gin-untat ang practice sang mga team sang tinalikdan nga Marso; kag sang Hulyo, nakabaton sang go-signal ang PBA gikan sa gobyerno nga mahimo na i-resume ang small-group training sessions.
english: It can be recalled that the teams' practice was suspended last March; and in July, the PBA received a go-signal from the government that small-group training sessions could resume.

text: Apisar sini, may delay man sa gihapon nga natabo bangud ginpaidalom sa modified enhanced community quarantine ang Metro Manila kag ang kaiping nga mga probinsya.
english: However, there was still a delay because Metro Manila and neighboring provinces were placed under modified enhanced community quarantine.

text: Subong nga nakabalik na sa gym ang mga players, nagpasalig si Marcial nga sundon sang mga team ang istrikto nga health and safety protocols kag may yara man sang igapasa nga daily report agud mahibaluan kun sa diin sila nagapadulong kag kun sin-o ang ila naka-close contact.
english: Now that the players have returned to the gym, Marcial assured that the teams will follow strict health and safety protocols and will also submit a daily report to know where they are going and who they have been in close contact with.

text: May yara man sang patigayunon nga surprise inspections ang Office of the Commissioner agud masigurado nga wala sang may nagalapas sa protocol.
english: The Office of the Commissioner will also conduct surprise inspections to ensure that no one violates the protocol.

text: Nasiplatan ang isa ka Chinese aircraft carrier sa nakatundan nga bahin sang Luzon.
english: A Chinese aircraft carrier was spotted in western Luzon.

text: Suno sa report sang English-language Chinese newspaper nga Global Times, ang aircraft carrier sang People’s Liberation Army-Navy nga Shandong ang nag-abot 200 nautical miles ang kalayuon halin sa Luzon.
english: According to a report by the English-language Chinese newspaper Global Times, the People’s Liberation Army-Navy aircraft carrier Shandong arrived 200 nautical miles away from Luzon.

text: Ang Shandong amo ang ginapahayag nga most advanced aircraft carrier nga ginagamit sang China.
english: Shandong is said to be the most advanced aircraft carrier used by China.

text: Suno sa satellite image nga gin-provide sang MizarVision nga isa ka Shanghai-based technology kag intelligence company, nakit-an ini nga nagalayag pa-naaminhan-nakatundan ang Luzon sa West Philippine Sea.
english: According to satellite images provided by MizarVision, a Shanghai-based technology and intelligence company, it was seen sailing northwest of Luzon in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Mangin ang European satellite nga Sentinel-1 ang naka-detect man sa amo nga aircraft carrier nga nagapatrolya sa West Philippine Sea.
english: Even the European satellite Sentinel-1 also detected the aircraft carrier patrolling the West Philippine Sea.

text: Kun basehan ang Sentinel-2, may nagbiya nga aircraft carrier sang nagligad nga semana sa Sanya, Hainan province nga amo ang homeport sang Shandong carrier.
english: Based on Sentinel-2, an aircraft carrier left last week in Sanya, Hainan province which is the homeport of the Shandong carrier.

text: Wala pa sang kumpirmasyon halin sa Chinese kag Philippine Defense departments kaangot sini.
english: There is no confirmation from the Chinese and Philippine Defense departments.

text: Suno naman kay West Philippine Sea monitor Ray Powell nga isa man ka former officer sang US Air Force, mabudlay tumuron kun sa diin gid ang exact location sang sini nga aircraft carrier nga na-commission lamang sang 2019.
english: West Philippine Sea monitor Ray Powell, a former US Air Force officer, said it is difficult to pinpoint the exact location of the aircraft carrier, which was commissioned in 2019.

text: Ginatudlo nga rason amo ang automatic identification system (AIS) sang carrier nga ginpatay rason nga indi gilayon ma-detect.
english: The reason is believed to be the carrier's automatic identification system (AIS) that was turned off and could not be immediately detected.

text: Kun basehan ang reports sang Global Times, ang Shandong — nga isa sa duha ka aircraft carriers sa idalom sang fleet sang People’s Liberation Army-Navy — ang posible nga naga-layag bangud sa scheduled exercise bilang prepasyon sa potential voyage sini sa West Pacific Ocean.
english: Based on reports by the Global Times, the Shandong — which is one of two aircraft carriers under the fleet of the People's Liberation Army-Navy — is likely to be sailing due to a scheduled exercise in preparation for its potential voyage in the West Pacific Ocean.

text: Matandaan nga antes ini nga aircraft carrier sang China, nakit-an man sang Hunyo 17-Hunyo 27 ang pinakadaku nga barko sang China Coast Guard ukon ang monster ship nga nagalayag man sa exclusive economic zones sang Pilipinas, Malaysia kag Brunei.
