english: Before this Chinese aircraft carrier, the largest ship of the Chinese Coast Guard or the monster ship that also sails in the exclusive economic zones of the Philippines, Malaysia and Brunei was also spotted on June 17-June 27.

text: MANILA – Lauman ang pagsaka sa presyo sang diesel kag kerosene samtang may rollback naman sa gasolina sa Oktubre 13, Martes.
english: MANILA – The price of diesel and kerosene is expected to rise while there will be a rollback in gasoline on October 13, Tuesday.

text:
Santo sa forecast sang mga kompaniya sang langis:

• Kerosene – 50-60 centavos ang saka sa kada litro• Diesel – 40-50 centavos ang saka sa kada litro• Gasolina – 10-20 centavos ang buhin sa kada litro

May kaangtanan diri, wala pa nabaton sang Department of Energy ang desisyon sang Court of Appeals nga nagapabor sa pagbuhin sa presyo sang gatong.
english:
According to the forecast of the oil companies:

• Kerosene – 50-60 centavos increase per litre• Diesel – 40-50 centavos increase per litre• Petrol – 10-20 centavos reduction per liter

In this regard, the Department of Energy is yet to receive the decision of the Court of Appeals in favor of the fuel price reduction.

text: Plano sang ahensya nga magpasa sang motion for reconsideration kun kinahanglan.
english: The agency plans to file a motion for reconsideration if necessary.

text: Ginahibalo pa sang Oton Municipal Police Station ang identity sang driver sang awto nga ginaalegar nagtuyo nga mag-abduct sa tatlo ka mga kabataan.
english: The Oton Municipal Police Station is still investigating the identity of the driver of the car that allegedly tried to abduct the three children.

text: Ang mga bata ang lunsay residente sang Barangay Cagbang, Oton, Iloilo kun sa diin isa ang 13-anyos kag duha ang naga-edad sang 12-anyos.
english: The children are all residents of Barangay Cagbang, Oton, Iloilo where one is 13 years old and two are 12 years old.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Lunelyn Talamillo, Deputy Chief of Police sang Oton MPS, iya ginpahayag nga naglagaw sa Sunset Boulevard ang tatlo antes natabo ang insidente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Lunelyn Talamillo, Deputy Chief of Police of Oton MPS, said the three were walking on Sunset Boulevard before the incident.

text: Santo sa ila nga gin-report sa pulis, ginpamangkot sila sang ginabanta 30-anyos nga driver kun sa diin ang alagyan pakadto sa Oton kag gintanyagan man nga magsakay na lang bangud ihapit na lang niya ang mga ini.
english: According to their report to the police, the 30-year-old driver asked them where the road to Oton was and offered to ride because he would drop them off.

text: Nagsakay man ang tatlo, apang pag-abot sa Emerald Estates kun sa diin manaog na kuntani, gina-alegar nga wala nagpundo ang driver gani nga ginbuksan sang bata sa likod ang pwertahan kag naglukso.
english: The three also boarded, but when they reached Emerald Estates where they were about to get off, the driver allegedly did not stop so the child opened the back door and jumped.

text: Nagsunod man ang bata sa front seat nga nagbukas man sang pwertahan kag naglumpat.
english: The boy followed in the front seat who also opened the door and jumped out.

text: Suno naman sa bata nga nagapungko sa likod sang driver, nagpakitluoy ini nga manaog siya kag nagpundo man gilayon ang driver, nagpanaog ini, kag naglakat man ang salakyan.
english: According to the child who was sitting behind the driver, he begged him to get off and the driver immediately stopped, he got off, and the vehicle left.

text: Suno kay Talamillo, may slight injuries ang mga bata bangud sa ginaalegar nga paglumpat.
english: According to Talamillo, the children sustained slight injuries due to the alleged jump.

text: Indi matandaan sang mga bata ang nawong sang driver apang ginapahayag nga gray ang awto nga gina-pangita na subong sang awtoridad paagi sa pag-backtrack sa closed circuit television footages.
english: The children cannot recognize the driver's face but the car is said to be gray and is now being searched by authorities by backtracking on closed circuit television footages.

text: Gin-athag sang kapulisan nga gina-imbestigaran pa kun ano gid man ang motibo sang driver nga ginapahayag nga nag-resulta gid sa pagkapuhag sang mga menor de edad.
english: Police explained that they are still investigating the motive of the driver who allegedly resulted in the injury of the minors.

text: ESTADOS UNIDOS – Bugal para sa Pinoy NBA hopeful nga si Kai Sotto nga mapaanggid sa isa ka all-star center sa National Basketball Association.
english: UNITED STATES – Filipino NBA hopeful Kai Sotto is proud to be compared to an all-star center in the National Basketball Association.

text: Ini ang kasunod sang pahayag ni G League Select Team head coach Brian Shaw nga may yara sang abilidad si Sotto kasubong sang Denver Nuggets center nga si Nikola Jokic.
english: This follows G League Select Team head coach Brian Shaw's statement that Sotto has the same skills as Denver Nuggets center Nikola Jokic.

text: Suno sa 7-foot-2 nga si Sotto, dungog para sa iya nga ipaanggid sa Serbian professional basketball player.
english: The 7-foot-2 Sotto said it was an honor for him to be compared to the Serbian professional basketball player.

text: Ginpahayag ni Sotto nga handum kag dumot niya nga itiglawas ang Asya sa patag sang National Basketball Association.
english: Sotto said he wants and hates to represent Asia in the National Basketball Association.

text: Matandaan nga sang 2019, nagpadulong sa Estados Unidos si Sotto kasunod sang pagtapos sang iya high school basketball career sa Ateneo De Manila University.
english: In 2019, Sotto went to the United States after completing his high school basketball career at Ateneo De Manila University.

text:
Nag-abiso ang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) sa mga kandidato, party-list, kag campaign teams nga opisyal nga matapos ang campaign period subong nga adlaw, Mayo 10, 2025, takna ‘las-11:59 sang gab-i.

Sa amo nga tion, istrikto na nga dumilian ang ano man nga porma sang pagpangampanya para sa kandidato kag ‘partisan activity’ batok sa isa ka kandidato.
english:
The Commission on Elections (COMELEC) has advised candidates, party-lists, and campaign teams that the campaign period will officially end today, May 10, 2025, at 11:59 pm.

At that time, any form of campaigning for the candidate and 'partisan activity' against a candidate was strictly prohibited.

text: Kaangot diri, tanan nga mga campaign materials, lakip na ang mga posters, streamers, billboards, tarpaulins, kag ano man nga propaganda sa pribado ukon pampubliko nga lugar ang kinahanglan kakson indi maglapaw sa alas-12:00 sang tungang gab-i sang Mayo 11, 2025.
english: In this regard, all campaign materials, including posters, streamers, billboards, tarpaulins, and any propaganda in private or public places must be removed no later than 12:00 midnight on May 11, 2025.

text: Ginmanduan man sang COMELEC ang mga kandidato, party-list groups, kag ang ila tagsa ka campaign teams nga magpatigayon sang gilayon nga pagpanglimpyo sang tanan nga mga materyales sa kampanya agud masiguro ang pagsunod sa Fair Elections Act.
english: The COMELEC also ordered candidates, party-list groups, and their respective campaign teams to immediately clean up all campaign materials to ensure compliance with the Fair Elections Act.

text: Ang indi pagsunod pagakabigon nga paglapas sa pagsulundan sang eleksyon nga mahimo mangin ‘ground’ para sa administrative disqualification sa idalom sang layi.
english: Failure to comply will be considered a violation of the election rules which can be a ‘ground’ for administrative disqualification under the law.

text: Masobra na naman sa P1-million ang balor sang iligal nga droga ang nakumpiskar sa Iloilo City pila ka adlaw antes ang sinakuay sang mga aktibidad para sa Dinagyang Festival.
english: More than P1-million worth of illegal drugs were seized in Iloilo City a few days before the activities for the Dinagyang Festival.

text: Sa drug buy bust operation nga ginpatigayon sa Valeria St., Barangay Kauswagan, Iloilo City Proper subong nga gab-i, arestado ang mga subject nga sanday alias JR, 43, sang Rizal Pala-Pala 2; kag si alias Ryan, 36, sang Tanza Bonifacio, City Proper.
english: In a drug buy bust operation conducted at Valeria St., Barangay Kaujungan, Iloilo City Proper tonight, the subjects were arrested as alias JR, 43, of Rizal Pala-Pala 2; and alias Ryan, 36, of Tanza Bonifacio, City Proper.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Pol.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Pol.

text: Lt.
english: Lt.

text: Col.
english: Col.

text: Antonio Benitez, head sang City Drug Enforcement Unit, iya ginpahayag nga 23 ka sachets sang suspected shabu ang kabug-usan nga recoveries nga may ginabanta standard drug price nga P1.7-million.
english: Antonio Benitez, head of the City Drug Enforcement Unit, said the total recoveries were 23 sachets of suspected shabu with an estimated standard drug price of P1.7-million.

text: Ginapatihan nga kabahin pa ini sang plano kuntani ipalusot para sa Dinagyang Festival sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: It is believed that this is part of the plan to smuggle for the Dinagyang Festival in Iloilo City.

text: Suno kay Benitez, duha ka semana ang monitoring sang kapulisan sa duha ka mga lalaki antes natpatigayon ang operasyon.
english: Benitez said the police monitored the two men for two weeks before the operation was conducted.

text: Pareho nga natumod ang duha ka subject nga high value individuals.
english: Both subjects were identified as high value individuals.

text: Si alias Ryan ang ginapahayag may kaso anay nga frustrated murder apang naserbisyuhan niya ini; samtang si alias JR naman ang may kaso man anay sa pagpangawat kag may kaso man sa iligal nga droga apang nakaguwa paagi sa plea bargaining agreement.
english: alias Ryan allegedly had a previous case of frustrated murder but served it; while alias JR was also charged with robbery and illegal drugs but was released through a plea bargaining agreement.

text: MANILA – Gin-certify nga urgent ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte ang pagpasar sang 2021 national budget kun sa diin nalakip ang pondo para sa COVID-19 response sang gobyerno.
english: MANILA – President Rodrigo Duterte certified as urgent the passage of the 2021 national budget which includes funds for the government's COVID-19 response.

text: Suno kay Presidential Spokesperson Atty. Harry Roque, ginpaagi ni Presidente Duterte sa isa ka proclamation ang pag-certify nga urgent sa P4.5-trillion proposed national budget bill.
english: According to Presidential Spokesperson Atty. Harry Roque, President Duterte through a proclamation certified as urgent the P4.5-trillion proposed national budget bill.

text: Ang hagna nga certified as urgent ang indi na kinahanglan pa nga tun-an sang mga mamalidha antes botohan.
english: The bill, which is certified as urgent, will not need to be studied by lawmakers before being voted on.

text: Nahibalu-an nga ang nasambit nga lihok sang presidente ang kasunod sang pag-agaway nanday House Speaker Alan Peter Cayetano kag Marinduque Rep.
english: The president's move follows a clash between House Speaker Alan Peter Cayetano and Marinduque Rep.

text: Lord Allan Velasco sa house speakership row.
english: Lord Allan Velasco in the house speakership row.

text: Suportado ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr ang proposal nga buksan sa publiko ang bicameral conference committee (BICAM) sa deliberasyon sang 2026 proposed national budget.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. supports the proposal to open to the public the bicameral conference committee (BICAM) in the deliberation of the 2026 proposed national budget.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Usec Claire Castro, luyag ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr nga mangin transparent ang deliberasyon kag ipakita sa mga pumuluyo nga wala gina-usikan ukon gina-abusuhan ang pundo sang publiko.
english: According to Palace Press Officer Usec Claire Castro, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. wants the deliberations to be transparent and show the people that public funds are not being wasted or abused.

text: Sa SONA sang Presidente, nagpaandam ini nga handa siya nga i-veto ang ginaduso nga 2026 national budget kun may makita nga anomaliya.
english: In the President's SONA, he warned that he is ready to veto the proposed 2026 national budget if any anomalies are found.

text: Suno kay Castro, seryoso ang Presidente nga i-veto ang 2026 proposed budget kon magpadayon ang anomaliya nga pagsulod sang pondo.
english: According to Castro, the President is serious about vetoing the 2026 proposed budget if the anomalous inflow of funds continues.

text: Dugang pa ni Castro nga ang 2026 budget gin-obra sing maayo kag nag-agi sa maid-id nga deliberasyon kag indi joke ang paghimo sang budget para sa National Expenditure Program.
english: Castro added that the 2026 budget was carefully worked out and went through careful deliberation and that the budgeting for the National Expenditure Program was not a joke.

text: Ginhatagan punto ni Castro nga indi dapat pag-abusuhon ang poder sang purse sang Kongreso.
english: Castro pointed out that the power of the Congress purse should not be abused.

text: USA – Nagapati si anay UFC light heavyweight kag heavyweight world champion Daniel Cormier nga ang iya kadalag-an sa trilogy nila ni UFC heavyweight world titleholder Stipe Miocic ang mangin liyable agud siya ang kilalahon bilang sports icon.
english: USA – Former UFC light heavyweight and heavyweight world champion Daniel Cormier believes that his victory in his trilogy with UFC heavyweight world titleholder Stipe Miocic will be liable for him to be recognized as a sports icon.

text: Ang American mixed martial artist nga si Cormier ang natalana nga mag-atubang sa kasubong nga American mixed martial artist nga si Miocic sa main event sang UFC 252 nga patigayunon sa Las Vegas, Nevada, subong nga aga Agosto 16.
english: American mixed martial artist Cormier is scheduled to face fellow American mixed martial artist Miocic in the main event of UFC 252 to be held in Las Vegas, Nevada, this morning August 16.

text: Suno kay Comier, ang iya sambuwa batok kay Miocic ang mangin last fight na niya sa MMA career kag wala na siya sang plano nga magbalik matapos ang retirement.
english: Comier said his fight against Miocic will be his last fight in his MMA career and he has no plans to return after retirement.

text: Ginpahayag ni Comier nga ang importante amo nga iya nahibalu-an kun san-o ang nagakaigo nga oras sa pagbiya sa MMA.
english: Comier said the important thing is that he knows when the right time is to leave MMA.

text: Ginpaidalom sa heightened state of alert ang pila ka base-militar sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga nahamtang sa Europa.
english: Several US military bases in Europe have been placed on heightened state of alert.

text: Suno sa inisyal nga impormasyon halin sa duha ka wala ginhingadlan nga U.S. Officials, ginpasaka sa “Charlie” ang alert level sang Force Protection Condition (FPCON) sang weekend.
english: According to initial information from two unnamed U.S. Officials, the alert level of Force Protection Condition (FPCON) was raised to “Charlie” over the weekend.

text: Ang “Charlie” suno sa U.S. Army amo ang ikaduha sa pinakamataas nga alert nga gina-apply kun may natabo nga insidente ukon may intelligence report nga nabaton nga may porma ukon terrorist action nga naga-target sa personnel ukon sa pasilidad.
english: “Charlie” according to the U.S. Army is the second highest alert applied when an incident occurs or an intelligence report is received that there is a form or terrorist action targeting personnel or a facility.

text: Sa statement naman nga ginhatag sang U.S. European Command sa reporters, ginsiling nga gina-assess sini ang nagkalain-lain nga factors kaangot sa security kag safety.
english: In a statement to reporters, the U.S. European Command said it is assessing various factors related to security and safety.

text: “For operational security reasons, we will not get into specific measures, but we remain vigilant,” kabahin sang ginsapubliko sang EUCOM.
english: “For operational security reasons, we will not get into specific measures, but we remain vigilant,” EUCOM said in a statement.

text: Ini nga mga development ang una gin-report sa Stars and Stripes nga isa ka independent military publication.
english: These developments were first reported in Stars and Stripes which is an independent military publication.

text: Gintumod sang China’s Ministry of National Defense ang Pilipinas nga ginaalegar ginahalinan sang gamo kag katalagman sa West Philippine Sea (WPS).
english: China’s Ministry of National Defense has identified the Philippines as an alleged source of conflict and danger in the West Philippine Sea (WPS).

text: Kasunod ini sang dugang nga commitment sang pungsod sa maritime security kag pag-alyansa sa mga kaiping nga pungsod sa rehiyon.
english: This follows the country’s increased commitment to maritime security and alliances with neighboring countries in the region.

text: Suno kay Senior Colonel Zhang Xiaogang sang defence ministry sang China, ilegal ang pag-okupar sang Pilipinas sa Kalayaan Island Group, kag ginabasol ang pungsod sa pagdugang sang tensyon paagi sa maritime patrols kag presensya sa kadagatan.
english: According to Senior Colonel Zhang Xiaogang of China's defense ministry, the Philippines' occupation of the Kalayaan Island Group is illegal, and blames the country for escalating tensions through maritime patrols and presence in the sea.

text: Ini bilang sabat sa bag-o lang nga pahayag ni Defence Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr., nga ang Armed Forces of the Philippines magasaylo sang ila pokus halin sa internal security pakadto sa external defense—ilabi na nga wala naga-untat ang agresibo nga aksyon sang China sa WPS.
english: This is in response to Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr.’s recent statement, that the Armed Forces of the Philippines will shift its focus from internal security to external defense—especially as China’s aggressive actions on the WPS do not stop.

text: Ginpanindugan ni Teodoro nga ang nine-dash line claim sang China ang batok sa international law, kag nagpasalig nga ipakigbato sang administrasyon ni Marcos Jr ang kinamatarong sang pungsod sa kadagatan.
english: Teodoro insisted that China's nine-dash line claim is against international law, and assured that the Marcos Jr. administration will fight for the country's right to the sea.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nagpaandam ang China nga magahimo ini sang hugot nga mga tikang kon magpadayon ang mga probokasyon sang Pilipinas.
english: Meanwhile, China has warned that it will take strict measures if the Philippines' provocations continue.

text: Sa pihak sini, padayon nga ginapanindugan sang Pilipinas ang validity sang 2016 arbitral ruling nga nag-invalidate sang malapad nga claims sang China sa South China Sea.
english: Meanwhile, the Philippines continues to insist on the validity of the 2016 arbitral ruling that invalidated China's extensive claims in the South China Sea.

text: MANILA – Pagagamiton sang gobyerno ang sobra sa P10 billion tariff gikan sa importation para sa pagpasangkad sang productivity sang local rice farmers.
english: MANILA – The government will use the more than P10 billion tariff from imports to expand the productivity of local rice farmers.

text: Suno kay Department of Finance Assistance Secretary Tony Lambino, pagatutukan sang gobyerno ang productivity programs para sa rice sector.
english: According to Department of Finance Assistance Secretary Tony Lambino, the government will focus on productivity programs for the rice sector.

text: Sa idalom sang Rice Tariffication Law, ang P10 billion nga makolekta sa tagsa ka tuig ang automatic na nga pagagamiton sa Rice Competitiveness Enhancement Fund nga natunga sa apat ka components nga ginalakipan sang machinery kag equipment nga nagabalor sang P5 billion, certified inbred seeds nga P3 billion, credit nga P1 billion kag training and extension nga P1 billion.
english: Under the Rice Tariffication Law, the P10 billion collected each year will automatically be used for the Rice Competitiveness Enhancement Fund which is divided into four components including machinery and equipment worth P5 billion, certified inbred seeds worth P3 billion, training credit and extension worth P1 billion.

text: Umpisa sang ginpirmahan sang Presidente ang Rice Tariffication Law sang 2019, wala na sang quantitative restrictions sa rice importation kag ginpatuman ang 35 percent tariff sa rice imports.
english: Since the President signed the Rice Tariffication Law in 2019, there are no quantitative restrictions on rice importation and a 35 percent tariff on rice imports has been implemented.

text: Sa pito ka bulan, ang rice tariff collections ang naglab-ot na sa P11.036 billion, ukon mas mataas sang 4% year-on-year, kag nagsobra sa P10-billion worth of rice import tariffs santo sa Rice Competitiveness Enhancement Fund.
english: In seven months, rice tariff collections have reached P11.036 billion, or more than 4% year-on-year, and exceeded the P10-billion worth of rice import tariffs according to the Rice Competitiveness Enhancement Fund.

text: Apisar nga wala gindetalye kun paano gastuhon ang sobra sa P10 billion, ginpahayag sang Department of Finance nga naglab-ot sa P12.1 billion ang nakolekta sang 2019 kun sa diin ang sobra nga P2.1 billion ang pagagamiton sang Department of Agriculture sa crop diversification program (P1 billion) kag expanded crop insurance on rice (P1.1 billion).
english: Although it did not detail how to spend the more than P10 billion, the Department of Finance said that P12.1 billion was collected in 2019 where the excess P2.1 billion will be used by the Department of Agriculture for the crop diversification program (P1 billion) and expanded crop insurance (P1 billion).

text: Sa masobra 1,700 ka mga barangay sa bilog nga probinsya sang Iloilo, may 21 pa nga wala na-clear sa iligal nga droga.
english: Of the more than 1,700 barangays in Iloilo province, there are still 21 that have not been cleared of illegal drugs.

text: Suno ini sa data sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) subong nga nagahingapos na ang 2023.
english: This is according to the data of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) as 2023 comes to an end.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Colonel Ronaldo Palomo, director sang IPPO, iya ginpahayag nga sa 21 ka mga barangay, siyam gid diri ang naghalin sa banwa sang Oton.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Colonel Ronaldo Palomo, director of the IPPO, said that out of the 21 barangays, nine of them are from Oton town.

text: Gintumod sini nga rason ang pagpositibo sang pila ka drug surrenderers sa iligal nga droga.
english: He cited the positivity of some drug surrenderers for illegal drugs.

text: Ang iban pa nga nga indi drug-free nga mga barangay ang nahamtang sa Estancia, Tigbauan, Balasan, San Enrique, kag Sara.
english: Other non-drug-free barangays are located in Estancia, Tigbauan, Balasan, San Enrique, and Sara.

text: Gin-athag man sang director nga wala sang natumod nga organized drug group sa probinsya.
english: The director also clarified that there is no identified organized drug group in the province.

text: Ang ginakabig nga pinakadaku nga recoveries sang otoridad sa Western Visayas subong nga tuig amo ang P40.8 million nga balor sang shabu kag pagkadakop sa isa ka high-value individual sa buy-bust sa Janiuay, Iloilo sang nagligad lamang nga Disyembre 17.
english: The biggest recoveries of the authorities in Western Visayas this year are the P40.8 million worth of shabu and the arrest of a high-value individual in a buy-bust in Janiuay, Iloilo last December 17.

text: Ini kasunod sang P20-million man nga nakumpiskar sa Jaro, Iloilo City sang nagligad nga Nobyembre 9.#
english: This follows the P20-million also seized in Jaro, Iloilo City last November 9.#

text: Posible nga liwat magahampang sa sulod sang boxing ring si retired american five division world champion Floyd Mayweather Jr.
english: Retired American five division world champion Floyd Mayweather Jr. is likely to fight inside the boxing ring again.

text: 2017 pa ang katapusan nga hampang sang 43 anyos batuk kay Irish mixed martial artist Conor McGregor sa diin nangin madinalag-on ini pinaagi sa 10th round technical knockout.
english: The 43-year-old's last fight against Irish mixed martial artist Conor McGregor was in 2017, where he won by 10th round technical knockout.

text: Suno kay UFC President Dana White, luyag pa ni Floyd nga maghampang liwat sa sulod sang boxing ring.
english: According to UFC President Dana White, Floyd still wants to play inside the boxing ring again.

text: Si White ang key figure kun ngaa nadayon ang hampang nanday Myweather kag McGregor.
english: White was the key figure in why the fight between Myweather and McGregor went ahead.

text: Wala naman nagakabalaka si White sa edad ni Mayweather sa paghampang sang boxing.
english: White is not concerned about Mayweather's boxing age.

text: Nalakip ang pinuno sang pinakadaku nga ospital sa Gaza sa ginhilway sang Israel matapos ang masobra pito ka bulan nga detention.
english: The head of Gaza's largest hospital was among those released by Israel after more than seven months in detention.

text: Suno sa Israeli authorities, si Al-Shifa hospital director Mohammed Abu Salmiya kag dinosena nga iban pa nga Palestinians ang ginpaguwa kag ginbalik sa Gaza para madapatan sang nagakaigu nga pagbulong.
english: According to Israeli authorities, Al-Shifa hospital director Mohammed Abu Salmiya and dozens of other Palestinians were released and returned to Gaza for proper treatment.

text: Sa panaysayon naman ni Abu Salmiya, ginsiling sini nga siya kag ang iban pa nga mga preso ang naka-eksperyensya sang “severe torture” sa mga presuhan sa Israel matapos sila nga gin-detain kasunod sang Oktubre 7 nga pagpang-atake sang Hamas militants.
english: Abu Salmiya said he and other prisoners experienced “severe torture” in Israeli prisons after they were detained following the October 7 attack by Hamas militants.

text: Suno pa kay Abum Salmiya nga nabalian pa sang tudlo sang nakabalik sa Gaza Strip, pila sa mga preso ang nagkalamatay na lang sa interrogation centers samtang ang iban naman ang wala ginhatagan sang pagkaon kag bulong.
english: According to Abum Salmiya, who broke his finger when he returned to the Gaza Strip, some of the prisoners died in interrogation centers while others were not given food and medicine.

text: Sa sulod sang duha ka bulan suno sa iya, tunga lang gid nga tinapay ang ginahatag sa kada preso kada adlaw.
english: For two months, he said, only half a loaf of bread was given to each prisoner every day.

text:
Nakaagi man sila sang ginatawag nga “physical and psychological humiliation.”

Matandaan nga una na ginsiling sang Shin Bet intelligence agency nga nagpasugot ang Israeli military ang hilwayon ang iban nga preso para nga mahawanan kag makahatag sang ligwa sa detention centers.
english:
They also experienced what is called “physical and psychological humiliation.”

It can be recalled that the Shin Bet intelligence agency earlier said that the Israeli military agreed to release some prisoners in order to clear and provide relief to the detention centers.

text:
Ginpahayab sang ahensya nga nagapamatok ini sa pagpaguwa sang mga terorista nga kabahin sa mga nag-atake sa Israeli civilians gani ang ila ginhilway amo lamang ang Gaza detainees nga may “lesser danger.”

Nahibaluan nga si Abu Salmiya ang lakip sa gin-detain sang pwersa-militar sang Israel kadungan sang raid sa Al-Shifa.
english:
The agency said it was opposed to the release of terrorists involved in the attacks on Israeli civilians and therefore released only Gaza detainees with “lesser danger.”

Abu Salmiya was among those detained by Israeli military forces during the raid on Al-Shifa.

text: Gina-akusahan sang militar ang Hamas nga naggamit sang mga ospital sa Gaza Strip bilang palanaguan para sa ila operasyon.
english: The military accuses Hamas of using hospitals in the Gaza Strip as hideouts for its operations.

text: Ini ang rason kun ngaa ila gin-raid ang mga ospital sa Gaza lakip ang Al-Shifa kun sa diin nakit-an ang ginaalegar nga mga tunnel kag iban pa nga imprastraktura sang Hamas.
english: This is why they raided hospitals in Gaza including Al-Shifa where alleged tunnels and other Hamas infrastructure were found.

text: MANILA – Ginatos ka milyon ka pesos ang makinot sang gobyerno sa tion nga ipatuman na sa masunod nga tuig ang National Broadband Program (NBP).
english: MANILA – The government will save hundreds of millions of pesos when the National Broadband Program (NBP) is implemented next year.

text: Suno statement sang Department of Information and Communications Technology, ginalauman nga magalab-ot sa P720 million ang internet subscription expenses sa una nga tuig sang pagpatuman sang nasambit nga programa.
english: According to a statement from the Department of Information and Communications Technology, internet subscription expenses are expected to reach P720 million in the first year of implementation of the program.

text: Sa Phase 1, iga-activate ang Cable Landing station sa Baler, Aurora kag ini ang iga-angot sa National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) Node sa San Fernando La Union paagi sa Luzon Bypass Infrastructure.
english: In Phase 1, the Cable Landing station in Baler, Aurora will be activated and it will be connected to the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) Node in San Fernando La Union through the Luzon Bypass Infrastructure.

text: Pagkatapos sini, iga-activate kag iga-light up ang apat ka DICT nodes kag ang 15 ka NGCP nodes nga naga-konekta sa DICT equipment.
english: After that, the four DICT nodes and the 15 NGCP nodes connecting to the DICT equipment will be activated and lighted up.

text: Paagi sa National Broadband Program (NBP), ang DICT ang magapahamtang sang broadband capacity sa pungsod ilabi na sa mga malayo kag nabukid nga lugar.
english: Through the National Broadband Program (NBP), DICT will establish broadband capacity in the country especially in remote and mountainous areas.

text: Paagi sa nasambit nga programa, ang government agencies ang maka-angkon sang internet service nga P50 per megabits per second (Mbps) kun ipaanggid sa P350 per Mbps nga internet bandwidth per month.
english: Through the said program, government agencies will receive internet service at P50 per megabits per second (Mbps) compared to P350 per Mbps internet bandwidth per month.

text: Kun matigayon, ang average government office ang makagasto lamang sang P5,000 sa kada bulan ukon P60,000 kada tuig.
english: If available, the average government office can only spend P5,000 per month or P60,000 per year.

text: Katuyu-an sang connect-connect-connect initiative amo nga mapasangkad ang fiber optic cables kag wireless technologies paagi sa masangkad, madasig kag barato nga internet access.
english: The connect-connect-connect initiative aims to expand fiber optic cables and wireless technologies through broad, fast and affordable internet access.

text: Ang additional budget request sang DICT ang magalab-ot sa P17 billion para sa fiscal year 2021 ang aprobado na kag sa 2022, ang Phase 2 sang National Broadband Program ang maga-cover sa Luzon, Visayas kag Mindanao kag ginalauman nga magalab-ot sa 34 billion pesos ang government Internet expense.
english: The additional budget request of DICT amounting to P17 billion for fiscal year 2021 has been approved and in 2022, Phase 2 of the National Broadband Program will cover Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao and is expected to reach 34 billion pesos in government Internet expenditure.

text: Ginkummpirma sang Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) nga magapatigayon ang Philippine Navy upod ang Indian Navy sang labing una nga joint maritime drills sa West Philippine Sea (WPS) sa masunod nga semana.
english: The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) confirmed that the Philippine Navy and the Indian Navy will conduct the first-ever joint maritime drills in the West Philippine Sea (WPS) next week.

text: Sa isa ka statement, ginasiling sang AFP chief General Romeo Brawner Jr.
english: In a statement, AFP chief General Romeo Brawner Jr.

text: nga ang patigayunon nga joint maritime cooperation activity ang masobra pa sa isa ka ceremonial gesture.
english: that the joint maritime cooperation activity will be more than a ceremonial gesture.

text: Suno sa iya, ang presensya sang India naval tanker sang INS Shakti sa Manila ang nagapakita sang mabaskog nga senyales sang paghugpon sa tunga sang duha ka pungsod sa Indo-Pacific Region.
english: He said the presence of the Indian naval tanker INS Shakti in Manila shows a strong sign of rapprochement between the two countries in the Indo-Pacific Region.

text: Ang pagbisita sang isa ka Indian naval tanker sa pungsod isa ka patimaan sang nagapadayon nga pagpalig-on sang defense diplomacy sa tunga sang Pilipinas kag India, kag indi isa ka show of force.
english: The visit of an Indian naval tanker to the country is a sign of the ongoing strengthening of defense diplomacy between the Philippines and India, and not a show of force.

text: Naguba ang 11 ka mga balay, samtang nagkulob naman ang duha ka mga ka sakayan pandagat sa Brgy.
english: Eleven houses were destroyed, while two boats capsized in Brgy.

text: San Angel, San Jose, Antique matapos nga gin-agyan sang buhawi.
english: San Angel, San Jose, Antique after being hit by a typhoon.

text: Suno sa Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO) Antique, ang 11 ka mga balay ang partially damaged samtang ang duha ka nagkulob nga sakayan pandagat ang lunsay ginagamit sa pagpangisda.
english: According to the Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO) Antique, 11 houses were partially damaged while the two sunken boats were both used for fishing.

text: Dugang pa, ang buhawi nagporma bangud sa mga thunderstorm nga nagbutong sang hangin.
english: In addition, the tornado formed due to thunderstorms that pumped up the wind.

text: Nagbilin naman sang kahalitan ang amo nga insidente sa Brgy.
english: The incident left damage in Brgy.

text: San Angel, Brgy.
english: San Angel, Brgy.

text: Maybato North, Brgy.
english: Maybato North, Brgy.

text: 4, kag Brgy.
english: 4, and Brgy.

text: Malaiba sa San Jose, Antique.
english: Malaiba in San Jose, Antique.

text: Luyag sang Hall of Fame trainer nga si Freddie Roach nga padayunon pa ni Eight-division world champion Manny Pacquiao ang career sini sa patag sang boxing.
english: Hall of Fame trainer Freddie Roach wants Eight-division world champion Manny Pacquiao to continue his career in boxing.

text: Suno kay Roach, duha pa ka hampang sa sulod sang boxing ring kag mahimo na nga makapadalagan bilang Presidente sang Pilipinas si Pacquiao.
english: According to Roach, two more fights inside the boxing ring and Pacquiao can run for President of the Philippines.

text: Kun magapadalagan ang boxing champion bilang presidente, ini ang lain naman nga kabahin sang kasaysayan.
english: If the boxing champion runs for president, it will be another part of history.

text: Ginalantaw ni Roach nga mangin maayo nga Presidente si Pacquiao.
english: Roach expects Pacquiao to be a good President.

text: Pahayag pa sang Hall of Fame trainer, na-istoryahan na nila ni Pacquiao kun sin-o ang posible sini nga makasambuwa sa sulod sang boxing ring.
english: The Hall of Fame trainer said he and Pacquiao have already discussed who he might face inside the boxing ring.

text: Luyag kuntani ni Roach nga si American boxer Mikey Garcia ang masunod nga ma-kontra ni Pacquiao apang si Floyd Mayweather ang ginalaoman nga makasambuwa liwat sang boxing champ.
english: Roach wanted American boxer Mikey Garcia to be Pacquiao's next opponent but Floyd Mayweather is expected to fight the boxing champ again.

text: Bisan sin-o man ang maluyagan ni Pacquiao sa masunod sini nga hampang, ginasiguro ni Roach nga ang Team Pacquiao ang todo suporta sa Filipino boxing icon.
english: Whoever Pacquiao likes in his next fight, Roach assures that Team Pacquiao will fully support the Filipino boxing icon.

text: May gintanyag nga P100,000 bilang reward sa sin-o man nga makatudlo sa suspek nga nagpatay sa 57-anyos nga radio broadcaster nga si Juan Jumalon ukon DJ Johnny Walker sa Calamba, Misamis Occidental.
english: A P100,000 reward has been offered to anyone who can identify the suspect who killed 57-year-old radio broadcaster Juan Jumalon or DJ Johnny Walker in Calamba, Misamis Occidental.

text: Sandig ini sa anunsyo sang Presidential Task Force on Media Security kun sa diin nakabutang man ang computerized facial sketch sang itsura sang lalaki nga amo ang ginatudlo nga nag-serbe nga lookout malapit sa gate nanday Jumalon.
english: This is based on the announcement of the Presidential Task Force on Media Security which also includes a computerized facial sketch of the appearance of the man who allegedly served as a lookout near the gate of Jumalon.

text: Ginlaragway sang pulis ang lalaki nga may medium build, 5 feet 5 inches tubtub 5 feet 6 inches ang kataason, kag ginabanta 70 kilograms ang kabug-aton.
english: Police described the man as having a medium build, 5 feet 5 inches to 5 feet 6 inches tall, and weighing approximately 70 kilograms.

text: Nakasuksok ang suspek sang pula nga kalo, green nga shirt, kag itom nga shorts sandig sa nakuha sang CCTV footage.
english: The suspect was wearing a red hat, green shirt, and black shorts, according to CCTV footage.

text: Pasado ‘las singko sang kaagahon sang Domingo sang ginsulod sang suspek ang radio booth sa sulod mismo sang balay ni Jumalon.
english: It was around 5:00 am on Sunday when the suspect entered the radio booth inside Jumalon's house.

text: Ginpalapitan sini ang radio anchor, ginluthang, kag madasig nga nagpalagyo.
english: He approached the radio anchor, opened fire, and quickly fled.

text: Suno sa asawa sang biktima, wala naga-isahanon ang suspek bangud duha sila ang nagsulod sa balay kag may isa nga amo ang nagabantay sa guwa kag nagasakay sa motorsiklo.
english: According to the victim's wife, the suspect was not alone because two of them entered the house and one of them was guarding outside and riding a motorcycle.

text: Nagapati man ang asawa nga indi work-related ang rason sa krimen bangud indi commentator si Jumalon kundi nakatutok lamang sa entertainment ukon isa ka disc jockey nga nagabasa sang greetings kag mga public service.
english: The wife also believes that the reason for the crime is not work-related because Jumalon is not a commentator but focused on entertainment or a disc jockey who reads greetings and public services.

text: Wala ginadula sang otoridad ang tanan nga posible anggulo lakip na ang away sa duta kag away sa negosyo.
english: Authorities are not ruling out all possible angles including a land dispute and a business dispute.

text: Kinumpirma ng Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) na magsasagawa ang Philippine Navy kasama ang Indian Navy ng kauna-unahnag joint maritime drills sa West Philippine Sea (WPS) sa susunod na linggo.
english: The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) confirmed that the Philippine Navy and the Indian Navy will conduct the first-ever joint maritime drills in the West Philippine Sea (WPS) next week.

text: Sa isang statement, sinabi ng AFP chief General Romeo Brawner Jr.
english: In a statement, AFP chief General Romeo Brawner Jr.

text: na ang isasagawang joint maritime cooperation activity ay higit pa sa isang ceremonial gesture.
english: that the joint maritime cooperation activity is more than a ceremonial gesture.

text: Aniya, ang presensiya ng Indian naval tanker na INS Shakti sa Maynila ay nagpapakita ng malakas na senyales ng pagkakaisa, tibay ng samahan at sigla ng kooperasyon sa pagitan ng dalawang bansa sa Indo-Pacific Region.
english: He said the presence of the Indian naval tanker INS Shakti in Manila shows a strong sign of unity, strength of partnership and vitality of cooperation between the two countries in the Indo-Pacific Region.

text: Para sa Sandatahang Lakas, ang pagbisita ng Indian naval tanker ay pagmarka ng pagpapahusay pa ng defense diplomacy at hindi show of force kasabay ng pagpapalawig pa ng India sa naval engagements nito sa Timog-Silangang Asya.
english: For the Armed Forces, the visit of the Indian naval tanker marks a further improvement of defense diplomacy and not a show of force along with India's expansion of its naval engagements in Southeast Asia.

text: Pinuri naman ng AFP chief ang lumalalim pa na ugnayang pangdepensa sa pagitan ng PH at India.
english: The AFP chief praised the deepening defense ties between PH and India.

text: Ginawa ng AFP ang anunsiyo ilang araw bago ang nakatakdang pagbisita ni Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The AFP made the announcement a few days before the scheduled visit of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sa India mula sa araw ng Lunes, Agosto 4 hanggang sa Biyernes, Agosto 8.
english: in India from Monday, August 4 to Friday, August 8.

text: MANILA – Bad news sa mga motorista!
english: MANILA – Bad news for motorists!

text: May yara sang pagsaka sa presyo sang gasolina kag kerosene epektibo buwas nga adlaw Oktubre 6.
english: There will be an increase in the price of petrol and kerosene effective tomorrow October 6th.

text:
Santo sa abiso sang mga kompaniya sang langis:

10 centavos ang saka sa kada litro sang gasolina samtang 20 centavos ang saka sa kada litro sang kerosene

Sa pihak sini, gin-anunsyo sang oil companies nga wala sang pagsaka sa presyo sang diesel.
english:
According to the oil companies' notice:

10 centavos per liter of gasoline while 20 centavos per liter of kerosene

Meanwhile, oil companies announced that there will be no increase in diesel prices.

text: Lima ang patay kag 57 ang nasamaran sang nagsigabong ang isa ka restaurant sa Turkey.
english: Five people were killed and 57 injured when a restaurant caught fire in Turkey.

text: Suno kay interior minister Ali Yerlikaya, natabo ang pagsigabong bangud sa isa ka gas cylinder.
english: According to interior minister Ali Yerlikaya, the fire was caused by a gas cylinder.

text:
“May God have mercy on our citizens who lost their lives, and I wish a speedy recovery to our injured,” kabahin sang post sini sa X.

Natabo ini sa banwa sang Torbali sa nabagatnan sang syudad sang Izmir.
english:
“May God have mercy on our citizens who lost their lives, and I wish a speedy recovery to our injured,” he posted on X.

It happened in the town of Torbali south of the city of Izmir.

text: Base sa inisyal nga impormasyon, tuman ka tunog ang pagsigabong kag nahalitan pa pati ang facades sang pila ka kaiping nga buildings amo man ang mga salakyan nga yara sa guwa sang restaurant.
english: Based on initial information, the fire was very loud and damaged the facades of several neighboring buildings as well as vehicles outside the restaurant.

text: Ginahibalo pa ang identity sang casualties sa sini nga insidente.
english: The identity of the casualties in this incident is still unknown.

text: Gin-report man nga may isa ka tawo nga naaresto kasunod sang insidente.
english: It was also reported that one person was arrested following the incident.

text: Ini nga tawo ang ginatudlo nga nag-baylo sang propane tank sa site sang nagligad nga adlaw.
english: This person is alleged to have changed the propane tank at the site the previous day.

text: MANILA – Good news kag bad news sa mga motorista!
english: MANILA – Good news and bad news for motorists!

text: Lauman ang pagtaas sa presyo sang gasolina kag kerosene samtang may pagnubo naman sa presyo sang diesel sa Oktubre 6.
english: Gasoline and kerosene prices are expected to rise while diesel prices will fall on October 6.

text:
Santo sa forecast:

Gasolina – 5-15 centavos ang saka sa kada litroKerosene – 15-20 centavos ang saka sa kada litroDiesel – 5 centavos ang buhin sa kada litro

Nahibalu-an nga ini na ang ika-tatlo nga semana nga may yara sang pagsaka sa presyo sang gasolina kag kerosene.
english:
Santo in the forecast:

Petrol – 5-15 centavos per liter increaseKerosene – 15-20 centavos per liter increaseDiesel – 5 centavos per liter reduction

This is the third week that there has been an increase in the price of gasoline and kerosene.

text: RUSSIA – Duha na lang ka hampang antes magretiro sa mixed martial arts si reigning UFC lightweight world champion Khabib Nurmagomedov.
english: RUSSIA – Reigning UFC lightweight world champion Khabib Nurmagomedov is just two fights away from retiring from mixed martial arts.

text: Si Nurmagomedov ang natalana nga maghampang sa unification showdown batok kay UFC interim lightweight champion Justin Gaethje sa main event sang UFC 254 sa Oktubre 24 apang wala pa sang venue.
english: Nurmagomedov is set to play in the unification showdown against UFC interim lightweight champion Justin Gaethje in the main event of UFC 254 on October 24 but no venue has been set.

text: Ang goal sang Russian professional mixed martial artist amo nga indi mahigku-an ang iya unbeaten record nga 28-0.
english: The goal of the Russian professional mixed martial artist is not to tarnish his unbeaten record of 28-0.

text: Suno sa trainer nga si Javier Mendez, ang goal ni Nurmagomedov amo ang 30-0 nga win-loss record kun sa diin ang sambuwa sang Russian MMA player batok kay Gaethje ang greatest of all time.
english: According to trainer Javier Mendez, Nurmagomedov's goal is a 30-0 win-loss record where the Russian MMA player's fight against Gaethje is the greatest of all time.

text: Isa sa mga ginaduso nga masunod nga mangin kasumpong ni Nurmagomedov amo si GSP ukon Georges St-Pierre, isa ka retired UFC two-division world champion.
english: One of the proposed next opponents for Nurmagomedov is GSP or Georges St-Pierre, a retired UFC two-division world champion.

text: Santo sa oddsmakers, si Nurmagomedov ang -200 favorite samtang si St.
Pierre naman ang +170 underdog.
english: Pierre is the +170 underdog.

text: Siyam ang pilason matapos nga nagbaliskad ang de-pampasahero nga jeep sa Barangay Cagay, Leon, Iloilo.
english: Nine people were injured after a passenger jeep overturned in Barangay Cagay, Leon, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Mark Cortez, Deputy Chief of Police sang Leon Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga siyam ang tanan nga sakay sang amo nga jeep lakip ang driver sang nagluntad ang insidente.
english: Police Lieutenant Mark Cortez, Deputy Chief of Police of the Leon Municipal Police Station, said there were nine people on board the jeep including the driver when the incident occurred.

text: Suno kay Cortez kag santo sa pahayag sang driver sang jeep, pag-abot sang jeep sa nasambit nga lugar, nagpondo ini sa dulhogon nga parte sang dalan agud mag-unload sang karga.
english: According to Cortez and based on the statement of the driver of the jeep, when the jeep arrived at the said place, it stopped at the steep part of the road to unload the cargo.

text: Gintuad man sini nga sa amo nga tion ginkalsuhan sang konduktor ang jeep apang wala na nagkagat ang preno sini rason nga nadulaan sang control ang driver kag nagbaliskad ini.
english: He also admitted that at that time the conductor tried to hit the jeep but the brakes did not bite causing the driver to lose control and overturn.

text: Gilayon naman nga gindala sa Western Visayas Medical Center kag Aleosan District Hospital ang mga biktima.
english: The victims were rushed to the Western Visayas Medical Center and Aleosan District Hospital.

text: Isa na ka basurero sa subong sa Kobe, Japan ang anay boxing world champion nga si Malcolm Tuñacao.
english: Former boxing world champion Malcolm Tuñacao is now a garbage collector in Kobe, Japan.

text: Suno sa 2000 WBC flyweight titleholder, importante ang iya nga trabaho kag wala siya sang dapat nga ikahuya.
Pahayag niya, malipayon mismo ang mga Japanese nga makakita sang basurero bangud tuman ka importante sa Japan nga mapabilin ang katinlo sang ila lugar.
english: He said the Japanese themselves are happy to see a garbage collector because it is very important in Japan to maintain the cleanliness of their area.

text: Ang importante suno kay Tuñacao amo nga dako sa gihapon ang respeto sang mga tawo sa Japan sa mga basurero kaangay niya.
english: The important thing, Tuñacao said, is that people in Japan still have great respect for garbage collectors like him.

text: Sa masami, sa kada eleksyon, indi gid mag-zero ang boto sang pulitiko bangud pat-od nga botohon sini ang iya kaugalingon magluwas pa abi sa bulig sang iya pamilya.
english: Often, in every election, a politician's vote will never be zero because he will surely vote for himself without the help of his family.

text: Amo gani nga maragtas gid ang nahimo sang isa ka Canadian sang damlag lang bangud sa labing-una nga tion sa contested federal election sa ila pungsod, may kandidato nga wala gid sang nakuha nga bisan isa ka boto.
english: That's why a Canadian recently made history because for the first time in a contested federal election in their country, a candidate did not get a single vote.

text: Ini amo si Félix-Antoine Hamel, 45, nga nagbutang sang pangalan sa balota sa Toronto-St.
english: This is Félix-Antoine Hamel, 45, who put his name on the ballot in the Toronto-St.

text: Paul by-election sa Toronto.
Isa siya ka musician kag nagdesisyon nga magpadalagan bilang kabahin sang protesta batok sa first-past-the-post election system sa pungsod.
english: He is a musician and decided to run as part of a protest against the first-past-the-post election system in the country.

text: Kabahin si Hamel sang election reform advocacy group nga Longest Ballot Committee kag isa sa 84 nga nangisog nga ilista ang pangalan sa balota.
english: Hamel is part of the election reform advocacy group Longest Ballot Committee and is one of 84 who dared to list their names on the ballot.

text: Nahibaluan nga nga ang kaangay niya nga independent candidates ang ginalauman nga makakuha sang isa ukon duha ka boto bangud pwede nila botohon ang ila kaugalingon.
english: It is known that independent candidates like him are expected to get one or two votes because they can vote for themselves.

text: Apang natabuan nga lain man nga distrito ang ginapulian ni Hamel kag lain man nga distrito ang iya nga ginpadalaganan.
english: But it happened that Hamel was representing another district and he was running in another district.

text: Bangud sini, sang nakit-an sini ang resulta, gintawag niya ang kaugalingon nga siya ang matuod nga “unity candidate.” Ina bangud, suno sa iya, tanan nga tawo ang nag-unite kag nagsugtanay nga indi siya pagbotohon.
english: As a result, when he saw the results, he called himself the true “unity candidate.” That's because, he said, all the people united and agreed not to vote for him.

text: “When I saw the result, I was like, ‘Well, I am the true unity candidate.
english: “When I saw the result, I was like, ‘Well, I am the true unity candidate.

text: Everyone agrees not to vote for me,’” suno kay Hamel.
english: Everyone agrees not to vote for me,’” according to Hamel.

text: Apisar sang resulta, nalipay si Hamel bangud sa kadamo sang tawo sa Canada, talagsa lang suno sa iya nga makahimo ang history ang ordinaryo nga tawo kaangay niya.
english: Despite the result, Hamel was happy because with so many people in Canada, he said it is rare for an ordinary person like him to make history.

text: “I’m one of the last people that would be expected to make Canadian history in any way,” pahayag sini.“As long as I have the right and the privilege to get zero votes in an election, then we are truly in a democracy.”#
english: “I’m one of the last people that would be expected to make Canadian history in any way,” he said. “As long as I have the right and the privilege to get zero votes in an election, then we are truly in a democracy.”#

text: Suportado ni Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Supported by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: ang panukalang gawing bukas sa publiko ang deliberasyon ng bicameral conference committee (BICAM) kaugnay ng 2026 proposed national budget.
english: the proposal to make the deliberations of the bicameral conference committee (BICAM) on the 2026 proposed national budget open to the public.

text: Ayon kay Undersecretary Claire Castro, tagapagsalita ng Malacañang, nais ng Pangulo na maging mas transparent ang proseso upang masiguro ng taumbayan na ang pondo ng bayan ay hindi nasasayang o naaabuso.
english: According to Undersecretary Claire Castro, Malacañang spokesperson, the President wants the process to be more transparent to ensure that the people's funds are not wasted or abused.

text: Sa kanyang ika-tatlong State of the Nation Address (SONA), binigyang-diin ni Pangulong Marcos na handa siyang i-veto o i-basura ang 2026 national budget kung makakakita siya ng anumang iregularidad o anomalya.
english: In his third State of the Nation Address (SONA), President Marcos stressed that he is ready to veto or reject the 2026 national budget if he finds any irregularities or anomalies.

text: “Kung magpapatuloy ang mga maanomalyang insertion sa budget, seryoso ang Pangulo sa posibleng pag-veto nito,” ani Castro.
english: “If the anomalous insertions in the budget continue, the President is serious about possibly vetoing it,” Castro said.

text: Dagdag pa niya, pinagpaguran at dumaan sa masusing pagsusuri ang National Expenditure Program para sa 2026, kaya’t hindi dapat ito gawing kasangkapan ng ilang mambabatas para sa pansariling interes.
english: He added that the National Expenditure Program for 2026 has been thoroughly reviewed, so it should not be used as a tool by some lawmakers for personal interests.

text: Binigyang-diin din ni Castro na hindi dapat abusuhin ng Kongreso ang kanilang “power of the purse” — ang kapangyarihang magtakda kung saan ilalaan ang pondo ng bayan.
english: Castro also stressed that Congress should not abuse its “power of the purse” — the power to determine where to allocate public funds.

text: Nagmandu si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. ordered

text: sa Philippine National Police (PNP) nga maid-id nga imbestigaran ang pagpatay sa radio broadcaster sa Calamba sa Misamis Occidental nga si Juan Jumalon.
english: to the Philippine National Police (PNP) to thoroughly investigate the murder of radio broadcaster Juan Jumalon in Calamba, Misamis Occidental.

text: Pahayag ni Marcos, wala sang lugar sa Pilipinas ang amo sini nga sahi sang pagpang-atake sa mga katapo sang media gani ginapasalig sang iya administrasyon nga mahatagan sang hustisya ang kamatayon sini.
english: Marcos said there is no place in the Philippines for such attacks on members of the media and his administration assures that justice will be done to his death.

text: “Mahigpit na kinokondena ng ating Pangulong Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.
english: “Our President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. strongly condemns.

text: ang pagpatay sa broadcaster na si Juan Jumalon.
english: the murder of broadcaster Juan Jumalon.

text: Ang ganitong walang kabihasnang pag-atake sa ating mamamahayag ay walang lugar sa isang demokratikong bansa,” kabahin sang pahayag sang Presidential Communications Office (PCO).
english: Such senseless attacks on our journalists have no place in a democratic country,” the Presidential Communications Office (PCO) said in a statement.

text: Si Jumalon, 57, kilala nga si DJ Johnny Walker sang Gold FM 94.7 Calamba, ang ginpatay sang wala pa natumod nga suspek.
english: Jumalon, 57, popularly known as DJ Johnny Walker of Gold FM 94.7 Calamba, was killed by an unidentified suspect.

text: Ginluthang ini samtang nga naka-on air kag nakita mismo ang krimen sa Facebook livestream sang iya nga show.
english: He was shot while on air and saw the crime in the Facebook livestream of his show.

text: Natabo ang krimen pasado ‘las singko sang kaagahon sang Domingo, Nobyembre 5, sa iya kaugalingon nga radio station nga nahamtang sa ila balay.
english: The crime occurred around 5 am on Sunday, November 5, at his own radio station located in his house.

text: May yara man sang gintukod nga special investigation task group agud nga matutukan ang amo nga pagpang-atake.
english: A special investigation task group has also been set up to focus on the attack.

text: Suno naman sa Presidential Task Force on Media Security, naghingyo na ini sang bulig halin sa National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) para makatipon sang ebidensya.
english: According to the Presidential Task Force on Media Security, he has already sought assistance from the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) to gather evidence.

text: Nagpasalig man ang Department of Justice (DOJ) sang maid-id nga imbestigasyon, madasig nga pagdakop sa suspek/mga suspek kag pagpasaka sang kaso sa kutob sang may salabton.
english: The Department of Justice (DOJ) also assured a thorough investigation, prompt arrest of the suspect(s) and prosecution of those responsible.

text: MANILA – Tun-an sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) ang proposal nga pataasan ang presyo sang delata kag noche buena products.
english: MANILA – The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) will study the proposal to increase the price of candy and noche buena products.

text: Suno kay DTI Undersecretary Ruth Castelo, lakip sa mga naghingyo sang dugang nga presyo amo ang manufacturers sang sardinas, gatas, habon, kape, corned beef kag seasoning.
english: According to DTI Undersecretary Ruth Castelo, among those who requested the price increase were manufacturers of sardines, milk, soap, coffee, corned beef and seasoning.

text: Santo sa ginahingyo sang manufacturers, 11% ukon P0.25 centavos-P1.25 ang saka sa kada bilog sang nasambit nga mga produkto.
english: According to the request of the manufacturers, the increase of 11% or P0.25 centavos-P1.25 per piece of these products.

text: Magluwas diri, nagahingyo man sang price hike ang manufacturers sang hamon kun sa diin 1%-4% ukon P7-P20 ang saka.
english: Besides, the manufacturers of ham are also demanding a price hike of 1%-4% or P7-P20.

text: Para naman kay Steven Cua, presidente sang Philippine Amalgamated Supermarkets Association, mahimo nga maghina ang kita sa paskwa bangud sa COVID-19 pandemic.
english: According to Steven Cua, president of the Philippine Amalgamated Supermarkets Association, the COVID-19 pandemic could weaken Christmas revenue.

text: Agud nga makaganyat sang manubakal, kinahanglan nga panubu-an ang presyo sang mga produkto.
english: In order to attract buyers, it is necessary to lower the price of products.

text: KON sa pensar naton kinahanglan gid ang mabaskug nga linog agud kahadlukan ini, nagsala kita!
english: IF WE think that a strong earthquake is necessary to fear it, we are mistaken!

text: Ang kasubong kabaskug nga linog, nga nagdala sang kahalitan sa madamo nga tawo, palangabuhian, kag propriedad natabo sa Bohol sadtong Oktubre 15, 2013 (magnitude 7.2) kag sa Abra sadtong Hulyo 27, 2022 (magnitude 7.0).
english: Similar strong earthquakes, which caused damage to many people, livelihoods, and property, occurred in Bohol on October 15, 2013 (magnitude 7.2) and in Abra on July 27, 2022 (magnitude 7.0).

text: Ang mabaskug nga linog isa lang ugaling sa mga rason kon ngaa dapat naton kahadlukan ini.
english: But a powerful earthquake is just one reason why we should fear it.

text: Isa sang mga daku nga kahalitan sang linog nga ginatudlo sang mga otoridad amo ang “landslide”.
english: One of the biggest damages of the earthquake that the authorities are pointing out is the “landslide”.

text: Sunu sa Dept.
english: According to the Dept.

text: of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), nga gin-report ni Mario Alvaro Limos sa website: Esquire sadtong Pebrero 23, 2021, may tatlo ka mayor nga rason kon ngaa dapat naton kabalak-an bisan ang mahina nga linog.
english: of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), reported by Mario Alvaro Limos on the website: Esquire on February 23, 2021, there are three main reasons why we should be concerned about even a weak earthquake.

text: Ining tatlo ka rason amo ang mahuyang nga pagkahimtang sang mga kabatuhan sa idalom (weak integrity of the bedrock), mala-pil-as ukon matarik nga tindug sang bukid (steep slope), kag mabaskug nga pag-ulan (heavy rainfall) labi na gid kon sige-sige sa madamo nga inadlaw.
english: These three reasons are the weak integrity of the bedrock, the steep slope of the mountain, and heavy rainfall, especially if it continues for many days.

text: Ini ang kahimtangan sang Barangay Guinsaugon sa banwa sang St.
english: This is the situation of Barangay Guinsaugon in the town of St.

text: Bernard sa Southern Leyte.
english: Bernard in Southern Leyte.

text: Kag nangin kabangdanan ini sang “worst landslide” sa kasaysayan sang aton pungsod sang iguon ini sang magnitude 2.6 nga linog sadtong Pebreo 17, 2006.
english: And it caused the worst landslide in the history of our country when it was hit by a magnitude 2.6 earthquake on February 17, 2006.

text: Mahina lang ini nga linog, nga indi tani kinahanglan tagaan gid sing daku nga kabalaka.
english: It was a minor earthquake, which should not have caused much concern.

text: Apang indi sang mga pumuluyo sang Guinsaugon, tungod sang peligroso nga kahimtangan sini.
english: But not by the people of Guinsaugon, because of its dangerous condition.

text: Ang Guinsaugon, sunu gani sang DENR, nagatindug sa volcanic rocks nga nangin “unstable” nga madale matublag sang bisan indi lang mabaskug gid nga pag-uyog.
english: Guinsaugon, according to the DENR, is located on volcanic rocks that have become “unstable” and can be easily disturbed by even a strong earthquake.

text: Sunu sa Michigan Technology University, ang magnitude 2.5, ukon kubos pa dira, sa masami indi mo mabatyagan pero ma-record ini sang  seismograph; samtang ang 2.5-5.4 mabatyagan na ini pero kon makahalit gid man “minor damage” lang.
english: According to Michigan Technology University, a magnitude 2.5, or less, is usually not felt but can be recorded by a seismograph; while 2.5-5.4 can feel it but if it does damage it's only “minor damage”.

text: Ugaling kay sige-sige man sadto ang pagtupa sang ulan sa sulod sang 10 gid ka adlaw, nga nanalupsop sa mga giha (fracture) sang kabatuhan sa idalom duta nangin mahuyang ini kag natabo gid atong “landslide”.
english: However, because of the continuous rain for 10 days, which absorbed the fractures of the underground rocks, it became weak and the landslide occurred.

text:
***

Sunu sa report ni Limos, nagsugod ang makahalanguyos nga hitabo sadtong maulanon nga Pebrero 4, 2006 nga nagpadayon sa sulod sang 10 ka adlaw tubtub sa Pebrero 14.
english:
***

According to Limos' report, the tragic incident began on rainy February 4, 2006 and continued for 10 days until February 14.

text: Tatlo ka adlaw despues sadtong Pebrero 17, natabo ang magnitude 2.6 nga linog.
english: Three days later on February 17, a magnitude 2.6 earthquake struck.

text: Mga a las 10 sang aga yadto, samtang naga-preparar  ang elementary school sa barangay para sa pagtapos sang school year sa masunod nga bulan sang Marso.
english: It was around 10 am, while the elementary school in the barangay was preparing for the end of the school year next March.

text: Nagapadumdum ini nga hitabo sa aton diri sa Iloilo nga mangin alerto pirme ang mga pumuluyo nga yara sa mga lugar nga mahuyang ang duta, ang balay  sa likud ukon natung-an sang bukid, kag maulanon pa.
english: This incident reminds us here in Iloilo to always be alert to residents who are in areas where the soil is weak, the house behind or in the middle of the mountain, and rainy.

text: Mga 10 ka lugar sa Iloilo ang ginatudlo sang DENR nga “high risk” sa “landslide” nga mabuligan tuga sang bisan mahina lang nga linog katulad sang natabo sa Guinsaugon.
english: About 10 areas in Iloilo are designated by the DENR as “high risk” for landslides that can be affected by even a weak earthquake like the one in Guinsaugon.

text:
***

Sang aga nga ato, sunu gihapon sa report ni Limos, nabatian sang mga pumuluyo ang isa ka nagangurob (roaring) nga gahod.
english:
***

That morning, according to Limos' report, residents heard a roaring noise.

text: Amo na gali yadto ang ulihi nga mabatian nga gahod sang mga pumuluyo.
english: That turned out to be the last noise the residents would hear.

text: Temprano pa sang sina nga aga, daw sa wala lang nga nagapadayon sang ila ordinaryo nga pagpangabuhi ang mga pumuluyo.
english: Early that morning, residents seemed to be going about their ordinary lives.

text: Ang elementary school sa barangay masaku sa pag-preparar para sa pagtapos sang school year sa Marso.
english: The elementary school in the barangay is busy preparing for the end of the school year in March.

text: Sa malapit nga facilidad, ang mga kababaehan naga-selebrar man sang ika-lima nga Guinsaugon Women’s Health Association.
english: At the nearby facility, the women are also celebrating the fifth Guinsaugon Women’s Health Association.

text: Ang isa sa mga nakaluas nga 53 ka pumuluyo, nga si Dario Libatan, nagsugid nga sa pamati niya daw naglupok (explode) ang bukid kag hinali nga narumpag pakadto sa idalom sini.
english: One of the 53 survivors, Dario Libatan, said he felt as if the mountain had exploded and suddenly collapsed to the bottom.

text: “Nakita ko na lang nga wala na sing bisan isa ka balay nga nagatindug,” dugang niya.
english: “I just saw that there was not a single house standing,” he added.

text: May 1,800 ka pumuluyo ang Guinsaugon, sunu sa Citizen’s Disaster Response Center kag Leyte Center for Development.
english: Guinsaugon has a population of 1,800, according to the Citizen's Disaster Response Center and Leyte Center for Development.

text: Ang isa ka report nagsiling nga indi  magkubos sa 1,126 ang napatay.
english: One report said that at least 1,126 people died.

text: Si Eugene Pilo, nga isa man ka “survivor” nadulaan sang iya asawa kag mga kabataan.
english: Eugene Pilo, also a “survivor” lost his wife and children.

text: “Ang amon barangay wala na, nalubong tanan sa lunang (kag mga bato),” siling niya.
english: “Our barangay is gone, all buried in mud (and rocks),” he said.

text: Lakip sa napatay ang 246 ka mga estudyante sang elementary school kag pitu (7) nila ka mga manunudlo.
english: Among the dead were 246 elementary school students and seven (7) of their teachers.

text: Ang mga kababaehan nga naga-selebrar sang anibersaryo sang ila asosasyon nalakip man sa mga nagkalamatay.
english: Women celebrating the anniversary of their association were also among the dead.

text: Kag tungod lang ina sa mahina nga linog (magnitude 2.6) nga ginpalala sang 10 ka adlaw nga “heavy rainfall”./PN
english: And that's just because of a weak earthquake (magnitude 2.6) that was exacerbated by 10 days of “heavy rainfall”./PN

text: Natapos ang Gilas Pilipinas Youth sa group stage sang FIBA U16 Asia Cup nga may 1-2 nga record matapos nga nalutos sa kamot sang New Zealand, 85-54, sa hampang nga ginpatigayon sa Mongolia.
english: Gilas Pilipinas Youth finished the group stage of the FIBA ​​U16 Asia Cup with a 1-2 record after losing to New Zealand, 85-54, in the match held in Mongolia.

text: Madasig nga nakahimo sang 15-1 nga abanse ang Junior Tall Blacks kag wala na nakabalos ang Gilas sa una nga otso minutos sang ball game.
english: The Junior Tall Blacks quickly built a 15-1 lead and the Gilas were unable to fight back in the first eight minutes of the ball game.

text: Nagdominar man ang New Zealand sa rebounding (61-34) kag sa shooting (41.3% kontra 26%).
english: New Zealand also dominated in rebounding (61-34) and shooting (41.3% versus 26%).

text: Si Liam Anthony Keogh ang nanguna sa ila nga may 17 puntos, samtang si Jhustin Hallare ang nagpanguna para sa Gilas nga may 13 puntos.
english: Liam Anthony Keogh led them with 17 points, while Jhustin Hallare led the way for the Gilas with 13 points.

text: Nakasandig ang tyansa sang Pilipinas nga makasulod sa resulta sang hampang sang Chinese Taipei kag Indonesia, kun sa diin tatlo lang ka teams sa kada grupo ang makasulod sa masunod nga round.#
english: The Philippines' chances of qualifying depend on the result of the match between Chinese Taipei and Indonesia, where only three teams from each group will qualify for the next round.

text: Napilian si Sofronio Vasquez nga amo ang magakanta sang Philippine national anthem sa ikaapat nga State of the Nation Address (SONA) ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: Sofronio Vasquez was selected to sing the Philippine national anthem in the fourth State of the Nation Address (SONA) of President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.

text: sa Hulyo 28.
english: on July 28.

text: Suno sa Presidential Communications Office (PCO), ang mangin partisipasyon ni Sofronio sa sini nga event ang isa man ka “tribute” sa Filipino talent kag national pride.
english: According to the Presidential Communications Office (PCO), Sofronio's participation in the event is also a tribute to Filipino talent and national pride.

text: “Selecting Vasquez, a multi-awarded singer known for his powerful renditions of patriotic and classical pieces, reflects the administration’s intent to blend tradition and excellence in this year’s SONA ceremony,” suno sa PCO.
english: “Selecting Vasquez, a multi-awarded singer known for his powerful renditions of patriotic and classical pieces, reflects the administration’s intent to blend tradition and excellence in this year’s SONA ceremony,” according to the PCO.

text:
Dugang sa anunsyo sa website sang opisina: “The singing of the national anthem is a key ceremonial element of the SONA, setting the tone for the President’s annual address before members of Congress, government officials, foreign dignitaries, and millions of Filipinos watching from around the world.”

Matandaan nga naghimo sang maragtas si Sofronio bilang una nga Asian kag una nga Filipino nga nagkampyon sa “The Voice USA.”

Nangin kabahin siya sang Team Michael Bublé nga nagpabilib sa judges kag tumalan-aw sa iya performances sa finale nga amo ang “Unstoppable” ni Sia kag “A Million Dreams” halin sa “The Greatest Showman.”

Sang Enero, nagbalik siya diri sa Pilipinas, nagpatigayon sang una nga solo concert sa Cebu, kag ginkilala man sang Senado bangud sang iya kadalag-an sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.#
english:
The announcement on the office’s website added: “The singing of the national anthem is a key ceremonial element of the SONA, setting the tone for the President’s annual address before members of Congress, government officials, foreign dignitaries, and millions of Filipinos watching from around the world.”

Sofronio made history as the first Asian and first Filipino to win “The Voice USA.”

He was part of Team Michael Bublé who impressed the judges and audience with his performances in the finale which was Sia’s “Unstoppable” and “A Million Dreams” from “The Greatest Showman.”

In January, he returned to the Philippines, held his first solo concert in Cebu, and was also recognized by the Senate for his victory in the United States of America.

text: Nagapanugyan ang Regional Anti-Cybercrime Unit (RACU) 6 sa publiko nga mag-doble halong kag indi magdali-dali sa pagpati sa ka-transaksyon agud malikawan nga madugangan ang cybercrime cases sa Western Visayas.
english: The Regional Anti-Cybercrime Unit (RACU) 6 advises the public to be doubly vigilant and not rush to believe in transactions to avoid an increase in cybercrime cases in Western Visayas.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Rexy Calubing, chief sang Administrative Section sang RACU 6, iya ginpahayag nga kalabanan sa mga cybercrime incidents sa rehiyon ang naangot sa estafa, swindling, kag online scam nga paglapas sa Article 315 sang Revised Penal Code.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Rexy Calubing, chief of the Administrative Section of RACU 6, said most of the cybercrime incidents in the region are related to estafa, swindling, and online scams in violation of Article 315 of the Revised Penal Code.

text:
Photo: CNBC

Suno kay Calubing, pagkatapos sang pandemya, amat-amat nga nagadamo ang na-report nga kaso sang cybercrime sa rehiyon kag padayon ini sa pagsaka tubtub subong.
english:
Photo: CNBC

According to Calubing, after the pandemic, the number of reported cases of cybercrime in the region is gradually increasing and it continues to rise until now.

text: Agud mahimo nga non-bailable nga kaso ang estafa suno sa pulis, kinahanglan nga mahulog ini sa large-scale estafa gani kinahanglan nga madamo ang complainants.
english: In order to make estafa a non-bailable case, the police said, it must fall under large-scale estafa so there must be many complainants.

text: Bilang panugyan naman sa publiko, ginpahayag sang natungdan nga dapat nga mangin mahinalungon gid sa impormasyon kun involved na ang kuwarta kag sensitibo nga mga impormasyon.
english: As an advice to the public, he said they should be very careful with information when money and sensitive information are involved.

text: Kun makit-an nga makaduluda kag “too good to be true” ang offer suno sa natungdan, mas maayo nga indi na lang pagdayunon ang transaksyon.
english: If the offer is found to be suspicious and “too good to be true”, he said, it is better not to proceed with the transaction.

text: Ipinasara ng Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) ang isang agency na sangkot umano sa illegal recruitment at walang lisensiya, ang “Visa to America”, matapos ang serye ng sabayang operasyon sa iba’t ibang bahagi ng bansa.
english: The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) has shut down an agency allegedly involved in illegal recruitment and unlicensed, the “Visa to America”, after a series of simultaneous operations in different parts of the country.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay Asec.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Asec.

text: Jerome Alcantara ng Department of Migrant Workers, sinabi niyang bahagi ito ng mas malawak na operasyon laban sa nasabing kompanya, na may mga sangay sa Ortigas, Quezon City, Zamboanga, Isabela, at iba pa.
english: Jerome Alcantara of the Department of Migrant Workers, said this is part of a wider operation against the company, which has branches in Ortigas, Quezon City, Zamboanga, Isabela, and others.

text: Matagal na raw itong isinailalim sa surveillance matapos makatanggap ng reklamo mula sa ilang OFW kaugnay ng isang job fair kung saan inilahad ang mga alok ng naturang agency.
english: It has been under surveillance for a long time after receiving a complaint from some OFWs regarding a job fair where the offers of the agency were offered.

text: Ayon kay Alcantara, isa sa mga modus ng “Visa to America” ay ang pangakong mapagtatrabaho bilang guro sa Amerika.
english: According to Alcantara, one of the modus operandi of the “Visa to America” is the promise to work as a teacher in the United States.

text: Ngunit binigyang-diin niyang mapanganib ito dahil wala umanong kaukulang lisensiya ang kompanya mula sa DMW, kaya’t hindi lehitimo ang operasyon nito.
english: However, he warned that it is dangerous because the company does not have the necessary license from the DMW, so its operation is not legitimate.

text: Dagdag pa niya, sabay-sabay ang isinagawang operasyon sa iba’t ibang branch ng kumpanya upang tiyaking tuluyang mahinto ang ilegal na aktibidad.
english: He added that the operation was conducted simultaneously in different branches of the company to ensure that illegal activities are stopped.

text: MANILA – Ipaagi sang Social Security System sa PESONet ang paghatag sang pension agud nga mapadasig ang monthly crediting.
english: MANILA – The Social Security System will use PESONet to pay pensions to speed up monthly crediting.

text: Umpisa subong nga October 2020, ang regular pensions ang igahatag paagi sa DBP disbursement facility nga Philippine Electronic Fund Transfer System and Operations Network (PESONet) kag DBP-accredited remittance transfer companies/cash payout outlets.
english: Starting this October 2020, regular pensions will be disbursed through the DBP disbursement facility Philippine Electronic Fund Transfer System and Operations Network (PESONet) and DBP-accredited remittance transfer companies/cash payout outlets.

text: Ang pensioners ang makapili sa pagbaton sang monthly payout paagi sa ila account sa bisan diin nga PESONet participating bank kag e-wallet provider ukon cash pick-up via DBP cash padala.
english: Pensioners can choose to receive the monthly payout through their account at any PESONet participating bank and e-wallet provider or cash pick-up via DBP cash padala.

text: Ang mga magabaton paagi sa PESONet participating banks ang indi na kinahanglan nga magpa-enroll sang ila accounts apang ang mga magabaton naman paagi sa cheke gikan sa non-PESONet participating banks ang kinahanglan nga mag-ilis sang account tubtub sa Oktubre 31.
english: Those who will receive through PESONet participating banks will not need to enroll their accounts but those who will receive by check from non-PESONet participating banks will need to change their account until October 31.

text: Ang notification ang ipadala paagi sa registered email ukon mailing address kag ang mga miyembro ang mahimo nga maka-check sang lista sa PESONet participating banks ukon sa official website sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas.
english: The notification will be sent via registered email or mailing address and members can check the list at PESONet participating banks or on the official website of Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas.

text: Mahimo man nga makapakig-angot sa pinakamalapit nga SSS local kag foreign branches ukon sa mobile app.
english: You can also contact the nearest SSS local and foreign branches or the mobile app.

text: Ang monthly pensions ang igahatag sa una nga adlaw sang bulan para sa mga pensioners nga may date of contingency nga halin sa una tubtub ika-kinse nga adlaw sang bulan santo sa SSS memorandum circular nga napetsahan sang Setyembre 22.
english: The monthly pensions will be paid on the first day of the month for pensioners with a date of contingency from the first to the fifteenth day of the month according to the SSS memorandum circular dated September 22.

text: Ang monthly pension naman para sa mga pensioners nga may date of contingency nga ika-16 tubtub sa katapusan sang bulan ang gin-schedule sa ika-16 nga adlaw.
english: The monthly pension for pensioners with a date of contingency of the 16th to the end of the month is scheduled on the 16th.

text: Patay sa aksidente ang US undefeated boxing star nga si Travell Mazion.
english: US undefeated boxing star Travell Mazion died in an accident.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon sang mga pulis sa Texas, ginamaneho sini ang iya 2010 Cadillac STS (Seville Touring Sedan) sang siya ang ginbunggo-an sa likod sang isa ka Nissan Sentra nga nagresulta sa head-on collision sa Honda Pilot.
english: According to Texas police investigation, he was driving his 2010 Cadillac STS (Seville Touring Sedan) when he was hit from behind by a Nissan Sentra resulting in a head-on collision with the Honda Pilot.
