text: Magluwas sa 24 anyos nga boksingero, patay man ang 61 anyos nga driver sang Honda Pilot.
english: Besides the 24-year-old boxer, the 61-year-old driver of the Honda Pilot was also killed.

text: Nagpalab-ot naman sang pagpakig-unong ang Golden Boy Promotion nga amo ang naga handle kay Mazion nga ginbansagan nga Black Magic.
english: Golden Boy Promotion, which handles Mazion, nicknamed Black Magic, extended its condolences.

text: Gin-athag sang City Intelligence Unit (CIU) sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) nga ang papel sang mga nagkaladakpan nga Chinese nationals sa ginaalegar nga cybersex den sa Barangay Balantang, Jaro, Iloilo City amo ang pag-facilitate nga makakita sang mga kustomer kag pag-manipula sa mga video nga ila ipaguwa.
english: The City Intelligence Unit (CIU) of the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) explained that the role of the arrested Chinese nationals in the alleged cybersex den in Barangay Balantang, Jaro, Iloilo City is to facilitate finding customers and manipulating the videos they will release.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Pol.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Pol.

text: Lt.
english: Lt.

text: Col.
english: Col.

text: Antonio Benitez, head sang CIU, iya ginpahayag nga base sa ila natipon nga impormasyon, wala man sang videos kun sa diin nagapakighilawas gid ang mga models.
english: Antonio Benitez, head of the CIU, said that based on the information they gathered, there were no videos of the models having sex.

text: Ang makit-an lamang suno sa natungdan amo ang mga erotic moves kag mga nagahublas nga models nga ginalakipan sang mga Filipina kag foreigners.
english: The only things that can be seen, he said, are erotic moves and nude models including Filipinas and foreigners.

text: Suno pa kay Benitez, nakabaton man sila sang intelligence reports nga sa amo mismo nga balay sa Balantang, Jaro nagasaot kag nagahublas ang iban nga models kag ginakuhaan sang videos kag pictures, apang wala lamang naaktuhan sang mga pulis sang ginpatigayon ang raid.
english: Benitez said they also received intelligence reports that in the same house in Balantang, Jaro, other models were dancing and stripping and taking videos and pictures, but the police did not catch them when they conducted the raid.

text: Ginpahayag nga masobra anum ka bulan na nga naga-operate ang amo nga Chinese nationals sa amo nga balay apang masobra pa lamang isa ka bulan nga ginapanilagan sang otoridad antes nagkaladakpan.
english: The Chinese nationals had been operating in the house for more than six months but had been under surveillance for more than a month before they were arrested.

text: Aminado ang Department of Justice (DOJ) sa limitasyon nga kapasidad sang mga otoridad sa pagpatigayon sang DNA testing sa mga mga tul-an nga narekober sa Taal Lake.
english: The Department of Justice (DOJ) acknowledged the limited capacity of the authorities to conduct DNA testing on the bones recovered from Taal Lake.

text: Sa mensahe nga ginpalab-ot ni Assistant Secretary Mico Clavano, spokesperson sang DOJ, iya gin-ako nga may kabudlayan kag kulang sa kagamiton ang Pilipinas sa paproseso sang DNA testing.
english: In a message delivered by Assistant Secretary Mico Clavano, spokesperson of the DOJ, he acknowledged that the Philippines has difficulties and lacks equipment in the processing of DNA testing.

text: Ini ang reaksyon matapos ginpahayag sang Philippine National Police (PNP) nga wala sila sang nakuha nga DNA profile sa mga tul-an nga ila narecober sa nasambit nga lugar.
english: This is the reaction after the Philippine National Police (PNP) said they did not get a DNA profile from the bones they recovered in the said area.

text: Bangud sini, ginpahibalo ni Clavano nga nagapangayo na sila sang bulig halin sa gobyerno sang Japan.
english: Because of this, Clavano announced that they are already seeking help from the Japanese government.

text: Ginsiling sini nga nangayo na sila sang teknikal nga suporta agud masiguro kun sin-o ang mga tag-iya sang mga bangkay nga na-recover.
english: He said they have already sought technical support to ensure the identity of the owners of the bodies recovered.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginpahayag man ni DOJ Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla nga ginapadali na nila ang imbestigasyon sa kaso sang mga missing sabungeros.
english: Meanwhile, DOJ Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla said they are accelerating the investigation into the case of the missing sabungeros.

text: Suno kay Remulla, pila na ka tuig nga ginatutukan sang ila opisina ang kaso kag ginahingyo niya nga malapit na nila ma-file ang pormal nga reklamo batok sa mga ginatudlo nga responsable.
english: Remulla said his office has been focusing on the case for several years and hopes that they will soon file a formal complaint against those allegedly responsible.

text: Ginalauman man sang DOJ nga mas madamo pa nga testigo ang magguwa matapos ma-file ang complaint bilang kabahin sang ila padayon nga case buildup.
english: The DOJ also expects more witnesses to come forward after the complaint is filed as part of its ongoing case buildup.

text: Yara sa ika-11 nga pwesto si eight-division world champion Manny Pacquiao sa listahan sang 50 Greatest Boxers of All Time nga ginpaguwa sang The Pugilist — isa ka boxing magazine.
english: Eight-division world champion Manny Pacquiao is ranked 11th on the list of the 50 Greatest Boxers of All Time released by The Pugilist — a boxing magazine.

text: Nagapanguna sa listahan amo si American boxer Sugar Ray Robinson nga may 179 wins, 19 loses, 6 draws kag 106 knockouts.
english: Leading the list is American boxer Sugar Ray Robinson with 179 wins, 19 losses, 6 draws and 106 knockouts.

text: Nakasulod si Pacquiao sa listahan bangud sa iya madinuagon nga karera sa nakaligad nga duha ka dekada sa diin walo ka mga titulo sa nagkalain-lain nga dibisyon ang iya nakuha.
english: Pacquiao made the list because of his colorful career over the past two decades where he won eight titles in various divisions.

text: Sa subong, si Pacquiao sa gihapon ang nagakapot sang World Boxing Association (WBA) welterweight belt kag isa sa ginakabig nga living legend sa boxing.
english: Today, Pacquiao still holds the World Boxing Association (WBA) welterweight belt and is considered a living legend in boxing.

text: Sa edad nga 41 anyos, mabakod pa sa gihapon ang Pinoy champion sa diin nakit-an ang kapagsik sini sa iya duha ka mga hampang sang tinalikdan nga tuig batuk kanday Adrien Broner kag Keith Thurman.
english: At the age of 41, the Filipino champion is still strong as he showed in his two fights last year against Adrien Broner and Keith Thurman.

text: Natalana pa nga depensahan ni Pacquiao ang iya titulo sa oras nga matapos na ang coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic.
english: Pacquiao is scheduled to defend his title once the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic is over.

text: MANILA – Ginabasol sang Pork Producers Federation of the Philippines, Inc.
english: MANILA – The Pork Producers Federation of the Philippines, Inc.

text: ang Department of Agriculture sa pagtaas sang presyo sang karne sang baboy apisar sang outbreak sang African Swine Fever (ASF).
english: the Department of Agriculture on the increase in pork prices despite the outbreak of African Swine Fever (ASF).

text: Santo sa pagpaathag ni Pork Producers Federation of the Philippines, Inc.
english: According to Pork Producers Federation of the Philippines, Inc.

text: (ProPork) vice president Nicanor Briones, wala ginhandaan sang Department of Agriculture ang ASF outbreak rason nga nagataas sa gihapon ang presyo sang karne.
english: (ProPork) vice president Nicanor Briones, the Department of Agriculture was not prepared for the ASF outbreak, which is why meat prices are still rising.

text: Ginpahayag ni Briones nga ulihi na nag-akto ang nasambit nga ahensya kag wala man sang budget agud bayaran ang mga hog raiser nga naputo matapos na-infect sang virus ang ila ginasagod nga baboy.
english: Briones said the agency acted too late and does not have the budget to pay the hog raisers who broke down after their pigs were infected with the virus.

text: Magluwas diri, wala man ginpamati-an sang Department of Agriculture ang suhestyon sang pork industry rason nga 70% sang mga baboy sa Luzon ang nagkalamatay.
english: In addition, the Department of Agriculture did not listen to the suggestion of the pork industry, which caused 70% of the pigs in Luzon to die.

text: Agud nga indi maglala ang sitwasyon, kinahanglan suno sa iya nga painan sang pondo ang hog raisers sa Visayas kag Mindanao.
english: In order not to worsen the situation, he said, funds should be allocated to hog raisers in the Visayas and Mindanao.

text: Napili-an ang duha ka mga Filipino artists nga maghimo sang obra maestra ukon artwork sa nag-retiro na nga American NBA Star Vince Carter.
english: Two Filipino artists were selected to create a masterpiece or artwork for retired American NBA Star Vince Carter.

text: Ang duha ka mga artists amo sanday Jayson Atienza kag AJ Dimarucot sa diin makit-an ang ila illustration sa tribute website nga ginlunsyar para kay Carter.
english: The two artists are Jayson Atienza and AJ Dimarucot whose illustration can be found on the tribute website launched for Carter.

text: Sa instagram post ni Atienza, nagpasalamat ini bangud isa siya sa 15 ka mga artist sa bilog nga kalibutan nga napili-an agud maghatag sang tribute kay Carter.
english: In an Instagram post, Atienza expressed his gratitude for being one of 15 artists around the world chosen to pay tribute to Carter.

text: Samtang indi naman makapati si Dimarucot nga napili-an ang iya obra maestra.
english: Meanwhile, Dimarucot could not believe that his masterpiece was selected.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang tinalikdan nga bulan, gin-anunsyar sang NBA star nga ma-retiro na ini matapos ang masobra 20 ka tuig nga paghampang niya sa NBA.
english: Last month, the NBA star announced his retirement after more than 20 years of playing in the NBA.

text: ILOILO CITY- At-large ang isa ka kandidato sa pagka-punong barangay sa Pajo, Lambunao, Iloilo matapos gintudlo nga amo ang nagtiro sa salakyan sang newly-elected barangay chairman sa amo nga lugar nga si Renato Lebuna.
english: ILOILO CITY- A candidate for barangay captain in Pajo, Lambunao, Iloilo is at large after he was identified as the one who shot the vehicle of newly-elected barangay chairman in the area, Renato Lebuna.

text:
Ang salakyan ang ginapanag-iyahan ni Jona Lebuna nga asawa sang punong barangay kag may tatlo pa ka kaupdanan sang natabo ang insidente pasado ‘las onse kagab-i.

Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Jogen Suegay, hepe sang Lambunao Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagdul-ong si Lebuna sang iya nga poll watchers kagab-i kag papuli na kuntani sang ginbanggaan sa dalan.
english:
The vehicle was owned by Jona Lebuna, wife of the barangay captain, and was accompanied by three others when the incident occurred around 11 pm.

In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Jogen Suegay, chief of Lambunao Municipal Police Station, said Lebuna was taking his poll watchers last night and was on his way home when he was hit on the road.

text: Suno kay Suegay, base sa nakuha nga impormasyon sang otoridad, ang ginatudlo nga suspek amo si Dioscoro Lozada nga kasumpong sang biktima sa eleksyon kag nakit-an mismo sang punong barangay nga ang iya kasumpong ang nagtiro sa ila.
english: According to Suegay, based on the information obtained by the authorities, the alleged suspect is Dioscoro Lozada who was the victim's opponent in the election and the barangay captain saw that his opponent shot them.

text: Sang nag-responder ang pulis, pito ka igu sang bala ang nakit-an sa salakyan apang maswerte lang nga nakaluwas ang mga biktima kag wala man nasamaran.
english: When the police responded, seven gunshot wounds were found in the vehicle but fortunately the victims survived and were not injured.

text: Ginahibalo pa sang otoridad kun ano nga klase sang armas ang dala sini.
english: Authorities are still investigating what kind of weapon he was carrying.

text: Ginpahayag nga nagpalagyo gilayon ang suspek pagkatapos sang krimen kag nakapad-lock na ang balay sini.
english: The suspect reportedly fled the scene immediately after the crime and his house was locked.

text: Interesado sa gihapon nga maghampang sa Philippine Basketball Association si anay American-South Korean Star Hotshots import Ricardo Ratliffe.
english: Former American-South Korean Star Hotshots import Ricardo Ratliffe is still interested in playing for the Philippine Basketball Association.

text: Ini matapos nga nangin naturalized player na siya sang South Korea.
english: This is after he became a naturalized player of South Korea.

text: Suno kay Ratliffe ukon mas kilala subong bilang Ga Runa, kun wala siya napili sang South Korea, dako ang posibilidad nga sa Pilipinas sa gihapon ini nagahampang.
english: According to Ratliffe or better known as Ga Runa, if he had not been selected by South Korea, there is a high possibility that he would still be playing in the Philippines.

text: Masobra pito man ka bulan nga naghampang sa Pilipinas ang basketball player.
english: The basketball player also played in the Philippines for more than seven months.

text: Humalin sang 2012, nagahampang na siya sang Korean Basketball League kag sang 2018, ginkuha siya bilang naturalized player sang Mobis Phoebus.
english: Since 2012, he has been playing in the Korean Basketball League and in 2018, he was hired as a naturalized player by Mobis Phoebus.

text: Nangin kabahin man si Ratliffe sang Hotshots sang 2016-2017 PBA Commissioner’s Cup.
english: Ratliffe was also a part of the Hotshots in the 2016-2017 PBA Commissioner’s Cup.

text: MANILA – Atensyon sa mga motorista!
english: MANILA – Attention to motorists!

text: May yara sang mixed movement sa presyo sang gatong epektibo sa Setyembre 29, Martes.
english: There will be a mixed movement in fuel prices effective September 29, Tuesday.

text: Santo sa September 29 tubtub October 5 nga forecast, wala sang paghulag sa presyo sang diesel samtang 20 centavos naman ang saka sa gasolina.
english: According to the September 29 to October 5 forecast, there was no movement in the price of diesel while the price of gasoline increased by 20 centavos.

text: Ang year-to-date price adjustments ang may net decrease nga P4.62 per liter sa gasolina samtang P10.79 per liter sa diesel.
english: The year-to-date price adjustments have a net decrease of P4.62 per liter for gasoline while P10.79 per liter for diesel.

text: Gina-forecast sang state weather bureau nga tubtub sa tatlo ka mga bagyo ang magasulod ukon magaporma sa sulod sang Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) subong nga Agusto.
english: The state weather bureau forecasts that up to three typhoons will enter or form within the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) this August.

text: Sa latest nga update sang Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), mataas ang tyansa nga mangin Tropical Depression sa masunod nga 24 oras ang isa ka LPA nga na-monitor sa guwa sang PAR nga ulihi nakit-an sa 1,010 kilometros naaminhan-nasidlangan sang Extreme Northern Luzon.
english: According to the latest update of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), an LPA monitored outside the PAR that was last detected 1,010 kilometers northeast of the Extreme Northern Luzon has a high chance of becoming a Tropical Depression in the next 24 hours.

text:
Apisar ginalantaw nga indi ini direkta makaapekto sa Pilipinas, mahimo gihapon ini magsulod sa PAR, kag mahimo pangalanan nga “Fabian.”

May na-obserbahan man nga cloud clusters sa nasidlangan sang Mindanao nga possible mangin bagyo.
english:
Although it is not expected to directly affect the Philippines, it may still enter the PAR, and may be named “Fabian.”

Cloud clusters were also observed in eastern Mindanao that are likely to become typhoons.

text:
Kun mahimo nga bagyo, tawgon sila nga sanday “Gorio” kag “Huaning.”

Base sa state meteorologists, may apat ka posible nga agyan sang bagyo subong nga bulan.
english:
If it becomes a typhoon, they will be called “Gorio” and “Huaning.”

Based on state meteorologists, there are four possible typhoon paths this month.

text: Duha ka senaryo ang posible nga pa-naaminhan nga hulag halin sa northern Visayas ukon Central Luzon pakadto sa Northern Luzon nga mahimo magresulta sa landfall.
english: Two scenarios are possible northward movement from northern Visayas or Central Luzon to Northern Luzon that could result in landfall.

text: Sa iban nga kaso, mahimo ini magkadto sa direksyon sang Taiwan, Southern China, ukon sa Ryukyu Islands nga wala sang direkta nga impact sa Pilipinas.#
english: In other cases, it may go in the direction of Taiwan, Southern China, or the Ryukyu Islands without directly impacting the Philippines.#

text: Nag-withdraw sang iya kandidatura sa pagka-mayor sang Leon, Iloilo si Former Sangguniang Bayan Member Ramil Capariño.
english: Former Sangguniang Bayan Member Ramil Capariño has withdrawn his candidacy for mayor of Leon, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Capariño, iya ginpahayag nga kakulang sa political machinery kag pinansyal ang rason sang pag-withdraw sa pagpadalagan sa pagka-mayor.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Capariño said the lack of political machinery and finances was the reason for the withdrawal from the mayoral race.

text: Suno kay Capariño,ihatag nalang niya ang bug-os nga suporta kay mayoralty candidate Jun Calico.
english: Capariño said he will give his full support to mayoralty candidate Jun Calico.

text: Madumduman nga si Capariño ang nagserbe man sadto sa Leon bilang SB member halin 1995 tubtob 2004.
english: Capariño also served in Leon as an SB member from 1995 to 2004.

text: MANILA – Pagkatapos sang duha ka semana nga budget briefings, gin-aprobahan na sang House Committee on Appropriations ang proposed P4.5-trillion national budget para sa 2021.
english: MANILA – After two weeks of budget briefings, the House Committee on Appropriations has approved the proposed P4.5-trillion national budget for 2021.

text: Suno kay House panel chair Eric Yap, aprobado na ang Fiscal Year 2021 General Appropriations Bill kun sa diin ang proposed 2021 national budget ang 9.9% nga mas mataas kun ipaanggid sa P4.1 trillion nga pondo sa subong nga tuig.
english: According to House panel chair Eric Yap, the Fiscal Year 2021 General Appropriations Bill has been approved where the proposed 2021 national budget is 9.9% higher compared to the P4.1 trillion fund this year.

text: Nauna nga ginpahayag ni Budget Secretary Wendel Avisado nga ang kalabanan sa 2021 national budget ang pagagamiton para COVID-19 response ilabi na sa healthcare systems, food security, pagtuga sang madamo nga trabaho paagi sa labor intensive projects, pagpasangkad sang digital government and economy kag pagbulig sa nanari-sari nga sektor.
english: Earlier, Budget Secretary Wendel Avisado said most of the 2021 national budget will be used for COVID-19 response especially in healthcare systems, food security, job creation through labor intensive projects, expansion of digital government and economy and assistance in various sectors.

text: Ang education sector nga ginalakipan sang Department of Education, State Universities and Colleges, Commission on Higher Education kag Technical Education and Skills Development Authority ang makabaton sang “biggest chunk” nga nagalab-ot sa P754.4 billion.
english: The education sector, which includes the Department of Education, State Universities and Colleges, Commission on Higher Education and Technical Education and Skills Development Authority, will receive the “biggest chunk” amounting to P754.4 billion.

text: Nagasunod ang Department of Public Works and Highways nga may P667.3 billion, Department of the Interior and Local Government nga may P246.1 billion, Department of National Defense nga may P209.1 billion kag Department of Health nga may P203.1 billion.
english: The Department of Public Works and Highways follows with P667.3 billion, Department of the Interior and Local Government with P246.1 billion, Department of National Defense with P209.1 billion and Department of Health with P203.1 billion.

text: Yara man sa listahan sang mga ahensya nga may biggest allocation amo ang Department of Social Welfare and Development nga may P171.2 billion, Department of Transportation nga may P143.6 billion, Department of Agriculture nga may P66.4 billion, Judiciary nga may P43.5 billion kag Department of Labor and Employment nga may P27.5 billion.
english: Also on the list of agencies with the biggest allocation are the Department of Social Welfare and Development with P171.2 billion, Department of Transportation with P143.6 billion, Department of Agriculture with P66.4 billion, Judiciary with P43.5 billion and Department of Labor and Employment with P275 billion. billion.

text: Ang committee report para sa 2021 General Appropriations Bill ang igaduso sa plenaryo sa Lunes, Steyembre 28, samtang sa hapon naman ang sponsorship kag target nga maaprobahan sang Senado sa Oktubre 14.
english: The committee report for the 2021 General Appropriations Bill will be presented to the plenary on Monday, September 28, while the sponsorship and target will be approved by the Senate on October 14 in the afternoon.

text:
(Trigger Warning: This article discusses suicide and may be distressing for some readers.)

Ginbuyagyag ni Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC) Director Secretary Gilbert Cruz nga anom na ka mga tawo ang nag-utas sang kabuhi bangud sa ginapahayag nga pagpang-harass sang mga illegal online lending companies.
english:
(Trigger Warning: This article discusses suicide and may be distressing for some readers.)

Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC) Director Secretary Gilbert Cruz revealed that six people have already committed suicide due to alleged harassment by illegal online lending companies.

text: Suno kay Cruz, ginpakahuy-an sang mga online lending companies ang nasambit nga mga indibidwal.
english: According to Cruz, the online lending companies humiliated these individuals.

text: Kalakip sa mga sahi sang pagpang-harass sa ila amo ang pagpadala sang mga email kag text sa mga contacts agud pakahuy-an ang mga ini.
english: Among the types of harassment against them is sending emails and texts to contacts to embarrass them.

text: Nagpamahog man ang mga lending companies nga kun indi makabayad sang utang, i-post nila ang mga sensitibo nga mga laragway sang nasambit nga mga indibidwal.
english: The lending companies also threatened to post sensitive pictures of these individuals if they failed to repay the loan.

text: Nagpanawagan naman si Cruz sa publiko kag sa iban nga ahensya nga magbuligay agud ma-expose kag mauntat ang operasyon sang mga illegal online lending companies.
english: Cruz called on the public and other agencies to work together to expose and stop the operation of illegal online lending companies.

text: Ginpasiguro naman ni Cruz nga nagahimo sila sang paagi agud matapan ang nasambit nga iligal nga aktibidad.
english: Cruz assured that they are taking measures to curb the illegal activity.

text: Gin-depensahan nanday anay United States Presidents Barack Obama kag Bill Clinton si current President Joe Biden kasunod sang pigado sini nga performance sa una nga presidential debate batok sa Republican nga si anay President Donald Trump.
english: Former United States Presidents Barack Obama and Bill Clinton have defended current President Joe Biden following his poor performance in the first presidential debate against Republican former President Donald Trump.

text: Suno kay Obama, nagakatabo gid man ang “bad debate nights” apang ang eleksyon suno sa iya ang choice man gihapon sa tunga sang persona nga nagpakigbato para sa Americans kag persona nga kaugalingon lang niya ang iya ginapanumdom.
english: Obama said bad debate nights do happen but the election is still a choice between a person who fought for Americans and a person who thinks only of himself.

text: “Bad debate nights happen.
english: “Bad debate nights happen.

text: Trust me, I know.
english: Trust me, I know.

text:
But this election is still a choice between someone who has fought for ordinary folks his entire life and someone who only cares about himself,” suno sa post ni Obama sa X. “Last night didn’t change that, and it’s why so much is at stake in November.”

Sunod man nga nagpaguwa si Clinton sang iya post kag nagsiling nga ang importante amo ang facts kag history kasunod pa sang iya ginpaguwa nga lista sang “solid accomplishments” sa idalom sang termino ni Biden.
english:
But this election is still a choice between someone who has fought for ordinary folks his entire life and someone who only cares about himself,” according to Obama’s post on X. “Last night didn’t change that, and it’s why so much is at stake in November.”

Clinton also released a post saying that what matters is facts and history following her release of a list of “solid accomplishments” under Biden's term.

text: “I’ll leave the debate rating to the pundits, but here’s what I know: facts and history matter,” pahayag naman ni Clinton sa amo man nga social media platform.
english: “I’ll leave the debate rating to the pundits, but here’s what I know: facts and history matter,” Clinton said on the same social media platform.

text: Sa presidential debate sang nagligad nga Byernes sang aga (oras sa Pilipinas), matandaan nga indi na mahangpan ang ginpanghambal sang 81-anyos nga presidente kag pila ka beses man nga wala sang isugpon — bagay nga ginkadlawan sang Republicans kag ginakabalak-an naman sang Democrats.
english: In the presidential debate last Friday morning (Philippine time), it can be recalled that the 81-year-old president's speech was incomprehensible and several times without a connection — something that Republicans laughed at and Democrats were concerned about.

text: Gina-interpret sang iban ang komento nanday Obama kag Clinton nga gina-ako nila ang “debate disaster” nga natabo apang gina-engganyo man ang publiko nga indi ini pagtutukan.
english: Some interpret Obama and Clinton’s comments as acknowledging the “debate disaster” that occurred but also encouraging the public not to focus on it.

text: Una naman nga nagkumpirma ang Biden campaign nga indi mag-atras sa rematch si Biden kag magatambong gihapon ini sa ikaduha nga presidential debate sa Septyembre.
english: The Biden campaign earlier confirmed that Biden will not withdraw from the rematch and will still attend the second presidential debate in September.

text: Sa rally naman sa Virginia, wala na sang gin-usik nga tiyempo si Trump kag nag-deklarar sang daku nga kadalag-an batok kay Biden kasunod sang natabo nga presidential debate.
english: At the rally in Virginia, Trump wasted no time in declaring a landslide victory over Biden following the presidential debate.

text: Suno sa 78-anyos nga Republican presumptive nominee, todo gid ang tuon ni Biden tubtub nga wala na ini nakahibalo sang iya ginahimo.
english: According to the 78-year-old Republican presumptive nominee, Biden studied so hard that he didn't know what he was doing.

text: “He studied so hard that he didn’t know what the hell he was doing,” pahayag sini sa atubang sang iya supporters.
english: “He studied so hard that he didn’t know what the hell he was doing,” he said in front of his supporters.

text: “No amount of rest or rigging could help him defend his atrocious record.”#
english: “No amount of rest or rigging could help him defend his atrocious record.”#

text: Patay sa ambush ang isa ka kandidato sa pagka-punong barangay sa banwa sang Kapatagan sa Lanao del Sur.
english: A candidate for barangay captain was killed in an ambush in Kapatagan town in Lanao del Sur.

text: Ang biktima amo si Kamar Bilao Bansil, 50, nga napatay on the spot bangud sa tuman ka damo nga pilas nga naangkon tuga sang bala sang pusil.
english: The victim was identified as Kamar Bilao Bansil, 50, who died on the spot due to multiple gunshot wounds.

text:
Photo Courtesy: Lanao del Sur PPO

Suno pa kay Police Colonel Robert S. Daculan, police provincial director sang Lanao del Sur, yara man sa seryoso nga kondisyon ang asawa kag menor de edad nga anak ni Bansil.
english:
Photo Courtesy: Lanao del Sur PPO

Police Colonel Robert S. Daculan, police provincial director of Lanao del Sur, said Bansil's wife and minor daughter are also in serious condition.

text: Suno pa sa pulis, ginbanggaan sang indi pa matumod nga numero sang armado nga mga lalaki ang salakyan sang biktima sang yara ini sa Barangay Sigayan — ang barangay kun sa diin nagapadalagan siya sa pagka-kapitan bilang isa ka independent candidate.
english: According to police, an unspecified number of armed men hit the victim's vehicle while he was in Barangay Sigayan — the barangay where he is running for barangay captain as an independent candidate.

text: Lakip sa ginpangalanan nga gunman — sandig man sa testomoniya sang mga testigo sa pulis — amo si Pabril Pagrangan nga bana sang incumbent punong barangay sa amo nga lugar nga magapa-reelect man sa Oktubre 30.
english: Among the named gunman — based on the testimony of police witnesses — is Pabril Pagrangan, husband of the incumbent barangay captain in the area who will also run for re-election on October 30.
